blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. Beam delivers frontier level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class. Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens, Beam features a 1M-token context window achieved through a novel two-stage midtraining phase, built on verifiable, correctness-anchored data. Post-training leveraged a large-scale, fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) campaign across 10.5K GB300 GPUs, generating over 100M rollouts over 4 weeks of training. We believe this is one of the largest scale RL runs conducted by any open lab to date. Across our evaluation suite, capabilities continued to improve as we increased RL compute, with no sign of a plateau. Supported by deep hardware-model co-design, FP8/NVFP4 quantization, and a 1.93B-parameter speculative decoding drafter (DFlash 2), Beam maximizes serving throughput with efficient, flexible deployment. Averaged across conversation turns and harm categories, Beam refuses or pivots on 88.9% of harmful requests while complying with 81.5% of harmless requests, achieving the highest refusal/pivot rate on harmful requests among open-weight models on the Pareto frontier.
blocks.zh: Beam是一种稀疏的Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)模型,总参数为501.3B,活性参数为23.4B,专门为编码,推理,代理工作量而构建和优化. 比姆提供前沿级推理,同时要求3-4x的推论计算比其类中的许多模型要少. 预训于23.8T多样化,曲折,优质的代币,Beam的特点是通过新颖的两阶段中训阶段实现的1M-token上下文窗口,基于可核查的,正确的-焦虑的数据. 培训后利用了10.5K GB300GPU的大规模、完全同步的强化学习运动,在4周的培训中产生了超过100M的推广。 我们认为这是迄今为止任何开放的实验室进行的最大规模RL运行之一. 在整个评价套件中,随着我们增加RL计算,能力继续提高,没有高原的迹象。 在深层硬件模型共设计,FP8/NVFP4量化,以及1.93B参数的投机解码起草器(DFlash 2)的支持下,Beam以高效,灵活的部署,最大限度地服务吞吐量. 平均而言,在88.9%的有害请求上,Beam在遵守81.5%的无害请求时拒绝或吐出,在帕雷托边境的开放型模型中,有害请求的拒绝/中枢率最高。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
We are introducing Beam, Reflection’s first open-weight model.
Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters across 52 layers, 256 experts, and a 152K vocabulary size, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍Beam, Reflection的第一个开放式模型。
Beam是一个稀疏的Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)模型,总参数为501.3B,活性参数为23.4B,跨越52层,256位专家,词汇大小为152K,专门为编码,推理,代理工作量构建和优化.

blocks.en:
Beam’s capabilities stem from major investments across pretraining, midtraining, post-training, and infrastructure.
Beam advances the Western open-weight frontier and achieves competitive performance with larger models like GLM-5.2 while approaching Qwen 3.8-Max on LongBench-v2, while delivering frontier-level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class.
blocks.zh:
Beam的能力来自对培训前、中期培训、培训后和基础设施的重大投资。
贝姆推进西方开放量级前沿,并以GLM-5.2等更大的模型实现竞争性能,同时在Long Bench-v2上接近Quen 3.8-Max,同时提供前沿级推理,同时要求3-4x的推论计算量低于其类中的许多模型.

blocks.en:
The foundation of Beam’s efficiency and numerical stability lies in rigorous data curation and controlled scaling.
Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens—including high-value STEM, math, and code tokens preserved via novel domain-specific curation pipelines and internet-scale OCR—Beam’s scaling held predictably across four orders of magnitude in pretraining compute, training models from 300M to 23.4B active parameters. Beam’s base architecture employs auxiliary-loss-free load balancing with cosine decay, sequence-level balancing, and depth-based residual scaling to achieve near-uniform expert utilization and bounded residual norms.
It was pretrained end-to-end in under four weeks on 6,144 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs with a 92.3% goodput toward the end and 21% MFU during steady-state training, after accounting for restarts.
blocks.zh:
Beam的效率和数字稳定性的基础在于严格的数据整理和控制的缩放。
在23.8T种不同、精准、优质的标志(包括高价值的STEM、数学和密码标志)上, Beam的基建采用了辅助-无损失负载平衡与余弦衰减,序列级平衡,以及深层残余缩放,以实现近乎统一的专家利用和定界残余规范.
它在4周内在6,144 NVIDIA GB300 GPU上接受了预训的端到端,在计算重新启动后,在稳定状态训练中达到92.3%,在稳定状态训练中达到21%。

blocks.en:
To bridge foundational knowledge and agentic execution, a novel two-stage midtraining pipeline expanded Beam’s effective context length to 1M tokens on correctness-anchored data without degrading general capabilities.
Post-training was centered around a high-compute reinforcement learning (RL) campaign, where our high-compute RL run generated over 100M rollouts on 10.5K NVIDIA GB300 GPUs over four weeks of training. We believe this is one of the largest scale RL runs conducted by any open lab to date, enabled by a fully asynchronous platform with 110K concurrent rollouts, fast 12-second weight updates, and 99.99% dynamic batch packing, Beam organically developed tool-use, web browsing, and problem-decomposition capabilities.
Across our evaluation suite, capabilities continued to improve as we increased RL compute, with no sign of a plateau.
For serving, Beam leverages hardware-model co-design, FP8/NVFP4 quantization, and DFlash 2 (a 1.93B-parameter speculative decoding drafter) to reduce memory footprint and maximize throughput.
blocks.zh:
为了沟通基础知识和代理执行,一个新式的两阶段中程训练管道将Beam的有效上下文长度扩大到正确性-焦虑数据上的1M符号,而没有降低一般能力。
训练后以高功率强化学习(RL)运动为中心,我们的高功率RL在训练四周内在10.5K NVIDIA GB300 GPU上产生超过100M的推出. 我们认为这是迄今为止任何开放实验室进行的最大规模的RL运行之一,它由一个具有110K同步推出,快速12秒重量更新,以及99.99%的动态批量包装,Beam有机开发的工具使用,网页浏览和问题分解能力的完全同步平台提供。
在整个评价套件中,随着我们增加RL计算,能力继续提高,没有高原的迹象。
对于服务,Beam利用硬件模型共设计,FP8/NVFP4量化,以及DFlash 2(一个1.93B参数的投机解码起草器),以减少内存足迹,使吞吐量最大化.

blocks.en:
Safety and alignment were prioritized across the entire model development cycle.
Pretraining filtered harmful content and PII, while post-training combined deliberative alignment SFT with context-aware RL across multi-turn, jailbreak, and agentic tasks.
Dedicated safety and RL teacher capabilities were merged using multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD).
Under Reflection’s Open Safety Framework (OSF), we assessed Beam as Limited across all four systemic-risk categories: Biological Weapons, Chemical Weapons, Loss of Control, and Cyber Offense.
A Limited rating means there is no material shift in the offense-defense balance attributable to the model and no material expansion of the threat landscape relative to comparable open-weight models.
These findings are complemented by external third-party assurance evaluations.
In the Iris Safety Evaluations (ISE) benchmarks we developed in-house to span single-turn, multi-turn, jailbreak, and agentic evaluations, Beam achieves an 88.9% refusal/pivot rate on harmful requests while complying with 81.5% of harmless requests.
Scaling the alignment teacher from 100B to 501B parameters cut false-positive over-refusals by 48.7%, proving greater model capacity can substantially improve responses to permissible requests under the same safety-training setup.
blocks.zh:
在整个模型开发周期中,安全性和一致性被列为优先事项。
培训前过滤有害内容和PII,而培训后将SFT与具有上下文感的RL相结合,跨越多轮、越狱和代理任务。
利用多教师政策提炼法(MOPD)合并了专门的安全和RL教师能力。
根据《反省开放安全框架》,我们评估Beam是所有四个系统性风险类别(生物武器、化学武器、失控和网络防御)的有限责任组织。
A 有限评级意味着,与可比的开放量模型相比,该模型造成的犯罪-防御平衡没有实质性改变,威胁面没有实质扩大。
这些结论得到外部第三方保证评价的补充。
在Iris安全评估(ISE)基准中,我们内部制定了涵盖单回合、多回合、越狱和代理评估的基准,Beam在满足81.5%无害请求的同时,对有害请求的拒绝率/中枢率为88.9%。
将校对教师从100B提高到501B参数将假阳性超抗能力削减48.7%,证明更大的模型能力可以大大改进对同一安全培训机制下允许的请求的反应。

blocks.en: 2 Pretraining
blocks.zh: 2 预训

blocks.en: 2.1 Recipe
blocks.zh: 2.1 食谱

blocks.en: 2.1.1 Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 2.1.1 示范建筑

blocks.en:
Beam is a decoder-only sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformer [ 1 , 2 ] , designed for efficient long-horizon agentic reasoning.
Beam leverages SandwichNorm [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] , Group Query Attention (GQA) [ 6 ] with QK normalization [ 7 ] , interleaved local and global attention [ 8 , 4 ] , Rotary Embeddings [ 9 ] , SwiGLU [ 10 ] experts, and DeepSeek MoE-style [ 11 ] auxiliary-loss-free load balancing.
We used RMSNorm [ 12 ] for all normalization layers, and used untied input/output embeddings.
We applied soft capping to cap the final output logits at 30 30 [ 13 ] . Table 1 lists Beam’s configuration and hyperparameters.
We elaborate on individual components of our architecture below.
blocks.zh:
Beam是一台仅有解码器的稀疏的Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)变形器[1,2],为高效的长视距代理推理而设计.
Beam 杠杆 桑威奇诺姆 [3, 4, 5], Group Query attention (GQA) [6] 与 QK 正常化 [7] , 交互 地方和全球关注 [8, 4], Rotary Embeddings [9], SwiGLU [10] 专家,以及 DeepSeek MoE 风格 [11] 辅助-无损失负载平衡.
我们对所有正常化层使用RMSNorm [12],并使用不附带条件的输入/输出嵌入。
我们使用了软封顶,将最终输出对数限制在30 30 [13] 。 表1列出了Beam的配置和超参数。
我们阐述我们架构的以下各个组成部分。

blocks.en: Table 1: Beam configuration and hyperparameters.
blocks.zh: 表1:束的配置和超参数。

blocks.en: Attention
blocks.zh: 请注意

blocks.en:
We adopted an interleaved local-global attention pattern [ 4 ] with a local-to-global ratio of 5:1; local attention layers use a sliding window size of 512 tokens.
To further reduce the KV-cache footprint, we employed GQA, coupling 48 query heads with 8 key-value heads at a head dimension of 128 [ 6 ] .
We use RoPE [ 9 ] with a base frequency of 10,000 in local attention layers, and NoPE [ 14 ] in global attention layers.
blocks.zh:
我们采用了地方-全球相互间关注模式[4],地方-全球比例为5:1;地方关注层使用滑动窗口大小512个令牌.
为了进一步减少KV-cache足迹,我们采用了GQA,将48个查询头与8个键值头组合在一起,头部尺寸为128[6].
我们使用ROPE[9],基频为1万个局部关注层,使用NoPE[14] 全球关注层.

blocks.en:
To improve attention stability, we leveraged QK normalization [ 7 ] .
While removing the learnable gain parameters from QK normalization’s RMSNorms strictly bounds the attention logits, we observe that doing so degrades long-context extrapolation, and so we retain them.
We observed the model was susceptible to significant activation outliers after the attention output projection even when using QK normalization, so we adopted elementwise gated attention [ 15 ] .
We compute a gate vector 𝐠 h \mathbf{g}_{h} for each attention head h h as: 𝐠 h = σ ⁡ ( 𝐆 h ​ 𝐱 + 𝐛 h ) , \mathbf{g}_{h}=\sigma(\mathbf{G}_{h}\mathbf{x}+\mathbf{b}_{h}), (2.1) where 𝐱 ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} is the RMSNormed input to the self-attention sublayer, 𝐆 h ∈ ℝ d h × d , 𝐛 h ∈ ℝ d h \mathbf{G}_{h}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}\times d},\mathbf{b}_{h}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}} are trainable parameters, and d d and d h d_{h} are model and head dimension, respectively.
We effectively suppress the attention stream by initializing the bias vector to -2.5 and initializing the gating matrices to be very small.
Our preliminary experiments with headwise gated attention [ 16 ] and attention sinks [ 17 ] were less effective in either reducing gradient spikes or in promoting long-context modeling.
blocks.zh:
为提高关注稳定性,我们利用了QK正常化[7]。
在从QK正常化的 RMSNorms 中去除可学习的增益参数时, 我们观察到这样做会降低长文推断, 所以我们保留它们。
我们看到,即使在使用QK正常化时,该模型在注意输出投影后也容易发生显著的激活异常值,因此,我们采用了元素门式注意[15]。
我们计算每个注意头hh的门矢量 g h\ mathbf{ g}_{h} 如下: g h = \\ (Gh x + b h),\ mathbf{ g}_{h}=\h}=\sigma (\ mathbf{ g}_{h}\h}\h}h}h}h}h}h}h}h}h}h}h}h}h∈h∈h}h}h∈h∈h∈h∈h\h∈h∈h\h\h∈h∈h∈h∈h∈h∈h∈h∈h∈h∈h∈h∈h∈h∈h}\h}\h}\h}\h}\h}\h}\h}\h}\h}\h{h{h}}h}^{h{h{h{h{h{h{h{h{h{h{h}\h}\h}\h}\h}\h}\h}\h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h}^{h
通过将偏差矢量初始化到-2.5并初始化成非常小的引子矩阵,我们有效地抑制了注意力流.
我们初步试验了头部有关卡的注意[16]和注意力的沉积[17],在减少梯度坡度或促进长写模型方面效果较差。

blocks.en:
To improve length extrapolation, we followed the scalable softmax approach of Nakanishi [18] , which scales the attention logits of each query based on its absolute position.
To improve stability, we used the following root-compression formulation to scale logits: ( 1 + p 2048 ) 0.1 , \left(1+\frac{p}{2048}\right)^{0.1}, (2.2) where p p is the position index, rather than the formulation used by Nakanishi [18] .
blocks.zh:
为了改进长度推算,我们遵循了Nakanishi[18]的可伸缩软马克斯方法,它根据其绝对位置对每个查询的注意力记录进行比例化.
为了提高稳定性,我们使用以下的根压缩配方来缩放对数:(1+2048)0.1,\left(1+\frac{p}{2048}\right)\0.1},(2.2)p是位置指数,而不是Nakanishi使用的配方[18].

blocks.en: Mixture of Experts
blocks.zh: 专家的混合

blocks.en:
Our MoE architecture largely follows that of DeepSeek-AI et al. [11] , with the exception that we did not use shared experts.
We leveraged a top-k router with sigmoid gating. Expert biases were added to the router logits for top-k selection. The router probability is computed from the unbiased logits. We normalized routing scores before combining the expert outputs.
blocks.zh:
我们的教育部架构主要遵循DeepSeek-AI等人的架构。 [11],例外的是,我们没有使用共同的专家。
我们借了一个顶端的路由器 与sigmoid gating。 在路由器日志中添加了专家偏差,用于顶级选择。 路由器概率是从无偏见的日志中计算出来的. 在合并专家产出之前,我们调整了路线评分。

blocks.en:
To ensure balanced expert utilization, we adopt the auxiliary-loss-free load balancing method of Wang et al. [19] with additional sequence auxiliary loss.
To improve expert balance even when exposing the model to datasets not drawn from the pretraining data distribution, we used a relatively high sequence auxiliary loss coefficient of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} .
To avoid router logit saturation, we added a router z-loss term with a coefficient of 10 − 5 10^{-5} .
We used an expert bias update rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} .
blocks.zh:
为确保专家均衡利用,我们采用王等人的辅助无损失负载平衡法. [19] 附加序列辅助损失.
为了改善专家的平衡,即使将模型暴露在未从预训数据分布中提取的数据集上,我们使用了相对较高的序列辅助损失系数5×10−4 5\Times 10×4}.
为了避免路由器的登录饱和,我们增加了一个路由器的z-损失术语,系数为10−5 10−5}.
我们使用专家偏见更新率10 - 3 10 - 3

blocks.en:
Despite the above mechanisms, MoE routing can become unstable at large scale, particularly later in training.
We opined that it is detrimental to use a constant learning rate to update the expert bias once the routing distribution has largely converged, when learning may be more sensitive to routing outliers.
With that, we replaced the constant expert bias update with an adaptive update schedule: η bias ​ ( t ) = 1 2 ​ η bias max ​ [ 1 + cos ⁡ ( π ​ max ⁡ ( 0 , t − T w T − T w ) ) ] \eta_{\mathrm{bias}}(t)=\frac{1}{2}\eta_{\mathrm{bias}}^{\max}\left[1+\cos\left(\pi\max\left(0,\frac{t-T_{w}}{T-T_{w}}\right)\right)\right] (2.3) where η bias max \eta_{\mathrm{bias}}^{\max} is the maximum learning rate ( 10 − 3 10^{-3} in our case), T T and T w T_{w} are the total training and warm-up steps, respectively.
The above scheme uses a constant expert bias update during the warm-up period to ensure early routing convergence.
Then it follows that the cosine learning rate decays to 0.
This simple change significantly improves routing stability, and generalizes to models at Beam’s scale.
blocks.zh:
尽管存在上述机制,教育部的路线可能在很大程度上变得不稳定,特别是在后来的培训中。
我们认为,一旦线路分布基本趋同,在学习可能对线路输出器更为敏感时,使用恒定的学习率来更新专家偏差是有害的.
因此,我们用一个适应性更新时间表取代了不断的专家偏差更新: = 1 2 最大偏差 [1 + COs = ( 最大偏差 = 0, t → T → T → T → T → T ) ]\eta mathrm{ bias}}(t) = frac{ 1 + + }{ 2 → at → mathrm{ bias}}^{\ → 左 [1 → cos\ 左 (\pi\ max\ 左 (0,\ frac{ t → T_{w}}{- t_{w}}\right)\ right] (2.3) , 其中 = 最大偏差 → etamathrm{ bias}}^{\max} 是最高学习率 (10 → 3 10 → → ), T T T 和 T_{w} 分别是总培训和温暖步骤。
上述方案在暖和期使用不断的专家偏差更新,以确保早期的路由趋同.
由此可见,余弦学习速率衰减到0.
这一简单变化大大提高了路由稳定性,并以Beam的尺度向模型概括.

blocks.en: Residual Stability
blocks.zh: 残余稳定

blocks.en:
At a large scale, the residual stream can suffer from unbounded magnitude growth and activation outliers.
Below we describe several interventions to prevent blowup.
We note that we computed the entire residual stream in FP32, by upcasting sublayer outputs before adding them.
blocks.zh:
在大范围上,残余溪流可能会受到无限制的体积增长和活化外源的影响。
下面我们介绍防止爆炸的若干干预措施。
我们注意到,我们在计算整个FP32的残余流时,先对下层产出进行更新,然后再添加这些产出。

blocks.en:
To keep activations within a reasonable range, we apply SandwichNorm to all sublayers [ 3 , 20 , 4 , 5 ] ; SandwichNorm normalizes both the input to and output from each sub-layer.
In this way, the residual activations are decoupled from the internal dynamics of each sub-layer and largely depend on SandwichNorm’s output normalization.
We initialize SandwichNorm’s output gains to 1 L \frac{1}{\sqrt{L}} , where L L is the total number of layers [ 21 ] , and input gains to 1.0 1.0 , which we found to be the most empirically effective.
blocks.zh:
为了将激活保持在合理的范围内,我们对所有子层[3、20、4、5]使用桑威奇诺姆;桑威奇 Norm使每个子层的输入和输出都正常化.
这样,剩余激活与每个子层的内部动态脱钩,主要取决于桑威奇诺姆的输出正常化.
我们将桑威奇诺姆的输出收益初始化为1L\frac{1\sqrt{L},其中LL是层数的总数[21],输入收益则初始化为1.01.0,我们发现这是经验性最有效的.

blocks.en: In pre-normalization architectures, including SandwichNorm, the residual stream 𝐱 n \mathbf{x}_{n} is effectively a direct summation of all preceding sublayer outputs 𝐡 t \mathbf{h}_{t} (e.g., attention, MLP, MoE): 𝐱 n = ∑ t = 1 n 𝐡 t \mathbf{x}_{n}=\sum_{t=1}^{n}\mathbf{h}_{t} , and so the activation magnitude inevitably increases with network depth.
blocks.zh: 在包括桑威奇诺姆在内的前常态化架构中,残流x n\ mathbf{x}_{n}实际上是所有之前的子层输出h t\ mathbf{h}_{t}(如注意,MLP,MOE):x n = ∑ t = 1 n h t\ mathb{x}_{n}=\sum_{t = 1\}^{n}\ mathb{h}_{t}的直接总和,所以激活量必然随着网络深度而增加.

blocks.en: To prevent the residual stream from becoming too large, we proposed a depth-scaled residual connection (DSRes) , which rescales the stream by 1 over the square root of the number of accumulated sublayers: 𝐱 n = 1 n ​ ∑ t = 1 n 𝐡 t \mathbf{x}_{n}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\sum_{t=1}^{n}\mathbf{h}_{t} (2.4)

blocks.en: 2.1.2 Training Recipe
blocks.zh: 2.1.2 培训工具

blocks.en: Initialization
blocks.zh: 初始化

blocks.en:
Specific initialization schemes for the gains in the output RMSNorms of SandwichNorm and for gated attention parameters were described above.
Linear layers were initialized with standard fan-in initialization, RMSNorm gains were initialized with 1s, and input embeddings were initialized from a normal distribution with standard deviation equal to 1 / d 1/\sqrt{d} , where d d is the hidden dimension.
blocks.zh:
上文介绍了关于桑威奇诺姆产出RMSNorms收益的具体初始化办法和有门的注意参数。
线性层以标准的扇形初始化初始化,RMSNorm增益以1s初始化,输入嵌入从正常分布中初始化,标准偏差等于1/d1/\sqrt{d},其中dd为隐藏维度.

blocks.en: Hyperparameters and Optimization
blocks.zh: 超参数和优化

blocks.en:
For optimization we used the AdamC algorithm [ 22 ] and a linear warm-up plus cosine decay learning rate schedule, for more details see Appendix B .
We use decoupled weight decay [ 23 ] , with the weight decay term following the squared warm-up and cosine decay schedule reaching zero at the end of training.
We apply weight decay to all parameters except biases and RMSNorm gains. The AdamC weight decay schedule correction is used for all regularized parameters, not only for parameters followed by normalization layers.
blocks.zh:
为了优化,我们使用了 AdamC 算法 [22] 和一个线性热身加 余弦衰减学习速率表, 详见附录 B.
我们使用脱钩的重量衰减[23],在训练结束时,在平方暖和和余弦衰减时间表之后的重量衰减术语达到零.
除偏差和RMSNorm增益外,我们对所有参数都适用重量衰减。 AdamC重衰减表校正适用于所有正规化参数,而不仅仅用于常态层之后的参数.

blocks.en: 2.1.3 Scaling Methodology
blocks.zh: 2.1.3 扩大方法

blocks.en: Scaling Ladder and Ablations
blocks.zh: 缩放梯和缩放

blocks.en:
Pretraining ablations are conducted by testing a modeling or data intervention on each tier of a “ladder” of increasingly large model configurations.
We set up a scaling ladder [ 24 ] where every tier is trained at a constant number of tokens per (active) parameter (TPP) for any ablation.
We maintain a constant aspect ratio (width-to-depth) throughout the ladder.
The ladder tiers contain model configurations ranging from approximately 300M to 6B before the target tier of 23B active parameters.
In practice, we have found little signal in configurations with fewer than 0.5B active parameters.
blocks.zh:
培训前模拟是通过在日益大型的模型配置的“梯子”的每一级测试模型或数据干预进行的。
我们设置了一个缩放阶梯[24],每个阶梯按照每个(活性)参数(TPP)的常数对每个阶梯进行刻度训练,用于任何斜度.
我们在整个梯子上保持恒定的纵宽比(宽度-深度).
梯级包含的模型配置范围在23B活性参数的目标级之前从大约300M到6B不等.
在实际操作中,我们发现配置中的信号很少,活性参数少于0.5B.

blocks.en:
After fitting a FLOPs-to-validation-loss scaling law to a baseline model’s performance at each tier, we can determine whether an intervention has increased compute efficiency by calculating the number of FLOPs necessary to attain the intervention’s loss under the baseline scaling law [ 24 ] .
We accept the intervention if it reliably increases compute efficiency across tiers (i.e., it results in validation losses that would require significantly more FLOPs under the baseline scaling law), and does not hurt model stability or downstream evaluations.
blocks.zh:
在将FLOPs至验证-损失缩放法与基线模型的每一级性能结合之后,我们可以通过计算根据基线缩放法实现干预损失所必需的FLOP数量来确定某项干预是否提高了计算效率[24]。
如果干预可靠地提高各层级的计算效率(即导致验证损失,而根据基线缩放法,验证损失将要求大幅度提高FLOP),而且不影响模型稳定性或下游评价,我们接受干预。

blocks.en:
Compute efficiency (CE) is the ratio between the compute the baseline would require to achieve the intervention’s validation loss and the compute used by the intervention.
For each validation dataset, we fit a power law to the baseline ladder, L base ​ ( C ) = a ​ C b + c L_{\mathrm{base}}(C)=aC^{b}+c , where C C is training compute in FLOPs, a > 0 a>0 is the scaling coefficient, b < 0 b<0 is the scaling exponent, and c c is the fitted asymptotic loss.
For an intervention achieving loss L > c L>c with compute C C , its compute efficiency is: CE ⁡ ( C , L ) = L base − 1 ​ ( L ) C = 1 C ​ ( L − c a ) 1 / b . \mathrm{CE}(C,L)=\frac{L_{\mathrm{base}}^{-1}(L)}{C}=\frac{1}{C}\left(\frac{L-c}{a}\right)^{1/b}. (2.6)

Where C ​ E > 1 CE>1 indicates an improvement over the fitted baseline.
In practice, we found that a statistically significant change in either direction must register a CE change above 5% to cancel training-seed noise and sampling noise.
blocks.zh:
中、英 > 1 CE > 1 表明比装配基准有所改进。
实际上,我们发现,从统计上看,任何方向的改变都必须超过5%的CE变化,以取消训练种子噪音和取样噪音。

blocks.en:
Crucially, every pretraining recipe intervention must be ablated on the scaling ladder to measure its compute efficiency trend.
We applied this same standard to ML recipe changes, data mixture changes, and numerics changes.
Periodically, we bundled many proposals and trained the next-largest tier of the ladder, establishing a new baseline if the scaling projection passed validation.
This allowed us to discover interactions between data, recipe, and implementation early; re-establish baselines for fast iteration; and collect intermediate feedback on the impact of the latest pretraining recipe on the midtraining and post-training workflows.
blocks.zh:
关键的是,每一次预先培训的食谱干预都必须在梯子上减少,以衡量其计算效率趋势。
我们对ML的食谱变化、数据混合物变化和数字变化采用了同样的标准。
我们定期整理许多建议,并培训梯级的第二大层,如果比例预测通过验证,则确定一个新的基线。
这使我们能够及早发现数据、食谱和执行之间的相互作用;重新确定快速迭代的基线;并收集关于最新培训前食谱对中级培训和培训后工作流程影响的中期反馈。

blocks.en:
For scaling-ladder ablations to predict improvements at the target scale, smaller tiers must reflect the data constraints of the final pretraining run.
The target run repeats some datasets many times to pad its token horizon and re-expose the model to selected valuable training data.
In the ladder, smaller model tiers are trained on shorter horizons, and scaling down the mixture naïvely would make them train on unique tokens instead.
This setup would not accurately model the effect of data repetition in the target model, and would not project its effect across the scaling ladder tiers.
blocks.zh:
为了预测目标规模的改进,较小的等级必须反映最后预训运行的数据限制。
目标运行多次重复一些数据集,以达到其象征性的视野,并将模型重新曝光到选定的有价值的培训数据中.
在梯子中,较小的模范等级在较短的视野上训练,而缩小混合物的幼稚程度则会使它们在独特的标志上训练。
这种设置不会准确模拟目标模型中数据重复的效果,也不会将它的效果投射到跨梯级的尺度上.

blocks.en:
Following Muennighoff et al. [25] , we applied the procedure we coined data-limited subsampling (DLS) to include these effects in the scaling ladder.
For each tier, we reduced the available data in proportion to the number of training tokens.
This kept the number of passes through each source approximately equal to that of the final training run.
This makes the tradeoff between data quality and quantity visible throughout the ladder and helps distinguish improvements that transfer to the final training regime from those that depend on access to fresh data.
blocks.zh:
继Muennighoff等人[25]之后,我们采用了我们制作有限数据分样(DLS)的程序,将这些效果纳入缩放阶梯.
每一级,我们按照培训标志数量的比例减少现有数据。
这使得每个来源的通过次数与最后培训次数大致相等。
这使得数据质量和数量之间的权衡在整个阶梯上显而易见,并有助于区分向最后培训制度转移的改进与那些依赖获取新数据的方法。

blocks.en: Scaling Laws
blocks.zh: 扩展法律

blocks.en:
As our ladder varies the active parameters and the token horizon, we fit a scaling law to predict the peak learning rate and weight decay for each ladder tier.
We used a multiplicative form following Bjorck et al. [26] , which suggests that the active parameters, batch size, and token horizon dependencies can be isolated.
Our peak learning rate and peak weight decay scaling law takes the functional form: η max ∗ ​ ( N , D , B ) \displaystyle\eta^{*}_{\max}(N,D,B) = C η ​ N − α η ​ D − β η ​ B γ η , \displaystyle=C_{\eta}\,N^{-\alpha_{\eta}}\,D^{-\beta_{\eta}}\,B^{\gamma_{\eta}}, (2.7) λ max ∗ ​ ( N , D , B ) \displaystyle\lambda^{*}_{\max}(N,D,B) = C λ ​ N − α λ ​ D − β λ ​ B γ λ \displaystyle=C_{\lambda}\,N^{-\alpha_{\lambda}}\,D^{-\beta_{\lambda}}\,B^{\gamma_{\lambda}} Here, N N is the number of active non-embedding parameters, D D the token horizon, and B B the batch size.
We keep B B explicit because it varies across our ladder.
For γ η \gamma_{\eta} we use the exponent 0.5 0.5 following e.g. Malladi et al. [27] , and for β η \beta_{\eta} we use 0.32 0.32 following Bjorck et al. [26] .
To keep the effective learning rate constant across parameters, when varying the batch size and the token horizon, we set λ ∝ η 2 \lambda\propto\eta^{2} to fix the exponents γ λ \gamma_{\lambda} and β λ \beta_{\lambda} to 1.0 1.0 and 0.64 0.64 , respectively.
With these exponents fixed, the constant term and the exponent for the model size, namely, C η C_{\eta} , C λ C_{\lambda} , α η \alpha_{\eta} , α γ \alpha_{\gamma} , are the only remaining degrees of freedom.
We fit these four terms by using linear regression data collected from extensive hyperparameter sweeps conducted at the lower tiers of our ladder.
The tuning procedure is detailed in Appendix A , with scaling results in Figure 72 .

blocks.en:
We validated our scaling recipe on the ladder using diverse in-house code and web validation sets, with all training data decontaminated against them.
As shown in Figure 3 , the recipe scales predictably across four orders of magnitude in compute: Beam Base matched its predicted performance and matched or outperformed the comparable open-source base models evaluated.

如图3所示,根据计算,食谱可预测分为四个数量级: Beam Base与其预测的性能相匹配,并与所评价的可比开源基础模型相匹配或超过其业绩.

blocks.en:
Beam is pretrained on 23.8T diverse high-quality tokens, packed into sequences of 16,384 tokens each. Table 3 shows the high-level composition of our pretraining mixture.
We detailed below the numerous novel techniques to curate, filter, process, deduplicate, mix, and pack pretraining data for Beam.

我们在下面详细介绍了许多新颖的技巧, 来整理、过滤、处理、调试、混合和整理Beam的预训数据。

blocks.en: 2.2.1 Web Data Curation
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 网络数据校正

blocks.en:
Figure 4: Web data curation from Common Crawl and third-party crawls through domain-specific filtering and quality partitioning.
Technical domains are partitioned early and treated separately thereafter.
blocks.zh:
图4:来自Common Crawl和第三方的网络数据校验通过特定域的过滤和质量分区.
技术领域很早就被分割,然后分别处理。

blocks.en:
Our web data is sourced from a mixture of third-party providers and a high-value subset of Common Crawl, comprising 245B raw HTML pages.
We parsed each page with a proprietary parser that preserves mathematical and code content that open-source parsers not optimized for pretraining use cases often corrupt or drop.
We applied exact deduplication using an MD5 hash of the parsed text, resulting in 97B surviving documents.
We then enriched each document with heuristic quality signals and learned classifier scores that support flexible selection throughout the downstream pipeline.
The initial set of quality signals is listed in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
我们的网络数据来源于第三方提供者和共同爬行(Common Crawl)高值子集的混合,包含245B原始HTML页面.
我们用专有解析器对每个页面进行了解析,该解析器保留了数学和代码内容,而开源解析器并不优化用于预训使用时,经常会损坏或下降。
我们使用解析文本的MD5散列进行了精确的分解,产生了97B存活文件.
然后,我们用高压质量信号丰富每个文件,并学习分类器分数,支持整个下游管道的灵活选择。
首批质量信号列于附录C。

blocks.en:
MassiveWeb-style heuristic filters are commonly applied near the start of web-data curation pipelines [ 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 , 32 ] .
At their canonical thresholds, however, we found that they remove substantial amounts of high-quality technical content.
We instead partitioned the pool by domain and apply domain-specific filtering pipelines.
blocks.zh:
大众网式的heuristic滤波器通常在网络数据解析管道的起始位置附近应用[28,29,30,31,32].
然而,我们发现,在他们的理论门槛上,他们删除了大量高质量的技术内容。
相反,我们按域划分了池,并采用了特定域的过滤管道。

blocks.en: We partitioned the pool into five domains: math, code, STEM, English, and non-English. We trained three lightweight classifiers [ 33 , 34 ] to score each document’s relevance to the technical domains. To maintain high precision across 97B diverse, unfiltered web documents, we iteratively refined them using examples where their predictions disagreed with an internally configured judge models.
blocks.zh: 我们把游泳池分为五个领域:数学、代码、STEM、英语和非英语。 我们训练了三个轻量级 [33,34] 来评分每个文件与技术领域的相关性。 为了保持97B不同、未经过滤的网络文件的高精度,我们利用其预测与内部配置的法官模型不相符的例子,反复加以改进。

blocks.en:
We routed documents through a fixed-priority cascade (math, code, then STEM), assigning each to the first domain whose score exceeded its threshold. We split the remaining documents into English and non-English partitions using fastText’s lid-176 language identifier.
Each partition was then fuzzy-deduplicated against itself using the deduplication pipeline described in Section 2.2.4 . Table 4 reports token volume before and after deduplication.
We omit the non-English partition from the discussion because it was processed separately using similar curation procedures.
blocks.zh:
我们通过固定优先级联(math,代码,然后STEM)对文件进行路由,将每个文件分配到分数超过门槛的第一个域. 我们使用快讯的盖-176语言标识符将其余文件分为英文和非英文分区。
然后,利用第2.2.4节所述的分解管道,将每个分区都模糊地重复起来。 表4报告了重复前后的象征性数量。
我们从讨论中省略了非英语分区,因为它是用类似的解析程序单独处理的.

blocks.en:
To test whether domain partitioning preserves technical data that a standard unpartitioned pipeline would discard, we applied the canonical MassiveWeb filters to the curated technical datasets in our final mixture.
Across web-STEM, web-code, and web-math, these filters would remove 80–88% of tokens in each domain, totaling roughly 1.8T tokens, or 13% of the mixture’s 13.73T unique tokens.
blocks.zh:
为了测试域分隔是否保存了一个标准无分隔管道会丢弃的技术数据,我们把Canonic MassiveWeb过滤器应用到我们最后混合物中经过整理的技术数据集中.
在网络-STEM、网络编码和网络-math中,这些过滤器可以清除每个领域的80–88 % 的代币,总计约1.8T 代币,占该混合物13.73T 唯一代币的13%。

blocks.en:
Every filtering decision trades corpus quality against token volume ( Figure 5 ).
For a filter F F applied to a pool D D , let r tok ​ ( F ) r_{\mathrm{tok}}(F) denote the fraction of token mass removed and let q ¯ tok ​ ( S ) \bar{q}_{\mathrm{tok}}(S) denote the token-weighted mean judge score of subset S S .
We define filter efficiency as e ⁡ ( F ) = q ¯ tok ​ ( D keep ) − q ¯ tok ​ ( D ) r tok ​ ( F ) . e(F)=\frac{\bar{q}_{\mathrm{tok}}(D_{\mathrm{keep}})-\bar{q}_{\mathrm{tok}}(D)}{r_{\mathrm{tok}}(F)}\,. (2.8) Random removal has expected efficiency zero, while removing documents in increasing judge-score order traces the oracle envelope.
blocks.zh:
每个过滤决定书的质量与符号量相对照(图5)。
对于适用于游泳池 D D 的过滤器 F , 让 r tok (F ) r_{\mathrm{tok}}(F ) 表示去除符号质量的一小部分, 让 q ̄ tok (S )\ bar{q}_{\mathrm{tok}}(S) 表示子集 S 的符号加权平均评分 。
我们定义过滤效率为 e → (F) = q → tok (D keep) → q → tok (D keep) → e(F) → frac\ q}_{\ mathrm{ tok}}(D_{\ mathrm{ keep}})-\ bar{q}_{\ mathrm{ tok}}(D)}\ r_{\ mathrm{ tok}}(F)}, (2.8) 随机删除时预计效率为零,同时删除在增加法官分数顺序时记录到甲骨文信封的文件 。

blocks.en: To obtain these scores, we used an internally configured judge models with a handwritten, domain-specific prompt to score a uniform random sample of thousands of documents per domain from 0–4, similar to FineWeb-Edu [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了获得这些分数,我们使用了内部配置的法官模型,并用手写、域名专用的提示,从0–4对每个域的数千份文件进行统一的随机抽样,类似于FineWeb-Edu [31].

blocks.en: To discover filters for each domain, we began with basic document-length and mean-word-length filters, then extended the pipeline through the following iterative search-and-review loop:
blocks.zh: 为了发现每个域的过滤器,我们首先用基本的文档长度和正字长度过滤器,然后通过下列迭代搜索和审查循环延长管道:

blocks.en:
1. Enumerate one- and two-condition rules over a quantile grid of continuous signals and the discrete labels of categorical signals, then measure each rule’s marginal token-weighted efficiency on the current survivors. 2. Inspect the documents that each leading candidate would remove and retain, then select a rule, sometimes adjusting its threshold or choosing a candidate below the top-ranked rule. 3. Apply the selected rule and remove the matched documents from the active sample. 4. Repeat until the marginal efficiency of the remaining candidates no longer justifies further removal. The resulting domain-specific heuristic pipelines reduced total unique token volume to 19.5T, excluding the non-English partition.
We then trained English web, STEM, and code quality classifiers and used them in a second filtering stage.
English and STEM applied a threshold to their quality scores; code applied compound rules whose heuristic conditions fired only when a quality score was also low; math received no classifier-based filtering.
blocks.zh:
一、导 言 对连续信号和断断续续信号的离散标签 设定一个条件和两个条件,然后衡量每个规则在目前幸存者身上的边际标志加权效率。 2. 检查每个主要候选人将删除和保留的文件,然后选择一项规则,有时调整门槛值,或选择低于排名最高规则的候选人。 3. 应用选定的规则,从活动样本中删除匹配的文档。 4. 重复一次,直至其余候选人的低效率不再证明有理由进一步撤职。 由此形成的域特异性heuristic输油管将总的独特符号体积减少到19.5T,不包括非英语分区.
然后我们训练英语网络,STEM,和代码质量分类器,并在第二个过滤阶段使用.
英语和STEM对其质量分数应用了阈值;代码应用了复合规则,只有在质量分数也很低时,其热度条件才会发射;数学没有获得基于分类器的过滤.

blocks.en: Enumerate one- and two-condition rules over a quantile grid of continuous signals and the discrete labels of categorical signals, then measure each rule’s marginal token-weighted efficiency on the current survivors.
blocks.zh: 对连续信号和断断续续信号的离散标签 设定一个条件和两个条件,然后衡量每个规则在目前幸存者身上的边际标志加权效率。

blocks.en: Inspect the documents that each leading candidate would remove and retain, then select a rule, sometimes adjusting its threshold or choosing a candidate below the top-ranked rule.
blocks.zh: 检查每个主要候选人会删除和保留的文件,然后选择一条规则,有时调整门槛,或者选择低于排名最高规则的候选人.

blocks.en: Apply the selected rule and remove the matched documents from the active sample.
blocks.zh: 应用选定的规则,并从活动样本中删除匹配的文档。

blocks.en: Repeat until the marginal efficiency of the remaining candidates no longer justifies further removal.
blocks.zh: 重复一次,直到其余候选人的边际效率不再证明有理由进一步撤职。

blocks.en: Table 4: Token volume by web domain after partitioning, deduplication, heuristic filtering, and classifier-based filtering. All token volumes are reported in trillions.
blocks.zh: 表4:分割后按网络域分类的托肯量,分解,高压滤波,以及基于器的滤波. 所有信物数量以万亿计报告。

blocks.en:
Figure 5: Data curation as a quality-volume tradeoff.
The x-axis shows cumulative tokens removed, and the y-axis shows the token-weighted mean judge quality of the retained data.
Each curve progressively removes documents in ascending order of an individual quality signal, while markers show complete multi-rule filter pipelines.
Random removal preserves mean quality in expectation (gray dashed line), and removal in ascending judge-quality order defines the oracle upper envelope.
blocks.zh:
图5:数据校准作为一种质量量的权衡。
x轴显示已删除的累积符,y轴显示保留数据的符号加权平均值判断质量.
每个曲线按单个质量信号的递升顺序逐渐删除文档,而标记则显示完整的多规则过滤管道.
随机删除在期望中保留平均质量(gray flashed line),在上升法官质量顺序中删除定义了甲骨文上方信封.

blocks.en:
Our downstream quality-aware upsampling procedure assigns different weights to fine-grained quality tiers, thus the classifier must rank documents reliably across its full score range rather than merely separate high- from low-quality data.
We first evaluated two widely used open-source classifiers, DCLM [ 30 ] and FineWeb-Edu [ 31 ] , on the hand-curated binary evaluation in Table 5 .
They obtained AUCs of 0.65 and 0.52, respectively.
Agreement with human judgments does not necessarily predict downstream compute efficiency, so we subsequently evaluated each classifier on both judgment agreement and data ablations; their weak agreement nonetheless motivated training our own.
blocks.zh:
我们的下游质量意识提升抽样程序为精细质量等级分配了不同的权重,因此,分类员必须在其全部得分范围对文件进行可靠的排序,而不仅仅是将高质量数据与低质量数据分开。
我们首先在表5的手工二进制评价上评价了两个被广泛使用的开源分类器DCLM[30]和FineWeb-Edu[31].
他们分别获得了0.65和0.52的AUC.
同意人类判断并不一定预测下游计算的效率,因此,我们随后根据判断协议和数据模拟评估了每个分类者;然而,他们的弱协议却激励了我们自己的培训。

blocks.en: We used downstream data ablations as the primary evaluation, supported by three cheaper classifier-level evaluations:
blocks.zh: 我们使用下游数据模拟作为主要评价,并辅以三个更便宜的分类级评价:

blocks.en:
1. Data Ablation (Primary): We used each classifier to partition a fixed English web corpus into token-weighted quality tiers, apply a common exponential quality upsampling schedule matched to the final design’s mean repeat rate and effective-token budget, and train a scaling ladder.
Compute-efficiency differences isolated the ranking induced by the classifier. 2. Natural Holdout: We report Keep-AUC, the ROC-AUC for predicting the judge’s binary keep label, on a sample of documents from the natural web distribution excluded from classifier training. 3. Binary Evaluation: An small, adversarial set of web documents with unambiguous binary quality labels, hand-selected to probe specific failure modes (e.g. well-written documents on taboo subject matter). 4. Ordinal Evaluation: A pairwise-comparison tournament, run by an internally configured “oracle” judge model, produced a reference ranking over roughly 100 held-out documents; classifiers are scored by rank agreement (Spearman) against it. We developed a binary quality judge using a strong LLM and a handwritten prompt.
After tuning primarily against external development examples to limit overfitting to the binary evaluation, the final judge reached a Cohen’s kappa of 0.82 on that evaluation.
We then labeled several hundred thousand documents selected from a 522M-document sample using weighted reservoir sampling over document format, topic, and a “weak” quality score from a prior internal quality classifier.
The format and topic labels are supplied by internally developed WebOrganizer-style taxonomy classifiers [ 35 ] .
The best-performing sampling recipe preserved a natural-distribution backbone while upweighting rare formats and documents assigned mid-range or high scores by the prior classifier.
Finally, we used the labels to train an in-house small classifier.
blocks.zh:
一、导 言 数据偏差( 初级) : 我们用每个分类器将一个固定的英文网页表分割成符号加权的质量级,适用一个与最终设计的平均重复率和有效的预算相匹配的通用指数级质量提升表,并训练一个缩放梯子。
计算效率差异隔离了分类器引起的排名. 2. Natural Holdout:我们报告Keep-AUC,这是预测法官二进制标签的ROC-AUC,它来自不包括在分类员培训之外的自然网络分布文件样本。 3. 二进制评价: 一套带有明确二进制质量标签的小型对抗性网络文件,手选来探究具体的故障模式(例如关于禁忌主题的写得很好的文件). 4. 标准评价: 由内部配置的“神职”法官模式主持的双智比较锦标赛产生了大约100份搁置文件的参考排名;分级者根据排名协议(Spearman)与之相对。 我们用强力LLM和手写提示器 开发了二进制质量法官
在主要参照外部发展实例来限制过度适应二进制评价之后,最后的法官在这项评价上达到了0.82的科恩卡帕。
然后,我们将从522M文件样本中选取的几十万份文件标注在文件格式、专题上的加权储油层采样,以及以前内部质量分类器的“弱”质量分数。
格式和主题标签由内部开发的WebOrganizer-tyle分类器提供 [35].
最佳的采样食谱保留了自然分布的主干,同时提升了稀有格式和由先前的分类者指定中程或高分的文件。
最后,我们用标签来训练一个内部的小分类器.

blocks.en:
Data Ablation (Primary): We used each classifier to partition a fixed English web corpus into token-weighted quality tiers, apply a common exponential quality upsampling schedule matched to the final design’s mean repeat rate and effective-token budget, and train a scaling ladder.
Compute-efficiency differences isolated the ranking induced by the classifier.
blocks.zh:
数据偏差( 初级) : 我们用每个分类器将一个固定的英文网页表分割成符号加权的质量级,适用一个与最终设计的平均重复率和有效的预算相匹配的通用指数级质量提升表,并训练一个缩放梯子。
计算效率差异隔离了分类器引起的排名.

blocks.en: Natural Holdout: We report Keep-AUC, the ROC-AUC for predicting the judge’s binary keep label, on a sample of documents from the natural web distribution excluded from classifier training.
blocks.zh: 自然悬停 : 我们报告Keep-AUC, ROC-AUC用来预测法官的二进制标签,

blocks.en: Binary Evaluation: An small, adversarial set of web documents with unambiguous binary quality labels, hand-selected to probe specific failure modes (e.g. well-written documents on taboo subject matter).
blocks.zh: 二进制评价: 一套带有明确二进制质量标签的小型对抗性网络文件,手选来探究具体的故障模式(例如关于禁忌主题的写得很好的文件).

blocks.en: Ordinal Evaluation: A pairwise-comparison tournament, run by an internally configured “oracle” judge model, produced a reference ranking over roughly 100 held-out documents; classifiers are scored by rank agreement (Spearman) against it.
blocks.zh: 标准评价: 由内部配置的“神职”法官模式主持的双智比较锦标赛产生了大约100份搁置文件的参考排名;分级者根据排名协议(Spearman)与之相对。

blocks.en:
Table 5 reports the three classifier-level evaluations.
We also trained a fastText classifier on the same labels.
Both internally trained classifiers outperformed DCLM and FineWeb-Edu on all three evaluations, with the in-house classifier ranking first throughout.
blocks.zh:
表5汇报了三项分类评价。
我们还在同样的标签上培训了快速Text分类器.
内部培训的分类人员在所有三项评价中都超过了DCLM和FineWeb-Edu,内部的分类人员在整个评价中排名第一。

blocks.en: Table 5: Agreement with quality judgments across three classifier evaluations.
blocks.zh: 表5:对三个分类评价的质量判断一致。

blocks.en:
The same classifier ordering transfers to the data ablation, validating the use of our cheaper classifier evaluations as proxies for downstream performance.
Under the fixed schedule, our classifier achieves 1.35 × \times ladder-average compute efficiency on general web validation relative to DCLM’s fastText classifier ( Figure 6 ).
blocks.zh:
同样的分类器命令向数据衰减转移,验证了使用我们更便宜的分类器评价作为下游性能的代理.
根据固定的时间表,我们的分类器实现了 相对于DCLM的快速Text分类器(图6),

blocks.en:
Figure 6: Compute efficiency of English web data ablations that vary the quality classifier used to assign documents to quality tiers.
Classifier arms use a common quality upsampling schedule; DCLM fastText defines the 1.0 baseline.
A uniform-sampling control over the retained quality tiers from our classifier isolates the schedule’s contribution.
STEM and code validation serve as expected-neutral controls because only English web data differs.
blocks.zh:
图6: 计算英文网页数据拼贴的效率,这种数据会改变用于将文件分配给质量等级的质量分类器.
分类武器采用共同的质量改进取样时间表;DCLM快译文界定了1.0基线。
对保留的质量等级进行统一抽样控制,从我们的分类器中分离出时间表的贡献。
STEM和代码验证作为预期中性控制,因为只有英语的网络数据不同.

blocks.en: We used the same general procedure to train the domain-specific quality classifiers used in the second-pass code and STEM filters in Section 2.2.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用同样的一般程序来训练二号通道代码中使用的专用域名质量分类器和2.2.1节的STEM过滤器.

blocks.en:
Following OLMo 3’s quality-aware upsampling framework, we parameterized data selection as a repeat-rate curve over twenty token-weighted quality tiers [ 32 ] .
This exposes two mixture-design choices: how much of the English web corpus to retain, and how to distribute training weight across retained data.
The classifier ablations in Figure 6 hold the schedule fixed to isolate ranking quality; here we hold the classifier fixed and optimize the upsampling schedule.
Using our final quality classifier, we partitioned the corpus into quality tiers and study both choices with scaling-ladder ablations.
blocks.zh:
依据OLMo 3 的质量意识提升抽样框架, 我们将数据选择参数化为20个符号加权质量级的重复率曲线 [32] 。
这暴露了两种混合设计选择:保留多少英文网页目录,以及如何在保留的数据中分配培训权重。
图6中的分类器按固定的进度表来隔离排名质量;这里我们按固定的分类器并优化升级的进度表.
使用我们最后的质量分类器,我们把本体分成了质量等级,并用缩放式升降机研究两种选择。

blocks.en:
We first retained the top N N quality tiers and sample uniformly from them, increasing their repeat rate as N N decreases to fill the fixed effective-token budget.
The best measured setting shifts from retaining the top three quality tiers at the smallest tested scale to the top six at the largest scales, suggesting that the optimal retained fraction widens with scale.
Because the production horizon substantially exceeds the largest scale tested in this sweep, we erred toward broader coverage and retained the top nine quality tiers, or 45% of web tokens.
blocks.zh:
我们首先保留了N级最高质量等级,并且从中统一抽取样本,随着NN的减少而增加其重复率,以填补固定的有效预算。
最好的衡量设定从在最小测试尺度上保留前三个质量等级到在最大尺度上保留前六个质量等级的转变,表明最佳保留分数随尺度而扩大。
由于生产范围大大超过了本次扫荡中测试的最大规模,我们错向了更广泛的覆盖范围,并保留了最高的9个质量级别,即45%的网络标志。

blocks.en:
Fixing the top nine quality tiers, we swept several quality upsampling schedules and selected the strongest: a truncated-exponential taper capped at approximately 2 × \times repetition with a mean repeat rate of approximately 1.5 × \times .
Our final schedule yields roughly 10% higher compute efficiency than uniform sampling.
blocks.zh:
校对:Soup
最终的计算效率 比统一取样高10%

blocks.en: Our non-English partition followed the same high-level curation approach, using GlotLID [ 36 ] for language identification and language-aware variants of the filtering and quality-scoring stages in Section 2.2.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们的非英语分区采用同样的高层次校准方法,使用GlotLID[36]进行语言识别,以及第2.2.1节中过滤和质量评分阶段的语言认知变体。

blocks.en: 2.2.2 Code Data Curation
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 代码 数据校正

blocks.en:
The code corpus comprises three categories: source code files, source code notebooks, and web-code documents.
Web-code processing is described in Section 2.2.1 .
Below, we detail the processing of source code and notebooks.
blocks.zh:
代码表包括三类:源代码文件,源代码笔记本,和网络码文档.
第2.2.1节介绍了网络编码处理。
下面详细介绍源代码和笔记本的处理情况.

blocks.en:
We first enriched all files with metadata and quality signals.
We used go-enry [ 37 ] and Magika [ 38 ] for language detection, chardetng [ 39 ] for encoding detection, and additional detectors for licenses, binary content, generated code, and vendored dependencies.
We removed files with restrictive licenses and oversized files, then perform exact deduplication using Git blob content hashes.
When identical files occur in multiple repositories, we preferentially retained the copy from the repository with more stars and forks, followed by deterministic tie-breakers.
blocks.zh:
我们首先用元数据和质量信号丰富了所有文件。
我们用Go-enry [37] 和Magika [38] 来进行语言检测,用Chardetng [39] 来进行编码检测,并增加许可证、二进制内容、生成代码和销售依赖的检测器。
我们删除了带有限制性许可的文件和超大小的文件,然后使用Git blob内容散列进行精确的分解.
当在多个寄存器中出现相同文件时,我们优先保留寄存器中含有更多恒星和叉子的复制件,然后是决定断结器.

blocks.en:
We separated notebooks from ordinary source code files because notebooks are often experimental working documents rather than polished software artifacts.
They commonly contain exploratory work, repeated or partially executed code, prose, and embedded media, making them noisier and less structurally consistent than source code files.
Moreover, notebooks are stored natively in a verbose JSON container format, to which ordinary source-code filters cannot be applied reliably.
We parsed each notebook and convert its cells, in their original order, into a deterministic script-like representation.
We removed cell outputs, discarded empty cells, and replaced media references with compact textual placeholders.
Malformed notebooks that cannot be repaired and parsed are excluded.
blocks.zh:
我们把笔记本从普通的源代码文件中分离出来,因为笔记本往往是实验性的工作文件,而不是抛光的软件文物.
它们通常包含探索性的工作,重复或部分执行的代码,传言,以及嵌入式介质,使得它们比源代码文件在结构上更缺乏一致性.
此外,笔记本在本地以动词JSON容器格式存储,普通的源代码过滤器无法可靠地应用到其中.
我们解析了每本笔记本, 并按其原始的顺序将其单元格转换成一个像定型脚本的表示。
我们删除了单元格输出,丢弃了空单元格,并用紧凑的文本占位符取代了媒体引用。
无法修复和解析的错误笔记本不包括在内。

blocks.en: Next, we applied separate, multi-step filtering pipelines to conventional source-code files and notebooks to remove low-quality, unlearnable data.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们用单独的,多步骤的过滤管道对传统的源代码文件和笔记本进行过滤,去除低质量,不易读取的数据.

blocks.en:
• Source Code: We identified and removed files containing automatically generated code markers or originating from vendored dependencies.
We also removed binary-like files, highly compressible files dominated by repetitive content, and structured noise such as hexadecimal and hash dumps, Intel HEX and Motorola S-record files, numeric and metrics tables, serialized pickle data, OCR markup, subtitles, repeated digit-heavy tables, and documents with a high fraction of non-printable characters.
We then examined the distributions of curation signals separately for each programming language and use these distributions to establish language-specific thresholds for minimum and maximum file size, minimum alphabetic-character ratio, and maximum line length. • Notebooks: We examined the distributions of notebook-specific signals and establish separate thresholds for minimum and maximum document size, minimum number of lines, maximum line length, minimum alphabetic-character ratio, compressibility, and the presence of encoded data.
blocks.zh:
• 支助 源代码 : 我们确定并删除了包含自动生成的代码标记的文件,或来自供应商依赖的文件。
我们还移除了类似二进制的文件,以重复内容为主的高度压缩的文件,以及结构化的噪音,如十六进制和散列堆,英特尔HEX和摩托罗拉S-记录文件,数字和度量衡表,连载泡菜数据,OCR标记,字幕,重复数字重的表格,以及非打印字符比例高的文档.
然后,我们分别检查了每个编程语言的图解信号的分布,并利用这些分布来为最小和最大文件大小、最小字母特征比和最大行长确定特定语言的阈值。 • 支助 笔记本:我们检查了笔记本特定信号的分发情况,并为最小和最大文件大小、最小行数、最大行数、最小字母特征比、可压缩性和编码数据的存在分别确定了阈值。

blocks.en:
Source Code: We identified and removed files containing automatically generated code markers or originating from vendored dependencies.
We also removed binary-like files, highly compressible files dominated by repetitive content, and structured noise such as hexadecimal and hash dumps, Intel HEX and Motorola S-record files, numeric and metrics tables, serialized pickle data, OCR markup, subtitles, repeated digit-heavy tables, and documents with a high fraction of non-printable characters.
We then examined the distributions of curation signals separately for each programming language and use these distributions to establish language-specific thresholds for minimum and maximum file size, minimum alphabetic-character ratio, and maximum line length.
blocks.zh:
源代码 : 我们确定并删除了包含自动生成的代码标记的文件,或来自供应商依赖的文件。
我们还移除了类似二进制的文件,以重复内容为主的高度压缩的文件,以及结构化的噪音,如十六进制和散列堆,英特尔HEX和摩托罗拉S-记录文件,数字和度量衡表,连载泡菜数据,OCR标记,字幕,重复数字重的表格,以及非打印字符比例高的文档.
然后,我们分别检查了每个编程语言的图解信号的分布,并利用这些分布来为最小和最大文件大小、最小字母特征比和最大行长确定特定语言的阈值。

blocks.en: Notebooks: We examined the distributions of notebook-specific signals and establish separate thresholds for minimum and maximum document size, minimum number of lines, maximum line length, minimum alphabetic-character ratio, compressibility, and the presence of encoded data.
blocks.zh: 笔记本: 我们检查了笔记本专用信号的分布情况,并为最小和最大文件大小、最小行数、最大行数、最小字母特征比、可压缩性和编码数据的存在分别确定了阈值。

blocks.en: Finally, we inspected the corpus distribution and deterministically downsample overrepresented languages and artifact-heavy file categories, including markup and configuration formats, generated stubs, IDE-generated files, and framework-specific assets.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们检查了保单的分发和确定性地将代表人数过多的语言和文物重的档案类别,包括标记和配置格式、生成的结巴、IDE生成的文件和特定框架资产。

blocks.en: 2.2.3 STEM and PDF Data Curation
blocks.zh: 2.2.3 STEM和PDF 数据校正

blocks.en:
PDF documents are a large fraction of our training corpus.
We converted the PDF documents to structured text with an OCR model operated as a horizontally scaled Ray pipeline over GPU clusters.
Downstream of OCR, a conversion and quality layer turns per-page structured output into complete documents, with dedicated detectors for degenerate model output, blank or uninformative pages, and incomplete documents.
blocks.zh:
PDF文件是我们训练手册的一小部分。
我们把PDF文件转换成结构化的文本,使用OCR模型操作,在GPU集群上横向缩放Ray管道.
OCR的下游,转换和质量层将每页结构化的输出转换成完整的文档,并配备用于变质模型输出的专用探测器,空白或不信息化的页面,以及不完整的文档.

blocks.en: High-Level Architecture
blocks.zh: 高级别建筑

blocks.en:
Figure 7 illustrates the pipeline: a controller plus a fleet of mini-clusters .
The controller is a single Ray/KubeRay process per run that owns the workset, decides how work is partitioned, launches and monitors mini-clusters, and reconciles what finished against what was assigned.
Each mini-cluster is a self-contained Ray cluster that processes one slice of the corpus to completion and is torn down.
blocks.zh:
图7说明了管道:一个控制器和一个小型集群车队。
控制器是每个运行的单列雷/库贝雷进程,它拥有工作集,决定工作如何分割,发射并监测小型集群,将完成的与分配的对齐.
每个小型集群都是一个自成一体的雷星集群,它把其中的一部份处理到完成,然后被拆掉.

blocks.en:
Figure 7: Scalable OCR and document curation.
A run controller assigns work to warm Ray mini-clusters; co-located CPU rendering and GPU OCR actors process pages before document assembly and curation.
blocks.zh:
图7:可缩放的OCR和文件目录。
一个运行控制器分配工作给温暖的Ray迷你集群;在文档组装和校验之前,CPU渲染和GPU OCR演员处理页面合用位置.

blocks.en:
A mini-cluster maps to a given GPU node (H100, H200, RTX Pro 6000, etc).
Both rendering and OCR run on the same nodes: the render workers (CPU actors) are co-located with the GPU actors, so a node’s CPUs are rendering the next documents while its GPUs are transcribing pages that are already rendered.
Since transcribing takes twice as long as rendering, and with roughly a hundred render workers feeding eight GPUs per node, the GPUs set the node’s ceiling.
We feed the GPUs through bounded queues with backpressure detection, throttling rendering when they fill and draining stalled work when they starve, so that the GPUs stay saturated and every available GPU-second goes to transcription.
blocks.zh:
一个迷你集群地图到给定的GPU节点(H100,H200,RTX Pro 6000等).
渲染和OCR都运行在同一节点上:渲染工(CPU actors)与GPU 演员合用同一位置,因此一个节点的CPU正在渲染下一批文件,而它的GPU正在翻转已经渲染的页面.
GPU为节点设定了上限。
我们通过捆绑的队列给GPU喂食,反压检测,在他们填充时节节奏渲染,在他们饿死时排出停滞的工作,这样GPU保持饱和状态,每个可用的GPU-秒都进行抄录.

blocks.en:
A render worker takes a whole document, then validates, and rasterizes it into pages.
Rendered pages from many documents are interleaved in the GPU queue and packed into batches.
The structured OCR output ( Figure 8 ) is then reassembled per document: a document’s pages are written back to storage only once every one of them has been transcribed, so downstream consumers never see a partially processed document.
Failures follow the same shape: a problematic page fails alone and is recorded as such, and a document is dead-lettered only when its page failures exceed a per-document budget.
blocks.zh:
制成物的工人将整个文件,然后加以验证,并将其照成页。
许多文档的渲染页面在GPU队列中互页,并打包成批.
结构化的OCR输出(图8)然后按文档重新组装:文档的页面只有在每页都转录过之后才会写回存储,因此下游消费者从不看到部分处理的文件.
失败的形状相同:一个有问题的页面单独失效并被记录为这样的情况,只有当文件的页面失败超过每个文件的预算时,才会写死字母。

blocks.en: Serving Optimizations
blocks.zh: 服务优化

blocks.en:
OCR runs on vLLM as an in-process engine inside each GPU actor.
Because OCR is the bottleneck, two changes to how the engine is driven account for most of the serving-side throughput gain, and both were accepted on controlled measurements.
blocks.zh:
OCR运行在vLLM上,作为每个GPU演员内部的处理中引擎.
由于OCR是瓶颈,引擎如何驱动的两处变化占了大部分服务侧吞吐量增益,两者在控制测量上都被接受.

blocks.en:
The serving parameters that govern occupancy (admission width, page-pipeline depth, and the prefill token budget) interact with each other and with the accelerator’s memory and compute shape, so a single global default leaves throughput on the table on every node type.
We tuned them empirically per accelerator class on production hardware: we performed a parameter sweep for each accelerator (H100, RTX Pro 6000, H200, etc) to identify the correct parameter values that will maximize the throughput for said accelerator.
blocks.zh:
适用于占用的可用参数(允许宽度、页管深度和预填符号预算)相互影响,并与加速器的内存和计算形状相互作用,因此每个节点类型的桌面上都有一个单一的全球默认叶子吞吐量。
我们按经验调整了生产硬件的每个加速器类:我们为每个加速器(H100,RTX Pro 6000,H200等)进行了参数扫描,以确定正确的参数值,从而将上述加速器的吞吐量最大化。

blocks.en: Reliability and Auto Remediation
blocks.zh: 可靠性和自动补救

blocks.en:
• Pages Whose Prompt Exceeds the Model’s Context: Very tall or very dense pages produce more vision tokens than the context allows.
Pages are now pre-validated from their image headers against the model’s own processor geometry, with a threshold deliberately looser than the engine’s so a page the engine would accept is never refused, and any rejection that still reaches the engine evicts the largest page and retries until the batch settles. • Long Skinny Pages: Images with aspect ratio above 200:1 (for example an 8 × \times 1650 strip) make the vision processor’s resize routine raise unconditionally, deterministically poisoning any batch they join.
Rejected terminally at pre-validation. • Decompression Bombs: Images whose decoded size exceeds the imaging library’s pixel limit fail on every load attempt.
Rejected terminally at pre-validation. • Large PDFs: We found PDFs that are many thousands of pages to usually be very low quality, so we pre-filter them to reduce compute waste and improve processing throughput.
blocks.zh:
· 迅速超越模型背景的几页: 非常高或非常稠密的页面产生比上下文允许的更多的视觉符号.
页面现在从图像头对模型本身的处理器几何进行预先验证,其阈值故意比引擎松动,所以引擎所接受的页面永远不会被拒绝,任何仍然到达引擎的拒绝都会驱逐最大的页面并重试,直到批量结算. • 支助 长瘦 页面 : 视差比超过200:1的图像(例如8×\times 1650 条)使得视差处理器的调整大小例行提升无条件,确定性地毒害了他们加入的任何批次.
在预先验证时被拒绝 。 • 减压炸弹: 解码大小超过图像库像素极限的图像在每次负载尝试中都会失败 。
在预先验证时被拒绝 。 ^ 大型PDF:我们发现PDF有数千页,通常质量非常低,所以我们预先过滤,以减少计算浪费,提高处理的吞吐量.

blocks.en:
Pages Whose Prompt Exceeds the Model’s Context: Very tall or very dense pages produce more vision tokens than the context allows.
Pages are now pre-validated from their image headers against the model’s own processor geometry, with a threshold deliberately looser than the engine’s so a page the engine would accept is never refused, and any rejection that still reaches the engine evicts the largest page and retries until the batch settles.
blocks.zh:
模式的背景: 非常高或非常稠密的页面产生比上下文允许的更多的视觉符号.
页面现在从图像头对模型本身的处理器几何进行预先验证,其阈值故意比引擎松动,所以引擎所接受的页面永远不会被拒绝,任何仍然到达引擎的拒绝都会驱逐最大的页面并重试,直到批量结算.

blocks.en:
Long Skinny Pages: Images with aspect ratio above 200:1 (for example an 8 × \times 1650 strip) make the vision processor’s resize routine raise unconditionally, deterministically poisoning any batch they join.
Rejected terminally at pre-validation.
blocks.zh:
长瘦页: 视差比超过200:1的图像(例如8×\times 1650 条)使得视差处理器的调整大小例行提升无条件,确定性地毒害了他们加入的任何批次.
在预先验证时被拒绝 。

blocks.en:
Decompression Bombs: Images whose decoded size exceeds the imaging library’s pixel limit fail on every load attempt.
Rejected terminally at pre-validation.
blocks.zh:
解压炸弹:解码大小超过图像库像素极限的图像在每次负载尝试中都失败.
在预先验证时被拒绝 。

blocks.en: Large PDFs: We found PDFs that are many thousands of pages to usually be very low quality, so we pre-filter them to reduce compute waste and improve processing throughput.
blocks.zh: 大型PDF:我们发现PDF有上千页,通常质量非常低,所以我们预先过滤,以减少计算浪费,提高处理的吞吐量.

blocks.en:
Failure is inevitable due to the scale at which we operate.
The pipeline was therefore designed to absorb failures as they come, catching and containing failures at the smallest possible granularity and page level.
There are three main classes of failure:
blocks.zh:
失败是不可避免的,因为我们的行动规模很大。
因此,管道的设计是为了在出现故障时吸收故障,在最小的颗粒度和页面上捕捉和遏制故障。
失败有三大类:

blocks.en:
• Page Level: Every page is its own inference request.
After three failed retries, a page is classified as failed. • Document Level Due to Page Failure: If a document has more than two pages that have run out of retries, the entire document is marked as failed and is removed from downstream processing. • Defective Documents: Documents that are deemed unsuitable (corrupt, encrypted, or over the page limit) go to a dead-letter table with a specified reason listed. As a part of failure handling, we keep a thorough record of each action.
Each document writes status events to a status tracking table with the attempt number, final status, and error code.
Each page row records whether OCR succeeded, the error code if it did not, and how long it took.
Granular record keeping adds resiliency by allowing long running OCR jobs to continue from where they left off in the event of failure.
blocks.zh:
• 支助 页面级别 : 每页都是自己的推论请求.
经过三次失败的重试后,一个页面被归类为失败. · 由于页面故障造成的文件级别: 如果一个文档有两页以上且已耗尽复读,则整个文档被标记为失败,从下游处理中删除. • 缺陷文件: 被认为不适当的文件(破损、加密或超过页数限制)将放在一个有具体理由的死字表中。 作为故障处理的一部分,我们保留了每项行动的详尽记录。
每个文档将状态事件写入一个状态跟踪表,其中包含尝试号,最终状态和错误代码.
每页行记录OCR是否成功,如果成功,则记录错误代码,以及需要多长时间.
Granular 记录保存通过允许长期运行的OCR工作在失败时从所离开的地方继续运行来增加耐力.

blocks.en:
Page Level: Every page is its own inference request.
After three failed retries, a page is classified as failed.
blocks.zh:
页面级别 : 每页都是自己的推论请求.
经过三次失败的重试后,一个页面被归类为失败.

blocks.en: Document Level Due to Page Failure: If a document has more than two pages that have run out of retries, the entire document is marked as failed and is removed from downstream processing.
blocks.zh: 文档级别由于页面失败 : 如果一个文档有两页以上且已耗尽复读,则整个文档被标记为失败,从下游处理中删除.

blocks.en: Defective Documents: Documents that are deemed unsuitable (corrupt, encrypted, or over the page limit) go to a dead-letter table with a specified reason listed.
blocks.zh: 缺陷文件: 被认为不适当的文件(破损、加密或超过页数限制)将放在一个有具体理由的死字表中。

blocks.en:
Figure 8: Example of structured OCR output.
The input page and detected regions are shown alongside the rendered HTML, preserving text, tables, and equations.
blocks.zh:
图8:结构化OCR输出实例.
输入页和检测到的区域与渲染的 HTML 一起显示,保存文本、表格和方程式。

blocks.en: Post-Processing
blocks.zh: 处理后

blocks.en: Figure 9: Document post-processing: HTML-to-Markdown conversion, completeness checks, page-quality filtering, ordered assembly, and document-level quality checks.
blocks.zh: 图9 文档后处理: HTML 至 Markdown 转换,完整性检查,页面质量过滤,有序装配,以及文件级别质量检查.

blocks.en:
Figure 9 shows all the quality checks and processes that we have once OCR is done.
The goal of post-processing is to ensure that low quality and malformed data does not enter our pretraining corpus.
Quality issues can arise from different sources: low quality source, OCR processing artifacts.
blocks.zh:
图9显示了在OCR完成后我们所拥有的所有质量检查和程序.
处理后的目标是确保低质量和错误的数据不会输入我们的培训前程序。
质量问题可能来自不同来源:低质量来源,OCR加工文物.

blocks.en:
The PDF itself could be relatively low signal for a text model.
Content targeted at children with a large number of pictures and limited vocabulary is one example.
To address this, we employed custom filters for a minimum number of words per page.
blocks.zh:
对于文本模型来说,PDF本身可能是相对较低的信号.
以大量图片和有限的词汇为对象的内容就是一个例子。
为了解决这个问题,我们采用了每页最小字数的自定义过滤器。

blocks.en:
Figure 10: Schematic examples of (A) exact text repetition, (B) runaway counting, and (C) legitimate repeated structure.
These illustrate feature families, not production pages or measured classifier decisions.
blocks.zh:
图10:关于(A)准确文本重复,(B)奔跑计数,(C)合法重复结构的示意图示例.
这些说明特征家族,而不是制作网页或计量的分类决定。

blocks.en:
We observed that VLM-based OCR is prone to repetition loops, especially when input pages are unclear or blank.
To fix this, we developed a series of page-level filters we describe below.
Panels A and B of Figure 10 are types of repetitions that we observe from a VLM-powered OCR model.
blocks.zh:
我们注意到,基于VLM的OCR容易重复循环,特别是在输入页不明确或空白的情况下。
为了解决这个问题,我们开发了一系列我们下面描述的页级过滤器。
图10的A和B小组是从VLM驱动的OCR模型中观察到的重复类型.

blocks.en:
Figure 11: Repetition detection combines text-derived numeric features with the dominant HTML region type.
A section-specific logistic model and configured rules determine whether to flag a page.
blocks.zh:
图 11: 重复检测结合了文本衍生的数字特征与占支配地位的HTML区域类型.
特定节的后勤模型和配置规则决定是否标出一页.

blocks.en:
VLM-based OCR occasionally enters degenerate generation loops, particularly on blank, degraded or content-rich pages.
We detected these failures with a section-aware logistic regression model over features derived from both the generated text and its document structure.
These features measure compressibility, repeated substrings, repeated token sequences, repeated lines and table rows, and token n-gram duplication.
We also include features for non-exact loops, such as implausibly long sequences of increasing numbers. Figure 11 summarizes the detector, and Table 6 lists its numeric signals.
blocks.zh:
基于VLM的OCR偶尔会进入退化的生成循环,特别是在空白的,退化的或内容丰富的页面上.
我们发现这些故障时采用了一种了解部分的后勤回归模型,以取代生成的文本及其文件结构所产生的特征。
这些特性测量可压缩性,重复的子字符串,重复的符号序列,重复的行和表行,以及符号n-gm的重复.
我们还包括了非精确循环的特征,如数量不断增加的不可思议的长序列. 图11概述了探测器,表6列出了其数字信号。

blocks.en:
Table 6: Numeric repetition signals.
Parenthesized counts sum to nine core model inputs; extension rows are configuration-dependent.
blocks.zh:
表6:数字重复信号。
括号大小计算为9个核心模型输入;扩展行依赖配置.

blocks.en:
Because genuine repetition failures are rare, a uniformly sampled evaluation set would contain too few positive examples to measure recall reliably.
We therefore oversampled pages from relevant content types and repetition-risk ranges, then weighted each example by the inverse of its sampling probability when computing aggregate metrics.
This gave us enough failure cases to evaluate the detector while keeping the reported results representative of the full corpus.
blocks.zh:
由于真实的重复失败很少,统一抽样的评价集将包含太多积极的例子,无法可靠地衡量召回情况。
因此,我们从相关内容类型和重复风险范围中抽取了过多的页面,然后在计算总指标时,以反向的抽样概率对每个实例进行加权。
这使得我们有足够的失败案例来评估探测器,同时使报告的结果能够代表整个机构。

blocks.en:
Judged against an evaluation set sampled from our data, the detector caught 99.3% of severe repetition cases.
We achieved 89.5% precision and 92.0% recall overall, while falsely flagging only 0.06% of clean pages. Table 7 reports both page filters.
blocks.zh:
检测器从我们的数据中抽取了99.3%的重犯
我们取得了89.5%的精度和92.0%的总的召回率,而虚假的标清页只有0.06%。 表7报告了两页过滤器。

blocks.en: Table 7: Corpus-weighted OCR page-filter evaluation.
blocks.zh: 表7:公司加权的OCR页过滤器评价。

blocks.en:
Furthermore, we filtered pages that are blank or whose print is too faded to recover reliably.
We make this decision from the rendered page image rather than the OCR output, since the model can sometimes generate text even when the input page is empty.
To balance the needs of scale, we leveraged fast computer vision signals including image contrast, Maximally Stable Extremal Regions (MSER), and Sauvola adaptive binarization to search for connected components resembling printed characters.
The combination of these 3 signals allowed us to reach 98.2% precision and 96.5% recall, while incorrectly filtering only 0.06% of clean pages.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们过滤了空白或打印太淡,无法可靠恢复的页面。
我们从提供的页面图像而不是 OCR 输出中作出这个决定,因为即使输入页是空的,模型有时也能生成文本.
为了平衡规模需求,我们利用了计算机快速视觉信号,包括图像对比、Maximally Stable Extremal Regions(MSER)和Sauvola适应性二进制,以搜索与印刷字符相似的连接组件。
这3个信号的组合使我们能够达到98.2%的精确度和96.5%的召回率,同时错误地过滤了只有0.06%的干净页.

blocks.en:
Each page produced by the OCR model includes a confidence score.
We aggregate these scores at the document level and filter documents whose average confidence is below 0.8.
This removes documents where the transcription is broadly unreliable.
blocks.zh:
OCR模型制作的每页都包含一个信心分数.
我们在文件一级汇总了这些分数,并过滤了平均信任度低于0.8的文件。
这样做可以删除抄录方式大致不可靠的文件。

blocks.en:
Some pages are transcribed correctly but contain little self-contained information such as indexes, bare reference lists and predominantly decorative pages.
We used an LLM judge to label examples at scale, then train a fastText classifier on the resulting labels.
The classifier uses the normalized page text together with a coarse start, middle, or end position signal.
Essentially, this classifier ensures we increase the information density of our corpus instead of wasting compute on boilerplate and low-information pages.
blocks.zh:
有些页面的转写正确,但包含很少自成一体的信息,如索引,赤裸的参考列表和主要是装饰性的页面.
我们用一个LLM判断器来标注示例,然后在所产生的标签上训练一个快速Text分类器.
分类器使用规范化的页面文本,同时使用粗糙的起始,中间,或端位置信号.
基本上,这个分类器确保了我们提高我们仪器的信息密度,而不是浪费在锅炉板和低信息页上的计算。

blocks.en: Document Assembly
blocks.zh: 大 会

blocks.en:
Our VLM-based OCR model returns structured HTML for each page.
We converted it to Markdown, removing page headers and footers while preserving elements such as equations, tables, code, lists, and footnotes.
blocks.zh:
我们基于 VLM 的 OCR 模型返回每个页面的结构化 HTML 。
我们将其转换为Markdown,删除页眉和页脚,同时保留方程式,表格,代码,列表和脚注等元素.

blocks.en:
We first checked that all expected pages are present and that none are partial or failed.
Pages flagged as repetitive, blank, or low-information are excluded, and the rest are stitched together in order.
We discarded the entire document if more than 10% of its pages contain repetition.
Blank and low-information pages do not count toward this threshold.
blocks.zh:
我们首先检查了所有预期的页面都存在,而且没有任何网页是不完整的或失败的。
标记为重复的、空白的或低信息页不在此列,其余页按顺序缝合。
如果超过10%的文件有重复内容,我们便放弃了整个文件。
空白和低信息页不计算在这个门槛。

blocks.en:
Finally, we removed documents with low OCR confidence, too little text, or too few characters per page.
This catches image-heavy and otherwise sparse documents that contain little useful training content.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们删除了OCR信心低的文件,文本太少,或者每页字符太少.
这捕捉到图像重重的、或者很少的文件,其中很少包含有用的培训内容。

blocks.en: Key Results of Quality Improvements
blocks.zh: 质量改进的主要成果

blocks.en:
Under controlled experiments, we found that improving document quality and post-processing techniques produced gains comparable to increasing data volume.
The benefits were most pronounced on mathematics and STEM tasks and were consistent across multiple evaluations.
Within the range tested, we did not observe clear diminishing returns from adding more high-quality documents.
These results suggest that better filtering and data selection are as important as corpus scale.
blocks.zh:
在有控制的实验中,我们发现,改进文件质量和处理后技术所产生的收益与数据量的增加相当。
在数学和STEM任务方面,效益最为显著,在多种评价中都是一致的。
在所测试的范围内,我们没有看到增加更高质量的文件明显减少回报。
这些结果表明,更好的过滤和数据选择与机构规模同样重要。

blocks.en: 2.2.4 Deduplication and Decontamination
blocks.zh: 2.2.4 减重和去污

blocks.en:
Across all pretraining data pipelines we applied a single, unified deduplication process to remove exact and near-duplicates within individual sources and across the entire data mixture.
We designed this pipeline with recall and speed/scale as first-class constraints, and we accept some false positives at scale.
This let us run the pipeline regularly as new data is sourced or new ablations start.
blocks.zh:
在所有预先训练的数据管道中,我们采用了单一的、统一的分解程序来消除单个来源内部和整个数据混合物中准确和几乎重复的情况。
我们设计了这一管道,把召回和速度/尺度作为头等的限制因素,我们接受一些规模上的假阳性。
这让我们在新的数据来源或新的堆积开始时定期运行管道。

blocks.en: The pipeline has three stages: (a) an initial exact-deduplication step based on content hashing, (b) a cheap MinHash-based fuzzy prefilter that generates candidate clusters and duplicate pairs, and (c) a precision filter using Levenshtein-style edit distance that narrows matches based on token similarity, rank, and order.
blocks.zh: 管道分为三个阶段:(a) 基于内容散列的初始精确引线步骤;(b) 基于MinHash的廉价模糊预过滤器,生成候选集群和重复对子;以及(c) 使用莱文施泰因式编辑距离的精密过滤器,根据符号相似性、等级和顺序缩小匹配。

blocks.en:
For fuzzy matching, we represent each document using overlapping token n-grams and compute compact MinHash signatures.
Locality-sensitive hashing groups documents with similar signatures, avoiding an exhaustive comparison of every document pair.
We then compared candidate pairs using normalized token-level edit distance, which accounts for insertions, deletions, and substitutions.
When a pair meets the similarity threshold, we remove the lower-ranked document according to configured source priorities, document quality, and deterministic tie-breaking rules.
To bound computation on highly repetitive clusters and very long documents, some cases used rank-based removal without full edit-distance verification.
blocks.zh:
对于模糊的匹配,我们使用重叠的符号n克表示每个文档,并计算紧凑的MinHash签名.
对本地性敏感的散列组具有类似签名的文档,避免对每对文档进行详尽的比较.
然后,我们用正常的符号级编辑距离来比较候选对子,用于插入、删除和替换。
当一对达到相似性阈值时,我们根据配置的源优先级,文档质量,以及决定性的解绑规则,去掉排名较低的文档.
为了在高度重复的集群和非常长的文件上进行约束计算,一些案例使用没有完全编辑距离验证的按级别删除.

blocks.en:
We separately decontaminated training data against designated evaluation and validation collections.
This check measures the fraction of an evaluation sample’s distinct token n-grams that appear in a training document.
Using evaluation-side containment allowed us to detect evaluation text embedded in a much longer document without diluting the match with unrelated surrounding content.
After ablations on both precision and recall of decontamination, we chose to use overlapping token 13-grams and remove a training document if it contains at least 30% of the distinct 13-grams of any indexed evaluation or validation sample.
blocks.zh:
我们根据指定的评价和鉴定收集资料,分别对培训数据进行消毒。
这一检查测量了培训文件中出现的评价样本明显象征性无克数的分数。
利用评价方的封隔,我们可以探测嵌入较长文件的评价文本,而不稀释与之无关的周围内容。
经过精度和消毒的调试后,我们选择使用重叠符号13克,并删除一份培训文件,如果其中至少包含任何索引评价或验证样本中13克的30%。

blocks.en:
We also implemented a number of infrastructure optimizations so that each stage can be horizontally scaled as far as needed with minimal map-reduce -style coordination, and we rely on object storage as a cheap backend.
Together, these let us use CPU machines across most providers and instance shapes and be fault-tolerant if capacity is preempted or individual tasks fail.
blocks.zh:
我们还进行了一些基础设施优化,以便每个阶段都能够按需要水平进行升级,同时进行最低限度的地图简化式协调,我们依靠对象存储作为廉价的后端。
这些让我们共同使用大多数供应商和实例形状的CPU机器,如果能力被预先控制或个别任务失败,则能够承受过失。

blocks.en: 2.2.5 Data Materialization and Packing
blocks.zh: 2.2.5 数据物质化和包装

blocks.en: Offline Materialization
blocks.zh: 离线物质化

blocks.en:
We materialize all pretraining data offline: a dedicated data job compiles the weighted document mixture into an immutable artifact of fixed-length 16K training sequences, in exact training order, with every token span carrying provenance to its source document.
The training loop performs no sampling, mixing, shuffling, or packing of its own.
This buys three properties.
blocks.zh:
我们实现了所有离线培训前数据:一个专门的数据工作将加权文件混合物汇编成一个固定长度为16K的培训序列的不可改变文物,按精确的培训顺序排列,每个符号间距均带有其原始文件的来源。
训练圈不进行取样、混合、打乱或包装。
此买三业.

blocks.en: • Immutability: the data is frozen before the first step and cannot drift with input-pipeline changes, worker scheduling, or restarts. • Reproducibility: every run and restart consumes data in identical order, keeping run-to-run variance controlled. • Verifiability: the full artifact exists before training, so an independent offline job validates provenance, realized mixture ratios, token accounting, and shuffle quality before any accelerator time is committed; the final artifact for this run passed all such checks.
blocks.zh: • 支助 不可改变性:数据在第一步前被冻结,不能随输入管的变化、工人的日程安排或重新启动而漂移。 • 可复制性:每一次运行和重启都以相同的顺序消耗数据,使运行到运行的差异得到控制。 • 可验证性:培训前有完整的文物,因此,独立离线工作验证出处、已实现的混合比率、象征性会计和在任何加速时间投入之前的洗涤质量;最后的这项检查通过所有这些检查。

blocks.en: Immutability: the data is frozen before the first step and cannot drift with input-pipeline changes, worker scheduling, or restarts.
blocks.zh: 不可改变性:数据在第一步前被冻结,不能随输入管的变化、工人的日程安排或重新启动而漂移。

blocks.en: Reproducibility: every run and restart consumes data in identical order, keeping run-to-run variance controlled.
blocks.zh: 可复制性:每次运行和重启都会以相同的顺序消耗数据,保持运行到运行差异的控制.

blocks.en: Verifiability: the full artifact exists before training, so an independent offline job validates provenance, realized mixture ratios, token accounting, and shuffle quality before any accelerator time is committed; the final artifact for this run passed all such checks.
blocks.zh: 可验证性:完整的文物在培训前就已存在,因此,独立的离线工作验证出处、实现的混合比率、象征性的核算,以及任何加速器时间投入之前的洗涤质量;这一次检查的最后一件文物通过了所有这些检查。

blocks.en:
The same contract makes continued pretraining tractable.
When valuable new data lands after a run is underway, we tailpatch—preserve the consumed prefix exactly, let untouched sources continue their epochs, and materialize only the future suffix under an updated mixture.
The materialized data is bitwise equivalent to what a run planned on the new mixture from that point would have consumed.
blocks.zh:
同一合同使得继续预训可以进行。
当有价值的新数据在运行后着陆时,我们尾巴-精确地保留所消耗的前缀,让未触动的源源继续其时代,并在更新的混合物下实现未来的后缀。
实际化的数据与计划从此开始对新混合物进行的运行会消耗多少等值。

blocks.en: Packing
blocks.zh: 包装

blocks.en:
We pack using the concat-then-split (CtS) algorithm: documents are concatenated, separated by a single EOS at each document’s true end, and split into fixed 16K sequences.
Within a packed sequence, we also assign segment IDs that mark document boundaries, reset positions at each document boundary, and loss-mask the first token of a new document.
Sources that already arrive as coherent sequence-length chunks pass through unchanged; everything else is packed at the document level.
This enables document-level attention
masking , so that each token attends only to tokens within its own document.
blocks.zh:
我们使用 Concat-when-split (CtS) 算法进行打包: 文档是缩合的, 在每个文档的真实端由单一的 EOS 分隔, 并分成固定的 16K 序列 。
在打包的序列中,我们还指定了标记文档边界的片段ID,在每个文档边界上重设位置,以及损失掩码新文档的第一个符号.
已经作为连续序列长块运抵的源头没有变化;其他所有东西都装在文件一级。
这使得文档级别能够关注
遮掩,这样,每个令牌只出席自己的文档中的令牌.

blocks.en:
The variant of concat-then-split used in our pipeline we coin split-shuffle packing (SSP) . It addresses the main packing hazard of CtS—long documents that are packed continuously.
One document can dominate several adjacent batches, visible at scale as periodic loss dips and gradient-norm spikes, and fixed cut points re-expose exactly the same windows on every repeat epoch.
blocks.zh:
在我们的管道里使用的Concat -when -split的变体... ...我们铸造了拆卸包装。 它涉及连续包装的CtS长文件的主要包装危险。
一个文档可以主导几个相邻的批次,在尺度上可以看到周期性损失的滑动和梯度-规范的突起,固定的切点在每个重复的纪元上重新暴露出完全相同的窗口.

blocks.en:
SSP addresses both issues.
Long documents are cut into sequence-length pieces with deterministic, per-epoch randomized boundaries, and the pieces are dispersed by a strong global shuffle before packing.
That way, SSP changes local batch composition without changing the selected document mixture.
Matched SSP-versus-baseline training ablations at smaller ladder tiers showed smoother gradient-norm traces, lower loss variance, and a small compute efficiency improvement.
blocks.zh:
SSP处理这两个问题。
长的文档被切成序列长的片段,带有决定性的,逐个随机的边界,片段在包装前被强烈的全球洗涤所分散.
这样,SPP可以改变本地批量成分,而不改变选定的文件混合物.
在较小的梯级水平上进行SSP-比基线训练的比对显示梯度-标准轨迹较为平滑,损失差异较小,计算效率也略有提高。

blocks.en:
We applied the DLS subsampling procedure, described in Section 2.1.3 , before SSP.
Given a source, seed, epoch, and target ratio, DLS deterministically permutes logical document identifiers and selects the required portion.
The same configuration therefore produces the same membership independent of loader parallelism or storage partitioning.
Selecting before splitting also means that a document is sampled as one semantic unit rather than in proportion to the number of chunks it produces.
blocks.zh:
我们在SSP之前采用了第2.1.3节所述的DLS分取样程序。
给定一个源,种子,时代,和目标比,DLS定型的逻辑文档标识符并选择所需的部分.
因此,同一配置产生独立于加载器平行或存储分割的相同成员.
在拆分前进行选择,也意味着一个文件被取样为一个语义单元,而不是与其产生的块数成比例。

blocks.en:
For the scaling ladder, epoch-0 selections are nested across tiers: the documents used by a smaller tier are contained in the corresponding larger-tier selection.
Moving up the ladder adds data instead of replacing one random subset with another, making tier comparisons easier to interpret.
Mixture sizing uses exact selected-token counts, rather than only document counts, to determine source repeats and the final partial epoch.
blocks.zh:
对于缩放阶梯,划时代-0选择被嵌入跨级:较小阶梯使用的文档包含在相应的较大阶梯选择中.
向上移动梯级会添加数据,而不是将一个随机子集替换为另一个随机子集,使得分级比较更容易解释.
Mixture size 使用精确的选定托肯计数,而不是仅仅使用文档计数,以确定源重现和最终部分时段.

blocks.en: 3 Midtraining
blocks.zh: 3 中级培训

blocks.en:
Our midtraining stage focuses on sharpening the knowledge, reasoning, and core capabilities that allow Beam to perform agentic tasks.
We divide midtraining into two stages. Stage 1 focuses on developing the core logical and reasoning capabilities of the model by training on 850B tokens at 32K context length. Stage 2 extends the context length to 512K tokens using an additional 100B training tokens.
blocks.zh:
我们的中级培训阶段侧重于强化知识、推理和核心能力,使Beam能够执行代理任务。
我们把中级训练分为两个阶段。 第1阶段侧重于开发模型的核心逻辑和推理能力,在32K上下文长度上对850B令牌进行培训. 第2阶段使用额外的100B训练令牌将上下文长度延长至512K令牌.

blocks.en: 3.1 Optimization
blocks.zh: 3.1 优化

blocks.en:
We used a sawtooth schedule for training hyperparameters in midtraining.
We linearly warm up the learning rate from zero to the peak value, after which it follows the tail phase of the cosine scheduler curve used in pretraining.
We reset the optimizer state at the start of each stage and warm up the learning rate to allow the optimizer moments to adapt to the new data distribution, keeping weight decay constant during warmup.
After warmup, we scaled the weight decay by the square of the cosine-tail learning-rate schedule, following the AdamC methodology [ 22 ] .
We conducted sweeps on the peak LR and found 5% of maximum pretraining learning rate to balance forgetting and learning in the midtraining stages.
blocks.zh:
我们用锯齿表来训练中场的超参数
我们线性地将学习率从零加热到峰值,之后它跟随预训中使用的余弦排程曲线的尾相.
我们在每个阶段开始时重设优化状态,并加热学习速率,让优化时刻适应新的数据分布,在加热期间保持重量衰减不变.
热身后,我们按照AdamC方法, 将重力衰减 由余酸尾部学习率表的平方缩放。
我们在最高峰LR进行扫荡,发现最高预训学习率的5%是为了平衡中培训阶段的遗忘和学习.

blocks.en: 3.2 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Training Health
blocks.zh: 3.2 专家混合培训

blocks.en:
Our data distribution in midtraining differs from pretraining because it assigns greater weight to specialized domains like STEM and coding.
As a result, the token distribution per batch shifts between these two training stages, which affects the expert load balancing in MoE layers.
We observed that enforcing expert balancing via the same expert bias and auxiliary loss recipes used in pretraining can hinder specialization and lead to lower model performance overall.
To allow for expert specialization, we disabled router z-loss, sequence aux loss, and expert bias update.
Empirically, updating router weights was sufficient to stabilize the MoE during midtraining, as measured by expert loads and router probabilities for the selected experts.
To ensure expert diversification, we also track router weight rank and per-token entropy of the router probabilities.
blocks.zh:
我们在中训中的数据分布不同于预训,因为它给STEM和编码等专业领域分配了更大的权重.
因此,这两个培训阶段之间每批批次的象征性分配会影响到专家负载在教育部层的平衡。
我们发现,通过在预训中使用的相同的专家偏差和辅助损失方程实现专家平衡,会妨碍专业化,导致总体模型性能下降。
为了允许专家专业化,我们取消了路由器 z -损失,序列 aux 丢失, 和专家偏差更新。
从经验上看,更新路由器的重量足以在中训期间稳定教育部,根据专家的负载和路由器的可能性来衡量。
为了确保专家多样化,我们还追踪路由器的重量等级和路由器概率的每位演算式。

blocks.en: 3.3 Sequence Packing
blocks.zh: 3.3 序列包装

blocks.en:
We found that it is beneficial to preserve full data samples during training and prevent splitting data between consecutive sequences within a batch.
We therefore used a filter-best-fit packing algorithm for offline data preparation.
This algorithm keeps documents whole, filters out oversized documents, then places remaining ones in a bin with the least remaining space that still fits it.
When a document fits no bin, all occupied bins are emitted and padded to a fixed length. Figure 12 shows the four steps in the algorithm: filtering, best-fit selection, flushing, and reset/finish.
We still use document-level attention masking as in pretraining to limit attention only within each document’s tokens.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,在培训期间保存完整的数据样本,防止在批次内将数据分拆成连续序列,是有好处的。
因此,我们在离线数据准备中采用了一种滤波器最适合的包装算法。
这个算法使文档保持完整,过滤出超大小的文档,然后将剩余的文档放置在一个仍然适合其的剩余空间最小的盒子中.
当一个文档不匹配时,所有占用的垃圾桶都会被放出并加长到固定长度. 图12显示了算法中的四个步骤:过滤,最合适的选择,冲洗,以及重置/完成.
我们仍使用文件层面的注意遮掩,

blocks.en:
We adopted Unicron ( Section 6 ) with FlashAttention-4 [ 40 ] with zigzag-style sequence reordering for efficient (long-context) training.
When used with context parallelism, our attention kernel enforces certain constraints on the length of the packed sequence as well as the length of each document.
We address these constraints by adding padding tokens to each document whenever necessary during the offline packing.
blocks.zh:
