我们采用了Unicron(第6节),FlashAttention-4[40],Zigzag式序列重新排序,以便进行高效(长文)训练。
当与上下文并行使用时,我们的注意力内核对包装序列的长度以及每个文档的长度实施某些限制.
我们通过在离线包装过程中必要时在每份文件中添加贴纸符来克服这些限制。

blocks.en:
Padding enters the packed batches from two sources: the flushing step of the packing algorithm and the kernel-alignment constraints above.
Depending on the data’s structure and length distribution, the resulting padding can be non-trivial, and these tokens are no-ops for training.
We patched Megatron [ 41 ] to mask padding tokens from expert routing in the MoE layers, which saves computation and avoids expert overload and imbalance.
blocks.zh:
板块从两个来源进入打包批次:包装算法的冲洗步骤和上面的内核调节约束.
根据数据的结构和长度分布,由此产生的粘贴可以是非三角的,这些标志不是训练用的。
我们修补了威震天[41] 以掩盖来自MOE层中专家路由的粘贴符,这节省了计算,避免了专家超载和不平衡.

blocks.en:
Figure 12: This figure demonstrates an overview of the filter-best-fit algorithm.
Oversized documents are first filtered out, then a group of bins is allocated for packing.
Each sample is assigned to the bin with the tightest fit.
If no fit is found, the group is flushed and a new set of empty bins are allocated.
The process continues until all data is exhausted.
blocks.zh:
图12: 这一数字显示了滤波-最适合算法的概况.
超大小的文档首先过滤出,然后分配一组垃圾箱进行包装.
每个样本被分配到最紧凑的箱中.
如果没有找到适合的,则将组合冲出,并分配一组新的空箱.
这一过程一直持续到所有数据耗尽为止.

blocks.en: 3.4 Data Ablation Methodology
blocks.zh: 3.4 数据偏差 方法

blocks.en:
The midtraining mixture includes many small datasets that span different domains, sources, and quality tiers.
To derisk each individual data source and guide our final data mixture composition, we conducted iterative ablations at a smaller scale using smaller models and shorter token horizons.
These proxy training runs allow us to examine how mixture selection, data quality, and training format affect both training dynamics and downstream performance, informing decisions for large-scale runs.
All proxy runs use a consistent mixture recipe.
For each ablation, we draw 50% of the data from the stable mixture used in the previous large-scale run and 50% from the new source under ablation.
This allows us to ablate individual sources and also identify undesirable interactions between data and capabilities early on.
blocks.zh:
中级培训混合物包括许多跨越不同领域、来源和质量层次的小数据集。
为了消除每个数据来源的危险性,并指导我们最后的数据混合物组成,我们利用较小的模型和较短的符号视野,进行了规模较小的迭代。
这些代理培训使我们能够审查混合选择、数据质量和培训形式如何影响培训动态和下游业绩,为大规模运行的决定提供信息。
所有代理运行都使用一致的混合配方.
对于每次衰竭,我们从上次大规模运行中使用的稳定混合物中提取50%的数据,从衰竭下的新来源提取50%的数据。
这使我们能够减少个别来源,并及早查明数据与能力之间的不良互动。

blocks.en:
We enforce determinism in our training, which allows us to carefully study and diagnose the source of training instability manifested as spikes in loss and gradient norm in our ablations.
Aside from hardware and modeling issues, we used spike analysis as a tool to investigate bad data and flag batches for targeted inspection.
Repeating this methodology of data cleaning across our ablations allowed us to create customized data filters to catch corrupted content, malformed formatting, excessive repetition, and preprocessing errors across a wide variety of our data sources and domains.
blocks.zh:
我们在培训中执行确定性原则,使我们能够认真研究和诊断培训不稳定的根源,这表现在损失激增和装备梯度规范。
除了硬件和建模问题之外,我们还利用悬浮分析作为工具,调查不良数据和标注批次,以便进行有针对性的检查。
将这种数据清理方法重复到我们整个编程中, 使我们能够创建定制的数据过滤器, 以捕捉内容腐败、格式不当、重复过多,

blocks.en: 3.5 Stage 1 Data
blocks.zh: 3.5 第一阶段数据

blocks.en:
The final Stage 1 midtraining mixture comprised 90% new data and 10% high-quality pretraining data retained for recall, with the latter helping to preserve base knowledge and regularize against overfitting as the model acquired new capabilities.
By target token share, the full midtraining data mixture comprised 15% general knowledge, 30% advanced and intermediate STEM, and 45% coding skills, spanning competitive programming, basic software engineering, and terminal usage.
The following subsections describe each component.
blocks.zh:
最后阶段第一阶段中期培训混合体包括90%的新数据和10%的高质量预培训数据保留供召回,后者有助于保存基础知识,并随着模型获得新的能力而规范化,避免过于适应。
根据目标份额,完整的中级培训数据混合物包括15%的普通知识、30%的高级和中级STEM,以及45%的编码技能,包括竞争性编程、基础软件工程和终端使用。
以下各小节介绍每个组成部分。

blocks.en:
Our data pipelines in Stage 1 were aimed at teaching the model specific, often niche behaviors and skills. Figure 13 shows a high-level view of the common structure behind these pipelines.
Starting from real, licensed seed corpora, we passed them through a sequence of transformation stages that re-express that source knowledge in many new formats: programmatically constructed tasks with verifiable answers, worked procedures, and dense knowledge documents.
Many different open source models played distinct roles across the pipeline—curating and cleaning the seed pool, rewriting and reformatting content into varied surfaces and styles, solving tasks to produce ground truth when unavailable, verifying the quality of the final training data, and applying high-quality filtering—so that no one model’s idiosyncrasies dominated the resulting data.
Across the pipelines, we ensured the data was anchored to correct outcomes and grounded source knowledge.
The midtraining data embedded various tool modalities like terminal interfaces or coding, as well as different problem-decomposition skills the model will need later, establishing a strong base for exploration and solving complex reasoning tasks during agentic reinforcement learning.
blocks.zh:
我们第一阶段的数据管道旨在教授模式的具体、往往是特殊的行为和技能。 图13显示了这些管道背后共同结构的高级别观点。
从真实的,有执照的种子公司开始, 我们通过一系列的转换阶段, 以许多新的格式来重新表达源的知识: 以可核查的答案进行程序构建的任务, 工作程序, 以及密集的知识文件。
许多不同的开放源码模型在整个管道中发挥了不同的作用——清查和清理种子池,将内容改写和重新编排成不同的表面和样式,解决无法提供地面真实性时的任务,核实最后培训数据的质量,以及采用高质量的过滤——因此,由此产生的数据没有一位模型的特异性占主导地位。
在整个管道中,我们确保数据扎根于正确的结果和基于源的知识。
中间训练数据嵌入了终端接口或编码等各种工具模式,以及该模式日后需要的不同问题解析技能,为在代理强化学习期间探索和解决复杂的推理任务奠定了坚实基础.

blocks.en:
Figure 13: This figure demonstrates the midtraining data curation pipeline.
The seed pool feeds preparation and generation stages.
Candidate examples are assessed using source references and independent checks, then accepted, discarded, or returned for refinement.
This shared generate-assess-refine loop supports task synthesis, trace generation and rewriting, and instructional content generation.
blocks.zh:
图13: 这一数字显示了中级培训数据编程。
种子池为准备阶段和生成阶段提供信息。
使用来源参考和独立检查来评估候选实例,然后接受、放弃或退回加以改进。
这种共享生成-asses-refine循环支持任务合成,痕量生成和重写,以及指令内容生成.

blocks.en: 3.5.1 STEM and Other Niche Knowledge
blocks.zh: 3.5.1 科学、技术和社会经济知识

blocks.en:
To enhance Beam’s general reasoning and problem-solving capabilities, we created a targeted corpus of data focused on STEM and selected topics in other disciplines, including the social sciences. The corpus spans a broad range of disciplines and levels of specialization, with particular attention to underrepresented subtopics and specialized technical material.
Beyond topical coverage, we explicitly gathered data that leverages and showcases diverse problem-solving skills, including deriving results, explaining concepts, and implementing scientific methods.
blocks.zh:
为了增强Beam的一般推理和解决问题的能力,我们创建了一套有针对性的数据库,侧重于STEM和包括社会科学在内的其他学科的选定主题。 该教程涵盖广泛的学科和专业水平,尤其关注代表性不足的分专题和专门技术材料。
除了专题报道外,我们还明确收集了利用和展示不同解决问题技能的数据,包括得出成果、解释概念和执行科学方法。

blocks.en: Seed Curation
blocks.zh: 种子校正

blocks.en:
We curated seeds from technical web content like academic papers as well as licensed advanced textbooks.
We classified documents by subject area and filtered for educational value and technical substance, prioritizing material containing substantive explanations, derivations, and problem-solving.
Within each domain, we sought coverage of finer-grained subtopics using hierarchical subject labels.
We organized these labels into a knowledge graph, connecting broad disciplines to increasingly specialized subtopics and linking each topic to its associated source documents and seeds.
This structure made coverage gaps and concentrations visible, supporting targeted curation of underrepresented areas and balanced sampling across related subtopics.
blocks.zh:
我们从学术论文和特许高级教科书等技术网络内容中整理种子。
我们按主题领域对文件进行了分类,并对教育价值和技术实质进行了过滤,对包含实质性解释、推论和解决问题的材料进行了优先排序。
在每一个领域,我们寻求使用分级主题标签来涵盖更细的分专题。
我们把这些标签编成一个知识图,将广泛的学科与日益专业化的分专题联系起来,并将每个专题与相关的源文件和种子联系起来。
这一结构使覆盖面差距和浓度明显可见,有助于有针对性地治理代表性不足的地区,并在相关分专题中进行均衡的抽样。

blocks.en: Data Transformation
blocks.zh: 数据转换

blocks.en:
A model does not learn reasoning best from raw technical material like papers, or dense passages.
We focused our efforts on reshaping the raw data into formats that make the reasoning and logic itself explicit.
For research papers, we drew on derivations and calculations and recast them as self-contained tasks, supplying the needed context while withholding the target result, which surfaces specialized intermediate steps that research writing tends to skip.
For multi-step problems, we used the knowledge graph and concept co-occurrence patterns to select related ideas. We then synthesized tasks with dependencies between steps and checked that the combined concepts and reasoning were coherent. This approach broadened conceptual coverage while keeping the synthesized tasks grounded in established problem structures.
For explanatory material, we rewrote technical passages as tutorials and multi-turn discussions that mirror how reasoning actually unfolds, from decomposing a problem to exploring approaches and revising when something doesn’t hold up, giving content from varied sources a clearer, more consistent presentation without losing technical substance.
Together, these approaches turned source material into reasoning-rich training data that is grounded in real scientific work, broad in its concept coverage, and pedagogically clear.
blocks.zh:
模型不能最好地从原始技术材料中学习推理,如论文,或密集的段落.
我们集中努力将原始数据重塑为使推理和逻辑本身明确化的格式。
对于研究论文,我们借鉴衍生物和计算结果,并把它们重新编订为自成一体的任务,既提供所需的背景,又扣压目标结果,而目标结果则浮出研究写作倾向于跳过的专门中间步骤.
对于多步骤的问题,我们使用知识图和概念共现模式来选择相关的想法. 然后,我们以各步骤之间的依赖性综合各项任务,检查综合概念和推理是否一致。 这种方法扩大了概念范围,同时将综合任务建立在既定问题结构的基础上。
对于解释性材料,我们改写了技术段落,作为教程和多回合讨论,反映推理的实际情况,从解析一个问题到探索方法,再到某些东西不坚守时加以修订,使来自不同来源的内容更清晰、更连贯,同时又不失去技术实质。
这些方法共同将原始材料转化为以真正的科学工作为基础、概念范围广泛、教学清晰的、富于推理的培训数据。

blocks.en:
We tailored quality checks to the type of examples and formatting applied to the source data.
For any generated data, we used available source answers and derivations, and symbolic, numerical, or execution checks where applicable.
Multi-hop tasks were also checked for correct intermediate results and meaningful dependencies between steps.
For tutorials and discussions, LLM judges assessed technical accuracy, clarity, and fidelity to the source.
After rewriting, we checked the text for remaining unwanted behaviors.
Examples with errors, weak supporting evidence, or unwanted behaviors were repaired, rewritten, or regenerated while preserving style and necessary checks.
Refinement can also increase task complexity by adding constraints or adding further dependent seeds and steps.
blocks.zh:
我们针对实例的类型进行了质量检查,并对源数据进行了格式化。
对于任何生成的数据,我们使用现有来源的答案和推论,并酌情使用象征性、数字或执行检查。
还检查了多跳任务,以确定正确的中间结果和步骤之间的有意义的依赖性。
关于辅导和讨论,LLM法官评估了技术准确性、清晰度和对来源的忠诚度。
重写后,我们检查了文本 剩下的不想要的行为。
存在错误、支持证据薄弱或不良行为的例子在保留风格和必要检查的同时得到修复、改写或再生成。
精细化还可以通过增加约束或进一步增加依赖的种子和步骤来增加任务的复杂性.

blocks.en:
For portions of our data that have a computational final answer, we used pass@k calibration to measure difficulty and select data samples near the model’s capability frontier: challenging enough to require substantive work from the model, while remaining within reach.
Calibration was relative to the evaluated checkpoint and informed adjustments to task selection and formatting of the raw data as capabilities improved.
Low solve rates also prompted checks for ambiguity or low quality of the training document due to lossy reformatting.
We allowed Beam to also leverage written code as a computational medium where reasoning alone tended to fail, thus allowing the model to reproduce the complex computations encountered in the source documents.
blocks.zh:
对于有计算最终答案的部分数据,我们使用pass@k校准来测量难度,并选取靠近模型能力前沿的数据样本:挑战性足以要求模型进行实质性工作,同时保持可及性。
校准与经评价的检查站相对应,并随着能力提高,对任务选择和原始数据的格式进行知情调整。
低解析率还导致检查培训文件的模糊性或质量低,因为重订格式时有损失。
我们还允许Beam将书面代码作为计算介质,在其中,推理往往失败,从而使模型能够复制源文件中遇到的复杂计算.

blocks.en: 3.5.2 Competitive Programming
blocks.zh: 3.5.2 竞争性方案拟订

blocks.en:
Our data pipelines for competitive programming provide examples that emphasize algorithm selection, step-by-step reasoning, and reaching the correct implementation.
These pipelines combine human-authored artifacts with model-generated supervision, emphasizing coverage, correctness, and useful training signals.
blocks.zh:
我们用于竞争性编程的数据管道提供了强调算法选择,分步推理,并达到正确执行的范例.
这些管道将人类授权的文物与模型产生的监督相结合,强调覆盖,正确,有用的训练信号.

blocks.en: Seed Curation
blocks.zh: 种子校正

blocks.en:
Our competitive-programming data is curated from programming datasets, official contest archives, and repository-derived algorithmic examples.
We normalize these heterogeneous sources, reconcile overlapping records, and review statements for completeness and clarity.
We audit all data for semantic contamination against coding benchmarks that we use for signal.
We use lexical checks as well as embedding-based comparisons to flag potential paraphrases, and use LLM-assisted review to assess whether a training solution would solve an evaluation task with only mechanical changes.
blocks.zh:
我们的竞争性编程数据来自编程数据集,官方竞技档案,以及寄存器衍生的算法实例.
我们使这些不同来源正常化,核对重叠记录,审查报表的完整性和清晰性。
我们对照我们用来表示信号的编码基准, 对所有语义污染的数据进行审计。
我们使用词汇检查以及嵌入式比较法来标出可能的参数,并使用LLM协助的审查法来评估培训解决方案是否只用机械改变就能解决评价任务.

blocks.en:
We organize the decontaminated seeds under a topic hierarchy spanning dynamic programming, graph and string algorithms, advanced data structures, number theory, and geometry, with finer-grained techniques such as Digit DP, rerooting on trees, and rollback union-find.
This hierarchy guides how we control diversity and expand the seed collection.
blocks.zh:
我们把被污染的种子组织在一个主题层次之下, 包括动态编程,图和弦算法,高级数据结构,数字理论,和几何学, 具有精细的纹理技术,如Digit DP, 重新根植在树上, 以及回滚的联盟法。
这种等级制指导着我们如何控制多样性,扩大种子采集.

blocks.en: Data Transformation
blocks.zh: 数据转换

blocks.en:
Using the topic hierarchy over seeds, we expanded our training corpus by conditioning on a topic and a small set of relevant seeds to generate similarly structured problems, while reusing the reference solutions or an explanation of the underlying method.
We vary difficulty, structure, programming language, and interface.
blocks.zh:
利用对种子的分类,我们扩大了我们的训练大纲,对一个专题和一小组相关种子作了限定,以产生类似的结构问题,同时重新使用参考解决办法或对基本方法的解释。
我们的难度,结构,编程语言,和界面各不相同.

blocks.en:
Every problem, whether original or adapted, passes an LLM-assisted quality review covering clarity, internal consistency, difficulty, novelty, and learning value.
Where tests or verification checks exist, solutions are run against them.
Where only reference solutions exist, we built test suites from cases on which multiple solutions agree, and audit that trusted solutions pass and known-incorrect ones are rejected.
Problems lacking both are solved via a collection of different models and reviewed for correctness.
Where reference solutions are available, we also rewrite them into tutorial-style documents covering the key observations, algorithms, correctness arguments, complexity analysis, and pitfalls, surfacing concepts that are only implicit in source code.
blocks.zh:
每一个问题,无论是原始问题还是调整问题,都通过LLM辅助质量审查,涵盖清晰度、内部一致性、难度、新颖性和学习价值。
如果存在测试或核查核查,就对它们采取解决办法。
在只有参考解决方案的地方,我们从多个解决方案都同意的案例中建造了测试套件,而通过可信解决方案和已知不正确的解决方案的审计则被拒绝。
缺乏这两个问题都通过收集不同的模型来解决,并经过审查以正确无误。
在有参考解决方案的地方,我们也把它们重写成教程式文档,涵盖关键观测,算法,正确性参数,复杂性分析,以及陷阱,表面概念仅隐含在源代码中.

blocks.en: 3.5.3 Software Engineering (SWE)
blocks.zh: 3.5.3 软件工程

blocks.en:
This category of data teaches models the fundamental knowledge for understanding and improving codebases, extending their capability beyond code generation in isolation.
The data broadly covers two complementary capabilities: repository understanding , which involves identifying relevant code and reasoning about its structure and behavior, and feature implementation , which involves translating natural-language requirements into concrete code changes.
Together, these capabilities support the broader software engineering workflow, from understanding an unfamiliar repository to implementing and validating a change.
blocks.zh:
此类数据向模型传授理解和改进代码库的基本知识,将其能力扩展到孤立生成代码之外.
数据大致涵盖两个互补能力: 存储器理解 涉及确定相关代码和对其结构和行为的推理, 以及特征执行 涉及将自然语言要求转化为具体的代码修改.
这些能力共同支持更广泛的软件工程工作流程,从了解不熟悉的存储库到实施和验证变化。

blocks.en: Seed Curation
blocks.zh: 种子校正

blocks.en:
We constructed all software-engineering data from real GitHub repositories, drawing on issues, pull requests, and commit histories.
Across all data pipelines, we first apply a common set of repository filters: we exclude low-quality repositories, including those with few stars, no activity in recent years, or primarily non-code content.
We remove repositories that are duplicated, have non-permissive licenses, or are benchmark-contaminated.
From the remaining repositories, we further filter down the issues, commits, or pull requests (PRs) based on various heuristics of quality, completeness, complexity, and capability coverage.
blocks.zh:
我们从真正的 GitHub 寄存器中构建了所有软件工程数据, 利用问题,拉动请求, 并记录历史。
在所有的数据管道中,我们首先应用一套共同的存储器过滤器:我们排除了低质量的存储器,包括那些恒星少,近年来没有活动,或者主要是非编码内容的存储器.
我们移除了重复的、有不允许许可的或受到基准污染的储存库。
从其余的储存库中,我们根据质量、完整性、复杂性和能力覆盖面等各种热度,进一步过滤问题、承诺或拉动请求。

blocks.en: Data Transformations
blocks.zh: 数据转换

blocks.en:
One of the fundamental capabilities needed for software engineering is reasoning and understanding across files, interfaces, and dependencies.
To build this capability in the model, we constructed targeted repository-understanding data grounded in real GitHub issues that call for explanation or analysis rather than implementation, covering topics such as design rationale, dependency relationships, feature extensibility, and data or control flow.
We further expand this set by synthetically generating new questions that are attached to real code, broadening coverage beyond the distribution of organic issues.
The entire pool is filtered to retain questions that are answerable, grounded in the in-context code, and non-trivial.
We further produce design documents that describe the structure of code repos at multiple levels of abstraction.
Together, these training samples help models reason about repositories as a whole rather than individual code excerpts, enabling them to navigate unfamiliar codebases, connect information across files, and explain code structure and behavior.
blocks.zh:
软件工程需要的基本能力之一是对文件、接口和依赖性的推理和理解。
为了在模型中建立这种能力,我们构建了基于真正需要解释或分析而非执行的GitHub问题的有针对性的存储库理解数据,涵盖诸如设计理由、依赖关系、特征扩展性以及数据或控制流动等专题。
我们进一步扩大了这一组问题,通过合成产生附于实际守则的新问题,将范围扩大到有机问题的分布之外。
整个池被过滤,以保留可回答的问题,基于内文本代码,以及非三角.
我们进一步制作设计文件,在多个抽象层次上描述代码重置的结构.
这些培训样本共同帮助模型解释整个寄存器而不是单个代码节选,使其能够导航不熟悉的代码库,连接跨文件的信息,并解释代码结构和行为.

blocks.en: We built various forms of supervision from real repository history, focusing on building foundational SWE knowledge and skills at scale, and applying those skills through repository exploration and feedback-driven refinement.
blocks.zh: 我们从真正的存储历史中建立了各种形式的监督,重点是建立规模上的基础性SWE知识和技能,并通过存储库探索和反馈驱动的完善应用这些技能。

blocks.en: Starting from the retained seed commits, we reconstructed a natural-language task from the commit description and code changes, and pair it with repository context assembled from the changed files and their dependencies.
blocks.zh: 从保留种子承诺开始,我们从承诺描述和代码修改中重建了一个自然语言任务,并将其与从更改的文件及其依赖性组装的寄存器上下文配对。

blocks.en:
We use LLM-assisted refinement to improve the reference changes and to produce accompanying rationales and explanations for the seed code patches.
Finally, we reformat the training samples into several output styles, including unified diffs and Bash commands, so the model learns different code editing interfaces.
blocks.zh:
我们利用LLM辅助的完善来改进参考变化,并产生种子代码补丁的配套理由和解释.
最后,我们把训练样本重塑成几种输出风格,包括统一的diffs和Bash命令,因此模型学习不同的代码编辑界面.

blocks.en: We also create template data that teaches the model how to work with a repository over multiple steps, including skills such as inspecting files, searching for definitions and usages, and applying edits as its understanding develops.
blocks.zh: 我们还创建模板数据,教导模型如何在多个步骤上与存储器合作,包括诸如检查文件、搜索定义和用法以及随着其理解的发展应用编辑等技能。

blocks.en:
In addition to commit data, we also created additional targeted data by removing selected functionalities in existing code and writing specifications for reconstructing it.
Varying the scope of the removed code, from single functions to groups of files, yields tasks from localized edits to complex multi-file features.
blocks.zh:
除了承诺提供数据外,我们还通过删除现有代码中的某些功能和编写重建数据的具体规格,创建了更多的有针对性的数据。
从单个函数到一组文件,从本地化编辑到复杂的多文件特性,不同删除代码的范围产生任务.

blocks.en: 3.5.4 Terminal Use
blocks.zh: 3.5.4 终端使用

blocks.en:
We developed specific data pipelines to make the model familiar with problem solving using the terminal.
The focus at the midtraining stage was to introduce broad horizon coverage of terminal related skills including shell scripting, systems programming, networking, data processing and more.
Our pipelines are grounded in human written scenarios from our seed sources and are expanded to produce similarly diverse and realistic training examples.
blocks.zh:
我们开发了具体的数据管道,使模型熟悉使用终端解决问题。
中级培训阶段的重点是广泛涵盖终端相关技能,包括空壳脚本、系统编程、联网、数据处理等等。
我们的管道以我们种子来源的人类书面设想为基础,并被扩大,以产生类似多样和现实的培训实例。

blocks.en: Seed Curation
blocks.zh: 种子校正

blocks.en:
Our training data is grounded in real-world raw artifacts.
This gives us two benefits: • Distribution: Human-created issues, questions, and discussions capture the full spectrum of problems solved via terminal, including the long tail of flags, quoting mistakes, and environment quirks. • Verifiability: A post with an accepted answer gives us a reference to grade against or a concrete problem to turn into a sandbox-checked task.
blocks.zh:
我们的训练数据是基于现实世界的原始文物。
这给我们带来了两个好处: 分布:人类创造的问题,问题和讨论抓住通过终端解决的所有问题,包括长尾的旗帜,引用错误,以及环境怪异. • 可核查性:一个得到接受的答案的员额,向我们提及等级或具体问题,以变成一个经沙盒检查的任务。

blocks.en: Distribution: Human-created issues, questions, and discussions capture the full spectrum of problems solved via terminal, including the long tail of flags, quoting mistakes, and environment quirks.
blocks.zh: 分布 : 人类创造的问题,问题,和讨论,抓住了通过终端解决的所有问题,包括旗帜的长尾巴,引用错误,以及环境怪异.

blocks.en: Verifiability: A post with an accepted answer gives us a reference to grade against or a concrete problem to turn into a sandbox-checked task.
blocks.zh: 可读性 : 一个得到接受的答案的帖子,让我们提到等级或一个具体问题,以变成一个经沙盒检查的任务。

blocks.en:
We curated seeds from various available web sources and technical documentation like manual pages, --help , and library docs.
For community sources, we retained only examples with accepted answers and removed low-quality or incomplete records, including those that depended on missing images. Separately, we collected thousands of documentation pages covering command-line tools, shell builtins, shell-language constructs, and Python libraries.
We then create a comprehensive taxonomy of all skillsets the model is required to have in order to solve terminal tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们从各种可用的网络来源和技术文件,如手动网页, -- -- 帮助和图书馆文件,整理种子。
对于社区消息来源来说,我们只保留了有被接受答案的例子,并删除了质量低或不完整的记录,包括那些依赖缺失图像的记录. 另外,我们收集了数千个文件页面,包括命令行工具、外壳内建、外壳语言构造和Python库。
然后,我们将模型所需的所有技能进行综合分类,以便解决终端任务。

blocks.en: Data Transformation
blocks.zh: 数据转换

blocks.en:
The first family of training documents is question-and-answer data built from community threads with accepted solutions.
Each thread is rewritten into a standalone question with its implicit assumptions made explicit, personal and site-specific context removed, and the original technical setting preserved.
The rewrite is deliberately varied so it is never a verbatim copy.
Each question is then answered independently, without access to the accepted answer, and both the rewrite and the answer are scored for fidelity, correctness, completeness, and methodology.
Answers that reach a valid conclusion by a different route than the original post are retained rather than discarded, while weak rewrites and incorrect answers are removed.
blocks.zh:
培训文件的第一个家庭是问答数据,数据来自社区线条,有公认的解决方案。
每条线被重新写成一个独立的问题,其隐含的假设是明确的,个人的和特定地点的上下文被删除,原技术设置被保留下来.
改写是有意的,因此它从来不是逐字记录。
然后每个问题都独立回答,没有获得公认的答案,而且重写和答案都按忠诚、正确性、完整性和方法来评分。
以与原帖不同的路由得出有效结论的答案被保留而不是丢弃,而弱重写和不正确的答案被删除.

blocks.en:
The second family covers hands-on terminal work.
Starting from the skillset taxonomies, we augment them with detailed metadata, such as what the skill teaches, canonical commands and their commonly used flags, and related Python packages.
We also add verifier hints for writing tests that check outcomes rather than methods.
We then pair each seed artifact with their related skill augmentations and expand them into many complete, executable tasks that include a clear instruction, a realistic workspace, a setup procedure, an initial-state check, a hidden final test, and a reference solution.
We control diversity of the training samples by covering various capability combinations and difficulty axes, such as hidden faults, distractors, or subtle traps.
We apply two levels of quality control using 1) inexpensive static checks to catch obvious problems and mismatches with the original raw seeds, and 2) a validation step in a real environment to confirm that each task starts from a valid state, fails when nothing is done, and passes once the reference solution is applied.
blocks.zh:
第二家负责操作终端工作。
从技能分类学开始,我们用详细的元数据来补充这些元数据,例如技能所教导的,犬科指令和常用的旗帜,以及相关的Python软件包.
我们还为检查结果而非方法的写作测试增加了核查提示。
然后,我们把每个种子文物与它们相关的技能增强进行配对,并将其扩展为许多完整、可执行的任务,其中包括明确的指导、现实的工作空间、设置程序、初始状态检查、隐藏的最后测试和参考解决方案。
我们通过覆盖各种能力组合和困难轴来控制训练样本的多样性,例如隐藏的断层,分心器或微妙的陷阱.
我们运用两个层次的质量控制,使用1)廉价的静态检查来捕捉与原始原始种子明显的问题和不匹配,2)在真实环境中的验证步骤来证实每项任务都是从有效状态开始的,在无所事事时失败,并在适用参考解决方案后通过.

blocks.en: Figure 14: The final Stage 2 mixture balances improvements in long-context performance against regressions in other capabilities. The figure shows score differences relative to the Stage 1 checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 图14:第2阶段最后阶段的混合物平衡了长文本性能的改进和其他能力的倒退。 该图显示与第一阶段检查站的分数差异。

blocks.en: 3.6 Stage 2 Data
blocks.zh: 3.6 第2阶段数据

blocks.en:
The Stage 2 mixture combined recall data from pretraining and Stage 1 with the following new data sources: • Organic long-context data, such as books, research articles, and code repositories.
This data naturally encodes long-range dependency, providing crucial signals for long-context learning.
Repositories are carefully selected following natural programming language distribution.
We pack the coding files in a repository into a single sequence based on their cross-file dependencies. • Synthetic long-context data.
We use a mix of in-house and open-source datasets to enhance the model’s long-range retrieval and reasoning capability.
The in-house portion is question-answer (QA) pairs generated from high-quality books across various domains with grounded context.
We also adopt several open-license datasets such as LongCite [ 42 ] , LongData, and LongAlign [ 43 ] .
blocks.zh:
第2阶段混合了来自预训和第1阶段的召回数据,并增加了以下新的数据来源: 有机长文数据,如书籍、研究文章和编码寄存器。
这个数据自然地编码了远程依赖性,为长文本学习提供了关键信号.
仓库在自然编程语言分布之后会仔细选择.
我们根据文件的交叉依赖性,将编码文件打包在一个寄存器中成一个单一的序列. • 合成长文数据。
我们利用内部和开源数据集的组合来增强模型的远程检索和推理能力.
内部部分是问答(QA)对对对,这些问答对对对来自不同领域的高质量书籍。
我们还采用多个开放许可证数据集,如LongCite [42],LongData,以及LongAlign [43].

blocks.en:
Organic long-context data, such as books, research articles, and code repositories.
This data naturally encodes long-range dependency, providing crucial signals for long-context learning.
Repositories are carefully selected following natural programming language distribution.
We pack the coding files in a repository into a single sequence based on their cross-file dependencies.
blocks.zh:
有机的长文本数据,如书籍,研究文章,和代码寄存器.
这个数据自然地编码了远程依赖性,为长文本学习提供了关键信号.
仓库在自然编程语言分布之后会仔细选择.
我们根据文件的交叉依赖性,将编码文件打包在一个寄存器中成一个单一的序列.

blocks.en:
Synthetic long-context data.
We use a mix of in-house and open-source datasets to enhance the model’s long-range retrieval and reasoning capability.
The in-house portion is question-answer (QA) pairs generated from high-quality books across various domains with grounded context.
We also adopt several open-license datasets such as LongCite [ 42 ] , LongData, and LongAlign [ 43 ] .
blocks.zh:
合成长文数据.
我们利用内部和开源数据集的组合来增强模型的远程检索和推理能力.
内部部分是问答(QA)对对对,这些问答对对对来自不同领域的高质量书籍。
我们还采用多个开放许可证数据集,如LongCite [42],LongData,以及LongAlign [43].

blocks.en:
In experiments, we noticed that the mixing weight significantly affects the trade-off between long-context performance and other general model capabilities in the context extension stage: often, we saw consistent gains on long context benchmarks like RULER but with regressions of varying degrees on other benchmarks.
Following a grid search, we selected a mixture of 50% organic long-context data, 15% synthetic long-context QA and instruction-following data, and 35% recall data from pretraining and Stage 1.
This reaches a reasonable balance as shown in Figure 14 .
blocks.zh:
在实验中,我们注意到混合重量严重影响了上下文扩展阶段长文本性能与其他一般模型能力之间的权衡:我们经常看到在长背景基准(如欧盟驻科法治团)上取得持续进展,但在其他基准上出现不同程度的倒退。
经过网格搜索,我们选择了50%有机长文本数据的混合体,15%合成长文本QA和指令跟踪数据,35%的回溯数据来自预训和第一阶段.
如图14所示,这达到了合理的平衡。

blocks.en: 4 Post-Training
blocks.zh: 4 培训后

blocks.en: Beam’s post-training pipeline combines two separately trained experts, an agentic expert and an alignment expert, through multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Each expert undergoes a short supervised fine-tuning (SFT) phase to establish response formats and tool-use syntax, followed by reinforcement learning (RL). This section describes our training approach, data generation and curation, and supporting infrastructure.
blocks.zh: Beam的训练后管道通过多教师政策提炼(MOPD),将两名受过单独培训的专家、一名代理专家和一名协调专家结合起来。 每个专家都要经过一个短期的有监督的微调(SFT)阶段,以建立响应格式和工具使用语法,然后进行强化学习(RL). 本节介绍我们的培训方法、数据生成和整理以及配套基础设施。

blocks.en: 4.1 Agentic Expert
blocks.zh: 4.1 代理专家

blocks.en: We train the agentic expert to solve reasoning and long-horizon tasks across mathematics, STEM, competitive programming, software engineering, terminal use, web search, general tool use, and professional knowledge work. Training consists of a short supervised fine-tuning (SFT) phase followed by large-scale reinforcement learning (RL). SFT establishes the response and tool-call formats and seeds reasoning behaviors; RL develops these capabilities through interaction with tasks and environments. We first describe the training procedure and its empirical behavior, then detail the training data.
blocks.zh: 我们培养代理专家,解决跨数学、STEM、竞争性编程、软件工程、终端使用、网络搜索、一般工具使用和专业知识工作的推理和长视野任务。 培训包括短期监督微调(SFT)阶段,然后是大规模强化学习(RL)。 SFT建立响应和工具调用格式以及种子推理行为;RL通过与任务和环境的互动来发展这些能力. 我们首先描述了培训程序及其经验行为,然后详细介绍了培训数据。

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Supervised Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 监督罚款

blocks.en: We initialize the agentic expert with a short SFT phase focused on chat formatting, tool-call syntax, and reasoning behavior. We generate trajectories using an earlier version of our model on a subset of the final task pool spanning all training domains. These trajectories are filtered for correctness and quality before being used for supervised training.
blocks.zh: 我们以一个简短的SFT阶段来初始化代理专家,侧重于聊天格式化,工具调用语法和推理行为. 我们在涵盖所有培训领域的最终任务库中,利用早先版本的模型生成轨迹。 这些轨迹在用于监督培训之前经过过滤,以达到正确性和质量。

blocks.en: 4.1.2 High-Compute Reinforcement Learning
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 高强度强化学习

blocks.en: We train the agentic expert using a GRPO-style policy-gradient method [ 44 ] in a fully asynchronous setting. Asynchronous execution accommodates the wide variation in rollout durations, but introduces policy staleness as training proceeds while trajectories remain in flight. Stable optimization also requires consistency between training and inference, particularly in sampling and mixture-of-experts routing. Below, we describe our approach to these challenges, our reward design, and the resulting training dynamics and performance.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GRPO式的政策分级法来训练代理专家[44] 在完全同步的环境下. 同步执行可以适应推出时间的巨大变化,但随着训练的进行,在飞行轨迹保持时,却引入了政策停滞。 稳定优化还需要培训和推断之间的一致性,特别是在取样和专家混合路线方面。 下面我们介绍我们应对这些挑战的方法、我们的奖励设计以及由此产生的培训动态和业绩。

blocks.en: Agentic tasks produce a heavy-tailed distribution of rollout durations. In our RL run, the median rollout completes in approximately 12 minutes, while roughly 2% take longer than an hour. For approximately one in five training steps, at least one contributing rollout took more than six hours. Waiting for all rollouts in each batch would therefore introduce substantial synchronization overhead.
blocks.zh: 代理任务产生重尾分布的推出期限. 在我们的RL运行中,中位数的推出大约在12分钟内完成,而大约2%需要超过1小时的时间. 大约每五个培训步骤中就有一个,至少一个贡献的推广需要六个多小时。 因此,在每一批中等待所有推出将带来大量的同步管理。

blocks.en: We decouple generation from optimization and update the inference workers after every optimizer step. In-flight rollouts continue under the updated weights without interruption, following the general approach of in-flight weight updates [ 45 ] and partial rollouts [ 46 ] . A single trajectory may consequently span multiple policy versions. We record the policy version associated with each generated token.
blocks.zh: 我们从优化中分离出一代,并在每个优化步骤后更新推断工人. 按照飞行中重量更新[45]和部分推出[46]的一般办法,飞行中重量更新继续不间断地在更新重量下展开。 因此,单一的轨迹可能跨越多个政策版本。 我们记录与每个生成的符号相关的政策版本。

blocks.en: To accommodate differences in task duration, we use task-dependent rollout deadlines. Rollouts that exceed their deadlines are discarded, and rollout groups are retained only when enough rollouts have completed.
blocks.zh: 为了适应任务期限的不同,我们采用以任务为依据的推出期限。 超过期限的推出被放弃,仅在完成足够的推出后才保留推出组.

blocks.en: Long trajectories create many opportunities to sample low-probability tokens. Such tokens can disrupt reasoning or invalidate tool calls, potentially derailing an otherwise successful trajectory. To reduce this risk, we use nucleus sampling with p = 0.99 p=0.99 [ 47 ] and temperature set to 1.0.
blocks.zh: 长轨创造了许多机会来取样低概率的符号. 这种标志可以扰乱推理或失效工具的调用,有可能使原本成功的轨迹脱轨。 为了减少这种风险,我们使用核取样,p=0.99 p=0.99 [47],温度设定为1.0。

blocks.en: Nucleus sampling changes the behavior policy by truncating and renormalizing the token distribution. Computing full-vocabulary log-probabilities during training would leave this transformation unaccounted for and introduce gradients through tokens outside the sampled nucleus. Following the approach used in DeepSeek-V3.2 [ 48 ] , we retain the nucleus 𝒩 t \mathcal{N}_{t} used at each generation step and renormalize the training policy over that same set.
blocks.zh: Nucleus采样通过折射和重新规范符号分布来改变行为策略. 在培训期间计算全省记录概率,将使这种转变下落不明,并通过抽样核心以外的符号引入梯度。 按照DeepSeek-V3.2 [48] 中使用的方法,我们保留了每代步骤中使用的N t\ mathcal{N}_{t}核心,并重新将培训政策对准同一套。

blocks.en: This aligns the support used for generation and training, eliminating the mismatch due to applying different truncation masks. It does not eliminate differences caused by policy updates or numerical effects. Logits outside the recorded nucleus receive no direct gradient from the corresponding token-level objective.
blocks.zh: 这协调了用于生成和培训的支持,消除了因使用不同的截断口罩而造成的不匹配. 它不能消除政策更新或数字效应造成的差异。 记录核以外的逻辑没有从相应的符号级目标得到直接的梯度.

blocks.en: Mixture-of-experts routing introduces another source of training–inference mismatch: small numerical differences can change a token’s top- k k expert selection and therefore its subsequent computation. We use routing replay [ 49 ] to preserve the expert assignments made during generation. The inference engine records the selected experts for each token, and the trainer reuses those assignments while recomputing the gate values.
blocks.zh: 专家混合路线引入了另一个培训来源 — — 推论不匹配:小数字差异可以改变一个符号的顶级- k 专家选择,从而改变其随后的计算。 我们使用路由重播[49] 来保存在一代人时期完成的专家任务. 推论引擎记录每个符的选定专家,教练员在重算门值时重复这些任务.

blocks.en: Router weights and load-balancing biases remain frozen during RL. Although this fixes the router parameters, expert assignments can still change as the representations entering the router evolve, making replay relevant even with a frozen router. To further reduce numerical discrepancies, we run the LM head, router, and residual stream in FP32 in both training and inference.
blocks.zh: 路由器重量和负载平衡偏差在RL期间仍然冻结. 虽然这可以修补路由器参数,但专家任务仍然可以随着进入路由器的表达方式的演进而改变,即使使用冷冻路由器,也使得重播变得相关. 为了进一步减少数字差异,我们在FP32中运行LM头,路由器和剩余流,在培训和推论中都是如此.

blocks.en: For software-engineering and terminal tasks, passing an automated verifier does not necessarily establish that a solution is valid. A model may modify tests, hard-code expected outputs, or exploit weaknesses in the evaluation harness. We therefore apply a judge 1 1 1 In developing both the agentic and alignment experts, we made use of internally configured models which are variously referred to as “graders”, “agents”, and “judges” throughout this chapter. with a reward-hacking rubric to rollouts that pass their task verifier. Only the final patch was passed to the judge for evaluation. We additionally monitor the chain-of-thought of the model to detect hacking intention but do not apply direct optimization pressure to it.
blocks.zh: 对于软件工程和终端任务,通过自动验证器并不一定确定一个解决方案是有效的. 一种模型可能会修改测试、硬码预期产出,或者利用评价手段中的弱点。 因此,我们在培养代理专家和结盟专家时,使用了内部配置的模式,这些模式在整个本章中被称为“毕业生”、“代理人”和“法官”。 上面刻着一个奖赏的标语 用来进行任务核查 只有最后的补丁被交给法官进行评价。 我们还监测模型的思维链,以发现黑客意图,但不对其施加直接的优化压力。

blocks.en: If the judge flags a rollout as reward hacking, we set its correctness score to zero while retaining its length cost. Such a rollout receives the same reward as a failed attempt of equal length. The rubrics were updated during the run to track new reward hacks as the model discovered them.
blocks.zh: 如果法官将推举为奖励黑客 我们规定其正确性得分为零 同时保留其长度成本 这种推出得到的奖励与同样时间的失败尝试相同。 随着模型的发现,Rumics在运行中被更新,以追踪新的奖励黑客.

blocks.en: Figure 15 summarizes the optimization dynamics. The gradient norm remains in a narrow range without sustained drift, with a median of 1.7 × 10 − 3 1.7\times 10^{-3} and a 99th percentile of 3.0 × 10 − 3 3.0\times 10^{-3} . The median per-token KL divergence between the sampling and training policies is 2.2 × 10 − 4 2.2\times 10^{-4} nats, and the mean absolute difference in token log-probabilities is 0.0085 0.0085 .
blocks.zh: 图15总结了优化动态。 梯度规范保持在没有持续漂移的狭长范围内,中间值为1.7×10 − 3 1.7\times 10×3},第99百分位值为3.0×10 − 3 3.0\times 10×3}. 抽样和培训政策之间每桶KL的中位差为2.2×10 − 4 2.2\times 10×4 }nats,符号对数概率的平均绝对差为0.0085 0.0085。

blocks.en: Immediately after a restart, when rollouts are generated using the current weights, the KL divergence is 8.7 × 10 − 5 8.7\times 10^{-5} nats. This provides a reference for the remaining training–inference mismatch after sampling and routing replay. During asynchronous training, sampled tokens are on average five policy versions behind the trainer, introducing an additional source of divergence.
blocks.zh: 重新启动后,当使用当前权重生成时,KL差值为8.7×10−5 8.7\times 10×5}nats。 这为在取样和路由重放后剩余的培训-推论不匹配提供了参考。 在同步培训期间,抽样的标语平均在培训者后面有五个政策版本,增加了分歧来源。

blocks.en: The mean negative log-likelihood of sampled tokens increases gradually from 0.37 to 0.50 nats over the run. The trend differs by channel: for reasoning tokens, it rises from 0.63 to 0.69 nats, while for final-answer tokens it falls from 0.25 to 0.06 nats. These measurements show distinct changes in token predictability across channels, rather than a uniform concentration of the policy.
blocks.zh: 抽取的代币的平均负对数值从0.37纳特逐渐增加至0.50纳特。 趋势因渠道而异:对于推理符,从0.63升至0.69纳特,而对于最终答案符,则从0.25升至0.06纳特. 这些衡量表明,各渠道之间的象征性可预测性有明显变化,而不是政策的统一集中。

blocks.en: Response lengths remain broadly stable within each data-mixture phase. The mixture changes five times during training. Within a phase, the median response length varies by at most one third; in phases from 52% of the run onward, it varies by less than 5%. Larger shifts coincide with changes in the mixture toward longer agentic tasks.
blocks.zh: 在每个数据混合阶段中,反应长度基本保持稳定。 混合物在训练期间会改变五次. 在某一阶段中,中位响应长度最多有三分之一不同;在阶段中,从运行的52%,变化不到5%。 更大的转变与混合物向更长的剂性任务的变化相吻合。

blocks.en: Figure 15: Optimization diagnostics during RL, including global gradient norm, per-token KL divergence between the sampling and training policies, and sampled-token negative log-likelihood. Shaded regions indicate training restricted to mathematics, STEM, and competitive programming (light), or software engineering (dark).
blocks.zh: 图15:RL期间的优化诊断,包括全球梯度规范,抽样和培训政策之间的每端KL差异,以及抽样的负对数相似性。 阴影区域表示培训仅限于数学,STEM,以及竞争性编程(光),或软件工程(暗).

blocks.en: We train the model to balance task performance against token use through an explicit reasoning-effort input and a linear length penalty. The effort setting controls the rollout budget. Rollouts that exhaust this budget are terminated and receive no correctness reward. Among solutions with equal correctness rewards, the length penalty favors shorter responses. Varying the effort setting trains the model to adapt its token use to the requested budget.
blocks.zh: 我们通过明确的推理-努力输入和线性长度惩罚来训练模型,以平衡任务性能和象征性使用. 制定工作控制了推出预算。 预算用完的推出项目将终止,得不到正确的奖励。 在具有同等正确性奖励的解决方案中,长度处罚有利于较短的答复. 不同的努力设置培训模式,使其象征性的用途适应所要求的预算。

blocks.en: Figure 16 shows DeepSWE pass@1 as a function of requested reasoning effort and realized output length. Relative to the SFT checkpoint, RL achieves higher performance at comparable output lengths and reaches comparable performance with fewer tokens. It also extends the range of effort levels over which additional computation improves performance.
blocks.zh: 图16显示 DeepSWE pass@1是所请求的推理努力和实现输出长度的函数. 相对于SFT检查站,RL在可比输出长度上实现更高的性能,并以更少的符号达到可比性能. 它还扩大了额外计算能改善业绩的努力范围。

blocks.en: At 79% of the run, the model achieves 35% pass@1 at e = 512 e=512 . The final checkpoint continues to benefit from increasing effort through e = 512 e=512 , reaching 41% pass@1. A more difficult set of software-engineering tasks is introduced at 83% of the run, between these checkpoints. These results demonstrate improvements in both token efficiency and the ability to use larger inference-time budgets effectively.
blocks.zh: 在运行的79%时,该型号在e=512 e=512时实现了35%的通过@1. 最终检查站继续受益于通过e=512 e=512的努力,达到41%通过@1。 在83%的运行量中,在这些检查站之间,提出了一套更困难的软件工程任务。 这些成果表明,在象征性效率和有效利用较大推断时间预算的能力方面都有所改善。

blocks.en: Figure 16: DeepSWE pass@1 versus requested reasoning effort (left) and realized output length (right), for the SFT checkpoint and three RL checkpoints. RL improves the trade-off between performance and token use and extends the range of reasoning budgets over which performance continues to improve. The checkpoints at 39% and 79% of the run precede the introduction of a more difficult software-engineering task set at 83%.
blocks.zh: 图16:SFT检查站和3个RL检查站的DeepSWE通过@1对请求的推理努力(左)和实现产出长度(右)。 RL改进了性能与象征性使用之间的权衡,并扩展了推理预算的范围,使得性能继续得到改善. 检查点占运行时间的39%和79%,在此之前采用了83%的更困难的软件工程任务。

blocks.en:
We evaluated checkpoints during the run on a fixed suite of benchmarks whose tasks are excluded from the RL data.
Each benchmark used the same settings throughout: temperature 1, top- p p 0.99, e = 512 e=512 and a 256K output limit (Figure 17 ).
Scores improve steadily over the run.
blocks.zh:
在运行期间,我们根据一套固定的基准对检查站进行了评估,其任务不包括在记录仪数据之内。
每个基准在整个过程中使用了相同的设置:温度1,顶端-p 0.99,e = 512 e = 512,以及256K输出限制(图17).
得分稳步上升。

blocks.en:
In two phases of the run, we trained on a limited subset of domains: 26–52% of the run used only mathematics, STEM and competitive programming, and 52–65% used only software engineering. Figure 17 shows some of the evals across these phases.
Software-engineering benchmarks held their level through the STEM-only phase, and STEM and coding benchmarks did not regress during the SWE-only phase.
Skills also transferred across domains.
The run trained on no search or browsing tasks before the 83% mark, yet BrowseComp improved from 50.1 at 27% to 57.9 at 83%. This demonstrates the generalization ability of Beam.
blocks.zh:
在运行的两个阶段中,我们只接受了有限领域的培训:26-52%的运行只使用了数学,STEM和竞争性编程,52-65%只使用了软件工程。 图17显示了这些阶段的一些评估。
软件工程基准在STEM-仅限阶段保持了水平,STEM和编码基准在SWE-仅限阶段没有倒退.
技能也在各领域之间转让。
在83%的标记前没有搜索或浏览任务的运行经过培训,然而浏览Comp却从50.1%的27%提高到57.9的83%. 这表明了Beam的通用能力.

blocks.en: 4.1.3 RL Task Curation Principles
blocks.zh: 4.1.3 RL 任务审查原则

blocks.en:
We sourced a wide pool of several million verifiable RL tasks by drawing from open source repositories, purchasing them from vendors, or generating them synthetically with in-house pipelines.
This broader pool was of variable quality and difficulty, and we aggressively filtered it down to nearly one million of the most difficult, high-quality tasks to support the final RL run.
blocks.zh:
我们从开源储存库抽取了数百万项可核查的RL任务,从销售商那里采购,或用内部管道合成这些任务。
这一范围更广的人才库质量和难度各不相同,我们积极过滤到近100万个最困难的高质量任务,以支持最后的RL运行。

blocks.en:
Across all domains, our approach to RL environment curation was one of first ensuring a high bar for both the quality and difficulty of tasks.
Then, given those constraints, we scaled to as many diverse tasks as possible to support large-scale RL.
Our process was also iterative, after scaling we often filtered again based on our observations during RL.
blocks.zh:
在所有领域,我们采用RL环境管理方法,首先确保了任务质量和难度的高度障碍。
之后,鉴于这些制约因素,我们尽可能扩大各种任务,以支持大规模保护责任。
我们的过程也是迭代的,在缩放之后,我们经常根据在RL期间的观测结果再次过滤。

blocks.en:
By “quality”, we mean tasks that have zero noise in their rewards .
This means the tasks are not misleading (e.g., they should not be missing instructions or context, they should be well-formed, and the premise of the task should be sound), hackable (i.e., reward should be given only when the task is truly solved), or otherwise broken.
Additionally, verifiers/reward functions must be robust and consistent. They should always give the same reward for the same answer.
Some measures of quality are also model specific; for example, tasks where the model can give the correct answer without chain-of-thought, or in which a successful hack was observed.
blocks.zh:
我们所说的“质量”是指在报酬方面没有噪音的任务。
这意味着任务不会产生误导(例如,它们不应该是缺少指令或上下文,它们应该造型良好,任务的前提应该健全),可以黑客化(即只有在任务真正解决时才给予奖励),或者以其他方式破解.
此外,核查人/奖励人的职能必须健全和一致。 他们应该总是对同样的答案给予同样的奖励。
一些质量度量标准也是模型特异性的;例如,模型可以在没有思维链的情况下给出正确答案,或者观察到成功黑客的任务.

blocks.en:
By “difficulty”, we mean difficulty for training a particular model. This means the task must neither be too hard (i.e., all or mostly zero rewards in a group) nor too easy (i.e., all or mostly full rewards in a group).
Moreover, we work to ensure the task is not classified as “too hard” or “too easy” for the wrong reasons, such as: tasks where the answer is leaked in the question (making it seem artificially easy), evaluating the model with insufficient context (making it seem artificially hard), chat template formatting errors (masking the true difficulty), or impossible questions (which can lead to hacking behavior during evaluation, see [ 50 ] ).
In particular, there are a long tail of domain-specific failure modes that can make tasks seem artificially hard, such as not being able to access a particular website, overly strict memory/time requirements, and various sandboxing issues.
Some of these are described in more detail below in the domain-specific sections.
The sandbox service’s network controls are described in Section 6.6.5 .
blocks.zh:
“困难”是指培训某一特定模式的困难。 这意味着任务既不能过于艰巨(即在团体中全部或大部分为零奖励),也不能过于轻易(即在团体中全部或大部分为全额奖励).
此外,我们努力确保任务不会由于错误的原因被归类为“太难”或“太容易”,例如:问题中答案漏出的任务(使其看起来是人为的容易),上下文不足的评价模型(使其看起来是人为的硬),聊天模板格式化错误(掩盖真正的困难),或不可能的问题(这可能导致在评价过程中黑客行为,见[50]).
特别是,有很长的尾巴的域特定故障模式可以使任务看起来人为地困难,如无法访问特定网站,内存/时间要求过于严格,以及各种沙箱问题.
下文各具体领域章节将更详细地阐述其中一些问题。
第6.6.5节介绍了沙盒服务的网络控制。

blocks.en:
We sourced tasks from open-source repositories, purchased them from vendors, or generated them from our own in-house synthetic pipelines.
Existing open-source environments were valuable earlier in our development cycle; however, we found that when used in large-scale RL with a performant model like Beam, they required extensive quality and difficulty filtering.
Vendor-sourced tasks are high-quality and high-difficulty, but expensive.
We found that developing our own in-house pipelines allowed us to satisfy the quality, difficulty, and scale requirements for large-scale RL on Beam.
blocks.zh:
我们从开源的储存库中找到任务,从销售商那里购买,或者从我们自己的内部合成管道中产生。
现有的开源环境在我们开发周期的早些时候是有价值的;然而,我们发现,当使用Beam等表演模型的大规模RL时,需要广泛的质量和困难过滤.
供应商来源的任务质量高,难度大,但费用昂贵.
我们发现,开发我们自己的内部管道使我们能够满足Beam上大规模RL的质量、难度和规模要求。

blocks.en:
To ensure the generality of our model, we curated tasks across a wide diversity of task formats, programming languages, tool combinations, and topics.
We applied the deduplication and decontamination procedure described in Section 4.1.4 .
blocks.zh:
为了确保我们模式的通用性,我们负责各种任务格式、编程语言、工具组合和专题。
我们采用了第4.1.4节所述的去重复和去污程序。

blocks.en:
We considered our task pools to be ever-changing: following every round of experimentation, we analyzed rollouts and tried to understand if agent successes or failures could be attributed to issues in the tasks.
For example, reward hacks newly observed in a training run led to tasks being removed.
Although the pool of tasks shrank over time, we converged on a set that had the highest quality possible.
blocks.zh:
我们认为,我们的任务组合正在不断变化:在每轮试验之后,我们分析展开情况,并试图了解代理人的成功或失败能否归因于任务中的问题。
例如,在一次训练中新观察到的奖励黑客导致任务被移除.
虽然任务组合随时间推移而缩减,但我们在一套质量尽可能最高的组合上凝聚在一起。

blocks.en: 4.1.4 Deduplication and Decontamination
blocks.zh: 4.1.4 消散和消散

blocks.en:
For post-training task curation, we checked incoming training samples against a shared collection of previously registered samples and excluded identified exact and near-duplicates from training.
These checks addressed both repetition within the training data and contamination from evaluation samples.
We used a Jaccard similarity threshold of 0.95 for comparisons between training samples.
When either sample belonged to an evaluation, we lowered the threshold to 0.80 to detect a broader range of potential contamination.
The following section describes the matching procedure.
blocks.zh:
对于培训后的任务指导,我们对照以前登记的样本的共享收集,检查了收到的培训样本,并将已确定的确切和近似重复的样本排除在培训之外。
这些检查既涉及培训数据中的重复,也涉及评价样本中的污染。
我们用一个0.95的Jaccard相似阈值来比较训练样本。
当任何一个样本属于评估时,我们把阈值降低到0.80,以检测更广泛的潜在污染。
下一节介绍匹配程序.

blocks.en:
We represented each sample as a set of overlapping character 7-grams: every consecutive sequence of seven characters in its text.
For two sets A A and B B , Jaccard similarity measures the fraction of distinct n-grams shared by both samples relative to those present in either.
Jaccard distance is one minus this similarity: J ⁡ ( A , B ) = | A ∩ B | | A ∪ B | , d J ​ ( A , B ) = 1 − J ⁡ ( A , B ) . J(A,B)=\frac{|A\cap B|}{|A\cup B|},\qquad d_{J}(A,B)=1-J(A,B). Identical n-gram sets have distance zero; sets with no shared n-grams have distance one.
Small edits can preserve much of the overlap, allowing detection of near-duplicates as well as exact copies.
blocks.zh:
我们代表每个样本为一组重叠字符7克:其文本中每个连续七个字符的序列.
对于两套A和B,Jaccar的相似性衡量两个样本所共有的显著正克数与两个样本中存在的正克数的比例。
Jaccard距离是1减去这一相似性:J = ⁡ (A,B) = | (A,B) | (A,B) | (A,B) | (A,B) = (A,B) =\ (A,B) =\ (Frac) {| (A,B) \ (A) \ (A,B) \ (Cap) = (A,B). B|}{|A\cup B|},\qquad d_{J}(A,B)=1-J(A,B). 相同的n格子集有距离0;没有共享n格子的集有距离1.
小的编辑可以保留大部分重叠,可以检测到近复制件以及准确的复制件.

blocks.en:
To avoid comparing every pair of samples, we used MinHash to summarize each n-gram set in a compact signature and locality-sensitive hashing (LSH) to retrieve likely matches.
This allowed searches over a large collection without comparing each incoming sample directly with every stored example.
We then calculated exact Jaccard similarity for each retrieved candidate and accepted a match only when it met the relevant threshold.
blocks.zh:
为避免比较每对样本,我们利用MinHash在紧凑的签名和对地点敏感的散列(LSH)中总结了每组n-g,以获取可能的匹配.
这样就可以在大型收藏上搜索,而不直接将每个收到的样本与每个存储的例子进行比较。
然后,我们计算出每个被检索候选人的精确的Jaccard相似性,只有在符合相关门槛时才接受匹配。

blocks.en:
MinHash LSH provides probabilistic retrieval: more similar pairs are more likely to be retrieved, but some pairs that meet the threshold may be missed.
Exact verification ensures that accepted matches satisfy the similarity criterion; it does not guarantee that every near-duplicate is found.
blocks.zh:
米纳什 LSH提供概率检索:更相似的对子更容易被检索,但一些达到阈值的对子可能会被错过.
准确的核查确保所接受的匹配符合相似性标准;它不能保证找到每一个近似重复。

blocks.en:
The method does not assess semantic similarity.
Paraphrases, translations, and short questions embedded in much longer documents can have low Jaccard similarity.
We therefore treat deduplication as a practical but imperfect control on repetition and contamination.
blocks.zh:
该方法不评估语义相似性.
参数,翻译,以及嵌入较长文档中的短问题,可以具有较低的Jaccard相似性.
因此,我们把分解视为对重复和污染的一种实际但不完善的控制。

blocks.en: 4.1.5 Software Engineering (SWE)
blocks.zh: 4.1.5 软件工程

blocks.en:
Training software engineering agents with reinforcement learning requires diverse repository-level tasks and reliable feedback on whether a solution implements the requested behavior.
We constructed executable environments from changes mined from software repositories and from synthetic feature-implementation tasks.
Our approach combined environment reconstruction, behavioral verification, and task-quality assessment, building on recent work on scalable SWE environment construction [ 51 , 52 ] .
blocks.zh:
培训具有强化学习功能的软件工程代理商需要不同的存储层任务和关于解决方案是否执行所请求的行为的可靠反馈.
我们根据从软件储存库和合成特性执行任务中挖掘出来的变化构建了可执行环境。
我们的方法将环境重建、行为核查和任务质量评估结合起来,以最近关于可扩展的SWE环境建设的工作为基础[51、52]。

blocks.en: Task Curation
blocks.zh: 任务描述

blocks.en:
We used agents to turn mined repository changes into executable training tasks, drawing on methods for agentic environment construction described in SWE-Universe [ 53 ] and DockSmith [ 54 ] .
Starting from the repository at its pre-change revision, an agent inspected the source and test patches, dependency manifests, and continuous integration configuration to discover the required dependencies, build steps, and affected tests.
It specified the environment setup and wrote a verifier, using execution feedback to diagnose failures and iteratively refine both.
The agent packaged the resulting setup into a reproducible container image which included a problem statement, an executable repository snapshot, a reference implementation, and a verifier.
blocks.zh:
我们利用SWE-Universe [53] 和DockSmith [54]中描述的代理环境构建方法,将地雷储存器的变化转化为可执行的培训任务。
从寄存器在更改前的修订开始,一个代理检查了源和测试补丁,依赖性清单,以及持续的集成配置,以发现所需的依赖性,构建步骤,并影响测试.
它指定了环境设置,并写了一个验证符,利用执行反馈来诊断失败,并迭代地完善两者.
代理商将由此产生的设置包装成可复制的容器图像,其中包括一个问题说明、一个可执行的仓库快照、一个参考执行和一个核查人。

blocks.en:
We independently validated the constructed environment by running the verifier before and after the reference change, requiring it to fail before the change (“fail-to-pass”) and pass after it while rejecting observed regressions (“pass-to-pass”).
We also revalidated tasks through the patch-submission and grading path used in training, including submission extraction and application in a separate verifier environment.
This checked that the task remained executable under the training environment’s resource and isolation constraints.
blocks.zh:
我们独立地验证了建筑环境,在参考更改之前和之后运行核查器,要求核查器在更改之前失败(“无法通过”),并在更改之后通过,同时拒绝观察到的回归(“通过通过”)。
我们还通过培训中使用的补丁提交和分级路径,包括在单独的核查环境中提取和应用提交,重新验证任务。
这证明,在培训环境的资源和孤立的限制下,这项任务仍然可以执行。

blocks.en:
Execution validity alone does not establish that a task provides a useful learning signal—for example, task prompts can be under-specified, making it difficult for an agent to solve the task in a way that the verifier expects.
We separately assessed specification clarity and test adequacy, properties also studied in SPICE [ 55 ] and SWE-rebench V2 [ 51 ] .
The requested behavior had to be sufficiently specified by the problem statement and visible repository context (which we refer to as the “solver-visible specification”), and the verifier had to meaningfully test that behavior.
blocks.zh:
执行有效性本身并不能确定一项任务能提供有用的学习信号——例如,任务提示可能不够明确,使得代理者难以以核查者预期的方式解决任务.
我们分别评估了规格的清晰度和测试的充分性,特性也在SPICE [55] 和SWE-rebench V2 [51]中进行了研究.
所请求的行为必须被问题说明和可见寄存器上下文(我们称之为“溶剂-可见规格”)充分具体说明,核查者必须切实检验这种行为。

blocks.en:
We developed judges to assess the problem statement, reference implementation, tests, and verification command against separate criteria.
These models checked that: • Statements describe an actionable change without leaking the solution or depending on unavailable attachments or discussions. • Tests agree with the stated requirements, assert meaningful behavior, and permit equivalent correct implementations. • Reference fixes are relevant to the requested change, and do not have hard-coded answers or modifications to test files. • Verifier commands do not manufacture success, suppress failures, or substitute superficial checks for behavioral tests. Repairable descriptions were rewritten and reassessed; tasks with unresolved integrity defects were excluded.
blocks.zh:
我们开发了法官来根据不同的标准评估问题说明、参考执行、测试和核查命令。
这些模型检查了: 发言描述了可采取行动的改变,而没有泄露解决办法,或取决于没有附件或讨论。 • 支助 测试同意所申明的要求,坚持有意义的行为,允许同等的正确执行。 • 参考修正与要求的修改相关,没有硬编码的答案或对测试文件的修改。 • 校验命令不制造成功、抑制失败或用表面检查代替行为测试。 重写和重新评估了可修复的描述;排除了未解决完整性缺陷的任务。

blocks.en: Statements describe an actionable change without leaking the solution or depending on unavailable attachments or discussions.
blocks.zh: 声明描述了在不泄露解决办法或视无法提供的附件或讨论的情况下可采取行动的变化。

blocks.en: Tests agree with the stated requirements, assert meaningful behavior, and permit equivalent correct implementations.
blocks.zh: 测试同意所申明的要求,坚持有意义的行为,允许同等的正确执行。

blocks.en: Reference fixes are relevant to the requested change, and do not have hard-coded answers or modifications to test files.
blocks.zh: 引用修正与请求的更改相关,对测试文件没有硬编码的答案或修改.

blocks.en: Verifier commands do not manufacture success, suppress failures, or substitute superficial checks for behavioral tests.
blocks.zh: 校验命令不会制造成功,压制失败,或者用表面检查代替行为测试.

blocks.en:
A second, stricter review examined whether (1) every tested requirement could be determined from the solver-visible specification, (2) whether the tests enforced the requested behavior, and (3) whether trivial or incomplete implementations could pass.
The reference implementation was withheld from this assessment to avoid biasing the review with information unavailable to the solver.
Each of these criteria received three independent model calls, with any valid negative judgment rejecting the task.
blocks.zh:
第二次更严格的审查审查了:(1) 每一项经测试的要求能否从可看见的解答器规格中确定,(2) 测试是否强制要求的行为,以及(3) 是否可通过微不足道或不完整的执行。
本次评估中不采用参考执行办法,以避免将审查与解决者无法获得的信息相偏差。
每一个标准都收到三个独立的模式电话,任何有效的否定判断都拒绝这项任务。

blocks.en:
We complemented artifact-based checks with agentic audits that inspected repositories, traced verification logic, and executed candidate implementations.
Two judges assessed the agreement between the solver-visible specification and the verifier in complementary directions. • The ambiguity judge checked whether the requirements enforced by the tests were justified by the specification.
It looked for cases where the available information permitted multiple reasonable implementations, but the verifier accepted only some of them.
The agent examined repository code, documentation, and established interfaces for context that resolved the apparent ambiguity.
Where practical, the agent constructed and executed an alternative implementation to demonstrate that the verifier rejected behavior consistent with the visible specification. • The verifier-strength judge checked whether the tests enforced the requested behavior.
Before inspecting hidden tests or the reference implementation, the agent recorded the independently testable requirements established by the prompt and starting repository.
It then mapped each requirement to the verification logic, checking whether violating that requirement would cause a failure.
The agent then attempted to generate incomplete or incorrect implementations that exploited gaps in verification.
Such bypasses had to be discoverable from solver-visible information, rather than depend on privileged knowledge of hidden tests.
blocks.zh:
我们通过对储存库进行检查、追踪核查逻辑以及执行候选人执行的代理审计来补充基于文物的检查。
两名法官评估了可看见的解决者规格与核查者之间的协议。 模棱两可的法官检查了检验所执行的要求是否符合规格。
它研究了现有信息允许多种合理执行的情况,但核查人只接受了其中一些。
该代理人检查了寄存器代码、文件,并建立了解决明显模糊性的背景界面。
在实际可行的情况下,代理人构建并实施了替代执行,以证明核查人拒绝符合明显规格的行为。 核查员-强化法官检查测试是否强制要求的行为。
在检查隐性测试或参考执行之前,该剂记录了由即时和起始寄存器确定的独立可测试要求.
然后,它将每一项要求都与核查逻辑联系起来,检查是否违反这一要求会导致失败。
然后,该代理人试图产生不完全或不正确的执行,利用核查方面的差距。
这种绕行必须能够从溶解器可见的信息中发现,而不是依赖于对隐藏测试的特权知识.

blocks.en:
The ambiguity judge checked whether the requirements enforced by the tests were justified by the specification.
It looked for cases where the available information permitted multiple reasonable implementations, but the verifier accepted only some of them.
The agent examined repository code, documentation, and established interfaces for context that resolved the apparent ambiguity.
Where practical, the agent constructed and executed an alternative implementation to demonstrate that the verifier rejected behavior consistent with the visible specification.
blocks.zh:
模棱两可的法官检查了检验所执行的要求是否符合规格。
它研究了现有信息允许多种合理执行的情况,但核查人只接受了其中一些。
该代理人检查了寄存器代码、文件,并建立了解决明显模糊性的背景界面。
在实际可行的情况下,代理人构建并执行了替代执行,以证明核查人拒绝符合可见规格的行为。

blocks.en:
The verifier-strength judge checked whether the tests enforced the requested behavior.
Before inspecting hidden tests or the reference implementation, the agent recorded the independently testable requirements established by the prompt and starting repository.
It then mapped each requirement to the verification logic, checking whether violating that requirement would cause a failure.
The agent then attempted to generate incomplete or incorrect implementations that exploited gaps in verification.
Such bypasses had to be discoverable from solver-visible information, rather than depend on privileged knowledge of hidden tests.
blocks.zh:
核查员-强化法官检查测试是否强制要求的行为。
在检查隐性测试或参考执行之前,该剂记录了由即时和起始寄存器确定的独立可测试要求.
然后,它将每一项要求都与核查逻辑联系起来,检查是否违反这一要求会导致失败。
然后,该代理人试图产生不完全或不正确的执行,利用核查方面的差距。
这种绕行必须能够从溶解器可见的信息中发现,而不是依赖于对隐藏测试的特权知识.

blocks.en:
Any tasks which failed to pass the static and agentic validation steps were discarded.
We curated the resulting pool across programming languages and repositories, limited repeated variants of the same underlying change, and removed tasks that a reference model solved reliably.
We also excluded task identities and patch matches associated with held-out evaluations.
These stages produced a broad corpus of executable software changes spanning multiple language ecosystems.
blocks.zh:
未能通过静态和代理验证步骤的任何任务都被放弃。
我们管理了编程语言和寄存器之间的编程集合,同一基本变化的有限重复变体,并取消了参照模型可靠解决的任务。
我们还排除了与被搁置评价有关的任务身份和补丁匹配。
这些阶段产生了涵盖多种语言生态系统的广泛可执行软件变化。

blocks.en:
We curated an initial pool of candidate tasks, including those from our own pipeline, from proprietary vendor tasks, and from existing open-source SWE corpora: SWE-Gym [ 56 ] , R2E-Gym [ 57 ] , SWE-rebench V2 [ 51 ] , Multi-SWE-RL [ 58 ] , MEnvData [ 59 ] , SWE-smith [ 60 ] , and Scale-SWE [ 61 ] .
We subsampled from this set by balancing programming languages and filtering for quality and difficulty. Figure 18 visualizes the distribution of a subset of tasks from this final pool.
blocks.zh:
我们管理了一系列初步候选任务,包括来自我们管道的任务、来自专有供应商的任务、以及来自现有的开放源代码SWE公司的任务:SWE-Gym [56]、R2E-Gym [57]、SWE-rebench V2 [51]、Multi-SWE-RL [58]、MenvData [59]、SWE-smith [60] 和Scale-SWE [61]。
我们从这一集中抽取了平衡编程语言和筛选质量和难度的样本。 图18可视化此最终集合中一组任务的分布.

blocks.en:
Figure 18: Semantic Structure of the SWE Task Corpus. Each point represents a task, positioned by a t-SNE projection of embeddings of behavioral summaries and colored by programming language.
Labels describe communities identified in the original embedding space.
The figure shows 12K mined tasks and 1.5K synthesized feature tasks sampled from the full pool.
Sample proportions do not represent final training-mixture weights; projected distances and areas are not quantitative measures of coverage or difficulty.
blocks.zh:
图18: SWE任务公司语义结构. 每个点代表一项任务,定位为t-SNE对嵌入行为摘要的投影,并用编程语言配色.
标签描述在原始嵌入空间中识别的群落.
图中显示从全库抽取的12K地雷任务和1.5K综合特征任务.
抽样比例并不代表最后的培训-混合权重;预测的距离和地区不是衡量覆盖面或难度的量化尺度。

blocks.en: Synthetic Feature-Implementation Tasks
blocks.zh: 合成特性-执行任务

blocks.en:
In addition to the pipeline described above, we found synthetic task generation to provide a complementary way to expand the range of software changes available for training.
We generated feature-implementation tasks by having an agent examine a working repository’s documentation and source code.
The agent identified a substantial feature, and removed its implementation and associated tests.
The removed behavior was specified as a new implementation task and evaluated with hidden integration tests designed to permit alternative implementations.
We required the remaining repository tests to pass after removal, and the feature verifier to fail without the feature and pass when the reference implementation was restored.
This construction extended the task distribution to larger changes spanning multiple files and subsystems.
blocks.zh:
除了上述管道外,我们发现合成任务生成提供了一种补充方法,以扩大可用于培训的软件更改范围。
我们通过让代理人检查工作存放处的文件和源代码,产生了特性执行任务。
该代理人确定了一个实质性特征,并取消了其执行和相关测试。
被移除的行为被指定为新的执行任务,并以隐蔽的整合测试进行评估,以允许替代执行.
我们要求剩余的寄存器测试在移除后通过,特征验证器在没有特征的情况下失败,并在恢复引用执行时通过.
这一构建将任务分布扩展到跨越多个文件和子系统的较大变化.

blocks.en:
Synthetic tasks received additional checks specific to feature removal.
We inspected prompts for leaked implementation details, rebuilt derived artifacts from the modified repository, and scanned images for surviving copies of the removed code or tests.
Adversarial agents attempted to recover leaked artifacts and use them to obtain a passing result.
Verifier guards also rejected unauthorized changes to test-selection configuration and import hooks.
Tasks were required to pass three independent environment-validation trials under the training resource limits, excluding tasks with inconsistent outcomes.
blocks.zh:
合成任务收到了针对特性删除的额外检查。
我们检查了泄露的实施细节的提示,从经修改的存放处重建出产的文物,并扫描了被删除代码或测试的剩余副本的图像。
不良物剂试图回收泄露的文物,并利用这些文物获得过路结果.
校验者卫士还拒绝了对测试选择配置和导入钩子的未经授权的修改.
在培训资源限制下,需要通过三次独立的环境验证试验,但不包括结果不一致的任务。

blocks.en: Reward Hacking
blocks.zh: 奖励打包

blocks.en:
We also addressed reward hacking during training.
To minimize the risk of hacking, the solver’s submitted patch was evaluated in a separate environment, preventing it from directly carrying changes to its execution environment into the verifier.
We also cleaned repository images to remove post-change commit history and artifacts that could expose the reference solution.
For submissions that passed the tests, an additional model-based judge examined the submitted code and verifier for evidence of reward hacking; submissions classified as successful hacks received zero reward.
blocks.zh:
我们还在训练中解决了奖励黑客问题。
为了尽量减少黑客入侵的风险,解码员提交的补丁在一个单独的环境中得到了评价,使其无法直接将执行环境的变化带入验证器.
我们还清理了存储器的图像,以删除变革后的历史和文物,这些历史和文物可能暴露出参考解决方案。
对于通过测试的提交材料,另外一名基于模型的法官审查了提交的代码和验证人,以获取奖励黑客的证据;被归类为成功黑客的提交材料得到的奖励为零。

blocks.en:
We additionally analyzed groups of rollouts for submission failures, inconsistent grades on identical or closely similar patches, and suspicious passing solutions.
Task-health judges investigated whether groups with no successful solutions reflected genuine difficulty, underspecified requirements, broken environments, or grading failures.
Reward-integrity judges assessed whether successful solutions exploited test gaps or whether hidden tests required unsupported assumptions.
These analyses supported ongoing diagnosis of task quality, complementing construction-time filtering and online reward checks.
blocks.zh:
我们还分析了提交失败、相同或非常相似的补丁上的成绩不一致以及可疑的流传解决办法。
任务保健法官调查了没有成功解决办法的群体是否反映了真正的困难、不明确的要求、破碎的环境或分级失败。
奖励整合法官评估成功解决方案是否利用了测试差距,或者隐性测试是否需要不支持的假设。
这些分析有助于目前对任务质量的诊断,补充施工时间过滤和在线奖励检查。

blocks.en: 4.1.6 Terminal Use
blocks.zh: 4.1.6 终端使用

blocks.en:
Equipping an agent with a bash tool—a single interface for executing arbitrary shell commands—has become the dominant way to give a text-only language model autonomous control over a computer.
Through it, an agent can perform highly skilled work spanning software engineering, system administration, scientific computing, machine learning, and cybersecurity [ 62 ] .
blocks.zh:
向代理商配备一个 bash 工具—— 一个执行任意 shell 命令的单一接口—— 已经成为给计算机一个只使用文本的语言模型自主控制的主要方式。
通过它,代理人可以从事高技能的工作,涉及软件工程、系统管理、科学计算、机器学习和网络安全[62]。

blocks.en: Task Curation
blocks.zh: 任务描述

blocks.en:
We began by sourcing tasks both from vendors and our own synthetic pipelines, all following the Harbor format [ 63 ] .
We also investigated open-source terminal-use tasks, but we found these did not meet our quality bar.
Through our curation pipelines, tasks were filtered based on diversity, quality, and difficulty (described in the sections below).
blocks.zh:
我们从销售商和我们自己的合成管道中寻找任务开始,这些任务都遵循了港口格式[63]。
我们还调查了开源终端使用任务,但我们发现这些任务不符合我们的质量标准。
通过我们的管理管道,根据多样性、质量和困难对任务进行了过滤(见下文各节)。

blocks.en:
With terminal agents operating across a wide range of downstream tasks, we needed to ensure appropriate diversity in our training environments.
We considered task diversity along three dimensions. These dimensions were used to develop taxonomies that allowed us to better characterize each task: • Subject matter: 20 categories and 182 domains capturing realistic workflows and activities that can be performed in a terminal. • Task properties: 14 properties and 244 subproperties that describe the intent of a task, initial state of the environment, applicable constraints, and deliverables types. • Instruction style: 7 styles and 34 substyles representative of the ways in which users typically interact with terminal agents. All tasks were labeled against the taxonomies, providing up to 460 tags per task.
Shown in Figure 19 is an example of the “task intent” across the environments used in training.
Each task may have multiple intents to better represent complex multi-step workflows.
Together with embedding-based similarity checks, these tags allowed us to filter out near-duplicates or templated tasks, and ensured that each task seen in training covered a distinct aspect seen in real terminal workflows.
blocks.zh:
随着终端人员在广泛的下游任务中运作,我们需要确保培训环境的适当多样性。
我们从三个方面审议了任务的多样性。 这些维度被用来开发分类,使我们能够更好地描述每项任务的特点:主题:20个类别和182个域,包含现实的工作流程和活动,可以在终端进行。 • 支助 任务属性:14个属性和244个子属性,描述任务的意图,初始环境状况,适用的制约,以及可交付品类型. • 指导风格:7个风格和34个子风格,代表用户与终端代理的典型互动方式。 所有任务都被贴上分类标签,每个任务最多提供460个标记.
图19显示的是培训中使用的各种环境中的“任务意图”。
每项任务可能有多种意图更好地代表复杂的多步骤工作流程。
这些标签加上基于嵌入的相似性检查,使我们能够筛选出近似重复或模板化的任务,并确保在培训中看到的每一项任务都涵盖在真正的终端工作流程中看到的显著方面。

blocks.en: Subject matter: 20 categories and 182 domains capturing realistic workflows and activities that can be performed in a terminal.
blocks.zh: 事由:20个类别和182个域,包含可在终端执行的现实工作流程和活动。

blocks.en: Task properties: 14 properties and 244 subproperties that describe the intent of a task, initial state of the environment, applicable constraints, and deliverables types.
blocks.zh: 任务属性:14个属性和244个子属性,描述任务的意图,初始环境状况,适用的制约,以及可交付品类型.

blocks.en: Instruction style: 7 styles and 34 substyles representative of the ways in which users typically interact with terminal agents.
blocks.zh: 指令样式:7个样式和34个子样式,代表用户一般与终端代理互动的方式.

blocks.en:
Figure 19: Intent distribution across terminal use tasks.
Circles denote synthetic tasks; squares denote vendor tasks.
blocks.zh:
图19:各终端使用任务的意向分布.
圆形表示合成任务;方形表示销售者任务.

blocks.en:
All of our tasks went through multiple filtering stages to ensure that only the highest-quality tasks were retained for training.
These stages focused on flagging and removing tasks that could be detrimental for RL, such as those with flawed environments that made the goal unachievable, noisy or misaligned verifiers, and tasks that exposed privileged information allowing agents to bypass the intended work.
blocks.zh:
我们的所有任务都经过了多个过滤阶段,以确保只保留最高质量的任务进行培训。
这些阶段的重点是标注和清除可能对RL有害的任务,例如那些环境有缺陷,使目标无法实现、吵闹或不一致的核查者的任务,以及暴露特权信息,使特工能够绕过预定工作的任务。

blocks.en: Upfront rule-based methods were used to check for basic compatibility with Reflection’s internal sandbox infrastructure and task completeness: 1. Tasks had to be fully Harbor compatible. 2. Dockerfiles had to be well-structured to maximize layer reuse (see Section 6.6.3 ). 3. Any images associated with a task had to be buildable. 4. An “Oracle” script containing the reference solution had to consistently return a reward of 1.0 across 5 attempts. 5. A “no-op” script had to consistently return a reward of 0.0 across 5 attempts. 6. Checks for privileged information had to show no unintended information leakage in the agent sandbox.
blocks.zh: 使用基于规则的前期方法来检查与Reflection的内部沙盒基础设施和任务完整性的基本兼容性: 1. 任务必须完全与港口兼容。 2. 多克文件必须结构完善,以尽量多地重复使用(见第6.6.3节)。 3. 与一项任务有关的任何图像都必须可以建立。 4. 载有参考解决方案的 " Oracle " 脚本必须始终如一地在5次尝试中回报1.0的回报。 5. " 不开放 " 剧本必须始终如一地在5次尝试中回报0.0的奖励。 6. 对特殊信息的检查必须表明,在代理沙盒中没有意外的信息泄漏。

blocks.en: Tasks had to be fully Harbor compatible.
blocks.zh: 任务必须完全兼容港湾。

blocks.en: Dockerfiles had to be well-structured to maximize layer reuse (see Section 6.6.3 ).
blocks.zh: Dockerfiles必须结构完善,以便尽量多用一层(见第6.6.3节)。

blocks.en: Any images associated with a task had to be buildable.
blocks.zh: 任何与任务相关的图像都必须可以构建.

blocks.en: An “Oracle” script containing the reference solution had to consistently return a reward of 1.0 across 5 attempts.
blocks.zh: 载有参考解决方案的“甲骨文”脚本必须始终如一地在5次尝试中回报1.0的回报。

blocks.en: A “no-op” script had to consistently return a reward of 0.0 across 5 attempts.
blocks.zh: 一份“不公开”的剧本不得不在5次尝试中不断退回0.0的奖励。

blocks.en: Checks for privileged information had to show no unintended information leakage in the agent sandbox.
blocks.zh: 特殊信息的检查必须显示代理沙盒没有意外的信息泄漏.

blocks.en:
All tasks went through a comprehensive set of over 15 quality checks using an agentic judge to measure properties that rule-based methods couldn’t detect.
For instance, we checked for consistency between all of the requirements or constraints explicitly mentioned in the instructions, or those directly inferrable from the environment, and the behaviors tested for in the verifiers.
The definitions for each of these checks were updated over time based on the following feedback: • Expert human annotators were used to measure the efficiency of the automated checks and surface misalignment between the intent of the check and the model-produced judgments. • Newly discovered quality issues or systemic flaws observed in batches of vendor or synthetic tasks resulted in definitions being expanded.
For instance, we found that a subset of synthetic tasks required the agent to interact with “black-box” binaries that the agent was freely able to access and reverse-engineer.
blocks.zh:
所有任务都经过了15次以上的全面质量检查,
例如,我们检查了说明中明确提到的所有要求或限制,或直接从环境中推断出来的要求或限制,与核查者测试的行为之间的一致性。
• 利用专家人名注释员衡量自动检查的效率,以及检查意图与模型制作的判断之间的表面不一致。 · 新发现的质量问题或在批次供应商或合成任务中发现的系统性缺陷导致定义扩大。
例如,我们发现,一组合成任务要求代理人与“黑盒”二进制器进行互动,而代理人可以自由访问和反向工程。

blocks.en: Expert human annotators were used to measure the efficiency of the automated checks and surface misalignment between the intent of the check and the model-produced judgments.
blocks.zh: 使用专家人名注释器衡量自动检查的效率以及检查意图与模型制作的判断之间的表面错位。

blocks.en:
Newly discovered quality issues or systemic flaws observed in batches of vendor or synthetic tasks resulted in definitions being expanded.
For instance, we found that a subset of synthetic tasks required the agent to interact with “black-box” binaries that the agent was freely able to access and reverse-engineer.
blocks.zh:
新发现的质量问题或在批次供应商或合成任务中发现的系统性缺陷导致定义扩大。
例如,我们发现,一组合成任务要求代理人与“黑盒”二进制器进行互动,而代理人可以自由访问和反向工程。

blocks.en: By continuously monitoring task quality, and the reliability of our automated quality checks, we were able to make targeted improvements to synthetic pipelines and work with vendors to improve upstream task quality.
blocks.zh: 通过不断监测任务质量和我们自动质量检查的可靠性,我们能够有针对性地改进合成管道,并与供应商合作,提高上游任务质量。

blocks.en:
Static checks through oracle scripts are necessary but not sufficient to assess the health of a task: the oracle scripts do not always exercise the solution paths that an agent may find, and they can obfuscate fundamental issues with the agent environment.
We therefore validated tasks through end-to-end rollouts with live agents.
We discarded tasks that a strong model failed to solve within k k attempts.
Although repeated failure does not prove that a task is ill-specified or impossible, it provided a practical filtering criterion.
For successful rollouts, we used a judge to check for reward hacking and environment issues, such as missing tools, that may have interfered with the intended solution.
blocks.zh:
通过甲骨文进行静态检查是必要的,但不足以评估任务的健康性:甲骨文并非总能行使一个代理商可能找到的解决方案路径,它们可以将基本问题与代理商环境混淆.
因此,我们通过与现场人员进行端到端的推广来验证任务。
我们放弃了在 kk 尝试中无法解决的强模型的任务 。
虽然一再失败并不能证明一项任务没有规定或不可能,但它提供了一个实际的过滤标准。
为了成功推出,我们用一名法官检查奖励黑客和环境问题,例如缺失的工具,这些可能干扰了预期的解决办法。

blocks.en:
We also performed substantial filtering of reward-hackable tasks.
To do so, we built an adversarial agent that actively attempted to obtain a reward of 1.0 with an insufficient or incorrect solution.
The agent was provided with a full taxonomy of reward hacks and instructed to test out different approaches to fully assess the robustness of the verifiers.
We filtered out all tasks that were hacked by this agent.
blocks.zh:
我们还对可奖励的任务进行了大量的过滤。
为此,我们建立了一个对抗方代理人,积极试图以不充分或不正确的解决办法获得1.0的奖励。
向代理人提供了奖励黑客的完整分类,并指示测试不同方法,以全面评估核查者的稳健性.
我们过滤了所有被这个特工侵入的任务

blocks.en:
Verifiers are central to RL: they evaluate an agent’s work and produce the reward used for training.
Their quality directly shapes the training signal.
For terminal tasks, verifiers were typically custom shell or Python scripts that check an agent’s solution (e.g., inspecting files, validating computed values, or measuring runtime).
Good verifiers have three essential properties: alignment with the task description, comprehensive coverage, and robustness to reward hacking.
blocks.zh:
校验者是RL的核心:他们评价代理人的工作并产生用于培训的奖励。
他们的质量直接塑造了训练信号.
对于终端任务,核查者通常是自定义 shell 或 Python 脚本,用来检查代理的解决方案(例如检查文件、验证计算值或测量运行时间)。
良好的核查者有三种基本属性:与任务描述一致,覆盖全面,强力奖励黑客.

blocks.en:
The task’s state requirements needed to be enforced without imposing unstated constraints or assuming a particular implementation.
As an example, if the task left the deliverable’s file format unspecified the verifier had to be capable of checking a range of reasonable formats, rather than arbitrarily allow for a single format.
blocks.zh:
任务的国家要求必须在不施加未说明的限制或假定具体执行的情况下加以执行。
例如,如果任务未指明交付品的文件格式,核查者必须能够检查一系列合理的格式,而不是任意允许一种格式。

blocks.en:
Each individual constraint or requirement required by the task had to be tested for by the verifier.
If a task asked the agent to compute results across a range of inputs, the verifier had to validate all those inputs thoroughly.
Incomplete checks could reward partial solutions, reinforcing behavior that fell short of the task’s requirements.
blocks.zh:
任务所要求的每一项个别限制或要求都必须由核查人加以检验。
如果一项任务要求代理人对一系列投入的结果进行计算,核查者必须彻底验证所有这些投入。
不完整的检查可以奖励部分解决方案,强化不符合任务要求的行为。

blocks.en:
A verifier should reward successful task completion and resist attempts to manipulate the evaluation.
For example, test inputs and expected outputs should be protected from agent modification; otherwise, an agent may change the test data to make an incorrect solution pass.
blocks.zh:
核查人应奖励圆满完成任务,抵制操纵评价的企图。
例如,测试投入和预期输出应当受到保护,避免代理修改;否则,一个代理可能会改变测试数据,使不正确的解决方案通过.

blocks.en:
It is challenging to measure these properties with static checks alone as it requires comparing the verifier against the task’s requirements, identifying gaps in coverage, and reasoning about how an agent could exploit the evaluation.
Through both human and automated review of the tasks and real rollouts, we were able to identify robustness issues, and either fix or filter tasks with problematic verifiers.
blocks.zh:
仅用静态检查来衡量这些特性是一项挑战,因为它需要将核查人与任务的要求进行比较,找出覆盖面的空白,并推理代理人如何利用评价。
通过对各项任务进行人工和自动审查以及真正展开工作,我们得以确定强健性问题,或者用有问题的核查人员固定或过滤各项任务。

blocks.en: Synthetic Pipeline
blocks.zh: 合成管道

blocks.en: Our synthetic task generation was broken down into three separate stages: seed generation, task description generation, and task folder generation ( Figure 20 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的合成任务生成被分为三个不同的阶段:种子生成,任务描述生成和任务文件夹生成(图20).

blocks.en: Figure 20: Synthetic pipeline for terminal.
blocks.zh: 图20:终端的合成管道。

blocks.en:
The first stage filtered web data to generate terminal-compatible seed data.
It was a simple filtering pass in which a judge assessed whether the content of a web page could provide relevant material for a terminal task (“can the task be solved using a terminal”).
Seed data could alternatively be produced by sampling from the taxonomies of categories and task properties.
blocks.zh:
第一阶段过滤的网络数据生成终端兼容的种子数据.
这是一种简单的过滤通行证,法官在通行证中评估网页的内容是否能够为终端任务提供相关材料(“能否使用终端解决该任务”).
种子数据也可以通过从类别和任务特性的分类中取样得出。

blocks.en:
The second stage used a judge to convert seeds into full task descriptions that specifically targeted the contents of the seeds.
To control the diversity of the task descriptions, we relied on different “diversity knobs” for generation, including task specificity, and instruction style/tone.
These knobs were used to steer the model generation in certain directions and proved useful in preventing diversity collapse.
For instance, we could steer the task description toward a technical, informal or conversational tone.
Another example was the task specificity knob, which determined how prescriptive and detailed the task description should be.
We set specificity as a scale where high specificity meant the task description would explicitly mention every aspect of the deliverables including the kinds of edge cases the solution should support.
Lower specificity meant the task description would omit certain requirements that could be easily inferred from context, agent environment or common sense. Figure 21 shows a low-specificity and a high-specificity task description.
blocks.zh:
第二阶段使用判断器将种子转换成专门针对种子内容的完整任务描述.
为了控制任务描述的多样性,我们依靠不同的“多样化的节点”代代相传,包括任务具体化和教学风格/音调。
这些旋钮用于引导模型生成在某些方向上,并被证明有助于防止多样性崩溃。
例如,我们可以将任务描述导向技术、非正式或对话的基调。
另一个例子是任务具体化符号,它决定了任务描述应如何规定和详细。
