我们把具体化定为一个尺度,其中高度具体化意味着任务说明将明确提及可交付成果的每一个方面,包括解决办法应支持的边缘情况。
具体程度较低意味着任务说明将省略某些从上下文、代理环境或常识可以轻易推断的要求。 图21显示的是低特异性及高特异性任务描述.

blocks.en: Figure 21: Terminal task descriptions generated with low and high task specificity.
blocks.zh: 图21:以低和高任务特异性生成的终端任务描述.

blocks.en: (a) Low specificity
blocks.zh: (a) 特性低

blocks.en: (b) High specificity
blocks.zh: (b) 高度具体化

blocks.en:
The third stage took a task description and turned it into a fully fledged Harbor -compatible task.
It combined a coding agent operating in a sandbox environment with a quality gate that relied on the set of judge quality checks and static checks described above.
The agent was given 10 rounds to iterate on the task and pass the quality gate; we gave up on the task past that.
Tasks generated by this pipeline were later subject to further filters after monitoring behavior during RL.
We originally followed the “legacy” Harbor format for tasks where the verifier shared the same runtime as the agent.
As this was generally not robust to reward hacking, we subsequently switched to separating runtimes for agent and verifier.
blocks.zh:
第三阶段采用了任务描述,将其变成一个完全成熟的港口——兼容的任务.
它将一个在沙盒环境中运行的编码器与一个质量门结合在一起,该门依赖于上述法官质量检查和静态检查的一套.
特派员在任务上被给了10发子弹,通过质量门;我们放弃了过去的任务。
这个管道生成的任务后来在RL期间监测行为后会受到进一步的过滤.
我们最初遵循“遗留”港模式,执行核查员与代理人分享同样运行时间的任务。
由于这通常不足以奖励黑客,我们后来转而将代理和核查员的运行时间分开。

blocks.en:
Synthetic task creation is iterative rather than sequential.
We started with an initial batch and ran it through the full pipeline: tests, quality checks, rollouts, and finally training.
This surfaced issues such as undersized sandboxes, verifier timeouts, ambiguous task descriptions, insufficient difficulty, and hackable verifiers.
We turned these issues into improvements to the pipeline, strengthening the generation prompts and quality checks.
Through that improvement cycle, the quality of our synthetic tasks increased significantly over time.
blocks.zh:
合成任务创建是迭代而不是顺序.
我们从最初的批次开始, 并运行了整个管道:测试,质量检查,推出, 最后培训。
这种浮出水面的问题,如尺寸不足的沙盒、核查器超时、任务描述模棱两可、难度不足以及可入侵核查器。
我们把这些问题变成改进管道,加强发电提示和质量检查。
通过这一改进周期,我们综合任务的质量随着时间的推移大大提高。

blocks.en: 4.1.7 Math and Science
blocks.zh: 4.1.7 数学和科学

blocks.en: Question Curation
blocks.zh: 问题解析

blocks.en:
We began by sourcing over one million math and science tasks from open-source corporate [ 64 , 65 , 66 , 67 , 68 ] , vendors, and our own synthetic pipelines.
Each task consisted of a question and “gold” or ground-truth answer.
Of these, many were filtered for being too easy or for having quality issues.
In the final pool we had 65% math questions, 17% physics, 11% chemistry, 4% biology, and the rest from other scientific disciplines.
blocks.zh:
我们首先从开源公司[64、65、66、67、68]、销售商和我们自己的合成管道获得100多万项数学和科学任务。
每项任务都包含一个问题和“黄金”或地面真相答案。
其中,许多人因过于容易或存在质量问题而被过滤。
最后我们有65%的数学问题,17%的物理问题,11%的化学问题,4%的生物学问题,其余的则来自其他科学学科。

blocks.en: Verification
blocks.zh: 核查

blocks.en:
To grade the model’s answers to math and science questions, we instructed the model to output its final answer within \boxed{} and used that syntax to extract the answer from the model’s response.
We restricted math questions to those with a numeric or symbolic answer which could be compared to the model’s answer using SymPy -based verification [ 69 ] .
Science questions were graded using a judge verifier which was prompted to compare the gold answer with the model’s answer, given the question.
blocks.zh:
为了对模型对数学和科学问题的答案进行分级,我们指示模型在\boxed QQ 中输出其最终答案,并利用该语法从模型的答复中提取答案.
我们把数学问题限制在那些有数字或象征性答案的方面,这些答案可以与模型使用SymPy验证的答案相比较[69]。
科学问题通过法官核查员进行分级,考虑到这个问题,这是为了将黄金答案与模型的答案进行比较。

blocks.en:
For verification of math questions, we started from an implementation based on the math-verify library [ 70 ] .
We noticed that the original implementation lacked several crucial normalizations: ( a ) limited support for stylistic commands, ( b ) no support for European style interval markers, ( c ) ASCII style answers ( sqrt(13) instead of \ sqrt{13} ), etc.
We added support for these additional normalizations, reducing the false negative rate in verification.
We also noticed that the original implementation was prone to false positives, due to incorrect SymPy object resolution.
We resolved this by routing the answer to the appropriate SymPy object resolution class— LaTeX for symbolic answers, and Expr for numeric answers.
In addition to these, we filtered questions if the verification function could not resolve a SymPy object for the gold answer.
This avoided situations where the ultimate verification degenerated to string match, a highly false negative prone mechanism.
blocks.zh:
为了验证数学问题,我们从基于数学验证库的执行开始[70].
我们注意到,最初的执行缺乏几个关键的正常化:(a) 对文体指令的支持有限,(b) 对欧洲风格间隔标记没有支持,(c) ASCII风格答案(sqrt(13)而不是\ sqrt{13})等.
我们进一步支持这些额外的正常化,减少了核查方面的虚假负率。
我们还注意到,由于SymPy对象分辨率不正确,最初的执行容易出现假阳性.
我们解决了这个问题,将答案导向适当的SymPy对象解析类——作为符号解答的LaTeX和数字解答的Expr.
除此之外,我们过滤了是否验证函数无法解析一个SymPy对象的黄金答案的问题.
这避免了最终核查退化为串联的情况,这是一种非常虚假的负面易发机制。

blocks.en:
We found that some questions under-specified the form of the answer, making it difficult to grade.
For example, if the gold answer is 3.5 m/s, we found that judge verifiers were often inconsistent in accepting more precise answers (e.g. 3.51 m/s) or those in different units (351 cm/s).
Similarly, some questions required the use of well-known constants to calculate the answer, but the model can end up with different answers—and receive different rewards—depending on the precision chosen for those constants (e.g. 9.8 m/s 2 vs 9.81 m/s 2 for gravitational acceleration).
Because of these inconsistencies, the model may be sometimes rewarded and sometimes penalized for what is otherwise correct reasoning.
To avoid this issue of noisy rewards, we rewrote questions to specify the precision, units, and any relevant constants needed.
This ensured that if the model followed correct reasoning it always ended up at the gold answer.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,有些问题没有具体说明答案的形式,因此很难分级。
例如,如果黄金答案是3.5 m/s,我们发现法官核查员在接受更精确的答案(如3.51 m/s)或不同单位的答案(351 cm/s)时往往不一致.
同样,有些问题需要使用众所周知的常数来计算答案,但模型最终可以有不同的答案——并获得不同的奖励——取决于为这些常数选择的精确度(例如,重力加速度9.8 m/s 2 vs 9.81 m/s 2).
由于这些不一致之处,该模型有时可能因本来正确的推理而受到奖励和惩罚。
为了避免这种吵闹的奖赏问题,我们重写问题,以具体说明所需的精度,单位和任何相关的常数.
这确保了如果模型遵循正确的推理,它总是以黄金答案告终.

blocks.en: Quality Filters
blocks.zh: 质量过滤器

blocks.en: We applied extensive quality filters both to the question and to the answer.
blocks.zh: 我们对问题和答案都进行了广泛的质量过滤。

blocks.en:
Following Cheng et al. [71] , we filtered out questions where a strong model performed worse than a weak model, as these questions are more likely to have incorrect gold answers.
It also served the purpose of informing whether or not deeper reasoning abilities are needed to solve a problem.
blocks.zh:
继程等人[71]之后,我们过滤出强模型表现比弱模型更糟糕的问题,因为这些问题更有可能有不正确的金子答案.
它还有助于告知是否需要更深入的推理能力来解决问题。

blocks.en:
Questions where the answers are guessable pose a serious problem to the model.
These questions can cause the model to learn taking a guess at the answer in its chain of thought, rather than arriving at it through sound derivation.
Such behavior hinders the scaling of chain of thought tokens, as the model degenerates to a guess-based policy.
Thus, we filtered out questions whose answer could be guessed without doing the work, such as yes/no or multiple choice; whose wording hands the reader a short list of candidate answers; where what is asked (such as a rank of a matrix, or finite outcome probability mass questions) leaves only a few possible answers; whose reference answer is unusually frequent across the full task pool (such as 0, 1, π \pi , etc.); which are answerable by reciting a memorized definition or formula; and which accidentally reveal or trivialize the answer.
blocks.zh:
答案可猜到的问题给模型带来了严重的问题.
这些问题可以让模型学习在思想链中对答案进行猜测,而不是通过声音衍生来得出答案.
这种行为阻碍了思维符的链条的缩放,因为模型堕落为以猜想为基础的政策.
因此,我们筛选出在不做工作的情况下可以猜测答案的问题,如是/否或多重选择;其措辞给读者带来一份简短的候选答案清单;所询问的问题(如矩阵的排名,或有限结果概率质量问题)只留下几个可能的答案;其参考答案在整个任务库中异常频繁(如0,1,π\pii等);这些答案可以通过重新引用被记住的定义或公式来回答;以及不小心揭示或淡化答案.

blocks.en:
On the other end of the difficulty spectrum, we found many questions to be broken.
Similarly to guessable questions, broken questions can introduce noise into the rewards if the model can sometimes get the answer right by assuming things unstated in the question.
Thus, we filtered out questions which refer to a figure, table, earlier sub-question, or passage that is not included; which are self-contradictory, missing an assumption, or open to more than one reading; or which otherwise leave out information needed to pin down a single answer.
blocks.zh:
在难度谱的另一端,我们发现许多问题被打破.
与可猜到的问题类似,破解的问题如果模型有时能通过假设问题中未陈述的东西来得到正确的答案,则会给奖励带来噪音.
因此,我们筛选出一些问题,这些问题涉及一个数字、表格、早先的子问题或未包括的段落;这些问题自相矛盾,缺少一个假设,或开放不止一个读数;或者,如果不这样做,就遗漏了为确定一个答案所需的信息。

blocks.en:
The gold answers may themselves be incorrect.
We leveraged several strategies to detect wrong answers, including: asking a model to review the gold answer and judge it as correct or incorrect; asking a model to re-derive the gold answer with tools; and asking several independent solvers to re-derive the gold answer and only accepting the question if they agreed.
blocks.zh:
金色答案本身可能不正确。
我们利用几种策略来发现错误的答案,包括:要求一个模型来审查黄金答案并判断它是否正确;要求一个模型用工具重新判定黄金答案;要求几个独立解答者重新判定黄金答案,只有在他们同意的情况下才接受这个问题.

blocks.en: We also filtered out questions whose text requested a format contradicting the standard training format ( \boxed{} ); which contained spurious characters or formatting defects; and those in non-English languages.
blocks.zh: 我们还筛选了哪些问题,哪些问题的案文要求一种与标准训练格式(\boxed{})相矛盾的格式;哪些培训格式包含虚假的字符或格式缺陷;哪些是非英语的。

blocks.en:
As described above, we restricted ourselves to short answers which could be graded by SymPy or a simple judge.
To meet this requirement, we filtered questions asking for several separate answers at once (which cannot be checked as one right-or-wrong result) and those asking for a proof or written explanation (which require more sophisticated judge or rubric-based verification).
We limited the length of model-generated answers to 200 characters (or, for the small fraction of tasks having long gold answers, 3 × \times the number of characters of the gold answer) to avoid hedging or other forms of reward hacking.
We also found that some symbolic answers could not be parsed correctly by SymPy , and filtered these out.
Finally, there were questions which could not be reliably graded by the judge (e.g., the judge would sometimes give different rewards to the same answer), and we filtered these out as well.
blocks.zh:
如上所述,我们仅限于简短的答案,这些答案可以由SymPy或简单的法官评分。
为了满足这一要求,我们过滤了要求同时提供几个单独答案的问题(不能作为一种正确或错误的结果加以检查)和要求提供证据或书面解释的问题(这需要更复杂的法官或基于文字的核查)。
我们把模型生成的答案的长度限制在200个字符(或者,对于有长黄金答案的任务的一小部分,3×乘以黄金答案的字符数),以避免套期或者其他形式的奖励黑客.
我们发现一些象征性的答案无法被 SymPy 正确解析,
最后,有些问题不能由法官可靠地进行分级(例如,法官有时会对同一答复给予不同的奖励),我们也将这些问题过滤出来。

blocks.en:
Questions that are very easy for the model can cause wasted inference compute during RL training, failing to provide non-zero gradients.
To this end, we also filtered out questions which the initial checkpoint could solve frequently, with a low thinking budget.
blocks.zh:
对于模型来说非常容易的问题,在RL训练中可能会引起浪费的推论计算,无法提供非零梯度.
为此,我们还过滤了最初的检查站能够经常解决的问题,但考虑的预算很低。

blocks.en: Synthetic Pipelines
blocks.zh: 合成管道

blocks.en:
Online science forums such as the Physics, Chemistry and Biology StackExchange sites, as well as open-source science Q&A corpora, contain a large volume of expert-level questions, but we found that few of them are directly usable for RL: forum posts have no reference answer, questions often ask for an explanation or a derivation rather than a value, and many depend on context from the surrounding thread.
We built a pipeline that turns this seed material into verifiable short-answer tasks.
blocks.zh:
在线科学论坛如物理,化学和生物学堆积交换网站,以及开源科学QQA corpora,包含大量专家层面的问题,但我们发现,其中很少可以直接用于RL:论坛帖没有参考答案,问题往往要求解释或引申而非价值,很多问题取决于周围线条的背景.
我们建造了一条管道,将这种种子材料变成可核查的短答任务.

blocks.en:
The pipeline starts by extracting question-answer pairs.
A model rewrites each forum post into one or more self-contained questions, turning requests for a proof, derivation or explanation into questions with a short, checkable answer (e.g. “derive the moment of inertia of a uniform disk” becomes “what is the moment of inertia of a uniform disk of mass M and radius R?”).
It then synthesizes a concise answer from the replies and extracts a short reference answer (a number with units, a formula, a name, or a short phrase) grounded in the replies.
blocks.zh:
管道从抽取问答对开始.
一个模型将每个论坛的帖子改写成一个或多个自成一体的问题,把对证明、推论或解释的请求变成一个简短、可核查的答案(例如,“将统一磁盘惯性的时刻”变成“质量M和半径R的统一磁盘惯性的时刻?” )。
然后它从答复中合成一个简明的答案,并摘录一个基于答复的简短的参考答案(一个带有单位的编号,一个公式,一个名字,或者一个短短语).

blocks.en:
The remaining steps aim to make each question reliably gradable.
Even when the reference answer is correct, grading is inconsistent whenever the question leaves room for equally correct answers: different units or precision, an unstated sign convention, or a synonym for a phrase answer.
A model therefore reviews each question against its reference answer, and rewrites the question so that the reference becomes the unique correct answer, without changing what is asked or hinting at the value, or flags it as unrepairable.
The rewritten question is then solved several times by a model, each attempt is graded by the same judge used in training, and a final diagnosis step reviews the question, the reference, and the graded attempts together.
It distinguishes wrong references (several attempts agree against the reference), ambiguous questions (rejected attempts that are defensible under another reading) and judge noise (equivalent answers graded differently) from genuine difficulty.
blocks.zh:
其余步骤旨在使每个问题都能可靠地解决。
即使参考答案正确,每当问题留下同样正确答案的空间时,分级也是不一致的:不同的单位或精确度,一个未声明的符号惯例,或者一个短语答案的同义词.
因此,一个模型对照其参考答案来审查每个问题,并重写问题,使参考成为唯一正确的答案,而不改变所询问的内容或暗示值,或者标出无法修复的标记.
重写后的问题再由模型多次解决,每次尝试都由训练中使用的同一位法官进行分级,最后的诊断步骤审查问题,参考,分级的尝试一起进行.
它将错误的引用(若干次尝试都同意反对引用),模棱两可的问题(在另一种解读中可以辩驳的拒绝尝试)和对噪音(等同的答案分级不同)与真正的困难加以区分。

blocks.en:
Open-source math corpora are dominated by competition-style problems, and we also wanted a way to produce hard questions on the many topics that are underrepresented there.
To this end, we developed a top-down pipeline that generates questions from a synthesized university curriculum ( Figure 22 ).
Starting from a list of 38 course areas (e.g. measure theory, commutative algebra, random matrix theory), a model first designed a graduate-level course for each area, broken into 8 to 12 modules.
It then wrote the teaching material for each module: a handful of precisely defined concepts, the main theorems and techniques, and synthesis links pointing out combinations of concepts that interact in non-obvious ways (e.g. how concepts such as Borel σ \sigma -algebra, complete measure space, and Lebesgue σ \sigma -algebra relate).
The result was an inventory of several thousand concepts, each tied to a module and a course.
blocks.zh:
开源数学公司以竞争风格的问题为主,我们也想用一种方法来提出许多代表不足的问题。
为此,我们开发了自上而下的管道,从综合大学课程中产生问题(图22)。
从38个课程领域(如计量理论,共性代数,随机矩阵理论)的列表开始,一个模型首先为每个领域设计了研究生级课程,分为8至12个单元.
然后,它为每个模块撰写了教材:少数精确定义的概念,主要定理和技术,以及综合链接,指出以非明显方式相互作用的概念组合(例如,Borel \sigma - algra,完整度量空间,和Lebesgue \sigma - algebra等概念如何关联).
结果是清点了几千个概念,每个概念都与一个单元和一个课程挂钩。

blocks.en:
Questions were then generated by mixing and matching concepts from this inventory.
A planner allocated the question budget across five question types of increasing scope (a single concept in depth, several concepts from one module, concepts from different modules of the same course, course-wide synthesis, and combinations across courses).
For each planned combination, the model was asked to write one question built around exactly those concepts, subject to a set of constraints: the question had to be single-part and self-contained, had to have a numeric or closed-form answer that can be checked automatically, and had to be difficult because of the depth of reasoning required (rather than because of heavy notation or large numbers).
The model also needed to solve its own question and revise it if a one- or two-line shortcut existed, and it had to account for every stated premise in its solution, so that the question carries no decorative conditions.
blocks.zh:
然后,通过从这份清单中混合和匹配各种概念来产生问题。
一名规划人员将问题预算分配给五个范围不断扩大的问题类别(一个深入的概念,一个单元的若干概念,同一课程的不同单元的概念,全课程的综合,以及各课程的组合)。
对于每一个计划中的组合,都要求模型写一个完全围绕这些概念的问题,但受一系列限制:问题必须是单段的和自足的,必须有一个可以自动检查的数值或闭式的答案,并且由于需要的推理深度(而不是由于沉重的注音或大量数字)而困难重重.
该模型还需要解决自己的问题,如果存在一线或两线快捷键,则对其进行修改,它必须在其解决方案中考虑每一个已声明的前提,这样这个问题就不会有装饰性条件.

blocks.en: Figure 22: The synthetic task generation pipeline for University Math.
blocks.zh: 图22:大学数学的合成任务生成管道。

blocks.en:
We conditioned the question generation on concepts/modules from varied courses.
This ensured that the synthetically generated tasks were diverse in nature.
To further verify this claim, we used Text-Embedding based measures to ensure that tasks were diverse.
We used a strong embedding model to embed the tasks and visualized a t-SNE plot ( Figure 23 ).
We observed two things: ( a ) questions are quite diverse, and, ( b ) questions from similar/same course(s) cluster together.
blocks.zh:
我们以各种课程中的概念/模块为问题组的条件。
这确保了合成生成的任务具有多样性。
为了进一步核实这一说法,我们采用了基于文本的处理措施,以确保任务的多样性。
我们使用一个强大的嵌入模型来嵌入任务,并可视化一个T-SNE图(图23).
我们看到两件事:(a) 问题相当多样;(b) 类似/相同课程组的问题。

blocks.en: Figure 23: Distribution of embeddings of the University Math questions after t-SNE.
blocks.zh: 图23:t-SNE之后大学数学问题嵌入的分布.

blocks.en:
We generated additional expert-level mathematics tasks through an adversarial generation–solving–refinement loop.
A generator combined a broad set of mathematical concepts into self-contained problems, while independent solvers exposed ambiguities, errors, and unintended shortcuts.
Verification gates assessed reference-answer correctness and reasoning difficulty using derived solutions, solver attempts, and judging feedback.
This feedback guided revisions to repair defects and strengthen conceptual demands.
blocks.zh:
我们通过一个对抗的一代 — — 解决 — — 精炼循环,产生了额外的专家级数学任务。
一个生成器将一组广泛的数学概念结合到自成一体的问题中,而独立的解决者则暴露出模糊不清,错误,以及意想不到的捷径.
核查门利用衍生解决方案、解决者尝试和判断反馈,评估了参考答案的正确性和推理难度。
这种反馈指导了修订工作,以弥补缺陷和加强概念要求。

blocks.en:
We adapted this loop to research-level physics tasks grounded in scientific papers.
Extracted calculations, assumptions, and reasoning outlines guided problem construction.
Verification additionally checked consistency with the source material and whether each problem supplied sufficient information for an independent solution.
Refinement addressed missing assumptions and discrepancies while preserving the underlying physics.
blocks.zh:
我们调整了这个圈子 以科学论文为基础的研究层面的物理任务
摘录的计算、假设和推理概述了指导性的问题构建。
核查还检查了与来源材料的一致性,以及每个问题是否为独立解决提供了充分的信息。
完善既解决了缺失的假设和差异,又保留了基础物理.

blocks.en: 4.1.8 Competitive Coding
blocks.zh: 4.1.8 竞争性编码

blocks.en:
We used competitive-coding tasks to train algorithmic reasoning through executable feedback.
Each task paired a problem statement with a test suite and comparison script, and asked the model to produce a runnable solution.
blocks.zh:
我们用竞争性编码任务 通过可执行的反馈来训练算法推理.
每个任务将一个问题说明与测试套件和比较脚本配对,并要求模型生成一个可运行的解决方案.

blocks.en: We ingested and assessed problems both from open-source corpora [ 72 , 73 ] and licensed from online coding platforms.
blocks.zh: 我们摄取和评估了开源公司[72,73]和网上编码平台许可的问题。

blocks.en:
All the prompts of the tasks are language agnostic: they ask for code that receives inputs via stdin and emits outputs via stdout, and the test cases are simply files of inputs and expected outputs.
This means that these tasks can theoretically be used to train the model in any language that supports stdin and stdout.
However, the test cases and timeouts are often calibrated for a specific language; specifically, test cases calibrated for higher performance languages (such as C++) may become impossible for programs written in lower performance languages (such as Python).
In these cases, we generated reference solutions in Python and excluded the task from Python candidacy if the reference solution runtime was out-of-distribution.
blocks.zh:
任务的所有提示都是语言不可知:它们要求通过stdin接收输入的代码,通过stdout发送输出,测试案例只是输入和预期输出的文档.
这意味着这些任务理论上可以用来用任何支持stdin和stdout的语言来训练模型.
然而,测试案例和超时常常为特定语言校准;具体来说,为更高性能语言(如C++)校准的测试案例对于以较低性能语言(如Python)编写的程序来说可能变得不可能.
在这种情况下,我们在Python生成了参考解决方案,如果参考解决方案运行时间超出分配范围,则将任务排除在Python候选资格之外.

blocks.en:
The final languages we chose to use for these tasks were Python and C++.
The choice of which language a task was to use was randomly selected at runtime.
All tasks were eligible to be completed in C++, and 70% of these were also eligible to be completed in Python.
In a similar manner, we mixed in the ability for the model to use a bash tool, so the model learned both to write logically and syntactically correct problems without relying on code execution, as well as test its code when possible.
blocks.zh:
我们选择用于这些任务的最终语言是Python和C++.
任务使用哪种语言的选择在运行时随机选择.
所有任务都有资格在C++中完成,其中70%也有资格在Python中完成.
类似地,我们混合了模型使用bash工具的能力,因此模型既学会了在不依赖代码执行的情况下写出逻辑和合成纠正的问题,也尽可能地测试其代码.

blocks.en:
Verification extracted the final submitted program and ran it in an isolated grading sandbox with time limits.
The task reward was binary: 1 only if every test passes, otherwise 0.
Compilation errors, runtime failures, wrong outputs, and timeouts received no partial credit.
blocks.zh:
核查提取了最后提交的程序,并将其运行在一个有时间限制的孤立的分级沙盒中。
任务奖励为二进制:1,每次测试通过,否则为0.
汇编错误、运行时间故障、产出错误和超时没有得到部分信贷。

blocks.en:
For quality screening, we used deterministic checks, judges,classifiers, reference execution, and deduplication.
We checked that questions had a minimum number of test cases, that output comparison scripts aligned with prompt requirements (e.g. regarding case sensitivity, whitespace, numerical precision), that reference solutions passed in our environment, and that there were no broken prompts (e.g. prompts that rely on images or make requests about output contrary to the final reward, such as claiming partial scoring).
Deduplication was conducted both using the MinHash algorithm on the problem statement as well as using agents to find canonical problem IDs where available.
The main curation challenges were ensuring correct scoring semantics and separating genuine difficulty from broken prompts or harnesses.
blocks.zh:
在质量检查方面,我们使用了确定性的检查、法官、分类员、参考处决和重复。
我们检查过,问题有最少的测试案例,输出比较脚本符合即时要求(例如关于案例灵敏度,白空间,数值精确度),参考解决方案在我们环境中传过,并且没有断掉的提示(例如,依赖图像或对输出提出要求与最终奖励相反的提示,例如声称部分评分).
在问题语句上使用了MinHash算法,并在可用的情况下使用了代理查找犬类问题ID。
课程的主要挑战是确保正确的记分语义,将真正的困难与断掉的提示或操纵分开。

blocks.en:
The difficulty of these problems spanned nearly the entire spectrum, from trivial to national olympiad level, with the median task being roughly equivalent to what would be classified as “hard” in LiveCodeBench.
At the beginning of training, only roughly 10% of these problems were reliably solved by the model; this increased to roughly 70% by the end of training.
blocks.zh:
这些问题的困难几乎遍及整个范围,从微不足道到国家奥林匹克水平,中间任务大致相当于LiveCode Bench中被归类为“硬”的任务。
在培训开始时,只有大约10%的问题得到模式的可靠解决;到培训结束时,这一数字增加到大约70%。

blocks.en: 4.1.9 Web Search
blocks.zh: 4.1.9 网络搜索

blocks.en:
To teach the model how to find information on the internet, we sourced a number of high-quality and difficult multi-hop web search tasks.
Each task consisted of a question, “gold” answer, and web search tools which accessed the internet via a third-party search provider.
blocks.zh:
为了教该模型如何在互联网上找到信息,我们从中获得了一些高质量和困难的多跳网络搜索任务.
每项任务包括一个问题、“黄金”答案和通过第三方搜索提供者访问互联网的网络搜索工具。

blocks.en: Tasks
blocks.zh: 任务

blocks.en:
We began by sourcing web search tasks from open-source corpora, vendors, and a synthetic pipeline based on InfoSeek [ 74 ] .
The open-source tasks came from OpenSeeker [ 75 ] , whose questions are similar to InfoSeek’s but obfuscated with multiple constraints per answer, and from DeepDive [ 76 ] , a mix of questions based on Wikipedia (and other knowledge-graph sources) and academic publications.
Our tasks covered a broad range of topics, including history, art, finance, sports, science & technology, media, law, and more.
blocks.zh:
我们首先从开源公司、销售商和基于InfoSeek[74]的合成管道寻找网络搜索任务。
开源任务来自OpenSeeker [75],他们的问题与InfoSeek的相似,但每个回答都受到多重限制的模糊不清,来自DeepDive [76],一个基于维基百科(和其他知识-图源)和学术出版物的混合问题.
我们的任务涉及广泛的主题,包括历史、艺术、金融、体育、科学和技术、媒体、法律等等。

blocks.en:
All search environments exposed two tools to the model: a search tool and a browse tool.
The search tool accepts a query string and returns URLs along with page titles and snippets that preview relevant page content, with content averaging around 200 characters per snippet.
The browse tool accepts a URL and returns the page rendered as Markdown, capped at 8K tokens.
It also supports arguments from the command-line tool ripgrep [ 77 ] .
When supplied, these arguments are applied to the full Markdown representation, allowing the model to search within the page and retrieve targeted excerpts.
blocks.zh:
所有搜索环境都向模型暴露了两种工具:搜索工具和浏览工具.
搜索工具接受查询字符串,并返回URL以及预览相关页面内容的页面标题和片段,内容平均每片段约200个字符.
浏览工具接受一个 URL 并返回作为 Markdown 提供的页面, 封顶为 8K 令牌 。
它还支持来自命令行工具 riggrep [77] 的参数.
在提供时,这些论据被应用到全部的Markdown表示,使模型可以在页面内搜索并检索目标节录.

blocks.en:
We used a regular expression to extract the excerpt of the agent’s final message starting with “The answer is:” and ending at a newline or citation.
We assigned rewards based on this excerpt using a three-stage procedure: 1. Exact Match: We normalized the proposed and reference answers and compared them.
An exact match received a reward of one.
Answers that could not be extracted received a reward of zero. 2. Length Check: If the answers did not match, we assigned a reward of zero when the proposed answer exceeded max(150, len(gold_answer) * 4.5) .
This discouraged increasingly verbose answers that hedged or offered multiple alternatives. 3. Model-Based Judgment: Answers that passed the length check were evaluated by a judge for equivalence to the reference answer.
The judging prompt included few-shot examples illustrating how to handle ambiguity and reject hedged answers.
blocks.zh:
我们用一个正则表达式来摘录从 " 答案是: " 开始、以新行或引文结束的最后信息。
我们利用三阶段程序根据这一节选给予奖励: 1. 精确匹配: 我们使提议的和参考的答案正常化,并加以比较。
准确的比赛得到了一个奖赏.
不能提取的答案得到的奖励为0。 2. 长度检查: 如果答案不匹配,当拟议答案超过最大值(150,len(gold_sanswer) * 4.5)时,我们给出了0的奖励.
这不利于越来越多地提出对冲或提供多种替代办法的动词性答案。 3. 基于模型的判决: 法官评估了通过长度检查的答案,认为这些答案与参考答案相当。
判断的提示包括几个实例,说明如何处理含糊不清和拒绝被套期的答复。

blocks.en:
Exact Match: We normalized the proposed and reference answers and compared them.
An exact match received a reward of one.
Answers that could not be extracted received a reward of zero.
blocks.zh:
精确匹配 : 我们使提议的和参考的答案正常化,并加以比较。
准确的比赛得到了一个奖赏.
不能提取的答案得到的奖励为0。

blocks.en:
Length Check: If the answers did not match, we assigned a reward of zero when the proposed answer exceeded max(150, len(gold_answer) * 4.5) .
This discouraged increasingly verbose answers that hedged or offered multiple alternatives.
blocks.zh:
长度检查 : 如果答案不匹配,当拟议答案超过最大值(150,len(gold_sanswer) * 4.5)时,我们给出了0的奖励.
这不利于越来越多地提出对冲或提供多种替代办法的动词性答案。

blocks.en:
Model-Based Judgment: Answers that passed the length check were evaluated by a judge for equivalence to the reference answer.
The judging prompt included few-shot examples illustrating how to handle ambiguity and reject hedged answers.
blocks.zh:
基于模型的判决: 法官评估了通过长度检查的答案,认为这些答案与参考答案相当。
判断的提示包括几个实例,说明如何处理含糊不清和拒绝被套期的答复。

blocks.en: Quality and Difficulty Filtering
blocks.zh: 质量和筛选难度

blocks.en: We excluded questions that met any of the following criteria:
blocks.zh: 我们排除了符合下列任何标准的问题:

blocks.en:
We dropped questions containing answer-revealing text, as determined by lexical string comparison and judge-based checks.
We also examined URLs searched by the model, and implemented blocklists to target URLs which exposed the question/answer pair.
We used a two-layered approach: (1) explicitly flagging URL patterns corresponding to known answer dumps, including datasets, papers, and blogs; (2) a dynamic blocklist that fuzzy matched both question and answer in a page.
blocks.zh:
我们放弃了包含解答文本的问题, 由词汇字符串比较和法官检查决定。
我们还检查了模型所搜索的URL,并实施了针对显示问答对等的URL的块列表.
我们采用了双层方法:(1) 明确标出与已知答题相对应的URL模式,包括数据集,论文和博客;(2) 动态块列表,模糊地与一个页面中的问答匹配.

blocks.en: We dropped questions which could be answered by a model without access to search tools, indicating questions whose answers likely appear frequently on the internet and may be memorized.
blocks.zh: 我们放弃了无法使用搜索工具的模型可以回答的问题,

blocks.en:
We dropped questions whose solution paths relied on websites which our search tool could not access.
For example, not all search engines use the same index, and some questions required pages that were not present in the index of our search provider.
Some pages were also inaccessible despite being indexed; e.g. gated behind a CAPTCHA.
blocks.zh:
我们放弃了那些依赖我们搜索工具无法访问的网站来解决的问题。
例如,并非所有搜索引擎都使用相同的索引,有些问题需要我们搜索提供者索引中没有的页面.
一些网页虽然被编入索引,但还是无法访问;例如,在CAPTCHA后门。

blocks.en:
We also dropped questions for which a model, given both the question and gold answer, judged the answer invalid.
Similarly, we also filtered questions where a model preferred a common alternative answer over the gold answer, where it judged the question contradictory (because neither answer satisfied its constraints), or where it judged the question underspecified (because both answers satisfied its constraints).
We identified common alternative answers by sampling multiple rollouts per question and extracting answers that occurred multiple times.
blocks.zh:
我们还放弃了一些问题,一个模型,从问答和黄金答案来看,都认为答案无效。
同样,我们也过滤了一个模型更喜欢共同的替代答案而不是黄金答案的问题,它判断问题自相矛盾(因为两个答案都满足了它的制约),或者它判断问题不够精确(因为两个答案都满足了它的制约)的问题.
我们确定了共同的替代答案,通过对每个问题进行多次推广取样,并提取多次出现的答案。

blocks.en:
Sometimes, the judges graded equivalent answers differently, accepted substantively different answers as correct, or exhibited subjectivity in its judgments.
We dropped any question that triggered this inconsistent behavior in the judge.
blocks.zh:
有时,法官对等的回答有不同的分级,接受实质上不同的回答为正确,或者在判决中表现出主观性。
我们放弃了任何引起法官行为不一致的问题。

blocks.en: We excluded questions whose primary language was not English, as determined by a language-model classifier.
blocks.zh: 我们排除了主要语言不是英语的问题,正如一个语言模式分类员所确定的那样。

blocks.en:
We retained tasks for which a strong model’s solve rate exceeded a weak model’s by at least 12.5 percentage points, or the weak model’s solve rate was zero.
This was to ensure that all questions contained reward signal; questions for which a weak model outperforms a strong model often indicate a problem such as an incorrect but plausible answer.
blocks.zh:
我们保留了强模型的解析率超过弱模型至少12.5个百分点或弱模型的解析率为零的任务。
这样做是为了确保所有问题都包含奖励信号;对于一个弱的模型表现优于一个强的模型的问题,往往表明一个问题,如一个不正确但可信的答案。

blocks.en: Synthetic Pipeline
blocks.zh: 合成管道

blocks.en:
In addition to open-source and vendor tasks, we experimented with synthetic task generation following InfoSeek [ 74 ] , in which a planner agent and a browser agent build a question backwards from a single Wikipedia answer entity, adding hops and constraints until the answer is uniquely identified.
The main differences between our pipeline and the original InfoSeek pipeline were: 1. Our pipeline truncated each article to 20K tokens, instead of the original 1K. 2. We required answers to have a Wikipedia page exceeding 200 words. 3. We implemented retries for validation failures. 4. We further filtered questions through a multi-stage grading funnel.
This grading funnel included all the quality and difficulty filters described in the previous section, plus two additional filters.
First, we also asked another model to validate whether the question was valid given the claims from the parent/children trees built during the synthesis pipeline.
Second, given the source pages built during the synthesis pipeline, we asked another model to judge whether the answer was grounded in the supporting evidence.
blocks.zh:
除了开源和供应商任务外,我们还在InfoSeek[74]之后进行了合成任务生成的实验,其中计划员代理和浏览器代理从单一的维基百科解答实体中向后构建一个问题,添加了hop和制约,直到解答被唯一识别.
我们的管道与最初的InfoSeek管道的主要区别是: 1. 我们的输油管将每条货物划为2万个令牌,而不是原来的1K。 2. 维基百科的网页要超过200个字,我们要求答案。 3. 我们对验证失败进行了复审。 4. 我们通过多阶段分级漏斗进一步过滤问题。
这个分级漏斗包括上一节描述的所有质量和难度过滤器,加上两个额外的过滤器.
首先,我们还问了另一个模型,以确认鉴于在合成管道中建造的父母/子女树的索赔,这一问题是否有效。
第二,鉴于在合成管道中构建的源页,我们请另一个模型来判断答案是否基于佐证。

blocks.en: Our pipeline truncated each article to 20K tokens, instead of the original 1K.
blocks.zh: 我们的输油管把每篇文章都划到2万个符号 而不是原来的1K

blocks.en: We required answers to have a Wikipedia page exceeding 200 words.
blocks.zh: 我们需要答案 维基百科的页面超过200字。

blocks.en: We implemented retries for validation failures.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了验证失败的复试。

blocks.en:
We further filtered questions through a multi-stage grading funnel.
This grading funnel included all the quality and difficulty filters described in the previous section, plus two additional filters.
First, we also asked another model to validate whether the question was valid given the claims from the parent/children trees built during the synthesis pipeline.
Second, given the source pages built during the synthesis pipeline, we asked another model to judge whether the answer was grounded in the supporting evidence.
blocks.zh:
我们通过多阶段分级漏斗进一步过滤问题。
这个分级漏斗包括上一节描述的所有质量和难度过滤器,加上两个额外的过滤器.
首先,我们还问了另一个模型,以确认鉴于在合成管道中建造的父母/子女树的索赔,这一问题是否有效。
第二,鉴于在合成管道中构建的源页,我们请另一个模型来判断答案是否基于佐证。

blocks.en: Although we found tasks generated by the InfoSeek pipeline to be useful earlier in our development cycle, we found that by the end of Beam’s training they were largely too easy.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们发现InfoSeek管道产生的任务在我们开发周期的早些时候是有用的,但我们发现,在Beam的训练结束时,这些任务基本上太容易了。

blocks.en: 4.1.10 Professional Knowledge Work
blocks.zh: 4.1.10 专业知识 工作

blocks.en:
Beyond terminal and software-engineering tasks, we trained Beam on a broader class of professional work.
Frontier agents need to do more than write code: they need to understand source material, use the right tools, and produce the artifacts that real organizations rely on, including reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and other business documents.
Our real-world corporate tasks were built around this idea: we put the agent in a realistic professional setting and asked it to deliver the kind of finished work one would expect from someone in that job ( Figure 24 ).
blocks.zh:
除了终端和软件工程任务外,我们还对Beam进行了更广泛的专业工作培训。
边疆代理人需要做的不仅仅是写代码:他们需要了解源材料,使用正确的工具,并生产真正的组织所依赖的文物,包括报告,电子表格,演示,以及其他商业文件.
我们的现实世界的企业任务就是围绕这个想法构建的:我们把代理人置于一个现实的专业环境中,并要求它提供人们期望从事这一工作的人完成的那种工作(图24)。

blocks.en:
When producing artifacts like reports or presentations, there is usually no simple unit test to check whether the output is right: it has to make sense, be consistent, be backed up by evidence, and be useful in practice.
The central technical challenge was therefore how to evaluate and reward this kind of work.
Since we could not run a test suite and get a pass or fail, we used an agentic judge to inspect the final deliverables and decide whether they were high-quality and correct.
This changed how we approached task design, reward construction, and defense against reward hacking compared to classic software engineering.
blocks.zh:
在制作报告或演示等文物时,通常没有简单的单位测试来检查产出是否正确:它必须合理,一致,有证据支持,在实践中有用.
因此,主要的技术性挑战是如何评价和奖励这类工作。
由于我们无法运行一个测试套房并获得通行证或失败,我们利用一名代理法官来检查最终交付品,并决定其是否高质量和正确.
这改变了我们处理任务设计的方式, 奖励建筑, 和防御奖励黑客 相比经典软件工程。

blocks.en: Figure 24: Agentic knowledge-work environments and task curation.
blocks.zh: 图24:代理知识-工作环境和任务指导。

blocks.en: Sourcing
blocks.zh: 判决

blocks.en:
We began with a broad pool of tasks covering a wide range of occupations and industry sectors, with an emphasis on realistic artifact-producing professional work.
Tasks came from both our synthetic generation pipeline and external vendors, and were filtered through our quality, difficulty, and integrity checks.
blocks.zh:
我们首先广泛开展涵盖各种职业和工业部门的任务,重点是现实的工艺品生产专业工作。
任务来自我们的合成发电管道和外部供应商,并且通过我们的质量、难度和完整性检查加以过滤。

blocks.en:
The largest sectors in the final pool were finance & insurance, health care & social assistance, and professional, scientific & technical services.
Required deliverables included .docx , .xlsx , .md , .csv , .pdf , and .pptx , alongside other formats.
Many tasks required multiple output formats, and tasks were evaluated against weighted rubric criteria, including penalty criteria for undesirable outputs.
blocks.zh:
最后人才库中最大的部门是金融和保险、保健和社会援助以及专业、科学和技术服务。
所需交付品包括.docx、.xlsx、.md、.csv、.pdf和.pptx,以及其它格式。
许多任务需要多种产出格式,并且按照加权标码标准评价任务,包括对不良产出的处罚标准。

blocks.en: Every task was authored as a Harbor task directory and ships as a digest-pinned container image built from its environment, together with its source assets.
blocks.zh: 每个任务都是作为港湾任务目录撰写的,而船舶则是从其环境及其来源资产中建造的以消化池为主的集装箱图像。

blocks.en: Synthetic Task Generation
blocks.zh: 合成任务生成

blocks.en:
Our synthetic knowledge-work tasks were produced by the same three-stage recipe as our terminal tasks ( Figure 20 ), re-grounded in professional work.
Seeds were real professional documents drawn from a curated web corpus, each paired with an occupation sampled from the pre-defined skill set and taxonomy (sector, then occupation group, then O*NET code).
An authoring agent working in a Docker-enabled sandbox then built the complete task folder in one episode: a manager-voice instruction, two to five reference documents with the seed preserved byte-for-byte, golden deliverables, the weighted rubric, and the environment image.
As with terminal tasks, every submission had to clear a quality gate of static checks plus a tool-using a judge: eight deterministic validators and nine judged criteria spanning professional meaningfulness, difficulty, rubric coverage, and ground-truth protection.
Per-criterion feedback was returned to the authoring agent for up to ten revision rounds.
Because authoring and in-loop judging shared a model family, accepted tasks additionally passed an independent majority-vote quality filter from a different model family (three votes over five defect classes, retaining roughly 42% of published tasks), before the solvability screening.
blocks.zh:
我们的合成知识-工作任务是由与我们最终任务相同的三阶段方法(图20)产生的,在专业工作中重新定位。
种子是真实的专业文件,取自一个经整理的网页目录,每个网页都配有从预先定义的技能和分类学(部门,然后是职业组,然后是O*NET代码)中抽取的职业样本。
作者代理在一个多克启用的沙盒中工作,然后在一集中构建了完整的任务文件夹:管理者-语音指令,2-5个参考文件,种子保存的字节换字节,黄金交付品,加权面额,以及环境图像.
与终端任务一样,每一份呈文都必须清理一个高质量的静态检查门,加上一个使用法官的工具:8个确定性验证员和9个判断标准,涉及专业意义、难度、名义覆盖范围和地面真相保护。
每条标准反馈被退回给作者代理最多十轮修订.
因为写作和在读判断共享了一个模范家庭,所以接受的任务额外通过来自不同模范家庭的独立多数投票质量过滤器(超过5个缺陷类别3票,保留了大约42%的公布任务),然后才进行可溶性筛选。

blocks.en:
Each task was packaged in Harbor format as a reproducible workspace containing the task instructions, source artifacts, and the tools and applications needed for execution, so the agent operated in a controlled environment that could be reproduced consistently across validation and training.
Agent execution took place in an untrusted sandbox, while grading was performed separately in a trusted evaluation sandbox by a tool-using judge that inspected generated files, verified calculations and sources, and applied the task-specific rubric.
blocks.zh:
每项任务都以港湾形式包装为可复制的工作空间,其中包含任务说明、源头文物以及执行所需的工具和应用程序,因此,代理人在可控制的环境中运作,在整个验证和培训过程中可以一致地复制。
代理执行是在一个不信任的沙盒中进行的,而分级则由一个使用工具的法官在一个信任的评价沙盒中单独进行,该法官检查生成的文件,核实的计算和来源,并应用任务特定标题.

blocks.en:
We designed both the task and how we evaluated it at the same time.
Rubrics were authored alongside each task by decomposing the intended professional deliverable into atomic, independently verifiable criteria spanning content, structure, functionality, and presentation.
We calibrated their coverage and granularity so that distinct facts, calculations, comparisons, recommendations, and failure modes could be scored separately, while weighting each criterion according to its professional consequence rather than simply its level of detail.
Rubrics were then further refined through downstream quality checks and adversarial analysis (especially white-box attacking): grader failures, reward-hacking traces, and model rollouts were used to identify criteria that were underspecified, overly coarse, redundant, or vulnerable to shortcuts, and to improve both the rubric and grader before training.
blocks.zh:
我们同时设计了任务和如何评估任务。
Rubrics与每项任务一起编写,将预期的专业交付品分解为原子性、可独立核查的标准,涵盖内容、结构、功能和列报。
我们校准了它们的覆盖范围和颗粒性,以便可以将不同的事实、计算、比较、建议和失败模式分别评分,同时根据每个标准的专业后果,而不仅仅是其详细程度来加权。
Rubrics随后通过下游质量检查和对抗性分析(尤其是白盒式攻击)得到进一步完善:分级器故障,悬赏式追踪,以及模型推出,用于识别那些规格过低,过于粗糙,冗余,或易被捷径攻击的标准,并在训练前同时改进分级器和分级器.

blocks.en:
A tool-using judge evaluated each submitted artifact against the resulting rubric by inspecting files, checking calculations and source material, and scoring each criterion independently.
We then aggregated these criterion-level judgments and applied a threshold selected through extensive experiments for training stability and learning effectiveness; submissions that met the threshold received a binary reward of 1, while those that did not received 0.
blocks.zh:
一名使用工具的法官根据结果对每个提交的文物进行了评估,方法是检查文件、检查计算和源材料,并独立评分每个标准。
然后,我们汇总了这些标准层面的判断,并采用了通过广泛试验选定的阈值,以培养稳定性和学习有效性;达到阈值的提交得到1的二进制奖励,而未获得0的提交则得到0的奖励。

blocks.en: Quality Control
blocks.zh: 质量控制

blocks.en: Tasks passed through a staged and heuristic-based quality-control and derisking funnel before entering training.
blocks.zh: 任务在进入培训前经过一个以高压为基础的质量控制和去冒险漏斗。

blocks.en: We first applied rubric-level quality checks for coverage, atomicity, observability, non-duplication, and appropriate weighting.
blocks.zh: 我们首先对覆盖面、原子性、可观察性、不重复性以及适当的加权进行了分类质量检查。

blocks.en:
Next, we adversarially probed the surviving tasks using both white-box and black-box attackers.
White-box attackers were given the task together with its rubric and grading specification, allowing them to directly probe weaknesses in rubric design and identify ways to earn credit without achieving the intended goal.
Black-box attackers saw only the solver-facing task and environment, and were used primarily to test the intrinsic quality of the task itself, including ambiguity, missing information, unintended shortcuts, and other specification gaps.
Separate rubric and goal judges then evaluated the same frozen deliverables: the rubric judge checked whether the stated criteria were satisfied, while the goal judge independently checked whether the artifact actually achieved the underlying professional objective.
Disagreement between the two exposed potentially underspecified or exploitable tasks.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们利用白盒和黑盒攻击者 来调查幸存的任务
白盒攻击者被赋予任务及其标题和分级规格,使他们能够直接探究标题设计中的弱点,并找出在未实现预定目标的情况下获得信用的方法。
黑匣子攻击者只看到解答器的任务和环境,主要用于测试任务本身的内在质量,包括模糊,缺少信息,意想不到的捷径,以及其他规格漏洞.
单独的标点和标点法官随后评价了相同的被冻结的可交付品:标点法官检查了所述标准是否得到满足,而标点法官则独立检查文物是否真正实现了基本的专业目标.
二者之间的分歧可能未明确或可开发的任务。

blocks.en:
Candidate tasks were subsequently validated through model rollouts to establish empirical solvability, followed by RL derisking runs under the same reward setup used for training.
Failures discovered at later stages fed back into the earlier quality-control process: problematic tasks were revised or removed, while rubric criteria and grader checks were updated to close the observed gaps before the task was re-evaluated.
blocks.zh:
随后通过模式推出验证了候选人的任务,以确定经验性溶解性,随后RL除险运行采用与培训相同的奖励机制。
在以后阶段发现的缺陷反馈到早先的质量控制过程中:有问题的任务被修改或删除,同时更新了标点标准和分级检查,以便在重新评价任务之前弥补所观察到的差距。

blocks.en:
Letting a judge assign rewards introduces its own failure modes.
An agent may produce outputs that superficially satisfy the rubric without completing the intended work, exploit weaknesses in how evidence is judged, or attempt to influence the evaluator through the artifact or environment.
Reward integrity therefore depends on the model, task environment, and evaluator—not just the scoring prompt.
We addressed this by auditing both the final deliverable and the trajectory used to produce it.
During training, an online integrity judge checked whether the policy earned, or attempted to earn, rubric credit through shortcuts such as unsupported provenance, surface-level criterion gaming, or evaluator manipulation; detected cases received zero reward.
Offline audits then inspected artifacts and trajectories for new or ambiguous failure modes and fed those findings back into the task, rubric, and online judge.
Tasks with credible shortcuts or evaluator exploits were removed from subsequent training mixtures until they were repaired and revalidated.
blocks.zh:
让法官分配奖励会引入自己的失败模式。
代理人可以产生表面满足标的而未完成预定工作的产出,利用判断证据的弱点,或试图通过文物或环境影响评估者。
因此,对诚信的奖励取决于模式、任务环境和评价者,而不仅仅是评分的提示。
我们通过审计最后交付品和生产成果的轨迹来解决这一问题。
在培训期间,一名在线廉政法官检查了该项政策是否通过不支持的出处、表面标准游戏或评估员操纵等捷径获得或试图获得名义信用;发现的案件得到的奖励为零。
然后进行离线审计,检查新的或模棱两可的失败模式的文物和轨迹,并将这些结果反馈到任务、标题和在线法官。
具有可信捷径的任务或评估利用的任务从随后的培训混合物中删除,直到修复和重新鉴定为止。

blocks.en: 4.1.11 General Tool Use
blocks.zh: 4.1.11 一般工具使用

blocks.en:
To teach the model to perform general tool use, we sourced single- and multi-turn tasks requiring the model to call a diverse set of tools.
Our tool use tasks involved a prompt, a set of environment-provided tools, a set of artifacts, and either a rubric, a rule-based verifier, and/or an expected environment state-hash.
Tasks were provided to the agent in Harbor format [ 63 ] .
Across all tasks the agent had the opportunity to interact with a total of 1,107 unique tools, with individual tasks exposing 61.9 tools per task on average.
To further increase the model’s exposure to a wide range of tools, we also supplemented the SFT set described in Section 4.1.1 with SFT traces drawn from open-source corpora.
blocks.zh:
为了教该模型进行一般工具的使用,我们源出单回合和多回合的任务,要求该模型调用一套多样的工具.
我们的工具使用任务包括一个即时的,一套环境提供的工具,一套文物,或者一个标题,一个基于规则的核查人,和/或预期的环境状态。
以港湾格式向代理商提供了任务[63].
在所有任务中,代理商都有机会与总共1 107个独特的工具互动,每个任务平均有61.9个工具。
为了进一步增加该模型接触各种工具的机会,我们还用从开源公司提取的SFT痕迹来补充第4.1.1节所述的SFT成套工具。

blocks.en:
A subset of SFT traces supporting general tool use capabilities were included in the agentic teacher’s SFT phase ( Section 4.1.1 ), while the full set were used for the alignment teacher.
The RL tasks were used in training of the alignment teacher ( Section 4.2 ), rather than the agentic teacher.
blocks.zh:
代理教师的SFT阶段(第4.1.1节)中包括了支持一般工具使用能力的SFT痕迹的子集,而全集则用于校对教师.
RL任务用于校对教师的培训(第4.2节),而不是代理教师。

blocks.en: Sourcing
blocks.zh: 判决

blocks.en: We began with tasks both from an open-source corpus [ 78 ] and from proprietary vendor deliveries covering enterprise workflows (manufacturing, finance, insurance, legal and revenue operations), consumer and productivity applications, and multi-turn conversational assistance.
blocks.zh: 我们首先从一个开放源码[78]和专有供应商交付的任务开始,这些任务涉及企业工作流程(制造、财务、保险、法律和收入业务)、消费者和生产力应用以及多回合对话援助。

blocks.en:
Our SFT dataset consisted of traces which were either sourced from open source SFT sets [ 79 , 80 ] or generated synthetically from rollouts on our RL tasks, as in Section 4.1.1 .
Some of the open-source traces lacked reasoning, which we backfilled.
We also applied our trace-level graders, described below.
For traces generated from our RL tasks, we only kept rollouts that earned a full reward, passed our trace graders, and fit in a 64K context, with at most three traces per task.
blocks.zh:
我们的SFT数据集包含来自开源SFT集[79,80]的痕迹,或者像第4.1.1节那样,通过推出我们的RL任务合成生成的痕迹.
一些开源的痕迹缺乏推理,我们回填了.
我们还采用了下文所述的跟踪分级仪。
对于从我们的RL任务中产生的痕迹,我们只保留了获得全额奖励的推出,通过了我们的痕量分级器,并适合一个64K的背景,每个任务最多有三个痕量.

blocks.en: Quality and Difficulty Filtering
blocks.zh: 质量和筛选难度

blocks.en:
We used graders and programmatic checks to ensure that our RL tasks and SFT traces were high quality.
Task-level graders decided whether an RL task was high quality; trace-level graders decided whether a specific rollout could be imitated in SFT.
We developed graders to check for the following pathologies.
blocks.zh:
我们使用分级仪和方案检查,以确保我们的RL任务和SFT痕迹的质量很高。
任务级分级人员决定RL任务是否质量高;痕量级分级人员决定是否可以在SFT中模仿具体的推出.
我们开发了分级器来检查以下的病变.

blocks.en:
As in other domains, a task whose answer can be produced without doing the work is a reward-hacking behavior we wish to avoid completely.
We required that the expected answer was not guessable from the prompt alone, and that tasks did not pass if the environment was unchanged.
We also checked that the simulated user could never reveal the expected answer by checking both the task’s held-back details and rollouts generated from the task.
blocks.zh:
同其他领域一样,一个可以不做工作就提出答案的任务,是我们希望完全避免的报复行为。
我们要求预期的答案不能仅从瞬间中猜到,如果环境没有变化,任务就不会通过。
我们还检查过,模拟用户通过检查任务背负的细节和任务产生的推展,永远无法透露预期的答案。

blocks.en:
We filtered out tasks where the verifier demanded things the instruction never stated, and where the reward was unreasonable given the initial user requirements.
Where golden solutions were available, we also checked that by replaying the golden solutions we could obtain a reward of 1 and score 0 when no actions were taken.
blocks.zh:
我们过滤了核查者要求指示中从未说明的东西的任务,以及考虑到最初用户的要求,奖励是不合理的任务。
在有黄金解决方案的地方,我们也检查过,通过重放黄金解决方案,我们可以在不采取行动的情况下获得1分和0分的奖励.

blocks.en: A judge read the prompts, rubrics and example trace tool calls to flag tasks whose requirements were not covered by its reward function or whose reward function could not be inferred from the task—if it introduced an unrequested requirement, if its tools were insufficient, if its reward function criteria were vague or unscorable, or if its request was unclear or contradictory.
blocks.zh: 法官阅读提示、标语和示例跟踪工具的调用,以标出其奖励功能未涵盖其要求或不能从任务中推断其奖励功能的任务——如果引入了未经要求的要求,如果其工具不足,如果其奖励功能标准模糊或不可调和,或者如果其要求不明确或自相矛盾。

blocks.en:
A trace had to be structurally valid: reasoning on every assistant turn, only known tools called, arguments that validated against the tool schema, and every call answered exactly once.
A tool-use judge then checked instruction adherence, that reported facts were grounded in tool outputs, and that reasoning was consistent with the action taken.
A conduct grader additionally rejected traces that pasted raw tool output or made useless calls or repeated tool calls.
We also checked for broken reward functions at a trace level, ensuring that a rollout was earned by a genuine completion of the task and not a shortcut.
Any missing reasoning was backfilled (as described in Section 4.1.11 ) and then graded to ensure causal consistency.
We also checked to ensure that any reasoning or assistant messages were in the same language as the original user message.
blocks.zh:
追踪必须在结构上有效:每个助手转弯时的推理,只有已知的工具被调用,验证了反对工具计划的论点,每个呼叫都准确回答一次.
然后,一名工具使用法官检查遵守指示的情况,报告的事实以工具产出为依据,推理与所采取的行动一致。
一个行为分级器又拒绝了粘贴原始工具输出的痕迹,或者让无用的呼叫或重复的工具呼叫.
我们还在追踪一级检查了断裂的奖励功能,确保通过真正完成任务而不是捷径获得推广。
任何缺失的推理都回填(如第4.1.1.1节所述),然后分级以确保因果一致性。
我们还检查过,以确保任何推理或助理信息都使用与原始用户信息相同的语言。

blocks.en: Training Considerations
blocks.zh: 培训考虑

blocks.en:
Tasks were graded via programmatic rules and/or rubrics.
In all cases, a score of one was assigned only when the task passed all scoring criteria; there was no partial credit.
blocks.zh:
通过方案规则和(或)标题对任务进行分级。
在所有情况下,只有在任务通过所有评分标准时才分配一个分数;没有部分分数。

blocks.en:
A task’s tools were presented in one of two ways.
With passthrough, every tool was advertised under its own name with its full JSON schema in the developer prompt, which gave the policy typed schemas immediately and ate into the model’s context length.
With the meta-tool, only three tools were advertised: a listing tool that returned a compact registry (one line per tool, required parameters marked), a describe tool that returned full descriptions and typed parameters on demand, and a call tool that routed the invocation and rejected unknown names.
This resembled some common harnesses.
During RL we presented tools through one of the two surfaces, chosen with equal probability.
blocks.zh:
以两种方式之一介绍了一项任务的工具。
每一个工具都以自己的名字在开发商的提示下以完整的JSON schema发布广告,这让政策型的schemas立刻进入模型的背景长度.
有了元工具,只有三种工具被公示:一个上市工具返回一个紧凑的注册(每个工具一行,需要的参数标记),一个描述工具根据要求返回完整的描述和打入的参数,以及一个调用工具,引导引用和拒绝未知名称.
这就像一些常见的绳子。
在RL期间,我们通过两个表面中的一个提供了工具,选择概率相等。

blocks.en: Task Distribution Analysis
blocks.zh: 任务分配分析

blocks.en:
We classified tool surfaces into the 27 categories from Xu et al. [79] with a classifier over each task’s tool set.
The open-source SFT corpora are broad but skew toward consumer categories (weather, web search, travel, e-commerce), whereas the RL tasks concentrated in business and enterprise categories (database operations, finance, customer relationship management, productivity, legal).
blocks.zh:
我们把工具表面分为徐等人的27个类别. [79] 在每个任务的工具组上设置一个分类器。
开放源代码SFT公司面向消费者类别(天气、网络搜索、旅行、电子商务),而RL任务集中于企业类别(数据库业务、财务、客户关系管理、生产力、法律)。

blocks.en:
While all of our tasks were multi-step (i.e., requiring multiple tool calls), some of our tasks were additionally multi-turn (i.e., involving multiple user messages).
Single-turn tasks (41%) contained a single user message where the user stated the request once and the agent worked autonomously until it stopped calling tools or submitted.
The remainder (59%) were multi-turn tasks in which the assistant asked follow-up questions to a simulated user, which was implemented either as a scripted persona or as a judge persona that disclosed details when asked.
Multi-turn episodes averaged around 13 turns and 30 tool calls.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们的所有任务都是多步骤的(即需要多个工具呼叫),但是我们的一些任务是额外的多回合(即涉及多个用户信息).
单回合任务(41%)包含一个单一用户信息,用户一次声明请求,代理者自主工作,直到停止调用工具或提交.
其余(59%)是多回合任务,其中助理向一个模拟用户提出后续问题,或作为脚本人物执行,或作为法官人物在被询问时披露细节。
多个回合的场次平均在13个回合和30个工具呼叫左右.

blocks.en: 4.2 Alignment Teacher: Aligning a Model to Human Values
blocks.zh: 4.2 对齐教师:将模式与人类价值观接轨

blocks.en:
We trained a second alignment teacher whose goal was to ensure the final model’s adherence to human values such as safety, accuracy, instruction-following, and helpfulness.
The alignment teacher’s starting point was the same midtrained checkpoint used for its sibling agentic teacher ( Section 4.1 ), and we used a similar supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) recipe, with a few key differences.
blocks.zh:
我们培养了第二位校对教师,他的目标是确保最终模式坚持人类价值观,如安全、准确、遵循教学和帮助。
校对老师的起点是同一家训练有素的检查站,

blocks.en:
The first difference was that steering the model’s behavior towards these values required a broader set of SFT demonstrations and RL tasks beyond coding, STEM, and terminal use.
Our data mixture spanned the domains of writing and editing, fact-finding, document understanding, open-ended conversation, and multi-turn collaboration to achieve user goals.
The second difference was that model properties like helpfulness and safety cannot be easily verified programmatically.
We thus used a combination of verifiable checks, task-level rubrics applied by a judge, and generative reward models calibrated to human ground-truth judgments.
Finally, the principles we sought to teach the model were often in tension with one another. For example, safety can conflict with instruction-following, and helpfulness can come at the expense of accuracy.
We took a quality-over-quantity approach to constructing the data mixture and conducted shorter runs with regular human-in-the-loop evaluations.
This allowed us to quickly adjust subjective criteria, tune delicate tradeoffs, catch reward hacks, and iteratively shape the model’s behavior.
blocks.zh:
第一个不同之处在于引导模型的行为向这些值的方向发展,需要一系列更广泛的SFT演示和RL任务,超越编码、STEM和终端使用。
我们的数据混合涉及编写和编辑、实况调查、文件理解、开放式对话以及多回合协作以实现用户目标等领域。
第二个不同之处是,诸如帮助和安全等模型特性难以在方案上加以核实。
因此,我们综合运用了可核查的检查、法官采用的任务级别标准以及根据人类地面真实性判断调整的基因奖励模式。
最后,我们试图教导这一模式的原则往往相互矛盾。 例如,安全性可能与遵循指令相冲突,而帮助可能牺牲准确性。
我们在构建数据混合物时采用了质量超过数量的方法,并进行了较短的运行,定期进行人与人之间的“即时”评价。
这让我们能够快速调整主观标准,调和微妙的权衡,抓住奖励黑客,迭代地塑造模型的行为.

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Objectives

We defined the desired behavior of the model in terms of a hierarchy of principles [ 81 ] .
The first tier of principles are invariants that the model should follow without exception, and should never be overridden by system, developer, or user messages or subsequent principles: • Safety, as defined by Reflection’s safety guidelines.
See Section 7 for details on our safety post-training. • Model Identity, i.e. maintaining its core identity as an AI assistant. The second tier are commitments the model should always strive to uphold; these interact with system, developer, and user messages: • Accuracy, including factuality of claims, faithfulness to the input context, and calibrated confidence about these. • Instruction Following, including compliance with system and developer instructions, transparent pursuit of user objectives, and reasonable resolution of uncertainty. The third tier are helpful defaults that we want the model to maintain in the absence of other instructions. • Helpfulness covers aspects of user interaction quality and style including the comprehensiveness, efficiency, proactivity, and consistency of model responses.
blocks.zh:
我们用原则的等级来定义模型的理想行为[81].
第一层原则是模式应毫无例外地遵循的,绝不能被系统、开发者或用户信息或随后的原则所压倒: 安全,如Reflection的安全准则所定义。
关于我们的安全培训后的详细情况,见第7节。 • 模式身份,即保持其作为AI助手的核心身份。 第二层是模型应始终坚持的承诺;这些承诺与系统、开发者和用户信息相互作用:准确性,包括索赔要求的准确性、对输入背景的忠诚以及对这些信息的准确性。 • 遵循指示,包括遵守系统和开发者指示,透明地追求用户目标,合理解决不确定性。 第三层是有用的默认,我们希望模型在没有其他指令的情况下能够维护. • 帮助涉及用户互动的质量和风格,包括模型反应的全面性、效率、积极性和一致性。

blocks.en:
Safety, as defined by Reflection’s safety guidelines.
See Section 7 for details on our safety post-training.
blocks.zh:
安全,由Reflection的安全准则定义.
关于我们的安全培训后的详细情况,见第7节。

blocks.en: Model Identity, i.e. maintaining its core identity as an AI assistant.
blocks.zh: 模型身份,即保持其作为AI助手的核心身份.

blocks.en: Accuracy, including factuality of claims, faithfulness to the input context, and calibrated confidence about these.
blocks.zh: 准确性,包括权利要求的事实质量,对输入背景的忠诚,以及对这些内容的校准信心.

blocks.en: Instruction Following, including compliance with system and developer instructions, transparent pursuit of user objectives, and reasonable resolution of uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 遵循指令,包括遵守系统和开发者指令,透明地追求用户目标,合理解决不确定性。

blocks.en: Helpfulness covers aspects of user interaction quality and style including the comprehensiveness, efficiency, proactivity, and consistency of model responses.
blocks.zh: 帮助涉及用户互动的质量和风格,包括模型反应的全面性、效率、积极性和一致性。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Supervised Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 监督罚款

blocks.en:
To initialize the alignment teacher, we compiled a set of demonstrations spanning a variety of domains and use-cases ( Table 8 ).
Empirically, we observed that shared demonstrations with the agentic teacher (including SWE, STEM, and terminal-use data) improved the convergence speed of MOPD (see Section 4.3 ) and built a stronger prior for the alignment teacher’s user-assistant interaction training.
blocks.zh:
为了初始化校对教师,我们汇编了一系列跨越多个领域和使用案例的演示(表8)。
与代理教师(包括SWE、STEM和终端使用数据)共同的示威提高了MOPD的聚合速度(见第4.3节),

blocks.en: Table 8: SFT data mixture of the alignment teacher.
blocks.zh: 表8:校对师的SFT数据混合物.

blocks.en:
For each principle that we explicitly trained for in RL, we included a small amount of targeted SFT data to seed the desired behavior.
We describe those specific datasets in their corresponding RL subsections.
We often self-distilled from our older checkpoints, particularly in cases where the responses should draw from the model’s own knowledge (see Section 4.2.3 ).
blocks.zh:
对于我们在RL中明确培训的每一项原则,我们包含了少量有针对性的SFT数据,以孕育理想的行为.
我们在其相应的RL小节中描述这些具体数据集。
我们常常从旧的检查站中自我疏远,特别是如果这些反应应该从模型本身的知识中吸取(见第4.2.3节)。

blocks.en:
Helpful user-assistant multi-turn interaction. We sought to give the model priors on how to respond helpfully and safely across extended conversations with users on open-ended topics.
Thus, we emphasized realism and diversity across both topics (e.g. Arts & Entertainment, Finance, Jobs & Education) and conversational modes (e.g. Ideas and Brainstorming, Casual Chat, Writing and Editing).
We started the synthetic conversations with heavily filtered prompts from WildChat [ 82 ] which includes real user queries up through August 2025.
This dataset has been shown to be representative of real-world distributions, proving useful for spotting misaligned behavior as recently as June of 2026 [ 83 ] .
Then, we generated user-assistant conversations involving 1–32 turns with a user simulator in the loop.
Since the WildChat dataset contains clusters of conversations with similar prompt templates, we limited the number of identical prompts to three per cluster to ensure we did not overrepresent specific prompts.
We also truncated conversations at the first verbatim-repeated assistant response or follow-up message that was deemed unnecessary by a judge.
blocks.zh:
用户-助手多回合互动。 我们力求让模式先行者了解如何在与用户就开放式议题进行广泛对话时作出有益和安全的反应。
因此,我们强调现实主义和多样性,涉及两个专题(如艺术与娱乐、金融、就业和教育)和对话模式(如思想与集思广益、空谈、写作与编辑)。
我们开始用来自WildChat [82] 的大量过滤提示进行合成对话,其中包括2025年8月之前的真正用户查询。
这个数据集被证明代表了现实世界的分布,证明最近到2026年6月[83],对于发现错位行为是有用的.
然后,我们产生了用户协助的对话,涉及1-32转动,在循环中有一个用户模拟器。
自从荒野 聊天数据集包含带有类似即时模板的对话集群,我们把相同的提示数限制在每组3个,以确保我们不会过度表示具体的提示.
我们还在法官认为不必要的第一次逐字记录助理答复或后续信息中进行了简短的交谈。

blocks.en:
We filtered model generations to remove traces which leaked system or developer prompt instructions into the responses that the user messages did not warrant, and traces containing non-English text in either the reasoning or final response (as the model was trained primarily for English use).
Finally, we audited model responses to time-sensitive prompts and tasks which needed live data or unavailable tools and removed traces where the model guessed answers instead of acknowledging the uncertainty in its knowledge or lack of tool access, to avoid accidentally encouraging hallucinations.
blocks.zh:
我们过滤了模型世代,以去除泄露系统或开发者迅速指示的痕迹,输入用户信息没有根据的回复,以及推理或最后回复中包含非英语文本的痕迹(因为模型主要是为英语使用而训练的)。
最后,我们审计了模型对时间敏感的提示和任务的反应,这些提示和任务需要实时数据或没有可用的工具,并消除了模型猜测答案的痕迹,而不是承认其知识的不确定性或缺乏工具获取,以避免意外鼓励幻觉。

blocks.en:
Reasoning over long inputs. To preserve the model’s long-context capabilities from midtraining (see Section 3.6 ), we incorporated long-context traces into the SFT mixture.
We assembled tasks whose inputs span 16K to 200K tokens, drawn from two sources: open-source long-context datasets (multi-document question answering, retrieval and aggregation over long documents and long-input reasoning tasks) and vendor-authored tasks built on long source documents with human-written rubrics.
For each prompt we sampled N completions with an open-weights model.
Tasks with verifiable answers were graded by exact match, accuracy etc. against reference answers; open-ended tasks were graded by a judge against per-task rubrics covering correctness, grounding in the provided context, and completeness.
We selected the highest-scoring candidate per task and kept only traces that cleared a score threshold.
These traces produced significant gains on long-context benchmarks for the SFT checkpoint without regressing short-context performance, and the gains carried through to the RL stage.
blocks.zh:
原因是投入过长。 为了保持该模型的长文本能力,使其远离中训(见第3.6节),我们在SFT混合物中加入了长文本痕迹。
我们从两个来源收集了16K至200K个信使的任务:开源长文数据集(多文件问题回答、检索和汇总长文文件和长文推理任务)和供应商授权的任务,这些任务建立在长文源文件基础上,带有人文文字。
每一次我们用一个开放式的量子模型对N的完成进行抽样。
具有可核实答案的任务按精确的匹配度、准确度等对参考答案进行分级;开放式任务由法官按每个任务分级,包括正确性、上下文和完整性。
我们选择了每项任务得分最高的候选人,只保留了清除得分门槛的痕迹。
这些痕迹在SFT检查站的长文基准上取得了显著进展,但没有使短文业绩倒退,这些成果也一直延续到RL阶段。

blocks.en: Predicting RL Evolution from the SFT Checkpoint
blocks.zh: 从 SFT 检查点预测 RL 进化

blocks.en:
Recent industry reports have found that most of a model’s safety- and alignment-relevant behaviors are already in place at the SFT checkpoint [ 84 , 85 ] .
We found that the SFT checkpoint is indeed predictive of alignment-relevant behaviors, but their prevalence can change dramatically through RL, similar to Wong et al. [86] .
Taking inspiration from population genetics, we found that we could more accurately predict the evolution of behaviors through RL using a combination of prevalence at SFT and selective advantage under the reward function.
blocks.zh:
最近的行业报告发现,在SFT检查站[84,85],一个模型的大多数安全性和一致性相关行为已经到位。
我们发现,SFT检查站确实预言了与校正相关的行为,但其流行程度可以通过RL发生巨大变化,类似于Wong等人. [86] (中文(简体) ).
从人口遗传学的启发下,我们发现,我们可以更准确地预测行为通过RL通过SFT的流行和奖励功能下的选择性优势的结合来进行演化.

blocks.en:
Under GRPO, a rollout pushes the policy toward itself in proportion to its normalized advantage, so a behavior present in a fraction π \pi of rollouts with mean advantage A ¯ \bar{A} gains log-weight Δ ​ θ = κ ​ η ⋅ π ⋅ A ¯ \Delta\theta=\kappa\eta\cdot\pi\cdot\bar{A} per batch, with κ ​ η \kappa\eta being a single learning constant of the training recipe.
If the behavior’s rewards sit g g within-group standard deviations above the alternatives (its selective advantage under the reward) then its log-odds L L follow a replicator-type equation: d ​ L d ​ t ≈ 2 ​ κ ​ η ​ g ​ π ​ ( 1 − π ) \frac{dL}{dt}\approx 2\kappa\eta g\pi(1-\pi)

Behaviors with g > 0 g>0 are amplified, g < 0 g<0 squashed, and g ≈ 0 g\approx 0 frozen at their SFT prevalence.
The SFT prevalence π 0 \pi_{0} and g g are measured at step 0 from a few dozen scored groups; κ ​ η \kappa\eta is fitted once on one completed run and reused across runs.
Applied to the reward itself, the same update gives d ​ R d ​ t = κ ​ η ​ σ R \frac{dR}{dt}=\kappa\eta\sigma_{R} , with σ R \sigma_{R} the within-group reward standard deviation, so reward climbs with the spread that remains and saturates at the pass@ k k ceiling.

具有 g 的行为 > 0 g>0 被放大, g < 0 g<0 被压扁, 和 g → 0 g\\ 0 在它们的 SFT 流行时被冻结 。
SFT 流行率 ~ 0\pi\0} 和 g 是从几十个得分的组进行0级测量的; off $\kappa\eta 在一个完成的运行和跨运行再利用时安装一次 。
适用于奖励本身,同样的更新给予d R d t = o = o = σ R\ frac{ dR}{dt}=\kappa\eta\sigma_{R}, 与 σ R\sigma_{R} 团体内奖励标准偏差, 因此奖励随着在  k / k k 上限 上方的分布和饱和度攀升.

blocks.en:
With κ ​ η \kappa\eta fitted on a single run, the reward equation predicts the realized gain of each reward component across 318 runs better than the pass@ k k ceiling alone ( r = 0.79 r=0.79 v.s. r = 0.46 r=0.46 ).
Moreover, with the same κ ​ η \kappa\eta and only step-0 measurements, the behavior equation predicted whether a misbehavior would be amplified or squashed under different reward functions.
Using such predictions, we designed interventions including filters and reward modifications to squash undesired behaviors such as template-heavy scaffolding and unnecessary markdown formatting.
blocks.zh:
在单次运行中安装了 $\ kappa\eta 时, 奖励方程预测318 个奖励部分的实现收益优于通过数@ kk 单是上限(r=0.79 r=0.79 v.r=0.46 r).
此外,用相同的 $\ kappa\eta 并仅进行步骤 - 0 测量, 行为方程预测一个不当行为是否会在不同的奖励函数下被放大或被抵消 。
利用这些预测,我们设计了干预措施,包括过滤器和奖励性修改,以压制不受欢迎的行为,如模板重脚手架和不必要的降标格式。

图25:可预测的RL演变。 左翼:预计SFT检查站的奖励收益与通过RL实现的收益相比,各部分针对不同原则。

散射显示在318次训练后运行中分布,大符号代表最终对齐老师.
