奖励函数的变化(绿色圆圈)准确预测了对不当行为的压制.

blocks.en: 4.2.3 RL Training
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 RL 培训

blocks.en: Safety
blocks.zh: 安全问题

blocks.en:
Safety is the highest priority invariant within our model principles.
We trained the model to align to Reflection’s safety guidelines via targeted SFT and RL.
See Sections 7.2.2 and 7.2.3 for a description of our methods.
blocks.zh:
在我们的模式原则中,安全是最高优先的。
我们通过定向SFT和RL来训练该模型,以配合Reflection的安全准则。
关于我们的方法,见第7.2.2和7.2.3节。

blocks.en: Model Identity
blocks.zh: 型号标识

blocks.en:
An influential idea in alignment research is that models learn about many different personas through pretraining, but select a specific “AI assistant” persona through different stages of post-training [ 87 ] .
It has been observed that deviations from this persona are predictive of misaligned behavior [ 88 ] ; hence, we consider maintaining core identity as an AI assistant to be a second invariant .
In order to bake this identity into the model weights, we train the model on an RL environment that reinforces the default persona of Beam, a helpful AI assistant trained by Reflection.
We seeded the identity in SFT using handwritten and synthetically generated traces, half with our default system prompt and half with a generic system prompt (“You are a helpful assistant”…).
Our RL tasks included both realistic inquiries about model identity, as well as adversarial inquiries that attempted to alter core identity, and were scored by a judge to capture nuance and negations.
blocks.zh:
校正研究中一个有影响力的想法是,模型通过预训来了解许多不同的人,但通过培训后的不同阶段选择一个特定的“AI助理”人a [87].
据观察,与这个人物的偏差是对错位行为的预测[88];因此,我们认为保持作为AI助手的核心身份是第二个变化无常的.
为了将这个身份烤成模型重量,我们用RL环境来训练这个模型,这个环境强化了Beam的默认人物a,一个由Reflection训练的有帮助的AI助手.
我们使用手写和合成生成的痕迹在SFT中植入了身份,其中一半是默认系统即时,一半是通用系统即时(“你是一个有帮助的助手......”)。
我们的RL任务包括:对模式身份进行现实的询问,以及试图改变核心身份的对抗性询问,并被一名法官打分以获取细微差别和否定。

blocks.en: Accuracy & Calibrated Confidence
blocks.zh: 精确度校准( C) 信心

blocks.en:
In accordance with our model principles, we want our model to provide accurate and factual answers and be well-calibrated to the limits of its own parametric knowledge.
To this end, the knowledge calibration component trains the model to only answer factual questions when it knows the answer, and to abstain when it does not.
Accuracy measures whether an answer is correct, whereas calibration also asks whether the model should have answered at all.
Accuracy-only training and evaluation tend to reward guessing, which helps explain why models often answer confidently when uncertain [ 89 ] .
blocks.zh:
根据我们的模型原则,我们希望我们的模型能够提供准确和事实的答案,并很好地调整到它自己的参数知识的极限.
为此,知识校准组件训练模型只有在知道答案时才能回答事实问题,而在不知道答案时才能弃权.
准确性衡量一个答案是否正确,而校准也问该模型是否应该回答。
只有准确性的培训和评价往往奖励猜测,这有助于解释为什么模型在不确定时往往有自信地回答[89].

blocks.en:
We generated closed-book, short-answer questions from documents in our pretraining web corpus so that correctness depends only on the model’s parametric knowledge.
These questions are self-contained with a single answer.
Additional filters removed time-sensitive questions, ambiguous questions with multiple valid answers, questions which cannot be answered using the source document, and false-premise questions. Some example questions generated using our pipeline are as follows:
blocks.zh:
我们从我们训练前的网络教程中从文件中产生了封闭的、简短的回答问题,因此正确性只取决于模型的参数化知识。
这些问题是自成一体的,只有一个答案。
额外的过滤器移除了时间敏感的问题,带有多个有效答案的模糊问题,无法使用源文档解答的问题,以及假真问题. 利用我们的管道所产生的一些问题如下:

blocks.en: Domain Question Extracted Gold Answer Biochemistry What are fatty acid ethyl esters (FAEEs) direct metabolites of? Ethanol Food culture Who was the north Texas newspaperman credited with inventing “Two-Alarm Chili”? Wick Fowler Photography In what year did photographer Herman Leonard open his own studio in Greenwich Village? 1948 Law Which section of the California Fish and Game Code governs notification requirements for non-emergency streambed alteration projects? Section 1602
blocks.zh: 域 域 域 域 域 脂肪酸乙酯(FAEE)的直接代谢物是什么? 伊森诺尔食品文化 谁是德克萨斯州北部的记者 发明了“双报警奇利”? 威克·福勒摄影 摄影师赫尔曼·伦纳德在格林威治村开自己的工作室是哪一年? 1948年法律 《加利福尼亚鱼类和游戏法》哪节规定了非紧急溪流板改造项目的通知要求? 第1602节

blocks.en:
Since our initial policy rarely abstains, the behavior must be present before RL can reinforce it.
We constructed an SFT set with 66% abstentions and 33% correct answers. These were created from the model’s own rollouts, since the boundary being demonstrated is Beam’s parametric knowledge and is specific to the SFT checkpoint.
A prior Beam checkpoint that was trained with knowledge calibration tasks during RL was sampled 16 times per question at six reasoning efforts; abstentions were taken from questions whose rollouts contained only abstentions and wrong answers (abstentions in the majority), and correct answers from questions whose rollouts contained only correct answers and abstentions (correct in the majority).
We used stratified random sampling across the six reasoning efforts and retained one filtered trace per question.
blocks.zh:
由于我们最初的政策很少投弃权票,所以在RL强化之前,行为必须存在.
我们以66%的弃权率和33%的正确答案建造了一套SFT。 这些是该模型自己推出的,因为所展示的边界是Beam的参数化知识,是SFT检查站特有的。
先前的Beam检查站在RL期间接受了知识校准任务的培训,在6次推理中每个问题抽查了16次;对只包含弃权和错误答案的问题弃权(多数人弃权),对仅包含正确答案和弃权(多数人正确)的问题作出正确答复。
我们用分层随机抽样 6个推理工作 并保留一个过滤的跟踪每个问题。

blocks.en:
With abstention seeded, we selected RL tasks to maximize signal in GRPO: a question teaches the model to abstain only when its responses include both abstentions and wrong answers, and to answer only when correct responses appear alongside abstentions.
Rather than sampling at random, we scored 16 responses per candidate question with the RL judge and reward, discarded questions whose responses all receive the same reward (all correct, all wrong, or all abstained), and binned the rest by mean reward into five bands, drawing equally from each and requiring at least one abstention in the low-reward bands.
This kept both sides of the calibration boundary represented and kept groups away from the saturated rewards at which the trainer discards them, so the component’s small share of the mixture stays informative throughout training.
blocks.zh:
在投弃权票的情况下,我们选择了RL任务,以便在GRPO中实现信号最大化:一个问题教导模型只有在其答复既包括弃权也包括错误的答案时才能弃权,只有在正确答复同时出现弃权时才能回答。
而不是随机抽查,我们给每个候选人的问题打出16个答复,由RL评委和奖励,放弃所有答复都得到相同奖励的问题(所有正确,所有错误,或所有弃权),以平均奖励的方式将其余部分分为五个段,从每个段中平等抽取,要求低奖励段至少1个弃权。
这使校准边界的两边都有代表,使各组远离训练员抛弃的饱和奖励,因此,该成分在混合物中所占的一小部分在整个训练期间都保持信息。

blocks.en:
A strict judge compares the model’s final answer with the (offline) search-verified gold answer and assigns one of three outcomes—correct (1.0), abstain (0.5), and wrong (0.0).
Since abstaining always gets a reward of 0.5, answering is beneficial only when the expected reward p > 0.5 p>0.5 .
This is closely related to ternary abstention rewards studied in Reinforced Hesitation [ 90 ] .
Knowledge calibration accounts for approximately 3% of the RL mixture.
Each task also has one of the ten variants of a developer message which encourages short-form responses.
blocks.zh:
严格意义上的法官将模型的最后答案与(离线)搜索验证的黄金答案进行比较,并指定三个结果之一——正确(1.0)、弃权(0.5)和错误(0.0)。
由于弃权总是得到0.5的奖励,只有在预期的奖励p > 0.5p > 0.5时,回答才有益。
这与在强化犹豫中研究的三弃权奖励密切相关。
知识校准约占RL混合物的3%.
每项任务还有一个开发者消息的十个变体之一,鼓励短式响应.

blocks.en:
We moved away from a five-way reward [ 24 ] (confident correct > > hedged correct > > abstain > > hedged incorrect > > incorrect) as the policy learned to exploit the judge’s drawback of inferring confidence from the response wording.
We tightened the judge prompt to penalize multiple answers, empty answers, and reward hedged commitments as abstentions.
Rewarding such hedged commitments as abstentions rather than wrong or correct can help with mitigating potential over-refusal behavior that could leak into other alignment environments—especially ones that do need the model to reasonably provide a potential answer with hedging if not confident and not always offer a clean abstention as the answer.
blocks.zh:
我们远离了五行的报应。 套期正确的 > > 弃权 > > 由于政策是用来利用法官从答复措辞中推断信任的缺点的,因此存在套期错误。
我们收紧了法官 迅速惩罚多重答案 空洞的答案 和奖励被套期承诺 作为弃权。
将这种被套期承诺作为弃权而不是错误或纠正的回报,可有助于减轻可能渗入其他调整环境的潜在过度反制行为——特别是那些确实需要这种模式以套期为目的合理提供潜在答案,如果这种模式不具有信心,而且并不总是能提供明确的弃权作为答案。

blocks.en:
Figure 26 shows how the rate of confident errors drops as training progresses, with accuracy on questions classified as known remaining approximately stable on our held-out test set.
This demonstrates that knowledge calibration RL trains the model to selectively abstain on questions without simply suppressing answers everywhere.
blocks.zh:
图26显示信心差错率如何随着培训的进展而下降,在被归类为已知的问题上的准确性在我们搁置的测试中保持了大约稳定。
这表明,知识校准RL训练模型有选择地对问题投弃权票,而不简单地压制各地的答案。

blocks.en:
We found that higher reasoning efforts (REs) at inference time caused the model to commit to incorrect answers more often than lower REs, corroborating prior work [ 91 ] that shows that longer reasoning (i.e. higher RE) results in fewer abstentions even to unanswerable queries.
Notably, knowledge calibration RL seemed to mitigate this tendency.
Before RL (i.e., at step 0 of RL), 41% of the test set questions the model abstained on at low RE became wrong answers at high RE; after RL, this proportion fell to 12%.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,在推论时间作出更高的推理努力(REs),导致模型比较低的REs更经常地承诺作出不正确的回答,从而证实了先前的工作[91],这表明较长的推理(即较高的RE)导致甚至更少的弃权,甚至导致无法回答的询问.
值得注意的是,知识校准RL似乎减轻了这一趋势。
在RL(即RL的0步)之前,41%的测试设定质疑在低RE时弃权的模型在高RE时成为错误的答案;在RL之后,这个比例下降到12%.

blocks.en:
Too little abstention produces confident errors; too much abstention produces a safe but unhelpful model.
Since a single aggregate index can hide this distinction, we report accuracy, wrong-answer rate, and abstention rate separately on AA-Omniscience [ 92 ] in Section 5 .
blocks.zh:
太多的弃权产生自信的错误;太多的弃权产生一种安全但无益的模式。
由于单一的汇总指数可以掩盖这种区别,我们在第5节中分别报告AA-Omniscience[92]上的准确性、错误回答率和弃权率。

blocks.en: Knowledge calibration RL does not teach the model new facts; it leads to fewer wrong answers rather than more right ones.
blocks.zh: 知识校准RL不教模型新事实;它导致错误答案较少,而不是更正确的答案.

blocks.en:
Figure 26: Knowledge Calibration Training Reduces Hallucinations and Increases Honest Abstentions. Top left: how the model answers its training questions over RL, from an offline five-level regrade of sampled training rollouts; the model was trained with the three-level reward (correct / declined / wrong).
Top right: 117 held-out questions grouped by how often the pre-RL checkpoint answered them correctly in 16 samples; each point pools the 20 steps before its x.
Bottom left: accuracy and hallucination on held-out knowledge calibration questions graded by the training judge, same pooling.
Bottom right: the same rates on AA-Omniscience, 600 questions, external judge, evaluated at every tenth checkpoint.
Hallucination is wrong answers divided by all non-correct answers, i.e. the share of non-correct answers that are wrong rather than declined.
blocks.zh:
图26:知识校准培训减少幻觉,提高诚意。 左上方:模型如何在RL上解答其训练问题,从五级线下复级的抽样培训展开;模型通过三级奖励(正确/下降/错误)进行训练.
右上方:117个被搁置的问题,按前RL检查站在16个样本中正确回答的次数分组;每个点集合其x前的20步.
左下方:在被训练法官分级的被搁置的知识校准问题上准确度和幻觉,同为集合.
右下角:AA-Omniscience的收费率相同,有600个问题,是外聘法官,每10个检查点评估一次.
迷幻是错误的答案除以所有不正确的答案,即错误而不是下降的不正确的答案的比例.

blocks.en: Faithfulness to Context
blocks.zh: 对背景的忠诚度

blocks.en:
We created two RL environments targeting faithfulness, or factuality with respect to the input context, with a particular focus on contexts longer than 32K tokens.
The first environment paired documents from our midtraining corpus with custom-written long-generation requests over it, and used a judge to reward both faithfulness and instruction-following.
The second used a novel SQL-based synthetic pipeline that scored model responses using programmatic verification.
blocks.zh:
我们创造了两个RL环境,针对的是忠诚,或与输入环境有关的事实,特别侧重于超过32K符号的环境.
我们的中级培训中的第一个环境文件 与定制的 长世代的请求配对 并用一名法官来奖励 忠诚和遵循指示。
第二套采用了基于SQL的新型合成管道,通过方案核查对模型响应进行评分.

blocks.en:
The grounded queries RL component pairs one document with one long-generation request written for it.
Documents are GoodWiki [ 93 ] Wikipedia articles and web documents from our midtraining corpus.
A judge generated one user request per document over nine request types that require long-form model responses, ranging from summarization to fact-finding to pros/cons listing, inspired by the FACTS Grounding [ 94 ] paradigm.
blocks.zh:
被基于的查询 RL 组件将一个文档与一个长代请求对齐。
文档为GoodWiki[93] 维基百科的文章和我们中训的网络文档.
一名法官根据FACTS Grounding[94]范式,每份文件生成一个用户请求,涉及9个需要长式模型答复的类别,从总结到实况调查,再到平手/平手。

blocks.en:
To keep responses faithful even with longer input context lengths, we extended our synthetic pipeline to longer documents.
Same-topic documents (GoodWiki articles from one Wikipedia category, web documents with the same Dewey Decimal Classification (DDC) topic) are packed into a single context of 2 to 40 documents.
Over each packed context we generated two types of question that required synthesis across the documents in a 50/50 mix: • navigation queries: the answer is scattered over multiple documents, in four flavors: cross document comparison, cross document synthesis, aggregate fact finding, relationship analysis. • multi-hop queries: 4 to 7 chained retrieval or computation steps (arithmetic, date math, counting, ranking, set operations), with an explicit output-format instruction. All grounded queries tasks shared one judge reward, adapted from the FACTS Grounding judge rubric.
An instruction-following judge checks that the response actually addresses every part of the request, calibrated against the reference answer.
A claim-level faithfulness judge checks that every claim is supported by the provided context.
blocks.zh:
为了保持回应的忠实,即使输入上下文长度更长,我们还是将我们的合成管道扩大到更长的文件。
同专题文件 (GoodWiki的文章来自维基百科的一个类别,具有相同杜威十进制分类(DDC)主题的网络文档被包装成2到40个文档的单一上下文.
在每打包的上下文中,我们提出了两类问题,需要以50/50的混合方式在文件之间进行综合:导航查询:答案分散在多种文件上,分为四种口味:交叉文件比较、交叉文件综合、汇总事实发现、关系分析。 ·多跳查询:4至7个链式检索或计算步骤(算术,日期数学,计数,排名,设置操作),并有明确的输出格式指示. 所有有根据的查询任务都有一个法官奖赏,改编自FACTS地面法官奖赏。
遵循指示的法官对照参考答复,检查答复是否确实涉及请求的每个部分。
索赔一级忠实的法官核实每一项索赔都有提供的背景证明。

blocks.en: navigation queries: the answer is scattered over multiple documents, in four flavors: cross document comparison, cross document synthesis, aggregate fact finding, relationship analysis.
blocks.zh: 导航查询:答案分散在多个文档上,分为四种口味:交叉文档比较,交叉文档综合,汇总事实发现,关系分析.

blocks.en: multi-hop queries: 4 to 7 chained retrieval or computation steps (arithmetic, date math, counting, ranking, set operations), with an explicit output-format instruction.
blocks.zh: 多跳查询:4至7个链式检索或计算步骤(算术,日期数学,计数,排名,设置操作),带有明确的输出格式指示.

blocks.en:
One limitation of judge based long-context RL tasks is that judges become more unreliable as the input context gets longer.
We designed a synthetic SQL-engine-based long-context RLVR environment starting from structured data.
The SQL engine provides verifiable answers and identifies the source facts, which we render into documents alongside distractors to create long-context tasks.
This allowed us to train with rule-based rewards instead of relying on a judge.
blocks.zh:
对法官长文RL任务的一个限制是,随着输入语境变长,法官变得更加不可靠.
我们设计了一个基于SQL-引擎的合成长文本RLVR环境,从结构化数据开始.
SQL引擎提供了可核查的答案并识别出源事实,我们将其与分散器一起制成文件,以创建长文本任务.
这使我们得以根据规则进行训练,而不是依靠法官。

blocks.en:
We were inspired by the observation that SQL primitives map to the skills a long-context task requires.
A filtered read of the fact table is a retrieval.
An aggregate, comparison, or ranking over the rows read is a reasoning step.
A read whose filter uses a value computed by an earlier stage is a dependent hop, so a chain of such reads is multi-hop retrieval, and several independent reads are breadth.
The full pipeline is illustrated in Figure 27 .
blocks.zh:
我们从SQL原始人对长文本任务所需技能的地图上的观察中得到启发。
对事实表进行过滤读取就是检索。
综合、比较或对所读行的排名是推理步骤。
其过滤器使用较早阶段计算的值的读取器是依赖的hop,所以这样的读取链是多跳检索,几个独立读取器是宽度.
图27显示了整个管道。

blocks.en: Figure 27: How one SQL-grounded RL item is produced.
blocks.zh: 图27:如何生产一个SQL定位RL项目。

blocks.en:
We evaluated the resulting model on LongBench-v2 ( Figure 28 ; see Section 5 for a description of the benchmark).
After RL training that included these two environments, Beam attains 67% accuracy, exceeding the human-expert reference of 50.1% by a large margin, and lies on the Pareto frontier of accuracy against total parameter count.
It surpasses all reported and reproduced models of comparable or smaller size and exceeds Qwen3.8 Max and Inkling, both substantially larger.
We saw improvements across all task domains; Beam leads all reproduced models on multi-document QA and is at or near the frontier on code-repository understanding and long structured data.
blocks.zh:
我们在LongBench-v2上评价了由此产生的模型(图28;基准说明见第5节)。
经过包含这两个环境的RL训练后,Beam的精确度达到67%,大大超过了50.1%的人类专家参考值,并且位于Pareto边框的精确度与总参数计数。
它超越了所有报告和复制的可比或较小的模型,并超过Quen3.8 Max和Inkling,两者都大得多。
我们看到所有任务领域都有改进;Beam在多文档QA上领导所有复制模型,在代码存储器理解和长期结构化数据方面处于前沿或附近。

blocks.en:
Figure 28: LongBench-v2 accuracy versus total parameter count (log scale). † \dagger indicates externally reported results; all others were reproduced internally.
Beam is served in NVFP4 with an FP8 KV cache.
blocks.zh:
图28:长本奇-v2精度相对于总参数计数(logscale). &\dagger表示外部报告的结果;所有其他结果均在内部复制。
Beam在NVFP4服务,有一个FP8 KV缓存.

blocks.en: Instruction Following
blocks.zh: 以下指令

blocks.en:
Our instruction-following (IF) components are motivated by the broader principles that an assistant should respect system and developer instructions, transparently pursue the user’s objectives, and sensibly resolve ambiguity among these requirements.
Although the model is already instruction-tuned, we add targeted training for constraint and objective following especially when they occur at different levels of the instruction hierarchy or must be retained across a conversation.
blocks.zh:
我们的指令跟踪部分的动机是更广泛的原则,即一名助理应尊重系统和开发者的指示,透明地追求用户的目标,并明智地解决这些要求之间的模糊性。
虽然该模式已经经过了教学调整,但我们增加了目标明确的培训,以达到约束和客观,特别是当这些培训发生在教学层次的不同层次或必须在整个对话中保留时。

blocks.en:
We train for single-turn instruction following using an environment with both programmatic verifiers and judges. We generate instruction-verifier pairs using an adapted version of the AutoIF pipeline [ 95 ] .
Each pair contains a natural-language constraint and a Python function that checks whether a response satisfies it.
The constraints cover response length; output format; required or forbidden vocabulary; per-sentence or per-section templates; capitalization and punctuation; and ordering or repetition patterns.
blocks.zh:
我们利用既有方案核查员又有法官的环境,对单回合教学进行培训。 我们使用AutoIF输油管的改编版本生成指令验证对 [95].
每对都包含一个自然语言约束和一个Python函数,用于检查一个响应是否满足.
限制范围包括响应长度;输出格式;要求或禁止的词汇;按判决或分节模板;资本化和标注;以及订购或重复模式。

blocks.en:
We combine these instructions with user requests sampled from a filtered set of prompts from the WildChat collection [ 82 ] .
The request remains in the user message, while the explicit constraint is placed in the developer message for 70% of tasks and in the user message for the remaining 30%.
This exposes the model to constraints at both instruction levels.
Finally, we filtered malformed instructions, unreliable verifiers, incompatible request-instruction pairs, and tasks that were trivial for the starting policy.
blocks.zh:
我们把这些指示和用户要求结合起来,从WildChat收藏的一套过滤的提示样本中抽取[82].
请求仍保留在用户消息中,同时在开发者消息中明确限制70%的任务,在用户消息中明确限制其余30%的任务.
这暴露了模式在两个教学层次都受到制约.
最后,我们过滤了错误的指令,不可靠的核查者,不兼容的请求-指令对,以及对于启动政策来说微不足道的任务.

blocks.en: We use a binary, double-gated reward for this environment: a response must pass both the Python verifier and be judged by a judge to have genuinely addressed the user’s request as verifier-only training makes the model circumvent the underlying task.
blocks.zh: 我们用二进制的双倍奖励来补偿这种环境:一个回应必须同时通过Python验证器,并由法官判断是否真正满足了用户的要求,因为只有验证器的训练使得模型规避了基本任务.

blocks.en:
As an extension, we also train on single-turn prompts containing many simultaneous non-programmatically verifiable constraints.
These tasks were sourced from vendors and cover writing, editing, planning, summarization, extraction, and classification. Each prompt is paired with task-specific rubrics ( ∼ {\sim} 21.8 rubrics on average) evaluated by a judge.
blocks.zh:
作为扩展,我们还在单回合制提示上进行训练,其中包含许多同时进行的非程序可核查的限制。
这些任务来自供应商,涉及书写、编辑、规划、汇总、提取和分类。 每个提示都与法官评估的具体任务标题(平均21.8个标题)成对。

blocks.en:
The final reward is all-or-nothing: a response receives reward 1 only if every required rubric passes.
This objective produced better full-task success than either averaging the individual rubric scores or combining partial credit with an all-or-nothing term, consistent with the reward-design findings reported for AdvancedIF [ 96 ] .
Through these complementary instruction-following training environments, we saw gains of 24.7% on the held-out IFBench evaluation over the course of RL.
blocks.zh:
最后的奖赏是全奖还是全奖:只有每一张需要的奖金证才能得到1奖赏.
这一目标取得了更好的全任务成功,而不是按照AdvancedIF[96]报告的奖励设计结果,平均个人名义分数或将部分信用与全或全术语合并。
通过这些补充性的培训环境,我们看到在RL过程中对IF Bench的搁置评价提高了24.7%。

blocks.en:
We extend the single-turn RL environment to instructions that evolve over a conversation.
Our multi-turn IF environment targets four behaviors: retaining a standing instruction across turns, applying a conditional instruction only when its condition is met, combining a conversation-wide constraint with a requirement for one turn, and replacing an earlier instruction during the conversation.
blocks.zh:
我们把单回合的 RL 环境 扩展到通过对话演变的指示。
我们的多回合IF环境针对四种行为:保留一个跨回合的长期指令,只有在满足条件时才适用有条件的指令,将一个全对话约束与一个回合的要求相结合,以及替换之前在对话期间的指令.

blocks.en:
Starting from filtered WildChat prompts [ 82 ] , we generate constraints and conversation templates that specify when a simulated user should introduce, activate, or revise an instruction.
The templates include requests such as asking for clarification or requesting a rewrite.
The generated conversations are checked for correctness, satisfiability, and consistency between the instruction and the user’s underlying request.
Each conversation records the constraints active on its final turn.
blocks.zh:
从过滤的 WildChat 提示 [82] 开始, 我们生成制约和对话模板, 指定模拟用户何时引入、 激活或修改指令 。
模板包括要求澄清或请求重写等请求.
生成的对白会被检查正确性,可调适性,以及指令与用户基本要求的一致性.
每一次谈话都会记录其最后回合时活跃的制约因素.

blocks.en:
These conversations provide disjoint SFT and RL datasets.
The SFT set contains traces combining stored multi-turn histories with successful final responses.
The RL set contains tasks in which the policy receives a stored conversation history and generates the final assistant turn.
The RL reward is all-or-nothing: a judge receives the active constraints and the limited context needed to evaluate them, and the response receives a reward of 1 only if every active constraint is satisfied.
blocks.zh:
这些对话提供了脱节的SFT和RL数据集.
SFT集包含将存储的多回合历史与成功的最终响应相结合的痕迹.
RL集包含任务,其中策略接收存储的对话历史并生成最终助手转折.
RL奖赏是全无的:法官接受积极约束和评价这些约束所需的有限背景,只有在满足每个积极约束时,才能得到1的奖赏.

blocks.en:
Multi-turn IF isolates whether instructions are tracked correctly across dialogue.
User-agent collaboration tasks, described below, extend this behavior to tool-enabled settings, where the model must retain instructions while gathering missing information, deciding whether clarification is necessary, calling tools, and observing their results.
blocks.zh:
多轮IF隔离指令是否在对话中正确跟踪.
下文描述的用户代理协作任务,将这一行为扩展至工具化的设置,模型在收集缺失信息时必须保留指令,决定是否有必要澄清,调用工具,并观察其结果.

blocks.en: User-Agent Collaboration
blocks.zh: 用户代理协作

blocks.en:
In order to imbue the alignment teacher with an ability to actively collaborate with users on agentic tasks—as opposed to purely conversational settings—we included some of our general tool use data (as described in Section 4.1.11 ) in the alignment teacher training.
This data included multi-turn tasks with a simulated user in which the agent needed to help the user accomplish a task, such as in a customer service or personal assistant setting.
Some of these tasks explicitly required the agent to ask follow-up questions of the simulated user, who does not always provide all information at the beginning of the episode.
Concerningly, after training on this data, we noticed the agent asking unnecessary follow-ups and clarifications in other conversational tasks.
blocks.zh:
为了使校对教师有能力在代理任务上与用户积极合作,而不是纯粹的对话环境,我们在校对教师培训中纳入了我们的一些一般工具使用数据(如第4.1.1.1节所述)。
这些数据包括一个模拟用户的多回合任务,其中代理人需要帮助用户完成某项任务,例如在客户服务或个人助理的环境下.
其中一些任务明确要求代理商询问模拟用户的后续问题,后者并不总是在剧集开始时提供所有信息.
关于这一点,经过关于这些数据的培训后,我们注意到代理人要求在其他谈话任务中采取不必要的后续行动和作出澄清。

blocks.en:
To address the leakage of follow-ups in other domains, we added two graders to the helpfulness preference reward ( Section 4.2.3 ) that penalized common ways of gaming it.
The first penalized unnecessary content, such as follow-up questions and self-validation, and the second withheld content, such as clarifying instead of answering and unwarranted refusal.
Each flag’s weight was set from its measured precision against human labels, and the two graders’ factors were multiplied onto the preference reward.
These penalties successfully reduced the incidence of follow-up questions and clarifications.
blocks.zh:
为了解决后续行动在其他领域的渗漏问题,我们增加了两个分级员,以奖励优先帮助(第4.2.3节),这惩罚了游戏的共同方式。
第一个是惩罚不必要的内容,如后续问题和自我验证,第二个是隐瞒的内容,如澄清而不是回答和无理拒绝。
每面旗帜的权重是根据它相对于人类标签的精确度设定的,两个分级者的因素被乘以优先奖励。
这些处罚成功地减少了后续问题和澄清的发生率。

blocks.en: Helpfulness
blocks.zh: 帮助

blocks.en:
In order to improve the model’s helpfulness and interaction quality on open-ended conversations, we trained it using an approach similar to RLHF/RLAIF [ 97 , 98 ] .
We treat human judgments as the ultimate source of ground-truth for the quality of conversational behavior, and collect fresh human data—per-attribute ratings and pairwise preferences—at a regular cadence.
We use this data to periodically calibrate a proxy preference judge that we use for automated “arena” style evaluations, as well as a generative reward model that we use in RL for on-policy evaluation.
We found that with a generative reward model strong enough to accurately rank rollouts and resist reward-hacking, RL in this environment steadily improves the model’s conversational behavior, yielding a model that pushes the open Pareto frontier on our in-house arena.
blocks.zh:
为了提高模型在开放式对话中的帮助和互动质量,我们用类似于RLHF/RLAIF[97,98]的方法对其进行了培训.
我们把人类的判断视为对话行为质量的终极真相来源,
我们利用这些数据定期校准我们用来进行自动“Arena”风格评价的代理偏好判断,以及我们在RL中用于政策评价的基因奖励模型。
我们发现,如果一个基因奖励模式足够强大,足以精确地排出排行榜和抵制奖励勒索,那么这种环境中的RL稳步改善该模式的对话行为,形成一个将开放的帕雷托前沿推向我们内部竞技场的模型.

blocks.en:
Figure 29: RLAIF Pushes the Open Pareto Frontier on Conversational Quality .
Top left: human preferences drift in relative weight of attributes, requiring regular calibration of proxy judges/reward models.
Bottom left: RLAIF steadily increases Elo scores of the alignment teacher on in-house arena evals above GLM5.2 levels (rev3, dark green) after switching to stronger judges and anchor responses (rev1 → \rightarrow 2) and fixing reward hacks (rev2 → \rightarrow 3).
Middle: Beam pushes the open Pareto frontier on in-house arena evals, achieving the strongest Elo performance for its size.
Right: observed win-rate over GLM-5.2 from human validation matches predicted win-rates from in-house arena evals.
blocks.zh:
图29: RLAIF在对话质量上推动开放的Pareto边疆.
左上方:人类偏好在属性的相对重量上漂移,需要定期校准代理裁判/奖励模型.
左下方: 报告格式稳步增加 Elo)的校对老师在GLM5.2级(rev3,深绿色)以上的内部竞技场eval上得分,之后转投更强的评委和主播回应(rev1 ~\rightarrow 2)和固定奖励黑客(rev2 →\rightarrow 3).
中段:Beam将开放的Pareto边疆推到了内部竞技场evals上,以其大小实现了最强的Elo性能.
右:从人类验证中观测到的GLM-5.2的胜利率 与内部竞技场的胜利率相匹配。

blocks.en:
Human judgments serve two critical roles in our training recipe.
First, they define our target: both the generative reward model and the proxy judge are calibrated against human labels.
Second, they are our main defense against Goodharting [ 99 , 100 ] : during training, the policy can optimize rewards in ways that diverge from what humans actually prefer, and only fresh labels on the trained policy’s outputs can reliably detect this divergence.
blocks.zh:
人的判断在我们的培训方法中起到两个关键作用。
首先,它们定义了我们的目标:基因奖励模型和代理裁判都根据人类的标签来校准.
第二,它们是我们对抗古德哈廷[99,100]的主要防御力量:在训练期间,政策能够以不同于人类实际喜欢的方式优化奖励,只有经过训练的政策产出上的新标签才能可靠地发现这种差异。

blocks.en:
We collected human annotations on the overall quality of model responses, as well as specific attributes like coverage, intent understanding, clarity, tone, and focus.
Our nine attributes of conversational quality are described in Table 9 .
Annotators rated model responses on a 5-point scale on each attribute and also on pairwise preference compared to an anchor.
Five annotators labeled each pair; the ground-truth label is the mean of the three most agreeing annotators.
blocks.zh:
我们收集了人类关于模型反应的整体质量的说明,以及诸如覆盖面、意图理解、清晰度、语气和重点等具体属性。
我们对话质量的九个属性见表9。
与主锚相比,注释者对每个属性和对偶偏好进行5分比例的模型响应评分.
每对标注5名注释员;地面真实标记是三个最同意的注释员的平均值。

blocks.en:
We collected fresh labels every two weeks, on responses generated by the latest model checkpoints and comparable external anchors on 200–300 prompts.
A factor analysis of per-criteria ratings found a single dominant “quality” factor that correlated strongly ( r = 0.95 r=0.95 ) with overall preferences, matching Bradley-Terry assumptions.
We found that as the model’s policy changed across batches, so too did the relative weights of different criteria: “coverage” initially exerted the largest weight while evaluating early, weaker checkpoints, but diminished over time in favor of “focus” on later, stronger checkpoints.
blocks.zh:
我们每两周收集一次新的标签,记录最新的示范检查站和200至300个提示的可比外部锚的反应。
对每个标准评级进行的一项因素分析发现,一个单一的主导性“质量”因素与总体偏好密切相关(r=0.95 r=0.95),与布拉德利-泰瑞的假设相吻合。
我们发现,随着该模式的政策在不同的批次上的变化,不同标准的相对权重也发生了变化: " 掩护 " 最初是用最大的权重来评估早期、较弱的检查站,但随着时间推移而减少,而是倾向于 " 注重 " 以后更强大的检查站。

blocks.en: Table 9: Attributes of conversational quality.
blocks.zh: 表9:对话质量的属性。

blocks.en:
We used human preference labels to calibrate a proxy preference judge for offline “arena” style evaluations [ 101 ] .
We periodically recalibrated this judge in order to prevent human and judge preferences from diverging as the model’s policy shifted.
We hill-climbed human agreement on a subset of labels, using an autoresearch -style sweep [ 102 ] over prompt variants.
The resulting nine-attribute rubric clears the human inter-rater agreement ceiling.
We use the calibrated preference proxy judge to adjudicate pairwise battles between candidate models and six anchors (ranging from weak to strong models) across 455 open-ended prompts. Candidate models are run using the reasoning effort setting that ranks highest on the chat subset of arena.ai evaluations, and Beam is run using high effort.
We fit these partial battles with a Bradley-Terry model to obtain Elo scores on our automated arena, with ELO=1,000 corresponding to GLM 5.2.
blocks.zh:
我们使用人类偏好标签来校准离线“Arena”风格评价的代理偏好法官[101]。
我们定期重新调整这个法官,以防止随着模式政策的变化,人和法官的偏好出现分歧。
我们用一种自动研究式的扫荡方式,在一组标签上 达成一个山坡式的人类协议。
由此产生的9个属性的标点清除了人类间协议的上限.
我们使用校准的偏好代理裁判来判断候选模型和6个锚(从弱型到强型)之间的双向对战,共有455个无限制的提示. 候选人模型使用在竞技场聊天子集上排名最高的推理设置进行运行. ai 评估,而Beam则投入了大量精力。
我们把这些部分的战斗与布拉德利-泰瑞模型匹配,以便在我们的自动竞技场上获得埃洛分数,而ELO=1000对应GLM 5.2.

blocks.en:
We used a bank of public open-ended conversational prompts, consisting of general-knowledge and advice questions, to train our policy model via RLAIF.
Each conversation was truncated to its first user turn, and was associated with a fixed anchor response that the policy was judged against.
The task difficulty was set by which model we selected to generate the anchor responses; anchors that were too easy started training already saturated, and responses from mid-sized models were saturated by the end of training.
We generated candidate anchors with several models and kept, for each prompt, the first candidate in a fixed priority order that passed claim-level factuality and temporal checks.
We dropped the 2.6% of prompts for which no candidate was both accurate and current.
blocks.zh:
我们利用一个由普通知识和咨询问题组成的公开的开放式谈话提示库,通过法律援助机构培训我们的政策模式。
每一次对话都被缩短到第一次用户回合,并与政策被判定的固定主播反应有关。
任务难度被设定为我们选择的生成主锚响应的模型;太容易开始训练的锚已经饱和了,中等规模模型的响应在训练结束时已经饱和了.
我们用几种模式培养了候选人主播,并为每个候选人迅速保留了第一位通过权利要求的事实和时间检查的固定优先级候选人。
我们放弃了2.6%的提示,没有候选人是准确的和最新的。

blocks.en:
We used a generative reward model as the primary reward signal in GRPO.
The judge compared the policy’s final answer with the anchor under the nine-attribute rubric and returned one of five levels from strongly disfavored to strongly favored, mapped onto a 0 to 1 scale.
Whether the policy or the anchor response appeared first in the pairwise comparison was fixed per prompt, so that position bias was canceled within a GRPO group.
Pairwise preference verdicts beat the alternatives: pointwise scores compressed each group into about a quarter of the reward range, and preference logits saturated in the loop, giving near-maximal reward for marginal or no quality differences.
The SFT checkpoint set both where RL started and how fast it moved.
Successive SFT iterations, including a self-distillation cold start, raised the step-0 in-house arena Elo by about 100 points (roughly 24% to 37% implied win rate against the Elo anchor model).
Rewriting our SFT reasoning traces for multi-turn chat to be more concise and less templated did not change step-0 Elo scores, but surprisingly, under an identical RL recipe the rewritten checkpoint raised our in-house arena evaluation scores much faster.
A linear penalty on final-answer length (alongside the reasoning effort cost) was subtracted from the reward to counteract the reward model’s preference for longer responses.
blocks.zh:
我们用基因奖励模型作为GRPO的主要奖励信号.
法官将政策的最后答案与九属性标题下的主锚进行比较,并将五个级别中有一个从强烈不满恢复到强烈赞成,并划为0到1级。
策略或主机响应是否在对偶比较中首先出现,每秒固定,因此位置偏差在GRPO组内被取消.
Pairwise偏好判断击败了其他选择:指针分数将每组压缩到大约四分之一的奖励范围,偏好对数在循环中饱和,给边际或没有质量差异的几乎最大奖励.
SFT检查站既设定了RL起始地点,也设定了移动速度.
相继发生的SFT迭代,包括一个自我消化冷却的开始,提升了内部的台阶-0 埃洛以约100分(约24%至37%暗示与埃洛锚定模型相比的胜率).
重写我们的 SFT 推理痕迹, 多回合聊天更简洁、模板更少,
从奖励中减去了最后答复长度的线性惩罚(除了推理成本外),以抵消奖励模式对较长答复的偏好。

blocks.en:
Held-out Elo scores on our in-house arena rose throughout training under the final alignment teacher recipe and finished above all prior runs, whereas the first recipe iteration peaked early and then collapsed as the policy exploited its reward model, and the second plateaued early.
The resulting Beam model reaches an Elo of about 1044, placing it on the Pareto frontier of Elo against total parameters across open-weight models, as illustrated in Figure 29 . Moreover, its arena-predicted 56.5% win rate over GLM 5.2 matched the 56.3% we measured with human raters.
blocks.zh:
被搁置 Elo在最后的校对老师配方下, 在整个训练中得分上升,
如图29所示,由此形成的Beam模型达到约1044的Elo,将其置于Elo的Pareto边疆,与各种开放量模型的总参数相对照。 此外,它的场景预测胜率比GLM 5.2高56.5%,与我们测得的56.3%的人类评分相当。

blocks.en: 4.2.4 Evaluation Methodology
blocks.zh: 4.2.4 评价方法

blocks.en:
We used a broad set of public and internal benchmarks, as well as frequent human preference ratings and qualitative assessments (see Section 4.2.3 ), to understand how ML and data interventions affected model behavior across the set of principles above.
We used the following procedure to compare model variants and summarize performance across evaluations.
blocks.zh:
我们使用了一套广泛的公共和内部基准,以及频繁的人类偏好评级和定性评估(见第4.2.3节),以了解ML和数据干预如何影响上述一套原则的模型行为。
我们使用以下程序来比较模型变体并总结各种评价的业绩。

blocks.en: Comparing Models on a Benchmark
blocks.zh: 基准模型比较

blocks.en: When comparing a candidate model with a baseline, we evaluated both on the same set of tasks and reported their native benchmark scores for within-benchmark comparisons, and normalized scores when combining results across benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 在将候选模式与基线进行比较时,我们既评估了同一组任务,又报告了本国基准的基准分数,用于基准内比较,并在将各项基准的结果合并时,将分数正常化。

blocks.en: Normalization for Aggregation
blocks.zh: 聚合物的正常化

blocks.en:
For evaluations included in the cross-benchmark aggregate, we rescaled each result relative to two reference scores.
If s m , e s_{m,e} is model m m ’s raw score on evaluation e e , and f e f_{e} and h e h_{e} are its lower and upper reference scores, z m , e = s m , e − f e h e − f e z_{m,e}=\dfrac{s_{m,e}-f_{e}}{h_{e}-f_{e}} This way, the lower reference, when passed as a model score, maps to zero and the upper reference to one, while values outside that range are retained rather than clipped.
The lower reference represents a model whose performance we aim to meet or exceed, while the upper reference represents a stronger model that serves as the current target.
As development progressed, we updated the upper reference with stronger models.
blocks.zh:
就跨基准汇总中包含的评价而言,我们根据两个参考分数对每个结果进行了调整。
如果 s m, e s_{m, e} 是 model m 的 原始 评分 e e , f e e e e e 和 h e e e e , 是 其 下 和 上 参考 分 z m , e = s m , e e e e e e e e = z _{m , e}=\dfrac { s_{m, e} - f _{ e e e }}{ e e = - f e e e e e = = = zm , e e e  e e − _{ frac {m , e }=\d }=\ frac { {m _{ _{ _{ _{ _{ _{ _{ _{ _{ }} }} }} }} 这样,较低参考值在作为模型分数通过时,会映射到0,上参考值会映射到1,而该范围以外的数值会保留而不是剪切.
较低参照是一个我们力求达到或超过的模型,而较高参照是一个更强大的模型,作为目前的目标。
随着发展的进展,我们以更强大的模式更新了上下文。

blocks.en:
References were held fixed for a given aggregate and its confidence intervals.
Because changing the references changes the normalization scale, aggregate scores are only directly comparable when computed using the same reference set.
blocks.zh:
某一总量及其置信间隔的参考文件被固定下来。
由于改变引用会改变正常化的尺度,所以总分只有在使用同一个引用集计算时才具有直接可比性.

blocks.en: Aggregating across Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 跨基准汇总

blocks.en:
To aggregate scores across benchmarks, we started by assigning each benchmark a category, such as instruction-following or safety. We then averaged normalized evaluation scores within categories and then averaged across categories.
Formally, if E c E_{c} is the set of contributing evaluations in category c c , and C C is the set of contributing categories, A m , c = 1 | E c | ​ ∑ e ∈ E c z m , e , O m = 1 | C | ​ ∑ c ∈ C A m , c . A_{m,c}=\dfrac{1}{|E_{c}|}\sum_{e\in E_{c}}z_{m,e},\qquad O_{m}=\dfrac{1}{|C|}\sum_{c\in C}A_{m,c}. This gives each category equal weight and each contributing evaluation equal weight within a category.
We used the overall score O m O_{m} as an internal summary for comparing model variants and a hill-climbing target.
blocks.zh:
为了汇总跨基准的分数,我们首先为每个基准指定一个类别,如遵循指示或安全。 然后,我们平均将各类别内部的评价分数正常化,然后按各类别进行平均。
形式上,如果Ec E_{c}是C类中贡献评价的一组,C是贡献评价的一组,A m,c = 1 → E → e → e → z m,e,O m = 1 → C → → ∑ C A m,c. (原始内容存档于2019-09-26). A_{m, c}=\dfrac{1}{|E_{c}|}\sum_{e\in (原始内容存档于2018-09-21). E_{c}}z_{m, e],\qquad 时间轴: (原始内容存档于2018-09-21). An_{m, c}. 这使每个类别都具有同等的权重,每个贡献的评价在一个类别中具有同等的权重。
我们用总体分数O m O_{m}作为比较模型变体和爬山目标的内部总结.

blocks.en: Statistical Testing
blocks.zh: 统计测试

blocks.en:
We estimated uncertainty in the overall score differences of two models using a paired bootstrap over evaluation tasks.
We generated 10K bootstrap replicates by resampling tasks with replacement, preserving paired model results and grouping repeated attempts within each task.
blocks.zh:
我们估计了两个模型的总体得分差异的不确定性,这两个模型使用双靴子而不是评价任务。
我们复制了10K靴子,用替换方式复制任务,保存配对模型结果,并在每项任务中将重复尝试分组。

blocks.en:
For category and overall scores, we applied the same normalization and aggregation procedure within each bootstrap replicate, with reference scores held fixed.
The resulting confidence intervals capture uncertainty due to the sampled evaluation tasks under the fixed evaluation setup.
However, they do not capture model-training variance, systematic grading errors, or uncertainty in the normalization references.
blocks.zh:
对于类别和总体分数,我们在复制的每个靴子中采用了相同的正常化和汇总程序,并固定了参考分数。
由此产生的信任间隔反映了固定评价结构下抽样评价任务的不确定性。
然而,它们没有记录模式-训练差异、系统定级错误或正常化参考中的不确定性。

blocks.en:
We used 2.5 th 2.5^{\text{th}} and 97.5 th 97.5^{\text{th}} percentiles of the resulting score differences as a 95% confidence interval.
Intervals excluding zero indicate a statistically significant difference at the nominal 5% level.
blocks.zh:
我们使用2.5°2.5=text{th}和97.5°97.5=text{th=%的百分位数来表示结果的得分差异,作为95%的置信间隔.
不包括零的间隔表示名义上5%的水平存在统计上的重大差异。

blocks.en: 4.3 Merging Experts with On-Policy Distillation
blocks.zh: 4.3 将专家与政策扭曲合并

blocks.en:
As described in Sections 4.1 and 4.2 , we train two complementary experts: an agentic expert focused on reasoning and agentic tasks, and an alignment expert focused on helpfulness, safety, and conversational behavior. We combine their capabilities into a single student through multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) [ 103 , 104 , 105 , 106 , 64 ] as illustrated in Figure 30 .
The student generates trajectories and learns from the teachers’ token distributions at the contexts it visits, with the supervising teacher selected according to the task family. This approach allows each expert to be trained and evaluated independently before their capabilities are consolidated into the final model.
blocks.zh:
正如第4.1和4.2节所述,我们培训了两位互补的专家:一位以推理和代理任务为重点的代理专家,一位以帮助、安全和对话行为为重点的协调专家。 如图30所示,我们通过多教师政策提炼[103、104、105、106、64],把他们的能力合并为一个学生。
学生在所访问的环境下会制作轨迹并学习教师的象征性分布图,由监督教师根据任务家庭选定。 这种方法允许每位专家在能力整合为最后模式之前接受独立培训和评估。

blocks.zh: 图30:我们的多教师政策提炼(MOPD)设置。

blocks.zh: 4.3.1 确定消化目标

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Implementing Full-Vocabulary Distillation in an Asynchronous RL System
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 在同步RL系统中实施全词汇稀释

blocks.en:
We built our OPD stack on top of our existing asynchronous, distributed RL system, reusing core infrastructure for rollout generation, weight synchronization, and MoE routing replay ( Section 4.4.1 ).
OPD adds teacher annotation and a full-vocabulary distillation loss to this pipeline. The main systems challenges are transporting teacher targets to the trainer and evaluating the KL without materializing full-vocabulary logit tensors for the entire batch.
blocks.zh:
我们在现有的同步分布式RL系统之上搭建了我们的OPD堆栈,再利用核心基础设施进行推出生成,重量同步,以及MOE的路由重放(第4.4.1节).
OPD为这条管道增加了教师注释和全省蒸馏损失. 主要的系统挑战包括将教师目标运送给教练员,以及评价KL,而没有实现整个批次的全省登录数。

blocks.en: Transporting the Teacher’s Hidden States
blocks.zh: 运送教师隐藏的国家

blocks.en:
For N N token positions and a vocabulary of size V V , transporting full-vocabulary teacher distributions would require O ⁡ ( N ​ V ) O(NV) values.
We reduce communication by transporting teacher hidden states and reconstructing the logits on the trainer.
This approach is also used in DeepSeek-V4 [ 107 ] . This reduces the payload to O ⁡ ( N ​ d T ) O(Nd_{T}) values, where d T d_{T} is the teacher’s hidden width.
blocks.zh:
对于 N N 符号位置和大小 V V 的词汇, 运输全省教师分布需要 O → (N V ) O 值 。
我们通过运送教师隐藏状态和重建训练员的日志来减少沟通。
这种方法也用于DeepSeek-V4 [107]. 这使得有效载荷降低到O QQ(Nd T) O(Nd_{T)值,其中d T d_{T}是老师隐藏的宽度.

blocks.en: Token positions and teacher identities are retained through sequence packing and sharding, keeping teacher hidden states aligned with the corresponding student tokens.
blocks.zh: 通过顺序包装和硬化来保留Token职位和教师身份,使教师隐藏状态与相应的学生标志保持一致。

blocks.en: The trainer reconstructs each teacher’s logits using its cached, frozen output head and applies the teacher’s own logit softcap before full-vocabulary softmax normalization. The student is normalized after its own softcap, which may differ from the teacher’s; this preserves each model’s native output distribution.
blocks.zh: 训练员使用其缓存的、冻结的输出头重建每个教师的日志,并在全省软max正常化之前应用教师自己的日志软盖。 学生在自己的软盖之后会恢复正常,这可能与教师不同;这保留了每个模型的本地产出分布。

blocks.en: What Student Probabilities to Use
blocks.zh: 学生的概率

blocks.en: The student that generates a rollout can differ from the student being updated: while inference is running, the trainer continues to learn from other rollouts. We must therefore decide which version’s disagreement with the teacher the loss should measure.
blocks.zh: 产生推出的学生可以与被更新的学生不同:在推论运行的同时,训练员继续学习其他推出. 校对:Soup

blocks.en: We use the trainer’s current probabilities for both the student log probabilities and the weighting over vocabulary entries in the KL. Consider a context where the current student distribution already matches the teacher’s. The per-token KL and its gradient are then zero, even if the earlier inference policy disagreed with the teacher. This makes each update address the disagreement that remains at update time.
blocks.zh: 我们用训练员目前的可能性来计算学生的日志概率, 考虑一下当前学生分配与教师匹配的背景。 即使先前的推论政策与老师意见不一,但按键的KL及其梯度是零。 这使得每次更新都能够解决更新时仍然存在的分歧.

blocks.en: At each sampled context, we differentiate the full-vocabulary KL directly, summing over all next tokens using current trainer probabilities. This vocabulary sum requires no sampled-token importance correction. The contexts themselves, however, still come from the rollout-generating policy and may be stale. We treat them as fixed when differentiating the KL.
blocks.zh: 在每一个抽样上下文中,我们直接区分全省KL,使用当前教练机概率来汇总所有接下来的符号. 这个词汇总和不需要样本式的切换重要性校正. 然而,情况本身仍然来自推出的政策,而且可能僵化。 我们在区分KL时把他们当成固定的

blocks.en: Figure 31: Blockwise reverse KL processes paired C × V C\times V student and teacher logit chunks, reducing temporary logit memory from O ⁡ ( N ​ V ) O(NV) to O ⁡ ( C ​ V ) O(CV) .
blocks.zh: 图31:逆向逆向 KL 进程配对 C × V C\times V 师生登录块, 将 O QQ( N V ) O( NV ) 临时登录内存减少至 O QQ( C V ) O( CV ) 。

blocks.en: Memory-Efficient Full-Vocabulary Reverse KL Computation via Blocking
blocks.zh: 通过屏蔽实现内存- 有效全词汇反转 KL 计算

blocks.en:
Transporting hidden states reduces communication, but reconstructing all teacher and student logits at once would still require O ⁡ ( N ​ V ) O(NV) memory.
We evaluated the same full-vocabulary reverse KL in chunks of C C token positions, reducing temporary logit memory to O ⁡ ( C ​ V ) O(CV) while retaining every vocabulary entry ( Figure 31 ).
blocks.zh:
传送隐藏状态会减少通信,但一次重建所有师生日志仍需要O QQ(N V) O(NV)内存.
我们评价了C符号位置的整块全伏反向KL, 将临时登录内存减少为O QQ(CV)O(CV),

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Blockwise reverse KL: forward computation
blocks.zh: 算法 1 逆时针 KL: 前置计算

blocks.en:
For each chunk, PyTorch [ 108 ] matrix multiplications form two C × V C\times V logit buffers in GPU memory (HBM).
For simplicity, the pseudocode omits each model’s logit softcap, which is applied before computing the softmax normalizers and KL terms.
Custom Triton [ 109 ] kernels reduce vocabulary tiles, avoiding additional chunk-wide probability and log-probability tensors.
The forward pass saves the per-token KL and softmax normalizers and releases the logit buffers as shown in Algorithm 1 .
The backward pass follows the same chunked traversal, recomputing the logits and using the saved statistics to accumulate student gradients.
This follows the same IO-aware design principles as FlashAttention [ 110 ] : tiled reductions, compact normalization statistics, and recomputation during backward.
The output-head projections remain separate matrix multiplications; the O ⁡ ( C ​ V ) O(CV) memory bound applies to temporary logits, with hidden states and output heads retained across forward and backward.
blocks.zh:
对于每个块,PyTorch [108] 矩阵乘法在GPU内存(HBM)中形成两个C×V C\times V登录缓冲.
为了简洁起见,伪码省略了每个模型的logit softcap,在计算软max正常化器和KL术语之前应用.
自定义 Triton [109] 内核减少词汇瓦,避免了额外的块宽概率和日志概率的亮度.
前传会节省每托肯 KL 和软max 正常化器,并释放算法 1 所示的日志缓冲器 。
后传跟随相同的块状转弯,重算对数,并利用保存的统计数据积累学生梯度.
这遵循了与FlashAttention相同的IO-aware设计原理[110]:平板裁量,紧凑的正常化统计,以及落后时期的重算.
输出头的预测仍然是单独的矩阵乘法;O QQ(CV) O(CV)内存绑定适用于临时对数,隐藏状态和输出头保留在前后.

blocks.en:
In our system, this full-vocabulary implementation runs in roughly the same wall-clock time as our sampled-token OPD implementation.
The student-sampled reverse KL estimator uses teacher log probabilities on tokens sampled from the student [ 105 ] .
blocks.zh:
在我们的系统中,这种全省执行时间与我们抽样的OPD执行时间大致相同。
学生抽样的反向KL估计器在从学生身上抽取的标语上使用教师日志概率[105].

blocks.en: 4.3.3 Training Recipe and Details
blocks.zh: 4.3.3 培训指南和细节

blocks.en:
Our training recipe starts with SFT initialization, followed by MOPD with the teacher-routing policy and rollout settings described below.
We sample new trajectories only from the student; the teachers provide token-level supervision for these trajectories.
We use no external reward signal on student rollouts: the training signal comes entirely from the teachers’ probabilities.
blocks.zh:
我们的训练菜谱从SFT初始化开始,随后MOPD则有下文描述的教师路线政策和推出设置.
我们只从学生那里取样新的轨迹;教师对这些轨迹提供象征性的监督。
我们没有在学生推出时使用外部奖励信号:培训信号完全来自教师的概率。

blocks.en:
During MOPD, we use a context length of 256K tokens.
Each training step uses M = 512 M=512 tasks with R = 8 R=8 rollouts per task, for a total of 4,096 rollouts.
We use a constant learning rate of 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} after 20 linear warm-up steps from zero.
With this recipe, the merged student broadly recovers the teachers’ performance across the evaluated domains, as discussed in the results below.
blocks.zh:
在MOPD期间,我们使用256K符号的上下文长度.
每个训练步骤使用M=512 M=512任务,每个任务使用R=8 R=8推出,共计4,096推出.
我们使用持续学习率 3× 10 − 6 3\时 10× 6 } 20 线性暖和步骤从 0 开始。
如以下结果所述,通过这种配方,合并后的学生广泛恢复了教师在整个评价领域的业绩。

blocks.en: Student Initialization
blocks.zh: 学生初始化

blocks.en:
Consistent with recent analyses highlighting the strength of offline distillation [ 111 , 112 ] , our recipe starts with a self-distilled SFT stage.
We finetuned the midtrained ( Section 3 ) checkpoint on the combined SFT data of both experts, including the alignment mixture described in Section 4.2.2 .
Thanks to this, the student’s behaviors are close to the teachers’ distributions from the very beginning of training.
We appended to this data self-distilled traces sampled from the two experts’ models, which we found is important for reaching teacher-level performance downstream.
blocks.zh:
根据最近的分析,强调离线蒸馏的强度[111,112],我们的食谱从一个自我蒸馏的SFT阶段开始.
我们根据两名专家的SFT综合数据,包括第4.2.2节所述配对混合物,对中训练(第3节)检查站进行了调整。
因此,学生的行为从培训一开始就接近教师的分布。
我们在此数据后面附上了从两个专家模型中抽取的自我挖掘的痕迹,我们发现这对下游达到教师一级的成绩很重要。

blocks.en:
Our merging recipe therefore combines offline supervised self-distillation with MOPD.
In our experiments, SFT alone did not recover the performance of both experts, even with the additional expert-generated traces; we used MOPD to close the remaining gap.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们的合并配方 结合下线 监督的自我消化 与MOPD。
在我们的实验中,光是SFT并没有恢复两位专家的性能,即使有了额外的专家产生的痕迹;我们利用MOPD来弥补剩下的缺口.

blocks.en: Teacher Routing
blocks.zh: 教师游轮

blocks.en:
For instruction following, grounded queries, and long-context tasks, a 50–50 mixture gives each expert an equal probability of supervising a rollout.
We decided to supervise General Tool Use by both experts because workflow automation needs both the strong reasoning capability of the agentic teacher to coordinate actions across many tools and the alignment teacher’s complex instruction following and preference alignment. Table 10 summarizes the routing policy.
blocks.zh:
对于后续指示、有根据的询问和长篇小说任务,50-50的混合物使每位专家有同样的可能性监督推出。
我们决定监督通用工具 两位专家都使用,因为工作流程自动化既需要代理教师强大的推理能力来协调跨越许多工具的行动,也需要教师的复杂教学遵循和偏好调整。 表10汇总了路线政策。

blocks.en: Table 10: Routing between the agentic and alignment experts, grouped by component.
blocks.zh: 表10:按构成部分分类的代理专家和配对专家之间的路线安排。

blocks.en: Nucleus Sampling for the Student
blocks.zh: 学生核心抽样

blocks.en:
Consistent with the RL run, we applied nucleus sampling ( p = 0.99 p=0.99 ) when generating student rollouts to reduce problematic sequences caused by sampling low-probability tokens.
On the trainer, we evaluated Equation 4.1 over the full vocabulary for both student and teacher.
We did not mask or renormalize either distribution to the rollout nucleus, because doing so would change the distributions being matched, including the teacher’s target.
Truncating the teacher to its own nucleus could also assign zero probability to tokens with nonzero student probability, making the reverse KL infinite.
blocks.zh:
与RL运行一致,我们在生成学生推出时应用了核取样(p = 0.99 p = 0.99),以减少采样低概率符号引起的问题序列.
在训练员方面,我们评价了4.1 学生和教师的完整词汇。
我们没有遮掩或重新规范向推出核心的分布,因为这样做会改变匹配的分布,包括教师的目标。
将老师挤到自己的核上也可以给有非零学生概率的符号分配零概率,使反向KL无限.

blocks.en:
With sampled-token KL, the same rollout samples determine both the visited contexts and the Monte Carlo estimate of KL within each context.
Under nucleus sampling, tokens outside the nucleus cannot enter that estimate and receive no direct comparison with the teacher at that context.
Our full-vocabulary loss includes those tokens at every visited context, keeping rollout truncation separate from the vocabulary sum.
blocks.zh:
采用抽取的KL样本,同样的推出样本既确定访问的背景,又确定蒙特卡洛对每个背景的KL的估计。
在核子取样下,核子外的标志不能输入该估计值,因此得不到与教师的直接比较。
我们的全省损失包括每个访问背景的这些纪念物,使推出的短句与词汇总和分开。

blocks.en: 4.3.4 Results on Merged Model
blocks.zh: 4.3.4 合并模式的结果

blocks.en:
In Table 11 , we compare the merged student with the two teachers.
The student broadly recovers their performance across the evaluated domains: it is competitive with the agentic teacher on agentic coding and mathematics and science benchmarks, matches or exceeds the alignment teacher on the lanes it supervises, and exceeds the stronger teacher where both supervise a lane.
The merged model carries both teachers’ capabilities, with some remaining performance gaps.
The broader model comparisons in Section 5 use temperature 0.7 0.7 ; this teacher–student comparison uses 1.0 1.0 .
Safety transfer is analyzed in Section 7.2.3 .
blocks.zh:
在表11中,我们比较了合并的学生和两名教师。
学生大致恢复了他们在整个评估领域的业绩:在代理编码和数学及科学基准方面与代理教师竞争,与其所监管的车道上的校对教师比对或超过校对教师,并超越两者都监管车道的更强大的教师。
合并的模式既具有教师的能力,也存在一些成绩差距。
第5节中更广泛的模型比较使用温度0.7 0.7;这一师生比较使用1.0 1.0。
第7.2.3节分析了安全转移。

blocks.en: Table 11: Student against the two teachers under temperature 1.0 and reasoning effort 512 unless otherwise noted. A dash marks a teacher that does not supervise the lane.
blocks.zh: 表11:学生在1.0温度和推理能力512下与两名教师对抗,除非另有说明。 破折号标志老师不监督车道。

blocks.en: Split Braining
blocks.zh: 拆分大脑

blocks.en:
Multi-teacher distillation can exhibit incomplete capability transfer and interactions across domains, even when each domain is assigned its own teacher.
These integration challenges motivate us to test a distinct potential failure mode: whether the merged student retains teacher-associated behaviors that depend on prompt-distribution cues, rather than reliably combining the teachers’ capabilities.
We refer to this behavior as “ split-braining .”
blocks.zh:
多教师蒸馏可以表现出能力不完全的转移和跨域的相互作用,即使每个域被分配到自己的老师.
这些融合挑战促使我们测试一种独特的潜在失败模式:合并的学生是否保留了依赖迅速分配提示的与教师相关的行为,而不是可靠地结合教师的能力。
我们把这种行为称为“分裂主义”。

blocks.en:
To test for this behavior, we developed a suite of hybrid tasks that combine features of both teachers’ prompt distributions, embedding challenging reasoning problems within conversational prompts.
On these hybrid tasks, we did not observe a significant degradation in performance, suggesting that reasoning performance is maintained even in alignment contexts.
However, in constructing these hybrid tasks, we found that models sometimes ignored small modifications to the prompt, such as changing the requested output format, and required stronger distributional cues to elicit alignment-associated behavior.
This suggests that certain features associated with the agentic teacher’s prompt distribution are relatively deeply ingrained.
Encouragingly, reasoning performance remained intact even when stronger alignment-associated cues were introduced.
blocks.zh:
为了检验这种行为,我们开发了一套混合任务,将两个教师的快速分布特征结合起来,将挑战性推理问题植入到对话的提示中。
关于这些混合任务,我们没有看到业绩显著下降,这表明即使在对齐的情况下,推理业绩也得到维持。
然而,在构建这些混合任务时,我们发现模型有时忽略了对即时器的小修改,如更改所要求的输出格式,并且需要更强的分布提示来引出对齐相关的行为.
这表明,与代理教师迅速分配有关的某些特征相对来说根深蒂固。
令人鼓舞的是,即使引入了更强有力的对齐提示,推理表现仍然完好无损。

blocks.en: 4.4 RL Infrastructure
blocks.zh: 4.4 RL 基础设施

blocks.en: The post-training stages described above require infrastructure that can support long-horizon agent interactions alongside continual model updates. The central challenge is to sustain high throughput while managing policy staleness, adapting to changing workloads, and recovering from failures. We built an asynchronous RL stack that separates training, inference, and tool execution, allowing resources to be allocated according to their distinct demands. The architecture also separates the learning recipe from execution infrastructure, enabling rapid experimentation throughout the training campaign.
blocks.zh: 上述培训后阶段需要基础设施,在不断更新模型的同时,能够支持远距离物剂互动。 中心挑战是维持高吞吐量,同时管理政策僵化、适应不断变化的工作量以及从失败中恢复过来。 我们建造了一个同步的RL堆,将训练,推论和工具执行分开,允许根据它们各自不同的要求分配资源. 该架构还将学习方法与执行基础设施区分开来,使整个培训活动能够迅速进行试验。

blocks.en: Across twelve production jobs, the system processed more than 80M rollout executions, with configured capacity reaching 1,920 trainer GPUs and 8,576 inference GPUs. The broader post-training campaign, including derisking and MOPD, exceeded 100M rollouts. Below, we describe the architecture and key design choices that supported this scale, followed by lessons from production experience.
blocks.zh: 在12个生产岗位上,该系统处理了超过80M的推出处决,配置的能力达到1 920名训练员GPU和8 576名推断员GPU。 更广泛的培训后运动,包括去风险和MOPD,超过了100M的推出. 下面我们介绍支持这一规模的架构和关键设计选择,然后是生产经验的经验教训。

blocks.en: 4.4.1 Architecture
blocks.zh: 4.4.1 建筑结构

blocks.en: Overview
blocks.zh: 概览

blocks.en: The architecture separates the RL recipe from distributed execution through stable interfaces for rollout generation, sampling, and preparation of training samples. These interfaces allow researchers to control which tasks run and how their results contribute to learning, while the infrastructure handles placement, scheduling, data movement, and recovery.
blocks.zh: 该架构通过稳定的接口将RL配方与分布式执行区分开来,用于推出生成,取样,以及准备培训样本. 这些接口使研究人员能够控制哪些任务运行及其结果如何有助于学习,而基础设施则处理放置、调度、数据移动和恢复。

blocks.en: Figure 32 shows the main components and their interactions. The control service manages the job lifecycle and coordinates rollout generation, batch assembly, and policy updates. Rollout workers execute agent–environment interactions using policy inference and sandboxes for tool execution, with a separate judge model reviewing solutions where enabled. The training service consumes completed batches and updates the policy, while the control service coordinates the publication and adoption of new policy versions. Storage preserves checkpoints and execution records.
blocks.zh: 图32显示主要组成部分及其相互作用。 控制服务管理工作生命周期,并协调推出生成、批量组装和政策更新。 推出人员利用政策推论和沙盒执行代理-环境相互作用,在允许的情况下,采用单独的法官模式审查解决方案。 培训服务消耗已完成的批次并更新政策,而控制服务则协调出版和采用新的政策版本。 储存保存检查站和执行记录。

blocks.en: Each job runs in a dedicated Ray cluster [ 113 ] with topology-aware placement and concurrent initialization of training and inference services. Generation begins once the data-pipeline state and initial policy weights have been initialized or restored. During training, the control service exchanges metadata and references, while trainer nodes fetch their assigned batch data and serving instances pull and verify updated weights directly from trainer memory. Keeping bulk transfers off the coordination path allows data movement to scale with the training and inference fleets.
blocks.zh: 每项工作都在一个专门的Ray集群[113]内进行,并进行地形意识的安置,同时启动培训和推断服务。 一旦数据管道状态和初始政策权重初始化或恢复,即开始生成. 在培训期间,控制服务交换元数据和参考资料,而训练员节点获取指定批量数据,并直接从训练员记忆中提取和核实更新的权重。 使批量转移脱离协调路径,使得数据流动能够随着培训和推断机队的规模扩大。

blocks.en: Rollout workers and serving instances can recover locally from isolated failures. Failures of the trainer or control service instead trigger a coordinated restart from a completed checkpoint, restoring the model, optimizer, and corresponding data-pipeline state.
blocks.zh: 推出工人和服务人员可以在当地从孤立的失败中恢复过来。 训练员或控制员的失败反而触发了从已完成的检查站协调重启,恢复模型,优化器,以及相应的数据管道状态.

blocks.en:

The control service coordinates rollout generation, batch preparation,
and policy updates. Rollout workers interact with policy inference,
sandbox, and optional judge services. The training service consumes
completed rollout data and publishes updated policy weights, while
storage preserves checkpoints and execution records. Arrows show
logical interactions rather than transport protocols.
blocks.zh:
图32:同步RL堆栈的高层次架构.
控制服务 协调推出生成,批量准备,
和政策最新情况。 推出人员与政策推论互动,
沙盒和可选法官服务 培训服务消费
完成推出数据并公布最新政策权重,同时
保存检查站和执行记录。 箭头显示
逻辑相互作用而不是运输协议。

blocks.en: Control Service
blocks.zh: 管制处

blocks.en: The control service coordinates rollout generation, batch preparation, and policy updates as concurrent activities. Rollout workers generate trajectories and evaluate task outcomes, completed samples are assembled into training batches according to the learning recipe, and updated policy weights are made available to inference workers. This organization allows generation and optimization to overlap despite substantial variation in rollout duration.
blocks.zh: 控制服务协调推出的生成、批量编制和政策更新,作为同时进行的活动。 推出人员产生轨迹并评价任务结果,完成的样本按照学习方法组装成培训批次,并向推论工作者提供更新的政策权重. 这一组织允许产生和优化重叠,尽管在推出期间有很大差异。

blocks.en: Rollout admission limits and bounded buffering regulate the flow of work through the system. When training consumption slows, these controls reduce further admission rather than allowing completed samples to accumulate indefinitely. Their settings balance keeping the trainer supplied against limiting policy staleness. They do not impose a hard bound on token age, since long-running trajectories can span multiple policy updates.
blocks.zh: 推出招生限额和限值缓冲调节通过系统的工作流量. 当训练消耗减慢时,这些控制会减少进一步的录取,而不是允许完成的样品无限期地积累. 他们的设置平衡了训练员的供给与限制政策停滞的关系。 它们不会对象征时代强加硬约束,因为长期运行的轨迹可以跨越多重政策更新.

blocks.en: Inference workers adopt updated weights asynchronously, verifying each update before resuming generation. Different workers may therefore serve different policy versions, and a single trajectory may span several versions. We retain per-token policy-version records through batch preparation to support staleness monitoring and diagnosis of training behavior.
blocks.zh: 推论工作者同步采用更新的权重,在恢复生成前核实每个更新. 因此,不同的工人可能服务于不同的政策版本,单一的轨道可能跨越若干版本。 我们通过批量准备保留每盘政策版记录,以支持对培训行为的停滞监测和诊断。

blocks.en: Policy Inference Service
blocks.zh: 政策参考处

blocks.en: The policy inference service is built on SGLang [ 114 ] . Each serving instance distributes inference across multiple GPUs, with attention computation and KV caches assigned to individual ranks and expert computation distributed across the instance. This organization supports concurrent generation for many long-running agent trajectories.
blocks.zh: 政策推断服务基于SGLang [114]. 每个在役实例在多个GPU之间分配推论,注意力计算和KV缓存分配到个人排名和专家计算在实例中分布. 这个组织支持许多长期存在的代理轨迹同时生成.

blocks.en: Long rollouts can span multiple policy updates ( Figure 33 ). In-flight requests retain their KV caches when adopting new weights, allowing generation to continue without restarting the trajectory. At the next turn following a weight update, earlier context is recomputed under the current weights, replaying the expert selections recorded during prior generation. Request placement preserves cache locality across turns.
blocks.zh: 长期推出可跨越多个政策更新(图33)。 飞行中的请求在采用新的权重时保留其KV缓存,允许生成继续而不重启轨迹. 在重量更新后的下一回合,更早的上下文在当前加权下重算,重播前一代记录的专家选择. 请求放置会保留缓存位置 。

blocks.en: This approach allows ongoing rollouts to incorporate policy updates, but means that decoding within a turn can combine updated weights with cached attention state computed under earlier weights. Policy-version records accompany generated tokens through training, supporting the staleness diagnostics discussed in Section 4.4.2 .
blocks.zh: 这种方法允许正在进行的推出纳入政策更新,但意味着在转弯内进行解码可以将更新的权重与根据先前权重计算的缓存的注意力状态结合起来。 政策版本记录通过培训产生信号,支持第4.4.2节所讨论的固态诊断。

blocks.en:

prefill only newly added tokens. When weights change during decoding,
the running turn retains its existing KV cache. At the next turn,
the full context is recomputed under the updated weights using
previously recorded expert selections. Widths are schematic.

在政策版本中,随后会转换回用缓存上下文和
预填只包含新添加的符号。 当重量在解码过程中发生变化时,
运行中转弯保留其现有的 KV 缓存。 下一转
使用
先前记录的专家选择。 宽是图.

blocks.en: Long, multi-turn trajectories require substantial input processing alongside ongoing decoding, including recomputation of earlier context after policy updates. Because attention ranks share expert-parallel resources, prefill work on one rank can delay decoding on others.
blocks.zh: 漫长的多回合轨道需要大量输入处理,同时进行中的解码,包括在政策更新后重新计算早先的背景。 由于注意力排名共享专家平行资源,一个级别上的预填工作会延迟对其它级别的解码.

blocks.en: We coordinate prefills across ranks to reduce interference between input processing and token generation. Grouping prefills into waves leaves intervening decode steps free to use low-latency DeepEP [ 115 ] dispatch. We also limit concurrent inference requests to preserve memory for KV caches. Together with the admission controls described in Section 4.4.1 , these mechanisms regulate resource use as rollout lengths and task mixtures change.
blocks.zh: 我们协调跨级别的预填,以减少输入处理和符号生成之间的干扰. 将预填组合成波浪,使干预解码步骤可以自由使用低常深EP[115]调度. 我们还限制同时提出的为 KV 缓存保存内存的推断请求。 这些机制连同第4.4.1节所述的准入控制措施,对作为推出时间和任务混合物变化的资源使用作了规定。

blocks.en: Training Service
blocks.zh: 培训处

blocks.en: The training service consumes asynchronously generated rollouts and produces policy updates. It must accommodate substantial variation in sequence length while preserving the sampling records and sample weights required by the learning recipe. Batch preparation overlaps optimization, and updated weights are published to the inference service as training progresses.
blocks.zh: 培训服务同步推出,并更新政策。 它必须适应序列长度的巨大变化,同时保留学习食谱所要求的采样记录和采样权重. 批量准备与优化重叠,随着培训的进展,更新的权重会发布到推断服务.

blocks.en: We use Megatron -style distributed training [ 41 ] , combining tensor, expert, and data parallelism with activation recomputation to support long-context optimization. Rollouts are packed by length to reduce padding and distributed across training replicas to limit workload imbalance.
blocks.zh: 我们使用威震天式的分布式训练[41],结合拉伸,专家,和数据并行主义与激活重算,支持长编优化. 推出工作按长度包装,以减少铺垫,并在培训复制品之间分发,以限制工作量不平衡。

blocks.en: Packing preserves sequence boundaries, prevents attention across independent sequences, and keeps token-level metadata aligned with the corresponding samples. Sample weights are preserved through batch preparation so that changes in packing or placement do not alter their contributions to the training objective.
blocks.zh: 包装保留了序列边界,防止了跨独立序列的注意力,使符号级元数据与相应的样本保持一致. 样品重量通过批量制备加以保存,以便包装或放置的改变不会改变其对培训目标的贡献。

blocks.en:

blocks.en: The trainer supports the sampling and routing consistency measures described in Section 4.1.2 . Recorded expert selections are reused during training, while activations and routing scores are recomputed under the current weights. Token probabilities are normalized over the nuclei recorded during generation.
blocks.zh: 训练员支持第4.1.2节所述的取样和路线一致性措施。 录制的专家选拔在训练期间被重新使用,而激活和路由分数则根据当前权重重新计算. 在生成期间记录的核子上,托肯概率得到正常化.

blocks.en: To reduce memory demand for long sequences, we compute the required token probabilities without materializing the full vocabulary-logit tensor. Together with activation recomputation and sequence packing, this limits the memory overhead of training on long agentic trajectories.
blocks.zh: 为了减少对长序列的内存需求,我们计算所需的符号概率,而不实现完整的词汇-logit radio. 再加上激活重算和序列包装,这限制了长剂轨迹训练的内存间接费用.

blocks.en: Frequent policy updates must be transferred from the trainer to inference workers that may use a different sharding layout. We transfer weights directly from trainer memory using NIXL [ 116 ] , avoiding the need to write and reload a durable checkpoint for each update. The transfer process accommodates the different layouts, and serving instances verify received weights before adopting them. This allows policy publication and inference updates to proceed without synchronizing the entire serving fleet.
blocks.zh: 经常更新的政策必须从训练员转移到可能使用不同硬化布局的推断工人。 我们使用 NIXL [116] 直接从教练记忆中传输权重,避免为每次更新写入和重新装入持久检查点。 转移过程包含不同的布局,服务实例在采用之前核实收到的权重. 这使得政策发布和推论更新得以进行,而不使整个服务机队同步.

blocks.en: Because rollout generation and batch preparation can advance ahead of optimization, recovery requires a consistent record of both training and data-pipeline progress. Checkpoints therefore capture the model, optimizer, training counters, and corresponding data-pipeline state.
blocks.zh: 由于推出生成和批量准备可以提前推进优化,恢复需要始终如一地记录培训和数据管道进度. 因此,检查站可以捕捉模型,优化器,训练计数器,以及相应的数据管道状态.

blocks.en: Following a trainer or coordination failure, the job restores a completed checkpoint and loads the restored policy into the inference service before generation resumes. Work beyond the checkpoint boundary may be discarded and regenerated. This provides a consistent recovery point without requiring exact replay of previously generated rollouts or prepared batches.
blocks.zh: 在训练员或协调失败后,该工作将恢复一个已完成的检查站,并将恢复后的政策加载到推断服务中,然后再恢复世代。 检查站边界以外的工作可能被丢弃和再生。 这提供了一个一致的回收点,而不需要精确地重播以前产生的推出或准备的批次。

blocks.en: Shared Infrastructure Services
blocks.zh: 共享基础设施服务

blocks.en: Sandbox execution, judging, and data preparation sit outside the core RL stack and are managed as part of the broader infrastructure effort.
blocks.zh: Sandbox执行,判断,和数据准备都位于核心RL堆外,并作为更广泛的基础设施工作的一部分进行管理.

blocks.en:
Tool-using rollouts execute commands in sandboxes created from task-specific Open Container Initiative (OCI) images.
Each sandbox preserves its own files and processes across turns.
Tool results and structured failure details return to the rollout actor; the rollout environment defines task behavior and rewards.
The sandbox fleet scaled independently of training and inference.
blocks.zh:
使用工具的推出在根据特定任务所创建的开放集装箱倡议图像创建的沙箱中执行命令。
每个沙盒都保存着自己的文件和程序。
工具结果和结构化失败细节返回推出的演员;推出环境定义了任务行为和奖励.
沙盒舰队在训练和推论之外独立规模扩大.

blocks.en:
Where enabled, a separately served, fixed judge model reviews rollouts that passed automated task checks against versioned assessment criteria and can veto a pass before reward reaches training.
Its endpoint scales independently and does not participate in policy weight updates.
Under fail-closed configuration, a judge request that still fails after retries fails the rollout, preventing an unreviewed verifier pass from becoming a positive training reward (see Section 6 ).
blocks.zh:
在允许的情况下,一个单独服务的固定法官模式审查推出程序,根据版本评估标准通过自动任务检查,并在奖励达到培训之前否决通行证。
其端点尺度独立,不参与政策权重更新.
在失败闭塞配置下,在复试失败推出后仍然失败的法官请求,阻止未经审查的核查员通过考试成为积极的训练奖励(见第6节)。

blocks.en: The data pipeline assembles task mixtures and associates each task with its environment, tools, and scoring rules. Its progress is saved alongside training checkpoints so that resumed jobs remain consistent with the restored training state (see Section 6 ).
blocks.zh: 数据管道集成任务混合物,并将每项任务与其环境、工具和评分规则联系起来。 其进展与培训检查站同时得到节省,使恢复的工作与恢复的培训状态保持一致(见第6节)。

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Production Experience
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 生产经验

blocks.en: Operating the RL stack across twelve production jobs highlighted the interaction between workload characteristics, policy staleness, and resource utilization. As task mixtures and rollout lengths changed, maintaining efficient training required monitoring the full path from generation to optimization. We summarize four operational lessons below.
blocks.zh: 在12个生产岗位上运行RL堆,突出了工作量特点、政策停滞和资源利用之间的相互作用。 随着任务混合体和推出时间的改变,维持有效的培训需要监测从一代到优化的整个路径。 我们总结以下四个业务经验。

blocks.en: The concurrency needed to keep the trainer supplied varied with rollout duration and task mix. We increased rollout admission when insufficient batch supply left the trainer waiting, and reduced it when generation outpaced consumption or policy age increased. In a pre-run tuning sweep, increasing concurrency beyond serving capacity added latency without improving generation throughput. Effective concurrency therefore depended on the workload and had to be revisited throughout training.
blocks.zh: 保持训练员供应所需的货币各不相同,有推出时间和任务组合。 在批量供应不足使教练等待的情况下,我们增加了推广招生率,在生产速度超过消费或政策年龄增加时,则降低了招生率。 在预运行的调频扫描中,超出服务容量的币种增加耐用性而不提高发电吞吐量。 因此,有效货币取决于工作量,必须在整个培训中重新审视。

blocks.en: Per-token policy-version records allowed us to distinguish staleness accumulated within individual trajectories, differences between related rollouts, and the remaining gap before training consumed the data (see Figure 35 ). Across the instrumented runs, version differences between rollouts in the same group were the largest component of policy age. This showed that managing staleness required attention to uneven trajectory progress as well as queueing. Combined with execution traces and queue metrics, these measurements informed adjustments to rollout admission and helped diagnose delays in the training pipeline.
blocks.zh: 逐一的政策版本记录使我们能够区分个别轨迹中积累的停滞性、相关推出之间的差别以及培训之前尚存的差距(见图35)。 在整个仪器运行中,同一组推出的版本差异是政策时代的最大组成部分。 这表明,管理停滞需要注意轨迹进展和排队不平衡。 这些测量结果与执行痕迹和排队测量结果相结合,为推广录取提供了依据,有助于诊断培训过程中的延误。

blocks.en: Figure 35: Sources of policy staleness across production jobs. The stacked components measure policy-version differences within rollouts, between rollouts in a group, between groups for a task, and the remaining gap at training consumption. Differences between rollouts in the same group were the largest component. All components share a common normalization: the mean total policy age over valid measurement windows is set to 1. The horizontal axis concatenates recorded 30-minute windows across twelve jobs, omitting gaps between jobs; alternating shaded bands distinguish jobs. The breakdown was recorded for eleven jobs, with unavailable measurements left blank. Policy age measures version differences, not elapsed time.
blocks.zh: 图35:生产岗位政策僵化的根源。 叠加的组件衡量在推出过程中的政策版本差异,在一组推出之间,任务组之间,以及培训消费方面尚存的差距。 同一组项目在展开方面的差异最大。 所有组成部分都有一个共同的正常化:平均总体政策年龄高于有效的计量窗口,定为1岁。 横向轴叠合物记录了12个工作的30分钟窗口,省略了工作间的差距;交替的阴影带区分了工作。 记录了11项工作的细分情况,没有可用的测量数据是空白的。 政策年龄计量版本的差异,没有时间。

blocks.en: Sequence length alone did not determine training memory requirements. We observed cases in which generated content concentrated token assignments on a small subset of MoE experts, causing out-of-memory failures despite remaining within the configured sequence-length limits. Some incidents involved repetitive outputs; another followed a task-mixture change without repetition. These failures showed that token counts and aggregate memory metrics were insufficient to characterize memory pressure: monitoring expert-routing concentration was also important.
blocks.zh: 仅靠序列长度不能确定培训记忆要求。 我们看到一些案例,其中生成的内容将象征性任务集中在教育部一小批专家身上,尽管仍保持在所配置的序列长度限度内,但造成非记忆性故障。 有些事件涉及重复的产出;另一个事件是在任务混合变化之后,没有重复。 这些失败表明,符号计数和总的内存度量不足以确定内存压力的特征:监测专家路线的集中也很重要。

blocks.en: High cache reuse did not eliminate substantial prefill work. Multi-turn trajectories repeatedly submitted growing conversation histories, and fresh input-token volume remained larger than generated-token volume through much of the run, despite cache-hit rates above 94%. Cache-hit percentage alone therefore understated the input-processing workload. These observations reinforced the importance of measuring fresh prefill separately from decoding and coordinating the two workloads, as described above. The token-volume measurements do not directly measure their relative compute costs.
blocks.zh: 高缓存再利用并没有消除大量的预填工作。 多回合的轨迹一再提交不断增长的谈话历史,新鲜的输入式音量在运行的大部分时间里仍然大于生成式音量,尽管缓存率高于94%。 因此,仅受缓存影响的百分比就低估了输入处理工作量。 如上文所述,这些观察加强了衡量新预填与解码和协调两个工作量的重要性。 代号量的测量不直接测量其相对计算成本.

blocks.en: 4.5 Quantization
blocks.zh: 4.5 量化

blocks.en:
Beam is available in BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 precision formats.
The two quantized checkpoints are produced from the same BF16 model using post-training quantization (PTQ), without further model training.
They offer different trade-offs in model footprint, supported hardware, and serving efficiency while retaining much of the BF16 model’s evaluated capability.
blocks.zh:
Beam以BF16,FP8和NVFP4精准格式提供.
两个量化的检查站采用相同的BF16模式,使用培训后量化(PTQ),没有进行进一步的模型培训。
它们在模型足迹、支持硬件和提高效率方面提供不同的取舍,同时保留BF16模型的大部分评价能力。

blocks.en: Table 12: Overview of the BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 表12:BF16、FP8和NVFP4检查站概况。
4.5.1 FP8 目标

blocks.en: The FP8 checkpoint was quantized using LLM Compressor [ 117 ] , built and maintained by the vLLM team.
blocks.zh: FP8检查站使用LLM压缩机进行量化[117],由vLLM团队建造和维护.

blocks.en: Quantization Scheme
blocks.zh: 量化计划

blocks.en:
FP8 stores weights and input activations as 8-bit E4M3 numbers.
Weights have a fixed scale per output channel; activation scales are computed dynamically per token during inference.
blocks.zh:
FP8将重量和输入激活存储为8位E4M3数字.
重量每个输出通道都有固定的尺度;激活尺度在推论期间按每个符号动态计算.

blocks.en:
FP8 conversion is applied to the following components: Attention blocks (query, key, value, output, and attention projections), dense MLPs, MoE experts block (gate, up, and down projections), and KV Cache.
Embeddings, the language modeling head, MoE routers, and normalization layers retain their original precision and values.
blocks.zh:
FP8转换适用于以下组件: 1. 注意块(清水,键,值,输出和注意预测),密集的MLP,MOE专家块(门,上,下预测),以及KV缓存.
嵌入式,语言建模头,MOE路由器,以及正常化层保留其原始精度和价值.

blocks.en: Quantization Method
blocks.zh: 量化 方法

blocks.en:
We used post-training quantization (PTQ) to convert selected BF16 weights to FP8 using the round-to-nearest (RTN) method.
This requires no additional training or calibration dataset.
blocks.zh:
我们使用训练后定量法(PTQ)将选定的BF16重量转换为FP8,使用圆对近法(RTN).
这不需要额外的培训或校准数据集。

blocks.en:
At a given quantized layer, let v r , j v_{r,j} denote either a weight or an input activation, with r r indexing output channels for weights or tokens for activations and j j indexing input features.
For a nonzero vector, both cases use the same scale and rounding rule: s r = max j ⁡ | v r , j | 448 , q r , j = round E4M3 ⁡ ( v r , j s r ) . s_{r}=\frac{\max_{j}|v_{r,j}|}{448},\qquad q_{r,j}=\operatorname{round}_{\mathrm{E4M3}}\left(\frac{v_{r,j}}{s_{r}}\right). The quantized values represent v r , j ≈ s r ​ q r , j v_{r,j}\approx s_{r}q_{r,j} .
Weight scales are computed separately for each output channel during conversion and remain fixed during inference.
Activation scales are recomputed from the current inputs for each token at each quantized layer on every forward pass, so no offline activation calibration is required.
Here, 448 448 is the largest finite FP8 E4M3 value, and round E4M3 \operatorname{round}_{\mathrm{E4M3}} rounds to the nearest representable value.
All-zero channels or activation vectors use a positive fallback scale to avoid division by zero [ 118 ] .
