对于一个非零向量,两个案例都使用相同的比例尺和四舍五入规则:s r = 最大 j = | v r, j = 448, q r, j = 圆 E4M3 = ⁡ (v r, j s r ). (原始内容存档于2017-09-29). s_{r}=\frac{\max_{j}|v_{r,j}|}{448},\qquad q_{r, j}=\operatorname{round}_{\mathrm{E4M3}}\左(\frac{v_{r, j}}{s_{r}}\r}}\r}}\右). 量化值代表 v r, j r q r, j r, j 近似 s_{r}q_{r, j}.
在转换过程中,每个输出通道的重量均单独计算,在推论期间保持不变。
激活天平从每个前传的每个整数层每个令牌的当前输入中重算出来,因此不需要离线激活校准.
这里,448,448是最大的限值FP8 E4M3值,圆形E4M3\操作器名{round}_{\ mathrm{E4M3}}}的回合为最接近的可代表值.
全零通道或激活矢量使用正回落尺度避免零除 [118].

blocks.en: 4.5.2 NVFP4
blocks.zh: 4.5.2 NVFP4 国家森林基金

blocks.en: The NVFP4 checkpoint was quantized using NVIDIA’s Model Optimizer [ 119 ] , built and maintained by the NVIDIA team.
blocks.zh: NVFP4检查站使用NVIDIA的模型优化器[119]进行定量,由NVIDIA团队建造和维护.

blocks.en: Quantization Scheme
blocks.zh: 量化计划

blocks.en:
NVFP4 stores values as 4-bit E2M1 numbers with one FP8 (E4M3) scale per 16-element block and one FP32 scale per tensor.
In the NVFP4 release, MoE experts use NVFP4 W4A4 precision, while dense MLPs, attention, embeddings, and the LM head remain in BF16.
The MoE router remains in FP32.
The KV cache remains in BF16, with FP8 supported.
blocks.zh:
NVFP4存储值为4位E2M1数字,每16个元素块有1个FP8(E4M3)比例尺,每加仑1个FP32比例尺.
在NVFP4发布中,MOE专家使用NVFP4 W4A4精度,而密集的MLP,注意力,嵌入,LM头则留在BF16中.
教育部的路由器仍留在FP32.
KV缓存仍留在BF16,FP8支持.

blocks.en: Quantization Method
blocks.zh: 量化 方法

blocks.en:
For each 16-element weight block, we picked the FP8 scale that minimizes output error using Model Optimizer ’s Local Hessian algorithm [ 120 ] .
We start from the BF16 checkpoint and calibrate one decoder layer at a time across 8 GPUs.
Every layer sees the BF16 model’s activations, not those of already-quantized layers, and statistics are reduced across ranks before the search so every rank selects identical scales.
blocks.zh:
对于每个16元素的重量块,我们选择了FP8比例,使用Model Optimizer的本地黑森算法[120]将输出错误最小化.
我们从BF16检查站开始,一次校准一个解码层,跨越8GPU.
每个层都看到BF16模型的激活,而不是那些已经量化的层的激活,在搜索之前,各个级别的统计数据都会减少,所以每个级别都会选择相同的尺度.

blocks.en:
Our calibration set is composed of 1,000 long agentic trajectories of 32,768 tokens each (32.8M tokens), mostly software-engineering sessions, rendered in Beam’s chat format.
Beam serves long-horizon agentic work, so we calibrate on sequences of the same kind.
The calibration took around 6 hours on one node of 8 B300 GPUs and used under 30 GiB of GPU memory per rank.
blocks.zh:
我们的校准集由1000个长的代理轨迹组成,每个32,768个令牌(32.8M令牌),大部分是软件工程会议,以Beam的聊天格式提供.
Beam)服务于长视距的代理工作,所以我们对同类序列进行校准.
校准在8个B300GPU的一个节点上用了大约6小时,每级使用30 GPU内存.

blocks.en:
We tried different NVFP4 quantization recipes on the BF16 checkpoint with the same data, seed and pipeline.
Our primary metric is held-out fidelity to BF16 in terms of KL ( BF16 ∥ NVFP4 ) \operatorname{KL}(\mathrm{BF16}\|\mathrm{NVFP4}) and top-1 agreement, measured teacher-forced on 64 agentic sequences of 32,768 tokens that are disjoint from calibration (2.1M scored tokens, BF16 KV cache on both sides).
blocks.zh:
我们在BF16检查站尝试了不同的NVFP4量化配方,使用相同的数据,种子和管道.
我们的主要衡量标准是对 BF16 的 坚持- 忠诚度, 包括 KL (BF16 QQ NVFP4 )\ 操作器名{ KL} (\ mathrm{ BF16 { mathrm{ NVFP4 }) 和 顶级-1 协议, 测量教师- 强制于 64 个代理序列, 共 32 768 个令牌, 与校准脱节( 2.1M 得分令牌, BF16 KV 缓存在两侧) 。

blocks.en:
Table 13: Recipe ablations with the same calibration data and a BF16 KV cache.
Fidelity is measured on 64 held-out sequences.
blocks.zh:
表13:具有相同校准数据和BF16 KV缓存的道具。
Fidelity是根据64个搁置序列来测量的.

blocks.en: Local Hessian maximizes fidelity, reducing KL divergence by 8% versus max scales and 6% versus four-over-six across nearly all held-out sequences.
blocks.zh: 当地的黑森州将忠诚度最大化,在几乎所有被搁置的序列中,KL差异比最大尺度减少8%,比四比六减少6%。

blocks.en:
Quantizing dense MLPs is inefficient because it saves only 1.26 GiB (0.5%) while increasing KL as much as altering the scale method across all 49 MoE layers.
Thus, only routed experts are quantized.
blocks.zh:
量化稠密的MLP效率低下,因为它只节省1.26 GiB(0.5%),同时增加KL,就像改变所有49个MOE层的尺度法一样.
因此,只有路线专家才被量化。

blocks.en:
Held-out KL ranks recipes better than single eval runs.
Benchmarks ( Table 13 ) showed minimal median spread ( < < 0.4%) and noisy individual variations up to 3.2 points.
The release recipes use Local Hessian with quantized MoE layers and were selected using held-out KL.
blocks.zh:
Hold-out KL的食谱排名优于单一的eval运行.
基准(表13)显示,中间差最小( < 0.4%),个别变化噪音高达3.2点。
发布食谱使用Local Hessian与定量的MOE层,并使用hold-out KL进行选择.

blocks.en: 4.5.3 Quantization Results
blocks.zh: 4.5.3 量化结果

blocks.en:
Evaluated using temperature 0.7, top-p 0.99, max reasoning effort, 1M context.
The FP8 and NVFP4 checkpoints are respectively using an FP8 and a BF16 KV cache.
blocks.zh:
使用温度0.7进行评估,最高0.99,最大推理努力,1M上下文.
FP8和NVFP4检查站分别使用FP8和BF16 KV缓存.

blocks.en:
Figure 36: FP8/NVFP4 vs. BF16 Beam 1.0 benchmark differences.
Each pair of bars compares FP8 (upper) and NVFP4 (lower) with BF16 on one of 22 benchmarks across coding, reasoning, search/tools, and general capabilities.
Bar length shows the score difference (quantized − - BF16) in percentage points: positive values indicate higher scores than BF16, and negative values indicate lower scores.
A label of 0.0 indicates a match to one decimal place.
Across all 22 benchmarks, the mean difference is +0.03 points for FP8 (higher on 9, lower on 11) and − - 0.45 points for NVFP4 (higher on 4, lower on 16).
All runs use temperature 0.7 and top-p 0.99; safety and AA Omniscience (index) are excluded.
Values reflect observed score changes rather than statistically verified shifts.
blocks.zh:
图36:FP8/NVFP4与BF16Beam 1.0基准差异.
每对条将FP8(上)和NVFP4(下)在跨越编码,推理,搜索/工具,以及一般能力的22个基准之一上与BF16进行比较.
栏长显示分数差(量化−-BF16)的百分点:正值表示比BF16高分,负值表示分数较低.
0. 0 的标签表示与小数点后一位相匹配。
在所有22个基准中,FP8的平均差值为+0.03分(高于9,低于11),NVFP4的平均差值为−0.45分(高于4,低于16).
所有运行都使用温度0.7和最高p0.99;安全性和AA Omniscience (index)被排除在外.
数值反映观察到的分数变化,而不是经统计核实的变动。

blocks.en:
Note: Due to stochastic sampling, evaluation scores vary across runs—especially on small evaluation sets and long-horizon agentic benchmarks, where key tasks can shift scores by 1–2 points.
Instances where FP8 or NVFP4 outperform BF16 reflect this variance rather than quality gains.
Overall, quantized checkpoints closely match BF16 performance, with FP8 recovering 99.93% and NVFP4 recovering 98.98% of median benchmark scores.
blocks.zh:
注:由于抽查有条理,评价得分各行各业——特别是小评价组和长距离代理基准,其中关键任务可转换得分1-2分。
FP8或NVFP4表现优于BF16的情况反映了这种差异而不是质量收益.
总体而言,量化的检查站与BF16的业绩非常吻合,FP8恢复99.93%,NVFP4恢复98.98%的基准中位数。

blocks.en:
To evaluate whether quantization alters refusal behavior, we tested the checkpoints on our Iris Safety Evaluations suite.
This shows quantization maintains safety without sacrificing helpfulness.
Learn more about our Safety & Alignment methodology and the detailed results of how we’ve evaluated Beam in Section 7 .
blocks.zh:
为了评估量化是否改变拒绝行为, 我们在Iris安全评估套间测试了检查站。
这表明量化在不牺牲帮助的情况下维持了安全.
了解我们的安全与调整方法,

blocks.en: Table 14: Safety suite results.
blocks.zh: 表14:安全套房结果。

blocks.en: 4.5.4 Quantization Performance
blocks.zh: 4.5.4 量化性能

blocks.en:
We measured serving performance of the three checkpoints on eight NVIDIA B300 SXM GPUs using SGLang [ 114 ] .
Each configuration runs a tensor-parallel replica with identical settings.
Performance is measured across 3.1M tokens of replayed traffic and prompts up to 150K tokens.
blocks.zh:
我们用SGLang [114] 测量了八个NVIDIA B300 SXM GPU上三个检查站的服役情况。
每个配置运行一个具有相同设置的朗诺平行复制.
性能通过重播流量的3100兆令牌进行测量,并提示高达150K令牌.

blocks.en: Memory and Serving Capacity
blocks.zh: 记忆和服务能力

blocks.en:
Quantization halves the GPU requirement for a 1M-token context.
BF16 requires 8 B300 GPUs per replica: on 4 GPUs, weights occupy 234.7 GiB per GPU, leaving KV cache capacity for only 213K tokens.
FP8 and NVFP4 both support the full 1M-token context on 4 GPUs.
blocks.zh:
量化将1M键上下文的GPU要求减半.
BF16每复制需要8台B300GPU:在4台GPU上,重量占据每台GPU的234.7GiB,使得KV缓存容量仅213K令牌.
FP8和NVFP4都支持4个GPU上的完整1M调上下文.

blocks.en:
Quantization provides more KV cache headroom.
On 4 GPUs, NVFP4 provides 8.2M tokens of replica-wide KV capacity versus FP8’s 5.8M (1.41 × \times ).
On 8 GPUs, FP8 and NVFP4 provide 17.3M and 19.1M tokens, respectively, versus BF16’s 11.7M.
blocks.zh:
量化提供了更多的KV缓存头室.
在4个GPU上,NVFP4提供了8.2M的可复制范围的KV容量的代号,相对于FP8的5.8M(1.41×\时).
在8个GPU上,FP8和NVFP4分别提供了17.3M和19.1M的令牌,与BF16的11.7M相对.

blocks.en:
Figure 37: Memory allocation per B300 GPU (268.6 GiB) after model load.
Each configuration reserves 90% of HBM; KV cache uses the space remaining after weights and other allocations.
Labels inside bars show GiB; right-hand labels show replica-wide KV capacity in full-attention tokens.
Rows are sorted by KV capacity.
blocks.zh:
图37:模型载荷后每架B300 GPU(268.6 GiB)的内存分配.
每个配置都保留90%的HBM;KV缓存使用权重和其他分配后的剩余空间.
条内的标签显示为GiB;右手标签显示在全意符中具有可复制的KV容量.
行按KV容量排序.

blocks.en: Throughput Gains
blocks.zh: 通过量增益

blocks.en:
We evaluated two workloads: a fixed-length benchmark (8,192 input / 1,024 output tokens per request; 8–256 concurrent requests) and AgentX , which replays 393 recorded agentic coding sessions (80K–100K input tokens per request, approximately 95% prefix cache hit rate; 8–64 concurrent sessions).
Per-user speed is the median decode speed after the first token.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了两个工作量:固定长度基准(每个请求8 192个输入/1 024个输出令牌;8-256个同时请求)和AgentX,它们重播393个记录的代理编码会话(每个请求80K-100K输入令牌,约95%的前缀缓存命中率;8-64个并行会议)。
per用户速度是第一个符号之后的中位解码速度.

blocks.en:
Figures 38 and 39 show measured throughput per GPU versus per-user speed, with each point labeled by concurrency.
Panel (a) uses each checkpoint’s smallest deployment—four GPUs for FP8 and NVFP4, and eight for BF16—while panel (b) uses eight GPUs for all checkpoints. Tables 15 and 16 compare throughput at fixed per-user speeds: 50 and 100 tok/s/user for the fixed-length benchmark, and 50 tok/s/user for AgentX.
Values are linearly interpolated between adjacent measured points.
For NVFP4 on AgentX, speed remains above 50 tok/s/user at the highest tested load of 64 sessions, so we report the measured throughput at that load as a lower bound.
blocks.zh:
图38和39显示每GPU的吞吐量相对于每个用户的速度,每个点都以货币标注.
小组(a) 使用每个检查站最小的部署 -- -- FP8和NVFP4使用四个GPU,BF16使用八个GPU -- -- 而小组(b) 在所有检查站使用八个GPU。 表15和16比较了按每用户固定速度计算的吞吐量:50和100吨/秒/用户为固定长度基准,50吨/秒/用户为AgentX。
数值在相邻测量点之间线性插值.
对于AgentX上的NVFP4,在64个会话的最高测试负载时,速度保持在50吨/秒/用户以上,因此我们将该负载的测量吞吐量报告为下限.

blocks.en: 4.6 Speculative Decoding
blocks.zh: 4.6 频谱解码

blocks.en:
Decoding a large mixture-of-experts model is memory-bound, which leaves most of the GPU’s compute idle.
Speculative decoding [ 121 , 122 ] puts this compute to use by having a small draft model propose several tokens, which the target model then verifies in a single forward pass.
With rejection sampling, the target’s output distribution is preserved exactly.
The speedup depends on the acceptance length τ \tau , the mean number of tokens produced per verification step, and on the cost of drafting.
Beam is released with a DFlash 2 drafter [ 123 , 124 ] , which increases its decode throughput by 1.9 × \times to 3.0 × \times .
blocks.zh:
解码一个大型的专家混合模型是内存的,这让GPU的大部分计算闲置.
光谱解码[121,122]通过有一个小的模型草案来进行计算,提出几个符号,然后目标模型通过一个单一的前传进行验证.
通过拒绝抽样,目标的产出分配得到准确保留。
速度的提高取决于接受长度\ tau,每个核查步骤生成的代币的平均数量,以及起草费用。
Beam使用DFlash 2起草器发布 [123, 124],它将其解码吞吐量增加了1.9×\时间到3.0×\时间.

blocks.en: 4.6.1 Architecture
blocks.zh: 4.6.1 建筑结构

blocks.en:
The drafter is a 1.93B-parameter block-diffusion model that proposes a block of tokens in one forward pass.
Its five transformer layers attend bidirectionally within the block and, through their keys and values, to Beam’s hidden states at layers 4, 16, 28, 40 and 46, the inputs of its global-attention layers.
DFlash 2’s in-block convolutions and path selector keep drafted tokens consistent, and the embedding and output head are Beam’s, kept frozen.
Context attention is limited to a 4,096-token window, so drafting cost stays constant as contexts grow.
Whether such a local drafter stays accurate deep into long contexts is the main question for training.
blocks.zh:
起草者是一个1.93B参数块分散模型,在一条前传中提出一组令牌.
它的五个变压器层在区块内双向排列,并通过它们的键和值,到Beam的隐藏状态在4,16,28,40和46层,即其全球关注层的输入.
DFlash 2 的块状进化器和路径选择器使已起草的符号保持一致,嵌入和输出头是Beam的,一直被冻结。
上下文的注意力仅限于一个4,096个托肯窗口,因此起草成本随着上下文的增长而保持不变.
培训的主要问题是,这样一个当地起草人是否在很长的时间内保持准确。

blocks.en: 4.6.2 Training Data
blocks.zh: 4.6.2 培训数据

blocks.en:
All targets are generated by Beam: the 1.42M PerfectBlend prompts [ 125 ] , regenerated with the released checkpoint, and rollouts from the multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) stage that produced Beam ( Section 4.3 ), which cover the agentic and reasoning interactions it is deployed on.
After the first 50 steps of that stage, the policy’s per-token likelihood of its own samples and their lengths were flat in every category, and we use rollouts from these later steps.
In ablations with pre-release versions of Beam, replacing 42% of PerfectBlend with such rollouts increased accepted draft tokens by 9.9%, and by 21% on agentic traces.
blocks.zh:
所有目标均由Beam产生:1.42M PerfectBlend points [125],与释放的检查站重生,并推出生产Beam(4.3节)的多教师政策蒸馏(MOPD)阶段,该阶段涵盖它部署的代理和推理互动。
在那个阶段的前50个步骤之后,政策本身的样本及其长度的每个类别都有平坦的可能性,我们使用这些后来步骤的推广。
在发行前版的Beam中,用这种推出取代了PerfectBlend的42%,被接受的代币增加了9.9%,在代理痕迹上增加了21%。

blocks.en: 4.6.3 Training Mostly at Short Context
blocks.zh: 4.6.3 主要短期培训

blocks.en:
Each time a sequence is used, a single forward pass of Beam captures its features, and each of its 512 blocks of 16 tokens, starting at randomly sampled anchor positions, reads the features of the tokens before its anchor.
Since the cost of this capture, like that of attention, grows with sequence length, we train mostly on short sequences.
Beam’s features shift with position (its global-attention layers scale queries with absolute position [ 18 ] ), but this does not prevent transfer to long contexts: in development experiments on 43 long agentic traces, a drafter trained only at 8K accepted 4.70 draft tokens per block of 16 at 4K to 8K of context and 5.02 beyond 64K.
A further long-context stage added gains only at longer contexts, 1.6% at 8K to 16K and 3.8% beyond 64K, and these saturated within 4K steps.
Since this is small relative to its cost, we keep that stage short: 6 epochs over 2.2M traces truncated to 8K tokens, then 2 epochs over 592K traces of up to 128K tokens.
blocks.zh:
每次使用一个序列,Beam的单个前传会捕捉其特征,其512个块的16个信使,从随机抽取锚位开始,在锚位之前读取信使的特征.
由于这种捕捉的成本,像注意力的成本,随着序列长度的增长,我们主要在短序列上训练.
Beam的特征随位置而变化(它的全局关注层具有绝对位置的查询[18]),但这并不妨碍向长背景的转移:在43个长代理痕迹的开发实验中,一名只经过8K训练的起草者接受了每块16个4K到8K上下文和5.02个超过64K的草稿令牌.
一段较长的阶段只在较长的时间内增加了收益,8K至16K为1.6%,超过64K为3.8%,这些收益在4K步内饱和。
由于这与其成本相比是很小的,我们保持了这个阶段的短幅:6个历程超过2.2M的痕迹缩短到8K的印记,然后2个历程超过592K的痕迹长达128K的印记.

blocks.en:
The loss weights each block position by the expected number of accepted tokens that depend on it [ 126 , 127 ] .
To train stably, we lowered AdamW’s β 2 \beta_{2} to 0.95 and added adaptive gradient clipping [ 128 ] , which eliminated the gradient spikes that occasionally made early runs diverge despite a fixed clipping threshold.
Beam’s features are captured online from its NVFP4 checkpoint, the one we serve, and using BF16 instead changed accepted tokens by at most 1.5%, in training or serving.
In total, both stages took about 3.4K B300 GPU-hours.
blocks.zh:
损失以所依赖的预期接受信使数量为每个区块位置加权[126,127].
我们将亚当W的β 2\beta_{2}降为0.95, 并增加了适应性梯度剪切[128],
我们所服务的NVFP4检查站在网上捕捉到Beam的特点,
两个阶段总共耗时约3.4K B300 GPU小时.

blocks.en: 4.6.4 Sizing for Serving Speed
blocks.zh: 4.6.4 速度大小

blocks.en:
Higher acceptance does not always give higher speed, because drafting and verification have costs.
Eight drafter layers instead of five added 2.8% accepted tokens in replay and 1.2% when served, but changed the speedup by only 0.5%, within noise, for 60% more parameters.
Block size shows the same trade-off.
Verifying 8 positions instead of 16 lowered acceptance length by 5% to 15%, but late positions are rarely accepted and each one still costs verification compute, so serving with 8 positions was faster in 11 of 12 workload and concurrency settings: on chat, the speedup rose from 1.63 × \times to 1.93 × \times for one request and from 1.46 × \times to 2.00 × \times at 128 concurrent requests.
Training is not bound by verification cost, so we train with blocks of 16, as DFlash does: a drafter trained on larger blocks can be served at smaller ones with little loss, but not the reverse [ 123 ] .
The released drafter has five layers, trains with blocks of 16 and serves with blocks of 8.
blocks.zh:
较高的接受率并不总是能提高速度,因为起草和核查费用很高。
8个起草层而不是5个在重播中增加了2.8%的接受符,在服务时则增加了1.2%,但只改变了0.5%的速度,在噪声范围内,增加了60%的参数.
块大小显示相同的取舍.
核查8个职位而不是16个职位将接受时间缩短了5%至15%,但很少接受较晚的职位,而且每个职位仍然需要计算费用,因此在12个工作量和货币设置中的11个职位中,担任8个职位的速度更快:聊天时,速度从1.63xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
训练不受核查费用的约束,因此我们用16个街区来训练,就像DFlash那样:一个受过较大街区训练的起草员可以在较小的街区服务,没有多少损失,但不能相反[123].
发行的起草器有5层,列车设有16块编组,服务区块为8块编组.

blocks.en: 4.6.5 Results

With Beam in NVFP4 on four B300 GPUs and 7 drafted tokens per step, the drafter reaches τ = 4.38 \tau=4.38 with sampling and 4.64 with greedy decoding, out of a maximum of 8, over 1,562 turns of math, code, long-context and chat.
In line with the transfer result, τ \tau on DeepSWE agentic traces [ 129 ] stays between 4.2 and 4.6 from 16K to 128K tokens of context ( Table 18 ).
Decode throughput increases by 1.96 × \times to 3.03 × \times for a single request and by 1.89 × \times to 2.75 × \times with 32 concurrent requests ( Table 17 ).

随着Beam在NVFP4中4个B300GPU和每步7个起草的代币,起草者通过采样达到 =4.38\tau=4.38,通过贪婪解码达到4.64,在最多8个版本中,超过1,562个转数,代码,长调和聊天.
根据转录结果,DeepSWE代理痕迹上的\tau在上下文的上下文标记上停留在4.2至4.6之间(表18)。
单一请求的解码吞吐量增加1.96×次,增至3.03×次,同时请求32次,增至1.89×次,增至2.75×次(表17)。

blocks.en: 5 Evaluations
blocks.zh: 5 评价

blocks.en: 5.1 Post-Trained Model Evaluations
blocks.zh: 5.1 培训后的示范评价

blocks.en: We evaluate Beam across software engineering, mathematics and science, tool use and search, and general capabilities. Section 7 presents the safety evaluations separately.
blocks.zh: 我们通过软件工程、数学和科学、工具的使用和搜索以及一般能力来评价Beam。 第7节分别介绍安全评价。

blocks.en:
We compare Beam to multiple open-weight models available at the time of announcement on October 16, 2026.
The results show the model’s strengths in coding and agentic tasks.
Beam advances the Western open-weight frontier. The model is competitive with larger open models like GLM 5.2 and approaches Qwen 3.8-Max on coding and agentic tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了Beam在2026年10月16日公布时提供的多个开放量级模型.
结果显示该模型在编码和代理任务方面的优势。
彬推进西部开放量产边疆. 该模型与GLM 5.2等较大的开放模型具有竞争力,并在编码和代理任务上接近Quen 3.8-Max.

blocks.en: Beam’s advantage lies in its token efficiency at inference time, even though frontier open models like Kimi K3 remain ahead on raw capability. This efficiency was learned through RL: we trained with a controllable length penalty that rewarded successful solutions while penalizing unnecessary output tokens beyond a per-effort budget. Figure 40 shows the effect on DeepSWE v1.1 evaluations over the course of training: the model first learns to solve the same tasks with fewer tokens, and as agentic capabilities grow, the additional tokens at higher reasoning efforts translate into higher performance.
blocks.zh: 尽管Kimi K3等前沿开放型号在原始能力方面仍然领先, 这种效率是通过RL学到的:我们用可控的长度惩罚来训练,奖励成功的解决方案,同时惩罚超出每个努力预算的不必要的产出符号. 图40显示了在培训过程中对DeepSWE v1.1评价的影响:模型首先学习用更少的符号解决相同的任务,随着代理能力的增长,更高推理努力中的额外符号转化为更高的性能.

blocks.en: Figure 40: Enhanced token efficiency through RL. DeepSWE pass@1 against mean output and tool tokens per episode; each curve is one RL checkpoint (darker is later), each point a reasoning effort from 64 to 512.
blocks.zh: 图40:通过RL提高符号效率. DeepSWE通过@1对每集平均输出和工具符号;每个曲线是1个RL检查点(darker是后来的),每个点都是从64到512的推理努力.

blocks.en:
We use published architecture specifications for the Nemotron, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, and DeepSeek models [ 130 , 131 , 132 , 133 , 134 ] .
For DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, we report 16B active parameters during decoding (8B during prefill) and a total of 748B, comprising the 552B backbone and 196B conditional memory [ 134 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们使用已公布的Nemotron、GLM、Kimi、Quen和DeepSeek模型的建筑规格[130、131、132、133、134]。
用于深搜索 V4.1 Flash,我们在解码时报告16B活性参数(预填时为8B),共计748B,包括552B主干线和196B有条件内存[134].

blocks.en: All evaluations were run using temperature of 0.7 0.7 , top- p p of 0.99 0.99 , and reasoning effort 512 512 .
blocks.zh: 所有评价都采用0.7 0.7的温度、0.99 0.99的p最高温度和512 512的推理能力。

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Agentic Coding and Terminal Use
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 代理编码和终端使用

blocks.en:
We assess software engineering with benchmarks that require repository inspection, code changes, and verification over multiple steps. Table 19 shows the results.
DeepSWE uses original engineering tasks [ 135 ] ; its v1.1 revision grades committed code in a clean environment [ 136 ] .
Terminal-Bench evaluates task completion in command-line environments [ 62 ] ; the results here use version 2.1 [ 137 ] .
SWE-Bench Pro evaluates long-horizon software engineering [ 138 , 139 ] .
We separately evaluate on the original 731-task public test split (v1), and on the 51-task HARD subset of its revised public release (v2).
The HARD subset contains tasks that at least two of five reference model families failed under Scale’s evaluation protocol, after ambiguous tasks were excluded.
SWE Atlas Codebase QnA evaluates code comprehension through technical questions that require running software and reasoning across multiple files [ 140 ] .
SWE-bench Multilingual evaluates software issue resolution across nine programming languages [ 141 ] .
SWE-bench Verified evaluates software issue resolution on a human-validated subset of SWE-bench [ 142 ] .

blocks.en: 5.2 Base Model Evaluations

blocks.en:
In this section, we present evaluation results of the Beam base model after pretraining and midtraining.
We compare it to the latest available base models at a similar size: DeepSeek V4 Pro Base, Nemotron 3 Ultra Base, MiMo-V2.5-Pro Base (as shown in Table 23 ).
Beam performs comparable to the baselines for commonsense, reasoning, and knowledge domains.
Beam is particularly strong in math, science, coding, SWE and terminal use capabilities, due to our emphasis on such domains for building a strong prior for agentic RL.
We note that the Beam base checkpoint does not have a chat template or official formatting available for tool calls.
For agentic SWE and Terminal, we allow the agent to write raw bash in a fenced block using our internal harness.
We find that MiMo is also able to use bash in this format while the other two baselines failed.
blocks.zh:

These evaluations are designed to ensure no possible cross-contamination with any publicly available data that went into Beam training. As shown, Beam outperforms other base models, even the larger DeepSeek V4 Pro and MiMo-V2.5-Pro.
blocks.zh: 图42:我们把Beam基础与其他基础模型相比较,我们制定的一系列内部基准涵盖多个领域。 这些评价旨在保证不会因接受Beam培训的任何公开数据而发生交叉污染。 如所示,Beam超越了其他基础模型,甚至更大的DeepSeek V4 Pro和MiMo-V2.5-Pro.

blocks.en:
Our in-house evaluations cover five capability areas.
First, logical understanding tests whether a model can read and reason over provided material.
This benchmark comprises multiple-choice questions that are answerable only from a supplied book passage or a piece of source code, as well as commonsense-reasoning questions scored by which answer the model finds most likely.
Second, Math & STEM combine multiple-choice science questions in biology, chemistry and physics, graduate-level science questions in the style of GPQA, and university-level math problems across different topics and difficulty levels.
Third, our internal coding benchmarks evaluate the ability of the model to add a code patch to an existing piece of code such that the unit tests pass.
This test set spans various languages including Python, Go, Java and Rust.
Fourth, SWE is a single-turn take on SWE-bench-style repository work (bug fixes, small features, refactors, build and test changes) across many languages, where the model’s edit is applied as a patch and must pass both the tests it should fix and the existing tests.
Fifth, Terminal consists of shell tasks, each in its own container, where the model writes a bash solution in one shot and hidden tests check the resulting state.
blocks.zh:
我们的内部评价涵盖五个能力领域。
首先,逻辑理解测试一个模型能否读取和理性超过所提供的材料.
这一基准包括只能从提供的书本段落或源代码中解答的多种选择问题,以及模型最有可能解答的常识推理问题。
第二,数学 & STEM将生物学,化学和物理学的多选择科学问题,GPQA风格的研究生级科学问题,以及跨不同主题和难度层次的大学级数学问题结合起来.
第三,我们的内部编码基准评价模型在现有代码中添加代码补丁的能力,使单位测试通过.
此测试集跨越多种语言,包括Python,Go,Java和Rust.
第四,SWE是对SWE-bench风格的寄存器工作(bug修正,小特性,重构,构建和测试更改)的单回合处理,该模型的编辑被作为补丁应用,必须同时通过它应该修复的测试和现有的测试.
第五,终端由弹壳任务组成,每个任务都在自己的容器中,模型在一个镜头中写一个bash溶液,隐藏测试检查结果状态.

blocks.en:
These evaluation sets have been curated via vendors and internal efforts using strictly data that would not be found in the pre and midtraining corpora (e.g., licensed private code repositories).
As such, we are confident they do not pose any contamination risk and provide a stable baseline to measure our training progress.
As seen in Figure 42 , the gap between Beam and other base models is more prominent in the held-out in-house evaluations, outperforming other base models, even the larger MiMo and DeepSeek V4 Pro baselines across the board.
blocks.zh:
这些成套评价是通过供应商和内部努力进行的,严格使用培训前和中层公司(例如,持有许可证的私人密码储存库)中找不到的数据。
因此,我们相信,它们不会造成任何污染风险,并为衡量我们的培训进展提供了稳定的基线。
如图42所示,Beam与其他基本模型之间的差距在搁置的内部评价中更为突出,表现优于其他基本模型,甚至更大的MiMo和DeepSeek V4 Pro总体基线。

blocks.en: 6 Infrastructure Approach
blocks.zh: 6. 基础设施办法

blocks.en: 6.1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 6.1 导言

blocks.en:
Training Beam required infrastructure that could sustain distributed model computation while supplying data, serving policy inference, and executing agent tasks at scale.
The workload changed across training stages: pretraining consumed materialized sequences, while RL coupled training with long-running rollouts, tool execution, and reward evaluation.
Our infrastructure combined GPU training and inference deployments with a multi-cluster sandbox fleet, allowing components with different resource requirements to scale independently.
blocks.zh:
培训Beam需要能够维持分布式模型计算,同时提供数据、服务于政策推论和大规模执行代理任务的基础设施。
各个培训阶段的工作量都发生了变化:预先培训消耗了实际的序列,而远程培训与长期推广、工具执行和奖励评价相结合。
我们的基础设施将GPU培训和推论部署与多集群沙盒机队相结合,使具有不同资源需求的组件能够独立规模化.

blocks.en:
Sustained progress depended on the interaction between model execution, workload placement, data delivery, and failure recovery.
We optimized the training path while building the structural process needed to validate changes, launch large jobs, and keep them running through hardware and software failures.
This chapter describes those shared mechanisms, their stage-specific configurations, and the performance and reliability measurements used to evaluate them.
blocks.zh:
持续的进展取决于模式执行、工作量安排、数据交付和故障回收之间的相互作用。
我们优化了培训路径,同时构建了验证变化,推出大型工作所需的结构过程,并不断通过硬件和软件故障运行.
本章介绍这些共享机制、其阶段性配置以及用于评价这些机制的性能和可靠性测量。

blocks.en: 6.2 Design Principles and System Architecture
blocks.zh: 6.2 设计原则和系统架构

blocks.en: 6.2.1 Design Principles
blocks.zh: 6.2.1 设计原则

blocks.en:
Four principles guided the infrastructure design. • Co-Design: Model design and infrastructure design shaped each other.
Kernel support influenced attention head dimensions, rack topology guided parallelism and placement, and memory optimizations reduced the cost of model execution.
We evaluated these choices together to preserve numerical behavior while improving performance on the available hardware. • Full-Stack Optimization: Training efficiency depends on the entire system working together.
Topology-aware scheduling, prefetched data loading, optimized kernels, and compute–communication overlap support efficient execution.
Asynchronous checkpointing and fast recovery preserve progress when failures occur.
We therefore considered execution performance alongside the time spent waiting, restarting, and repeating lost work. • Horizontal Scale: Training, policy inference, judge services, and sandbox execution have different resource and placement requirements.
Scaling each component independently allows capacity to follow those requirements, while multi-cluster sandbox placement extends execution across regions and providers.
Shared runtimes, image caching, and task-aware placement reduce repeated setup and data movement as the workload grows. • Operational Discipline: Sustained training requires a structural process for validating changes, preparing launches, and responding to failures.
Kernel correctness tests, numerical checks, release images, and reduced-scale launch validation establish readiness before committing the full cluster.
On-call coverage, structured handoffs, and a shared failure logbook support rapid diagnosis and carry operational knowledge across shifts during multi-week runs.
blocks.zh:
指导基础设施设计的有四项原则。 • 共同设计:模型设计和基础设施设计相互塑造。
内核支持影响了注意力头维,拉克地形指导平行主义和放置,内存优化降低了模型执行的成本.
我们共同评估了这些选择,以保持数字行为,同时改善现有硬件的性能。 • 全面优化: 培训效率取决于整个系统的合作。
Topology-aware 调度,预选数据加载,优化内核,和计算 - 通信重叠支持高效执行.
同步检查和快速恢复在出现故障时保持进展。
因此,我们考虑了执行业绩以及等待、重新开始和重复失去工作的时间。 • 水平尺度:培训、政策推论、法官服务和沙箱执行有不同的资源和安置要求。
独立扩大每个部分,使能力能够遵循这些要求,而多集群沙盒布置则将执行扩展到各区域和供应商。
共享运行时间、图像缓存和任务感知放置随着工作量增加,减少了重复设置和数据移动。 • 业务纪律: 持续的培训需要一个结构过程来验证变化,准备发射和应对失败.
内核正确性测试、数字检查、释放图像以及减少规模的发射验证在投入整个集群之前就已就绪。
在多星期的运行中,待命覆盖、分阶段的交割和共享的故障日志支持快速诊断和跨班操作知识。

blocks.en: 6.2.2 Training Components and Their Interactions
blocks.zh: 6.2.2 培训部分及其互动

blocks.en:
Our training infrastructure combines a shared distributed training engine with stage-specific data pipelines and training loops.
Pretraining, midtraining, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation use Unicron for model execution and parameter updates.
Their surrounding systems differ: pretraining and midtraining consume materialized training sequences, while RL and on-policy distillation use an asynchronous rollout and training path.
RL obtains its learning signal from reward evaluation; on-policy distillation uses teacher annotations of student-generated trajectories. Figure 43 shows where these paths converge on common training machinery.
blocks.zh:
我们的培训基础设施将共享的分布式培训引擎与特定阶段的数据管道和培训循环结合起来。
预训,中训,强化学习,以及政策提炼使用Unicron进行模型执行和参数更新.
它们周围的系统不同:预训和中训消耗了实际化的培训序列,而RL和在政策上蒸馏则使用同步推出和培训路径.
RL从奖励评价中获得其学习信号;关于政策的提炼使用学生产生的轨迹的教师说明. 图43显示这些途径与共同培训机制的趋同之处。

blocks.en:
Figure 43: Shared training machinery and stage-specific execution paths.
Pretraining and midtraining share a supervised training path; RL and on-policy distillation share asynchronous rollout infrastructure with different training objectives.
Judge services support selected RL tasks, while teacher annotation supplies the distillation targets.
Both paths supply microbatches and objectives to a common Unicron engine.
Supporting infrastructure spans both paths.
The diagram represents separate training configurations; policy-weight publication is specific to the online training path and is independent of durable checkpointing.
blocks.zh:
图43:共享培训机制和具体阶段的执行途径。
培训前和中期培训共享一个有监督的培训途径;RL和政策提炼共享一个具有不同培训目标的同步推出基础设施。
法官服务支持选定的RL任务,而教师注释则提供蒸馏目标.
两条路径都为通用的Unicron引擎提供微管和目标.
支助基础设施跨越两条道路。
该图代表了单独的培训配置;政策加权出版物是在线培训路径特有的,独立于持久的检查站。

blocks.en:
The training loops pass microbatches and a loss function through a common model-execution interface. Unicron supplies the transformer implementation, distributed forward and backward schedules, and communication required by the configured parallelism.
A common optimizer implementation performs gradient processing and parameter updates.
This separation allows model-execution and optimizer improvements to be reused across stages while preserving different learning objectives and orchestration requirements.
Sharing these implementations does not require identical parallelism, kernel selection, precision, or activation-recomputation settings; those choices are configured for each workload.
blocks.zh:
训练循环通过一个通用的模型执行界面,通过微管和丢失函数. Unicron提供变压器的实现,向前和向后分配时间表,以及配置的平行主义所需要的通信.
一个通用的优化器执行执行梯度处理和参数更新.
这种分离使得模型执行和优化器的改进可以跨阶段再利用,同时保留不同的学习目标和管弦乐要求.
分享这些执行并不需要相同的平行性、内核选择、精确度或激活-重构设置;这些选择是针对每一工作量的。

blocks.en:
Materialized sequences are read from storage, partitioned across training replicas, and prefetched to overlap data delivery with computation.
The loader preserves document boundaries and prepares token inputs, targets, and masks for the supervised objective.
The supervised training loop consumes these batches and invokes the shared engine.
Checkpointed input progress allows loading to resume alongside the restored model and optimizer state.
blocks.zh:
物化序列从存储读取,分解到训练复制品之间,并预留与计算重叠的数据发送.
装载器保存文件边界,并为受监督的目标准备象征性输入、目标和口罩。
受监督的训练循环消耗了这些批次并引用了共享引擎.
经检查的输入进度允许加载与恢复的模型一起恢复并优化状态.

blocks.en:
Rollout workers coordinate policy-inference requests and interactions with task environments.
Tool-using tasks execute in sandboxes, and selected RL tasks invoke an independently served judge.
On-policy distillation reuses rollout generation, weight synchronization, and router replay, adding teacher annotation and a full-vocabulary distillation loss ( Section 4.3.2 ).
Teacher servers return hidden states to rollout workers; the trainer fetches these targets and reconstructs teacher logits for the loss.
The distillation signal comes from teacher probabilities, without an external reward signal.
Sample finalization and batch preparation select, weight, and pack completed trajectories while preserving the sampling records needed by the learning objective.
The RL and distillation training loops consume the prepared batches and invoke the same execution engine with their configured losses.
Replay of recorded expert choices is integrated into this engine.
Updated policy weights are then published to serving instances, closing the asynchronous learning loop.
blocks.zh:
推出人员协调政策推论要求以及与任务环境的互动。
工具使用任务在沙盒中执行,选择的 RL 任务引用独立服务法官.
政策性蒸馏再利用推出生成,重量同步,路由器重放,增加教师注释和全省蒸馏损失(第4.3.2节).
教师服务器将隐藏的州归还给推开工人;教练员取出这些目标并重建教师日志以弥补损失.
蒸馏信号来自教师概率,没有外部奖励信号.
样本定稿和批量准备 选择、重量和包装完成的轨迹,同时保留学习目标所需的取样记录。
RL和蒸馏训练循环消耗了准备的批次,并用它们配置的亏损引用了相同的执行引擎.
重播记录的专家选择被整合到这个引擎中.
然后将更新的政策权重发布到服务实例,关闭同步学习循环.

blocks.en:
Both training paths used common checkpointing components to preserve model, optimizer, and stage-specific progress.
Their input-state representations and checkpoint schedules differ, while the underlying staging and storage mechanisms are reused.
Weight synchronization transfers updated policy weights from the trainer to inference without waiting for a durable checkpoint.
Shared metrics and tracing support diagnosis of model execution and training progress, while workload placement and node-health services support the training and serving fleets.
blocks.zh:
两种培训途径都使用共同的检查站组件来保存模型,优化器和阶段性进展.
它们的输入状态说明和检查站时间表不同,而基本的中转和储存机制被重新使用。
重量同步将更新的政策权重从训练员转移到推论,而不等待持久的检查站.
共享衡量尺度和追踪支持对模式执行和培训进展的诊断,而工作量安排和节点保健服务则支持培训和服务车队。

blocks.en: 6.3 Compute Fleet and Workload Placement
blocks.zh: 6.3 计算机队和工作量

blocks.en: 6.3.1 Compute Fleet and Deployment Footprint
blocks.zh: 6.3.1 计算舰队和部署足迹

blocks.en: Our infrastructure spans GPU deployments for model training and inference and a multi-cluster fleet for sandbox execution.
blocks.zh: 我们的基础设施涵盖GPU用于模型培训和推论的部署,以及用于沙盒执行的多集群机队。

blocks.en:
Table 24 summarizes the NVIDIA GB300 deployments.
Pretraining ran for 21.9 days.
The high-compute reinforcement learning (RL) campaign ran for about four weeks and generated over 100M rollouts.
The inference-to-training GPU ratio varied from 3.9:1 to 5.4:1, and the trainer was resized across five mesh configurations within the same training lineage without losing training state.
blocks.zh:
表24汇总了NVIDIA GB300的部署.
预训跑21.9天.
高密强化学习(RL)运动持续了约4周,产生了超过100M的推出.
推论对训练的GPU比例从3.9:1到5.4:1不等,训练员在同一训练类别内被调整了5个网格配置,而没有失去训练状态.

blocks.en: Table 24: NVIDIA GB300 GPU deployment footprint.
blocks.zh: 表24:NVIDIA GB300GPU部署足迹.

blocks.en: The sandbox fleet aggregated capacity across more than 20 clusters, two clouds, and four regions.
blocks.zh: 沙盒船队在20多个集群,2个云层,4个区域汇集了能力.

blocks.en: 6.3.2 Hardware Topology and Interconnects
blocks.zh: 6.3.2 硬件地形学和互联

blocks.en:
For training and core inference capacity, we used the standard NVL72 rack architecture with RoCE interconnects between racks.
Within each rack, NVLink and NVSwitch connect the GPUs, providing 1.8 TB/s of bidirectional bandwidth per GPU in the 72-GPU domain [ 157 ] .
Across racks, RoCE provides inter-node communication, with 4 SuperNICs per tray providing 400 Gbps per GPU.
blocks.zh:
对于培训和核心推论能力,我们使用了标准NVL72架式架构,与架式间RoCE互联.
在每个架内,NVLink和NVSwitch连接GPU,在72-GPU域内每GPU提供1.8 TB/s双向带宽[157].
跨架,ROCE提供节点间通信,每盘4个SuperNIC提供每GPU400Gbps.

blocks.en: 6.3.3 Topology-Aware Placement and Spare Capacity
blocks.zh: 6.3.3 地形学-智能定位和备用能力

blocks.en:
Our topology-aware placement aligns tensor parallelism (TP) and expert parallelism (EP) with rack boundaries to use the high-bandwidth NVLink interconnect.
We allocate 16 of the 18 nodes in each NVL72 rack, using 64 of its 72 installed GPUs.
This allocation serves four purposes: • Uniformity: A consistent allocation per rack simplifies resource management. • Fault Resilience: Leaving spare capacity allows a rack to remain eligible when some nodes fail or require maintenance. • Quality of Service: Node grades guide selection of the 16 highest-performing nodes in each rack. • Resource Efficiency: The remaining two nodes act as warm spares, hosting lower-priority workloads with flexible topology requirements while remaining available for primary-job recovery.
blocks.zh:
我们的地貌意识定位将拉伸平行主义(TP)和专家平行主义(EP)与架边结合,使用高带宽的NVLink互联.
我们利用每个NVL72架中的64个安装的GPU,在18个节点中分配16个.
· 统一性:每个架子一致分配,简化资源管理。 • 支助 故障复原力 : 离开备用能力,在一些节点故障或需要维护时,可以保持机架合格. • 服务质量:节点等级指导在每个节点选择16个表现最高的节点。 • 资源使用效率:其余两个节点充当暖气备用,承担较低优先的工作量,具有灵活的地形要求,但仍可用于恢复初级工作。

blocks.en: Uniformity: A consistent allocation per rack simplifies resource management.
blocks.zh: 统一性:每个架子一致分配,简化资源管理.

blocks.en: Fault Resilience: Leaving spare capacity allows a rack to remain eligible when some nodes fail or require maintenance.
blocks.zh: 故障应变能力:当一些节点故障或需要维护时,离开备用能力可以保持机架合格.

blocks.en: Quality of Service: Node grades guide selection of the 16 highest-performing nodes in each rack.
blocks.zh: 服务质量: 节点分数指导每个节点选择16个表现最高的节点.

blocks.en: Resource Efficiency: The remaining two nodes act as warm spares, hosting lower-priority workloads with flexible topology requirements while remaining available for primary-job recovery.
blocks.zh: 资源效率: 其余两个节点作为温室备用,承担较低优先的工作量,具有灵活的地形要求,同时仍然可供初级工作恢复。

blocks.en: 6.3.4 GPU Scheduling with Internal Scheduler
blocks.zh: 6.3.4 GPU (英语). 带有内部调度器的排程

blocks.en:
We developed a custom Kubernetes -based scheduler [ 158 ] to manage workload priorities and topology requirements.
Its hierarchical queuing and quota system defines a strict total order of workloads that determines their resource entitlement.
Each workload specifies a power-of-two allocation-unit size (e.g., 1, 2, 4, 8, or 16 machines), the number of units required, and a minimum node health grade.
The scheduler places workloads according to this order, preempting or migrating lower-priority jobs as needed.
blocks.zh:
我们开发了一个基于Kubernetes的定制调度器[158],以管理工作量优先事项和地形要求。
它的分级排队和配额制度规定了严格的总工作量顺序,以确定其应享资源。
每项工作量都规定两个分配单位的功率大小(如1、2、4、8或16台机器)、所需单位数目以及最低节点健康等级。
排班员根据这一顺序安排工作量,根据需要先发制人或移徙低优先工作。

blocks.en: The scheduler also supports proactive node warming and in-place restarts to reduce recovery time after hardware failures ( Section 6.7.6 ).
blocks.zh: 调度器还支持主动节点变暖和就地重启,以减少硬件故障后的恢复时间(第6.7.6节).

blocks.en: 6.4 Efficient Model Execution
blocks.zh: 6.4 高效模式执行

blocks.en: Our training stack combines distributed execution, optimized kernels, and independently scaled serving services.
blocks.zh: 我们的训练堆结合了分布式执行,优化内核,独立规模化的服务.

blocks.en: 6.4.1 Training Framework and Parallelism
blocks.zh: 6.4.1 训练框架和平行性

blocks.en:
Unicron is our in-house LLM training framework, originally bootstrapped from Megatron-LM [ 159 ] .
It provides distributed training, transformer modules, and optimized kernels, with parallelism configured for each workload.
We use the Parallel Folding approach from Megatron-Core [ 160 ] to give attention and mixture-of-experts (MoE) blocks different sharding schemes.
blocks.zh:
Unicron是我们内部的LLM训练框架, 最初是从Megatron-LM[159]中脱落的.
它提供分布式培训,变压器模块,并优化内核,为每个工作量配置平行性.
我们使用威震天-核心的平行折叠方法[160]来关注和混合专家(MoE)阻断不同的磨损方案。

blocks.en:
The attention mesh combines tensor parallelism (TP), context parallelism (CP), and data parallelism (DP).
The MoE mesh combines expert tensor parallelism (ETP), expert parallelism (EP), and expert data parallelism (EDP).
Pipeline parallelism (PP) applies to both meshes; sequence parallelism (SP) distributes sequence activations.
blocks.zh:
注意力网结合了拉伸平行主义(TP),上下文平行主义(CP),和数据平行主义(DP).
教育部的网络结合了专家的拉诺平行主义(ETP),专家的平行主义(EP)和专家的数据平行主义(EDP).
管道平行主义(PP)适用于两个中间体;序列平行主义(SP)分布序列激活.

blocks.en: The pretraining configuration kept attention and expert sharding within the NVLink domain.
blocks.zh: 预训配置在NVLink域内保持了注意力和专家硬化.

blocks.en: 6.4.2 Training Data Loading
blocks.zh: 6.4.2 培训数据装载

blocks.en:
Our data loader reads materialized training sequences produced by the offline pipeline described in Section 2.2.5 .
The loading path supplies distributed training with prefetched batches while preserving document boundaries and recording progress for restart.
blocks.zh:
我们的数据装载机读取了第2.2.5节所述离线输油管产生的实成化训练序列。
装入路径供应在保存文件边界和记录重启进度的同时,以预留的批次分发培训。

blocks.en:
Materialized datasets are stored durably in GCS and copied to cluster-local NFS for production runs.
We used ArrayRecord files [ 161 ] containing protobuf records with pre-tokenized IDs, document segment IDs, provenance spans, byte counts, and loss masks. ArrayRecord supports parallel reads and random access by record index, allowing the loader to retrieve specific examples without scanning preceding records.
blocks.zh:
物质化数据集长期储存在GCS中,并复制到集群-局部NFS进行生产运行.
我们使用Array Record文件 [161] 包含原生生物记录, 并有预存的ID,文件片段ID, 出处跨度,字节计数,和损失口罩。 矩阵记录支持并行读取和通过记录索引随机访问,允许加载器在不扫描之前的记录的情况下检索特定实例.

blocks.en:
We used Grain ’s ArrayRecord integration [ 162 ] for indexed loading, distributed partitioning, batching, and prefetching.
Our configuration uses 16 prefetch threads and a buffer of 500 elements to overlap data reads with training.
Batch sizes count packed training sequences; each sequence can contain tokens from multiple documents.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Grain的矩阵记录集成 [162] 来进行索引加载、分配、分批和预选。
我们的配置使用16条预切线程和500个元素的缓冲器来与读取的数据与训练重叠.
批量大小计算了打包的训练序列;每个序列可以包含来自多个文档的符号.

blocks.en:
The loader converts stored segment IDs into cumulative sequence lengths that identify document boundaries.
Attention kernels use these boundaries to apply causal attention independently within each document, preventing attention across document boundaries ( Packing , Section 2.2.5 ).
blocks.zh:
加载器将存储的片段ID转换成可识别文件边界的累积序列长度.
注意内核使用这些边界在每份文件中独立应用因果注意,防止跨越文件边界的注意(Packing,第2.2.5节).

blocks.en:
For long-context training with CP, we applied zigzag partitioning within each packed document.
After alignment padding, each document is divided into 2 ​ C 2C equal chunks, where C C is the CP size.
Rank r r receives chunks r r and 2 ​ C − 1 − r 2C-1-r , pairing early and late portions of the document to balance causal-attention work across ranks.
blocks.zh:
在CP的长文本训练中,我们在每个装箱的文档中采用了zigzag分区。
在对齐补丁后,每个文档被分为2个C2C等块,其中C为CP大小.
r级得到r和2 C− 1 − r 2C-1-r,对文件的早期和晚期部分进行配对,以平衡各级的因果工作。

blocks.en:
Alongside model and optimizer state, checkpoints record the data loader’s completed-step position ( Section 6.7.3 ).
Indexed access allows loading to resume from that position without scanning the already-consumed prefix.
blocks.zh:
除了模型和优化状态外,检查站记录数据装载器的完成步骤位置(第6.7.3节)。
索引访问允许加载从该位置恢复,而不扫描已经消耗的前缀.

blocks.en: 6.4.3 Kernel Selection and Compute Optimization
blocks.zh: 6.4.3 内核选择和计算优化

blocks.en:
We used open-source kernels to improve performance and reduce implementation time. HybridEP [ 115 , 163 ] handles all-to-all communication for MoE dispatch and combine, and FlashAttention-4 [ 40 ] handles attention computation.
We used torch.compile [ 108 ] to fuse memory-bound and element-wise operations, including z-loss computation, multiplication by router per-token probabilities and SwiGLU activation, and attention output gating.
We also fused the QKV attention projection and combine the MoE gate and up projections into a single matrix.
To prevent garbage collection from desynchronizing ranks and delaying communication collectives, we disabled automatic Python garbage collection with gc.disable() and run it on all ranks every 50 steps.
blocks.zh:
我们利用开源内核来提高性能,缩短执行时间. HybridEP [115,163] 处理教育部发送和组合的全程通信,FlashAttentent-4 [40] 处理注意力计算.
我们使用火炬.comple [108] 来引导内存和元素的操作,包括z-损失计算、路由器乘以每托起概率和SwiGLU激活,以及注意力输出Gating。
我们还将QKV的注意力投影整合起来,并将MOE门和预测增加成单一矩阵.
为了防止垃圾收集使排位脱同步和延迟通信集体,我们用 gc.disable () 禁用自动 Python 垃圾收集, 每50 步运行在所有排位上 。

blocks.en:
Kernel availability also informed the model architecture.
Earlier internal versions used a head dimension of 256, for which we identified a correctness issue in FlashAttention-4 during the Blackwell migration.
A head dimension of 128 had broader attention-kernel support and showed no quality loss in our experiments.
We adopted it for the final configuration, which also allowed experiments to resume faster.
blocks.zh:
核心可用性也为模型结构提供了信息。
早期的内部版本使用256头维,为此我们在FlashAttention-4中确定了布莱克韦尔迁徙期间的正确性问题.
128头的维度具有更广泛的关注内核支持,在我们的实验中没有显示质量损失.
我们把它作为最后的配置,这也使得实验能够更快地恢复.

blocks.en:
We limit temporary logit memory using loss-specific implementations.
Pretraining uses the Liger fused linear cross-entropy kernel [ 164 ] with a chunk size of 1,024.
RL computes tiled logits over recorded sampling nuclei; MOPD (multi-teacher on-policy distillation) retains the full vocabulary but evaluates reverse KL in token chunks with tiled reductions ( Section 4.3.2 ).
blocks.zh:
我们使用特定的损失执行来限制临时记录内存。
Pretraining使用Liger引信线性跨内核[164],块大小为1,024.
RL 计算在所记录的取样核体上的瓦片对数;MOPD(多教师政策蒸馏)保留了完整的词汇,但用瓦片减少值来评价符号块的KL反向(第4.3.2节)。

blocks.en: Pretraining did not require activation recomputation; long-context RL uses full activation recomputation to reduce memory usage by recalculating intermediate activations during backward ( Training service , Section 4.4.1 ).
blocks.zh: Pretrainment不需要激活重算;长文RL使用全激活重算,通过在后期重新计算中间激活来减少内存使用(Trainment service ,第4.4.1节).

blocks.en: 6.4.4 Compute–Communication Overlap
blocks.zh: 6.4.4 计算 - 通信 重叠

blocks.en:
We used Megatron ’s distributed optimizer [ 160 , 165 ] to shard optimizer states.
As in Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) [ 166 ] , it all-gathers model parameters during the forward pass and reduce-scatters gradients during the backward pass.
Parameters and gradients are communicated in fixed-size buckets, overlapping these collectives with computation.
blocks.zh:
我们用威震天的分布式优化器 [160,165] 来压缩优化状态。
如在Fully Sharded Data Affair (FSDP) [166]中,它在前传时全加法模型参数,在后传时减少散射梯度.
参数和梯度以固定大小的桶表示,与计算重叠。

blocks.en:
The TransformerEngine RMSNorm kernel [ 167 ] occupied enough streaming multiprocessors (SMs) to starve concurrent NCCL kernels [ 168 ] , creating communication bubbles.
We replaced it with the cuDNN implementation [ 169 ] , which was faster and left enough SMs for communication to proceed without reserving SMs away from compute.
This change reduced step time by 10% in the pretraining configuration.
blocks.zh:
TransformerEngine RMSNorm内核 [167] 占用了足够的流式多处理器(SM),使同时存在的NCCL内核饿死 [168],产生了通信泡.
我们用CUDNN执行[169]代替了它,这个执行速度更快,留下足够的SM可以进行通信,而不保留SM去计算.
这一变化在预训配置中将步骤时间减少了10%.

blocks.en: 6.4.5 Numerical Precision and Stability
blocks.zh: 6.4.5 数值精度和稳定性

blocks.en: Weights and activations primarily use BF16, with FP32 retained for numerically sensitive operations and parameters. We maintain FP32 master copies of model parameters and FP32 optimizer states. MoE combine operations and the entire residual stream are computed in FP32. MoE router weights remain in FP32 throughout training, and router logits are computed with an FP32 GEMM. During pretraining, midtraining, and SFT, we observed no instability from keeping the LM head in BF16 and therefore used BF16 for the final vocabulary projection. For RL and OPD, we used an FP32 LM head, which helped reduce trainer–inference mismatch.
blocks.zh: 重量和激活主要使用BF16,FP32保留用于数值敏感的操作和参数. 我们保留了FP32模型参数和FP32优化状态的母版. 教育部将业务合并,整个剩余流按FP32计算。 在整个培训期间,教育部的路由器重量仍保持在FP32,路由器记录器用FP32 GEMM计算。 在预训,中训,和SFT期间,我们观察到将LM头保留在BF16没有不稳定,因此使用BF16进行最终词汇预测. 对于RL和OPD,我们使用了FP32 LM头,这有助于减少教练-推论不匹配.

blocks.en: 6.4.6 Inference and Judge Execution
blocks.zh: 6.4.6 推论和法官执行

blocks.en:
Policy inference and judge services are provisioned independently of the trainer and sandbox fleet, allowing their capacity to scale separately.
Policy serving uses SGLang [ 114 ] instances with tensor, expert, and attention data parallelism.
Each GPU holds the attention state and key/value (KV) caches for its assigned requests, while expert layers exchange tokens across the instance.
Request routers assign new rollouts to the healthy attention rank with the fewest active requests and retain that assignment across tool-use turns to preserve cache locality.
The deployment footprint is given in Section 6.3.1 .
blocks.zh:
政策推论和判断服务独立于教练机和沙盒机队提供,使其能力能够单独规模化.
政策服务使用 SGLang [114] 例,有朗诺语,专家语,和注意力数据并行论.
每个GPU持有其指定请求的注意状态和密钥/值(KV)缓存,而专家层则在整个实例中交换令牌.
请求路由器为健康关注级别分配了新的推广,并且是活动请求最少的,并保留了跨工具使用范围的任务,以保留缓存位置。
部署足迹见第6.3.1节。

blocks.en:
The serving configuration caps running requests, with dispatch buffers and CUDA graph coverage sized to leave room for KV caches.
Admission reservations remain in place during tool-execution pauses.
A prefill delayer groups input processing into coordinated waves across ranks to reduce interference with decoding; prefills are chunked into 8,192 tokens per rank, with a maximum delay of 64 forward passes.
Cache isolation, memory allocation, and routing across policy updates are described in Policy Inference Service ( Section 4.4.1 ).
blocks.zh:
服务配置封顶运行请求,带有调度缓冲器和CUDA图形覆盖大小,为KV缓存留有空间.
在工具执行暂停期间,对接纳的保留仍然有效。
预填延迟器分组输入到跨等级的协调波处理,以减少对解码的干扰;预填每级被划分为8,192个令牌,最大延迟64个前传通行证.
政策推论处(第4.4.1节)介绍了缓存隔离、内存分配和贯穿政策更新的路径。

blocks.en:
Serving instances pull updated weights from trainer memory rather than through durable checkpoints.
Hierarchical multicast relays weights through serving peers to reduce trainer traffic, with direct trainer reads as a fallback.
Each instance pauses generation and verifies the transferred weights before adopting a version; exhausted verification retries fail the instance.
The transfer and verification protocol is described in Training service ( Section 4.4.1 ).
Serving failures can be repaired locally: failed pods are replaced on healthy nodes, and unhealthy routing targets are excluded.
If a rack lacks enough healthy nodes, the scheduler ( Section 6.3.4 ) relocates the affected inference gang.
Trainer or coordination failures require a job restart from a completed checkpoint, as described in Overview ( Section 4.4.1 ).
blocks.zh:
服务性事件从教练记忆中汲取更新的权重,而不是通过持久的检查站。
等级式多播中继通过服务同伴来减少教练员流量,直接教练员读作倒数.
每个实例都暂停生成,并在通过一个版本之前核查所转移的权重;穷尽的核查重试使实例失败。
转移和核查协议见培训处(第4.4.1节)。
服务故障可以在当地修复:故障舱在健康的节点上被替换,不健康的路由目标被排除在外.
如果一个架子缺乏足够健康的节点,排程器(6.3.4节)会迁移受影响的推论帮派.
如概览(第4.4.1节)所述,训练员或协调失败需要从一个已完成的检查站重新开始工作。

blocks.en:
Where enabled, a separately served, fixed judge model reviews rollouts that passed automated task checks and can veto a pass before its reward reaches training.
The judge endpoint scales independently and does not participate in policy weight updates.
Under fail-closed configuration, a request that still fails after retries fails the rollout, preventing an unreviewed pass from becoming a positive training reward.
The judge’s role among the shared RL services is described in Shared infrastructure services ( Section 4.4.1 ).
blocks.zh:
在允许的情况下,一个单独服务的固定法官模式审查通过自动任务检查的推出情况,并可在奖励达到培训之前否决通行证。
法官端点会独立衡量,不参与政策权重更新.
在失败闭塞配置下,在复试失败推出后仍然失败的请求,使得未经审查的通行证无法成为积极的训练奖励.
共享基础设施服务(第4.4.1节)中描述了法官在共享RL服务中的作用。

blocks.en: 6.5 Performance
blocks.zh: 6.5 实绩

blocks.en:
We use model FLOPs utilization (MFU) as a main measure of training execution performance.
We count model FLOPs only and exclude recomputation.
We approximate per-token training FLOPs as 6 × N a ​ c ​ t 6\times N_{act} , where N a ​ c ​ t N_{act} is the number of parameters activated per token, including the output projection but excluding the input embedding.
We omit attention-core FLOPs; in the pretraining configuration, these accounted for approximately 2% of total model FLOPs under our document-level masking scheme.
For the measurements reported here, we use 2,250 TFLOPs/s as the denominator, the per-GPU dense BF16 peak of the NVIDIA B300 Max-Q GPU.
blocks.zh:
我们使用FLOPs模型(MFU)作为培训执行绩效的主要衡量标准.
我们只计算FLOP模型,不包括重算.
我们将每节训练 FLOP 大致为 6 × N a c t 6\times NQXact},其中 N a c t NXXact} 是每个符号激活的参数数,包括输出投影,但不包括输入嵌入.
我们省略了注意核心的FLOP;在预训配置中,这些占我们文件级别遮掩方案下FLOP模型总数的约2%.
对于这里报告的测量,我们使用2,250 TFLOPs/s作为分母,即NVIDIA B300 Max-Q GPU的每GPU密度BF16峰值.

blocks.en:
Table 25 summarizes reported MFU measurements across training configurations.
The measurements use different aggregation windows, so the table distinguishes steady-state values, averages over executed steps, and reported medians.
The training optimizations brought pretraining steady-state MFU to 21%; restart warm-up reduced the average over executed steps to 18%.
blocks.zh:
表25汇总了报告的各种培训组合的微额供资计量。
测量使用不同的聚合窗口,因此表格区分了稳态值,执行步骤的平均值,以及报告的中位数.
培训优化后,培训前稳定状态的MFU达到21%;重新开始热身,将执行步骤的平均数减少到18%。

blocks.en:
Table 25: Reported model FLOPs utilization by training configuration.
Token accounting and included execution phases must be aligned before interpreting differences as execution-efficiency differences.
blocks.zh:
表25:按培训配置分列的报告的FLOP模型使用情况。
在将差异解释为执行效率差异之前,必须调整会计和包括的执行阶段。

blocks.en:
MFU describes model execution, while delivered throughput also depends on restart warm-up and the supply of training batches.
The pretraining example in Section 6.6 illustrates the cost of returning to steady-state performance after a restart.
For asynchronous post-training, delivered throughput also depends on the supply of completed rollouts to the trainer.
blocks.zh:
MFU描述了模式执行,而交付的吞吐量也取决于重新开始热身和提供训练批次.
第6.6节中的培训前例子说明了重新启动后恢复稳定状态的成本。
对于同步的后培训,输送的吞吐量还取决于向训练员提供已完成的推广。

blocks.en: 6.6 Goodput
blocks.zh: 6.6 古德普特语

blocks.en:
We use goodput as the main metric for job stability over the observation windows reported in Table 26 .
We define goodput as the ratio of wall-clock time spent on steps retained in the final training trajectory to the total wall-clock duration of the run.
Goodput thus measures the fraction of compute time spent on productive work, complementing MFU and offering a separate path to improving throughput.
The non-productive time consists of failure detection, job rescheduling, process group initialization, checkpoint loading, and progress lost when rolling back to the last checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
我们使用良好产出作为表26所报告的观察窗口工作稳定性的主要衡量标准。
我们把 " 良好 " 定义为在最后训练轨迹中保留的步骤上花在墙上的时间与跑步时间的总墙上时间的比例。
因此,Goodput衡量了用于生产性工作的计算时间的一小部分,补充了MFU,并提供了提高吞吐量的单独途径。
非生产性时间包括故障检测、重新安排工作、流程组初始化、检查站加载,以及返回最后一个检查站时损失的进展。

blocks.en: Table 26: Goodput measurements and observation windows.
blocks.zh: 表26:Goodput测量和观测窗口。

blocks.en:
Restored service, preserved work, and retained training progress measure different outcomes.
The Recovery outcomes in Section 6.7.1 establish whether useful execution resumed.
Consumed batches, optimizer updates, and work represented in the final checkpoint chain are distinct measures of progress.
Recovery success alone does not establish end-to-end retained-progress goodput.
Rollout prefetching and retries reduced data loss during faults, although they did not guarantee 100% rollout preservation.
For example, a large fault that took down several NVL72 racks during one high-compute agentic RL run lost ∼ \sim 7% of the groups in a batch.
We considered this loss acceptable given the size of the fault domain.
blocks.zh:
恢复服务、保留工作和保留培训进度衡量不同成果。
第6.7.1款的回收结果确定是否恢复有益的执行。
完成的批次、最优化的更新和在最后检查站链中体现的工作是衡量进展的明显尺度。
仅靠恢复成功并不能确定端到端保留进度的良好产出。
推出预留和重试降低了断层期间的数据损失,尽管它们没有保证100%的推出保存.
例如,在一次高计算代理RL运行中,一个大断层将几个NVL72的架子拆下,一个批次中丢失了\\sim 7%的组.
考虑到过失域的大小,我们认为这种损失是可以接受的。

blocks.en:
Figure 44: Example of productive-time and interruption accounting during the 21.9-day pretraining run on 6,144 GPUs.
The timeline illustrates how retained progress, recovery, and operational events contribute to the goodput measurement.
blocks.zh:
图44:在对6 144 GPU进行21.9天预训期间,生产性时间和中断核算的例子。
时间表说明了所保留的进展、恢复和业务活动如何有助于衡量良好产出。

blocks.en:
Figure 44 illustrates our tracking methodology across the 21.9-day pretraining run, separating productive training from interruptions and operational events and yielding the 77.0% goodput reported in Table 26 .
Operational events (when the cluster was used for other purposes) took 1.7 days, so the effective duration of the run was 20.2 days. During training, the job experienced 103 recoveries, and the median time to the first resumed step was 9.7 minutes: 5.5 minutes for failure detection, teardown, and rescheduling, and 4.2 minutes for trainer initialization.
A planned relaunch for the final 20% of the steps (the tailpatch) bundled the infrastructure fixes accumulated up to that point, boosting
goodput from 73.2% to 92.3%.
The improvement was a result of multiple changes cherry-picked onto the release branch ( Section 6.8.2 ), including tuning alerting thresholds, adjusting checkpointing frequency, and hardening hardware detection ( Section 6.7.2 ).
blocks.zh:
图44显示我们在整个21.9天培训前的跟踪方法,将生产性培训与中断和业务活动区分开来,并实现了表26中报告的77.0%的效益。
业务活动(在集群用于其他目的时)耗时1.7天,因此运行的有效时间为20.2天. 在培训期间,该工作有103次恢复,到恢复的第一步的中位时间为9.7分钟: 5.5分钟的故障检测,拆卸,以及重新安排,4.2分钟的教练启动.
计划重启 最终20%的台阶(尾巴) 捆绑 基础设施的修复 积累到这一点,
从73.2%到92.3%。
改进的原因是对发行分支(第6.8.2节)进行了多次更改,包括调整警报阈值、调整检查频率和硬化硬件检测(第6.7.2节)。

blocks.en:
This example also exhibits an overhead that retained-progress goodput alone does not capture.
After each restart, MFU recovered gradually, a phenomenon we termed as “MFU climb.”
Across recoveries, the median time to reach 90% of plateau MFU was 34 minutes, and 95% took 50 minutes.
Combined with initialization overhead, a typical restart cost roughly an hour end-to-end.
In 19 attempts, another crash occurred before the climb completed.
The climb was charged to average MFU rather than to goodput.
blocks.zh:
这一例子还表明,仅保留进度的好产出并不能反映间接费用。
每次重启后,MFU逐渐恢复,我们称之为“MFU攀升”。 “
在整个恢复过程中,达到90%的高原MFU的平均时间是34分钟,95%需要50分钟。
加上初始化的间接费用,典型的重新启动费用大约为1小时到1小时。
在19次尝试中,在登山完成前又发生了一起坠机事件.
攀登被记为一般的MFU而不是良好产出.

blocks.en: 6.6.1 Sandbox Architecture and Lifecycle
blocks.zh: 6.6.1 沙盒建筑和生命周期

blocks.en:
Our sandbox service provides disposable task environments for RL, evaluations, and synthetic data generation through a shared interface.
Three requirements shape its design: • Concurrency: The service must accommodate training-job rollout concurrency and task-dependent resource needs. Meeting this demand required capacity across locations and providers, as summarized in Section 6.3.1 . • Environment Diversity: Self-contained task images combine common operating-system and toolchain layers with task-specific dependencies and source code. Fetching these images consumes time, bandwidth, and disk space. • Rollout Latency: Sandbox acquisition, startup, and command execution affect rollout completion time. The service must limit delays from stragglers and transient failures.
blocks.zh:
我们的沙盒服务通过共享接口为RL、评价和合成数据生成提供可支配的任务环境。
• 货币:这项服务必须满足培训 -- -- 工作推出 -- -- 货币和依赖任务的资源需求。 如第6.3.1节所概述,满足各地点和提供者的这一需要的能力。 • 环境多样性:自成一体的任务图像将共同的操作系统和工具链层与特定任务依赖和源代码结合起来。 获取这些图像会消耗时间,带宽和磁盘空间. • 推出时间:沙盒的购置、启动和命令执行影响推出完成时间。 服务必须限制延误者与瞬间故障。

blocks.en: Concurrency: The service must accommodate training-job rollout concurrency and task-dependent resource needs. Meeting this demand required capacity across locations and providers, as summarized in Section 6.3.1 .
blocks.zh: 货币 : 这项服务必须满足培训 -- -- 工作推出 -- -- 货币和取决于任务的资源需求。 如第6.3.1节所概述,满足各地点和提供者的这一需要的能力。

blocks.en: Environment Diversity: Self-contained task images combine common operating-system and toolchain layers with task-specific dependencies and source code. Fetching these images consumes time, bandwidth, and disk space.
blocks.zh: 环境多样性:自成一体的任务图像将共同的操作系统和工具链层与特定任务依赖性和源代码相结合. 获取这些图像会消耗时间,带宽和磁盘空间.

blocks.en: Rollout Latency: Sandbox acquisition, startup, and command execution affect rollout completion time. The service must limit delays from stragglers and transient failures.
blocks.zh: 推出 Latency:Sandbox收购,启动,以及命令执行影响推出完成时间. 服务必须限制延误者与瞬间故障。

blocks.en:
Figure 45 shows the service architecture.
A stateless placement gateway routes requests to independent Kubernetes clusters according to load and routing policy.
Each sandbox is a Pod whose task image comes from a standard OCI registry, with lazy fetching to reduce startup cost.
A guest daemon inside the Pod handles setup and lifecycle operations and provides command execution and file access.
The create response identifies the sandbox and its owning endpoint; subsequent commands and deletion requests address that cluster directly.
Each sandbox-server replica handles lifecycle control and command proxying.
blocks.zh:
图45显示了服务架构。
根据负载和路由政策,一个无国籍的布置网关路线请求独立的库伯涅特集群.
每个沙盒是一个Pod,其任务图像来自标准的OCI注册,懒惰的采集以减少启动成本.
Pod内部的客人守护进程处理设置和生命周期操作,并提供命令执行和文件访问.
创建响应可以识别沙盒及其自有的终点;随后的命令和删除请求直接处理该集群.
每个沙盒-服务器复制件处理生命周期控制和命令代理.

blocks.en:
We initially used only gVisor [ 170 ] to isolate sandbox Pods.
As we onboarded more sophisticated tasks, including multi-container setups with Docker Compose [ 171 ] , a growing subset encountered Linux compatibility limitations and subtle behavioral bugs.
The affected workloads included high-priority external benchmarks.
We adopted Kata Containers [ 172 ] with Cloud Hypervisor [ 173 ] as a near drop-in replacement for this subset, providing microVM isolation with greater fidelity to Linux behavior.
blocks.zh:
我们最初只使用gvisor [170] 隔离沙盒Pods。
随着我们登上更复杂的任务,包括多克编曲的多容器设置[171],一个不断增长的子集遇到了Linux兼容性限制和微妙的行为错误.
受影响的工作量包括高度优先的外部基准。
我们用Cloud Hypervisor[173]的卡塔集装箱代替这个子集,提供微型 VM与Linux行为更加忠实的隔离.

blocks.en:
Figure 45: Sandbox architecture.
The stateless gateway places new sandboxes in an eligible cluster using routing policy and advertised capacity; its response identifies the sandbox and owning endpoint.
Each sandbox-server replica implements both lifecycle control and command proxying.
Pod and Node watches feed the capacity snapshots read by the gateway.
Commands and deletion address the owning cluster directly.
Each sandbox contains one task container with the daemon and task processes, isolated by gVisor or Kata Containers with Cloud Hypervisor (CH).
blocks.zh:
图45:沙盒建筑.
无国籍者网关利用路线政策和公布的能力将新的沙盒放置在一个合格的集群中;其反应确定沙盒并拥有终点。
每个沙盒-服务器的复制都同时执行生命周期控制和命令代理.
Pod和Node手表为网关读取的能力快照提供素材.
命令和删除直接处理自有集群。
每个沙盒包含一个任务容器,包含守护进程和任务过程,由gVisor或Kata容器与Cloud Hypervisor(CH)隔离.

blocks.en: 6.6.2 Multi-Cluster Sandbox Placement
blocks.zh: 6.6.2 多块沙盒放置

blocks.en:
The sandbox creation rate exceeds the practical capacity of a single Kubernetes control plane.
We therefore use clusters as units of scale, with an experimentally selected size range that stays within control-plane limits.
This also lets us aggregate capacity across cloud regions and providers.
Clients access the fleet through a single placement gateway.
blocks.zh:
沙盒的生成率超过了单个库伯涅茨控制平面的实际容量.
因此,我们使用集群作为规模单位,实验性地选择了在控制飞机限度内保持的大小范围。
这也使我们能够在云区和供应商之间汇集能力。
客户通过单一的放置网关进入机队.

blocks.en: Routing policy first selects the clusters allowed to receive a request: • Experimental Features: Features can be piloted on selected clusters, with explicit opt-in or routing of an identifiable task subset. • Workload Separation: Priority, task metadata, and request type assign high-priority “hero” jobs, training, vendor validation, and evaluations to different eligible cluster sets. • Maintenance and Failures: Membership updates, health checks, and temporary exclusions steer new creates away from draining or unhealthy clusters.
blocks.zh: 运行政策首先选择允许接收请求的集群: • 实验特征:特征可以在选定的集群上进行试验,并明确可识别任务子集的选入或路由. • 工作量分离:优先事项、任务元数据和请求类型为不同的合格组别指派高度优先的“英雄”工作、培训、供应商验证和评价。 • 维持和失败:成员更新、健康检查和临时排斥使新创造者远离排水或不健康的集群。

blocks.en: Experimental Features: Features can be piloted on selected clusters, with explicit opt-in or routing of an identifiable task subset.
blocks.zh: 实验性地物:地物可以在选定的集群上进行试验,可以明确选择一个可识别的任务子集或路径.

blocks.en: Workload Separation: Priority, task metadata, and request type assign high-priority “hero” jobs, training, vendor validation, and evaluations to different eligible cluster sets.
blocks.zh: 工作量分离:优先、任务元数据和请求类型为不同的合格组别分配高度优先的“英雄”工作、培训、供应商验证和评价。

blocks.en: Maintenance and Failures: Membership updates, health checks, and temporary exclusions steer new creates away from draining or unhealthy clusters.
blocks.zh: 维护与失败:成员更新、健康检查和临时排除使新创造者远离排水或不健康的集群。

blocks.en:
Within the eligible set, the gateway uses consistent hashing with bounded loads [ 174 ] .
A stable, client-provided key derived from image and task-instance identity gives repeated attempts a consistent cluster preference order.
Utilization and remaining-capacity bounds allow other eligible clusters to receive work when a preferred cluster becomes too loaded.
Repeated attempts at the same task therefore prefer the same clusters, preserving opportunities to reuse image content without requiring a cache inventory.
This does not establish a measured cache-hit improvement.
blocks.zh:
在符合条件的集内,网关使用一致的散列负载[174].
从图像和任务执行身份中得出的稳定、客户端提供的密钥使多次尝试具有一致的集群偏好顺序。
利用和剩余容量范围允许其他符合条件的集群在首选集群加载过量时接受工作.
因此,在同一任务中屡次尝试倾向于相同的集群,保留了重新使用图像内容的机会,而不需要缓存库存。
这并不能确定有分寸的缓存打击改进。

blocks.en:
Each cluster advertises its capabilities and capacity.
Its control plane watches Pod and Node changes to maintain live resource snapshots, which gateway replicas read periodically.
The destination cluster makes the final admission decision and can reject a request before creating a Pod.
The gateway can then try other clusters in preference order within the request deadline.
blocks.zh:
每个集群都宣传其能力。
其控制平面观看Pod和Node的修改以维持实时资源快照,它网关复制定期阅读.
目的地集群作出最终接纳决定,可以在创建Pod之前拒绝请求.
网关然后可以在请求的最后期限内按偏好顺序尝试其他集群.

blocks.en:
Capacity changes affect admission without rehashing keys; adding or removing a cluster changes the preference set.
Existing sandboxes remain in place.
To retire a cluster gracefully, we stop new placements and let its sandboxes finish before removing the underlying nodes or cluster.
blocks.zh:
容量变化影响录用,而不重放密钥;加入或删除集群会改变首选集.
现存沙盒仍保留.
为了优雅地退出一个集群,我们停止了新的布置,让它的沙盒在移除基本节点或集群之前完成.

blocks.en: 6.6.3 Image Delivery and Cache Reuse
blocks.zh: 6.6.3 图像传送和缓存重用

blocks.en: Serving diverse task images across the fleet makes image reuse and transfer efficiency important to both startup latency and command execution.
blocks.zh: 在整个机队中提供各种任务图像,使图像再利用和转移效率对启动时间和命令执行都很重要。

blocks.en:
We organize images around common layers so that nodes running different tasks have less distinct content to fetch.
Operating-system and toolchain layers are separated from task-specific dependencies and inputs, and compatible runtimes are combined into a polyglot base.
Task vendors receive the same bases, with frequently changing source code layered above stable dependencies.
A node-local agent periodically fetches and pins a curated set of common base images to reduce cold-start work.
blocks.zh:
我们围绕共同的图层来组织图像,这样运行不同任务的节点可以获取较少不同的内容.
操作系统层和工具链层从任务特定依赖和输入中分离出来,兼容的运行时间被合并为一个多块块基.
任务供应商得到同样的基础,经常改变源代码层在稳定的依赖之上。
节点本地代理定期获取和固定一组经过整理的常见基像,以减少冷启动工作.

blocks.en:
Cluster-level affinity follows the placement policy in Section 6.6.2 .
Within each cluster, Pod scheduling also prefers nodes based on image affinity.
Concentrating image use on fewer nodes can extend caching beyond common base layers and reduce network transfers.
blocks.zh:
第6.6.2节中的安置政策是集群一级的亲和。
在每组内,Pod调度也倾向于基于图像亲和性的节点.
将图像使用集中在较少的节点上,可以将缓存延伸到共同基层之外,并减少网络传输。

blocks.en:
We use the Nydus snapshotter [ 175 ] for lazy image loading.
Our conversion pipeline prepares images for Nydus offline, while clients continue to use their original image references.
Fetching content on demand reduces startup work compared with eagerly pulling entire images.
Some fetching can shift into command execution, but accessing only needed content can also reduce total I/O.
For context, DSec reports runtime access to 4.2%–13.3% of image data in its sampled container images [ 176 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们用Nydus快照机 来装入懒惰的图像
我们的转换管道为Nydus下线准备图像,同时客户端继续使用其原始图像参考.
与急切地拉动整个图像相比,按需获取内容会减少启动工作。
有些获取可以转向命令执行,但只访问需要的内容也可以减少I/O的总量.
关于上下文,DSec报告说,在其取样的容器图像中,有4.2%的图像数据进入运行时间[176]。

blocks.en: 6.6.4 Multi-Container Task Support
blocks.zh: 6.6.4 多集装箱 任务支助

blocks.en:
Some task harnesses use Docker [ 177 ] or Docker Compose to run multiple containers within a sandbox.
An agent container handles tool calls, while supporting containers host services the agent can interact with but should not modify directly.
This task-environment pattern, popularized by Harbor [ 63 ] , motivated our support for additional images alongside the base sandbox image containing the Docker daemon and tools.
It is distinct from allowing the agent itself to use Docker.
blocks.zh:
一些任务拉带使用Docker[177]或Docker Compose在沙盒内运行多个容器.
代理容器处理工具呼叫,同时支持集装箱主机服务,代理可以与但不应直接修改.
这种由港湾[63]普及的任务-环境模式促使我们支持在包含Docker守护进程和工具的底部沙盒图像之外增加图像。
它不同于允许代理本身使用Docker.

blocks.en:
Pulling these images inside each short-lived sandbox repeats network transfers and unpacking, prevents reuse across sandboxes, and requires registry access from the task environment.
A node-level cache alone cannot avoid this work if the nested runtime downloads and unpacks its own copies.
We instead expose image content from the node as read-only Kubernetes image volumes [ 178 ] , using the same caching and streaming mechanisms as the main task image.
Image metadata, including the default command, user, environment, and working directory, is supplied alongside the content.
An in-guest loader makes the mounted filesystem available to the sandbox’s containerd [ 179 ] as a ready-to-use base snapshot.
This removes the need for network access or registry credentials to fetch these additional images inside the sandbox.
blocks.zh:
在每一个短寿命的沙盒内拉动这些图像重复网络传输和解包,防止跨沙盒重复使用,并要求从任务环境获取登记册。
如果嵌套的运行时间下载并解开自己的副本,单靠节点级缓存无法避免这项工作.
我们把节点的图像内容曝光为只读的Kubernetes图像卷[178],使用与主要任务图像相同的缓存和流线机制.
图像元数据,包括默认命令、用户、环境和工作目录,与内容同时提供。
一艘客货装货机使装在沙盒的容器[179]可以使用装有文件的系统,作为随时可以使用的底片快照。
这可以消除网络访问或注册证书在沙盒内获取这些额外图像的需要.

blocks.en: 6.6.5 Controlled Network Access
blocks.zh: 6.6.5 受控网络接入

blocks.en:
Agents need network access to install dependencies and interact with services.
Unrestricted access can harm external systems through agent behavior or request volume and create opportunities for reward hacking.
Network policy is therefore enforced separately from runtime isolation.
blocks.zh:
代理商需要网络访问以安装依赖关系并与服务互动.
不受限制的访问可能通过代理行为或请求量来伤害外部系统,并创造奖励黑客的机会.
因此,网络政策与运行时间隔离分开执行。

blocks.en:
A per-sandbox component processes workload packets using gVisor ’s userspace network stack as a library and re-originates only traffic allowed by policy.
It can drop or reject connections with normal network semantics, independently of whether the sandbox uses gVisor or a microVM.
blocks.zh:
使用gVisor的用户空间网络堆栈处理工作量包,
它可以放下或拒绝与普通网络语义的连接,而不管沙盒是使用gVisor还是微VM.

blocks.en:
Policy can route package-registry requests to internal mirrors or selected snapshots, as well as allow or deny destinations.
Decisions use the destination, protocol, DNS context, and, where needed, TLS identity.
Allowed flows pass through HTTP CONNECT tunnels that carry sandbox identity and policy context to a shared cluster-level egress service.
This service provides routing, HTTP caching, and request logs attributed to each sandbox.
Mirrors and caching reduce dependence on external services, although some traffic still reaches them.
blocks.zh:
政策可以将软件包注册请求引导到内部镜像或选定的快照,以及允许或拒绝目的地.
决定使用目的地,协议,DNS上下文,必要时使用TLS身份.
允许流经HTTP CONNECT隧道,这些隧道将沙盒身份和政策背景带入共享的集群级互换服务.
此服务提供路由, HTTP 缓存, 并要求每个沙盒的日志 。
镜像和缓存减少了对外部服务的依赖,尽管一些交通仍然到达它们.

blocks.en:
To support TLS interception in our sandboxes, we installed our certificate authority in system and runtime-specific trust stores and configure common package managers to use it.
Applications with independent trust stores require additional integration, while strict certificate pinning remains incompatible with interception.
blocks.zh:
为了支持TLS在我们的沙盒中拦截,我们在系统中安装了我们的证书授权,并运行特定时间的信托商店,并配置通用的软件包管理器来使用.
拥有独立信托商店的应用程序需要额外的整合,而严格的证书标记仍然与拦截不符。

blocks.en: 6.7 Fault Recovery
blocks.zh: 6.7 错失回收

blocks.en: 6.7.1 Failure Modes and Recovery
blocks.zh: 6.7.1 失败模式和回收

blocks.en:
Failures can affect individual devices, nodes, racks, or the fleet, and surface as crashes or hangs.
Detection combines node-health checks ( Section 6.7.2 ) with errors and timeouts propagated through the training and inference processes ( Section 6.7.4 ).
blocks.zh:
故障可影响单个设备,节点,架子,或舰队,表面为坠机或吊机.
检测将节点健康检查(第6.7.2节)与通过培训和推论过程传播的错误和超时(第6.7.4节)。

blocks.en: Our operational experience includes the following failure modes and mitigations.
blocks.zh: 我们的业务经验包括下列故障模式和缓解措施。

blocks.en:
Several power events rendered the entire fleet unusable.
We also saw nodes crash and become unreachable with no prior signal.
Most of these node failures were attributed to power faults and promptly remediated by the provider.
blocks.zh:
几起动力事件使得整个舰队无法使用.
我们还看到节点坠毁,而且没有事先的信号无法到达。
这些节点故障大多是功率断层造成的,并由提供商迅速补救.

blocks.en:
NIC failures presented as job hangs rather than crashes.
Our training stack initially used NCCL 2.27, which had an upstream bug that prevented NIC failures from propagating as NCCL errors.
A fault that should have terminated the job instead left it stalled until the PyTorch watchdog killed it.
The issue was fixed in NCCL 2.28; we used a workaround in the interim.
blocks.zh:
NIC失败表现为任务悬浮而非崩溃.
我们的训练堆最初使用NCCL 2.27,它有一个上游bug,防止NIC故障作为NCCL错误传播.
一个本该终止这个工作的过失 却让它停滞不前 直到PyTorch的监视员杀了它
这个问题在NCCL 2.28中得到了确定;我们在此期间采用了一种变通办法。

blocks.en:
Managing workload identity across heterogeneous clusters and provider environments introduced operational challenges.
Workload identity credentials expired mid-run, crashing the job.
We added backoff and retry around the control-plane calls.
The fix missed the release branch cut and was cherry-picked during the run ( Section 6.6 ).
blocks.zh:
管理不同组群和提供者环境的工作量特性带来了业务挑战。
工作负荷身份证明在中途过期,工作崩溃.
我们增加了后退 并重试 围绕控制飞机的电话。
固定装置错过了释放分支的切开,并在运行过程中被摘取樱桃(第6.6节)。

blocks.en:
NVLink faults were mostly caused by NVSwitch failures, which were reported as XID 149.
NVLink outages and GPU HBM ECC errors also contributed to job failures.
blocks.zh:
NVLink断层多由NVSwitch故障导致,报告为XID 149.
NVLink断电和GPU HBM ECC错误也导致了工作失败.

blocks.en:
NFS latency and reachability against our VAST cluster degraded several times.
Two incidents were caused by upstream networking changes.
These issues were promptly fixed by our partners.
blocks.zh:
NFS相对于我们的VAST集群的耐久性和可达性多次退化.
上游网络变化造成两起事件。
我们的伙伴迅速确定了这些问题。

blocks.en: Stalls arose from stuck or zombie pods occupying nodes, NCCL hangs following NIC failures, and software issues. Figure 46 groups the failure categories.
blocks.zh: Stalls源于卡住或僵尸舱占据节点,NCCL在NIC故障后悬挂,以及软件问题. 图46 将失败类别分组。

blocks.en:
Figure 46: Duration-weighted average of reported pretraining and RL failure-category shares, using 21.9 and approximately 28 days, respectively.
These values summarize the stage-specific distributions; they are not pooled shares of failure events.
Fatal XIDs include uncorrectable ECCs; general node/system failures include PCIe, driver, and runtime issues.
Miscellaneous includes GPU configuration, firmware mismatch, storage, Ray retry/scheduling delays, integer overflow, and dataset issues.
blocks.zh:
图46:报告的预训和RL故障类别份额的持续加权平均数,分别使用21.9天和约28天。
这些数值概括了阶段特定的分布;它们不是失败事件的集合份额.
致命的XID包括无法校正的ECC;一般节点/系统故障包括PCIe,驱动程序,以及运行时间问题.
杂项包括GPU配置,固件不匹配,存储,Ray重试/排程延迟,整数溢出,以及数据集问题.

blocks.en:
Inference failures are handled by rescheduling affected serving pods on healthy nodes ( Section 6.7.4 ).
Trainer failures require a job-level restart ( Section 6.7.6 ).
Some inference failures required manual intervention to stop a repeatedly crashing SGLang serving instance or mark a node unhealthy when automation had not done so in time.
blocks.zh:
通过重新安排健康节点上受影响的服务舱处理推论失败(第6.7.4节)。
训练员的失败需要重新开始工作级别(第6.7.6节)。
有些推论失败需要人工干预,以阻止一再崩溃的SGLang服务实例,或者在自动化未能及时做到的情况下标记一个不健康节点。

blocks.en:
Of 99 recorded failures in the high-compute agentic RL deployment, 89 (89.9%) were resolved automatically.
In two cases (2.0%), automatic recovery failed and manual intervention restored service.
Another seven automatic recovery attempts (7.1%) were interrupted.
In one case (1.0%), service was restored, but the record did not establish whether recovery was automatic or manual.
These percentages describe recovery outcomes for the recorded failures; they do not measure availability or failure frequency.
blocks.zh:
在记录的99次高计算剂RL部署失败中,89次(89.9%)自动得到解决。
在两种情况下(2.0%),自动恢复失败,恢复人工干预服务。
另有7次自动回收尝试(7.1%)被中断。
在一个案例中(1.0%)恢复了服务,但记录并未确定恢复是自动的还是人工的。
这些百分比说明记录的故障的回收结果;它们不衡量可用或故障频率。

blocks.en:
The scope of recovery determines what must resume: local serving repair can restore capacity without restarting the trainer, whereas a coordinated restart must restore state and resume training. Figure 47 illustrates these recovery boundaries with two measured cases from the RL deployment.
For the local serving repair, recovery ends at the first completed inference request after repair, excluding health checks; for the coordinated restart, it ends at the first completed training step after restart.
In a local serving repair, 41.5% of the interval preceded restart, 52.0% covered restart to passing health checks, and 6.5% covered passing health checks to an ordinary request; the trainer remained in its attempt.
In a coordinated restart, checkpoint restoration occupied only 11.8% of the failure-to-completed-step interval, leaving 88.2% after restore, so restoring state was an intermediate milestone rather than restored training service.
blocks.zh:
恢复的范围决定了必须恢复什么:当地服务修理可以恢复能力而不重新启动教练,而协调的重新启动必须恢复状态并恢复培训。 图47说明了这些复原界限,其中两个是经过衡量的RL部署案例。
就当地服务修理而言,修复后第一次完成推断请求的恢复即告结束,不包括健康检查;就协调重新启动而言,恢复在重新启动后第一个完成培训阶段结束。
在一次当地服务维修中,41.5%的间隔时间在重新启动之前,52.0%的间隔时间为恢复通过健康检查,6.5%的间隔时间为普通要求通过健康检查;培训人员仍在尝试中。
在协调重启中,检查站恢复只占用了11.8%的未完成的步态间隔,在恢复后留下88.2%,因此恢复状态是一个中间里程碑,而不是恢复培训服务.

blocks.en:
Figure 47: Recovery intervals normalized independently to 100%.
Left: a local serving-instance repair ending at an ordinary completed request.
Right: a coordinated job restart ending at its first completed trainer step.
Phase widths are relative to each case’s own interval; the two bars do not compare absolute duration or imply representative recovery percentiles.
blocks.zh:
图47:恢复间隔独立恢复正常,达到100%。
左侧:以普通完成的请求结束的局部服务维护.
右:协调工作重新开始,结束于其第一个完成的教练步骤.
相位宽度与每个案例本身的间隔是相对的;这两个条并不比较绝对持续时间,也不表示具有代表性的回收百分位数。

blocks.en: 6.7.2 Node Health, Repair, and Certification
blocks.zh: 6.7.2 节点保健、维修和认证

blocks.en:
Our compute fleet spans multiple clusters with thousands of GPUs.
Managing a fleet of this scale requires a dedicated pipeline for node drains and repairs ( node-problem-detector [ 180 ] , Meta’s GCM [ 181 ] , NVIDIA’s NVSentinel [ 182 ] , Lepton AI’s GPUd [ 183 ] ).
We built an in-house node lifecycle service that detects faults, removes unhealthy nodes from production, and certifies them before they return after repair.
blocks.zh:
我们的计算舰队 跨越多个集群 与数千GPU。
管理如此规模的车队需要一条用于节点排水和修理的专用管道(节点-问题-探测器[180],Meta的GCM [181],NVIDIA的NVSentinel [182],Lepton AI的GPUd [183]).
我们建立了一个内部节点生命周期服务,检测断层,从生产中去除不健康的节点,并在修复后返回之前对其进行认证。

blocks.en:
A Kubernetes DaemonSet runs on every GPU node and performs passive health checks without disturbing running workloads.
A failure in any passive check marks the node unhealthy in Kubernetes , preventing new jobs from being scheduled on it until it is repaired.
blocks.zh:
Kubernetes 守护进程 设置在每一个GPU节点上运行,并进行被动健康检查而不会扰乱运行工作量.
任何被动检查的失败都标志着Kubernetes的节点不健康,使得新的工作无法安排在节点上直到修复为止。

blocks.en:
A separate system picks up unhealthy nodes and attempts repair.
Depending on the fault, repair ranges from a software reboot to a power cycle or vendor handoff.
We apply a two-strike policy per health check to identify repeat offenders.
blocks.zh:
一个单独的系统可以接收不健康的节点并尝试修复.
视故障而定,修复范围从软件重启到动力循环或供应商交接.
我们实行每次健康检查的两次打击政策,以查明惯犯。

blocks.en:
Any node reintroduced after repair or added during cluster bring-up must pass a 2 to 2.5 hour acceptance test that stresses the GPUs, CPU, and interconnect.
For GB300 clusters, we also run rack-level tests as part of cluster acceptance.
blocks.zh:
任何在修复后重新出现的节点,或在集群提升过程中添加的节点,都必须通过2至2.5小时的接受测试,以强调GPU,CPU和互联.
对于GB300集群,作为集群接受的一部分,我们还进行机架级测试.

blocks.en: 6.7.3 Asynchronous Checkpointing
blocks.zh: 6.7.3 同步检查

blocks.en:
Frequent checkpointing reduces the progress lost after a failure, but serialization, memory copies, and storage I/O can interrupt training.
We use a common asynchronous checkpointing pipeline across training stages.
It overlaps checkpoint creation with subsequent training steps with negligible overhead on training, allowing us to checkpoint as frequently as the underlying storage and network bandwidth permit.
blocks.zh:
频繁的检查会减少失败后失去的进展,但序列化,内存复制,存储I/O可以中断训练.
我们使用一个共同的同步检查管道 跨越训练阶段。
